gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba na gnas pa'i phur pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bton ① nas/ blos rang gi lag pa'i rdo rje la bstems te/ phur bu'i khung bu tshon lngas bkang la mnyam par byas te/dril bu'i sgra dang rdo rje'i glus mtshan ma ngan pa bsal bar bya'o/ /chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste/ /sems can rnams ni rab grol mdzad/ /rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ /zhes pas chos dbyengs rnam par dag par mos nas/ dang por nang gi dkyil 'khor du 'dug ste—/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan zhing g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ oṃ badz+ra ra ga sa ma ya/ oṃ 26hūṃ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes pa brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi nang du shar du phyogs par 'dug pas dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas brtsams te g.yas skor zudu tshon dgye bar bya'o/ /phyi nas slob dpon nam ri mo mkhan la sogs pas ji ltar bde bar dgye bar bya'o/ / sbom du 4sgo yi nyi shu char/ /re khā yang dag drang bar bya/ /mnyam nyid drang la ma chad pa/ /ji ltar rigs par phan tshun gyi/ /bar gyi tshad ni nas tsam ste/ /'og dang steng ni ci mdzes bya/ /sgom por bkye na nad 'byung ngo / /pra mo yis ni nor rnams nyams/ /yon pa 3 yis ni rnam par sdang / /chad na bla ma slob ma 'chi/ /g.yas skor min par ༄ byebakye na ni/ /tshon rnams phur pas btab 3 par 'gyur/ /phur pas btab pa lduni dngos grub kyi rgyu yang ma yin pa'o/ /phan tshun 'dres na 9rigs chad tso 7par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑪ nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa/ tshon bkye ba la nyes pa gang / /de 39—94

nyid bsam sbyor med tū la'o/ /de nyid bsam bzang sbyor rnams la/ /sus kyang bar chad bya mi nus/ /dkyil 'khor ji lta ba de bzhin/ /ji srid du ni brtags pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar du'o/ /tshon gyi re khā rnams la yang rin chen du dkar po la sogs pa las byas pa'i thur ma la sogs pa'i ngo bor mos par bya'o—/ /'jug / dang 'byung las thig las dātshon/ /'goms pa'i sdig pas 'jigs pa yis/ /rdo rje shugs kyi ye shes kyis 3tshon gyi re khā yid kyis nam mkha' la bteg la/ oṃ badz+ra be gā gyekra ma hūṃ zhes brjod cing rtsa ba'i thig gi nang gi dkyil 'khor du bri ba'i phyir 'jug pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la dang por lha thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor la phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi spyi'i tshon gyi kha dog gi rim pa brjod par bya'o/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang / dbus kyi gtso bo'i kha dog gi go rims bzhin du phyi'i re khā nas brtsams te/ nang gi re khā'i bar du tshon lnga'i rtsig pa'i re khā'i kha dog go/ /phyogs dang dbus su lha gzhan dgod 7pa ni rgyas 'debs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog gi rim pas so/ /bsgom 7bya'i dkyil 'khor la rtsig pa lnga po 'di dag rin po che kha dog lnga las grub cing nas kyi bar tsam pa'o zhes pa ni kha cig go/ /rtsig pa 'di ni gcig pa nyid kyis 9rim gyis steng nas steng du kha dog lnga'i rin po che las byas pa'o zhes pa 9ni gzhan dag go/ /de la 'dod pa dang po la ni rin po che'i snam bu'i sa dmar po dang / do shal dang do shal phyed pa'i sa nag po'o/ /'dod pa gnyis pa la ni dang po'i kha dog gi rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi cha nyid rnam par bkra ba'i rin po che'i snam bu'o/ /yang na de la kha dog gzhan gyi rin po che las byas pa bkod pa'i rin po che'i snam bu'o/ /39—95

lnga pa'i kha dog gi rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi cha nyid dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa sna tshogs pa'i snam bu'am/ yang na de la mdog gzhan gyi rin po che las byas pa bkod pa'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa ⑫snam bu'o/ /phyogs gzhan brjod pa ni de'i steng du rin bo che'i snam bu dra ba'i snam bu lta bu'o/ /'dod pa gnyis ka la yang stegs bu ni shel lam gser gyi rang bzhin nam pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin nam/rin bo che gzhan yang rung ste ji ltar ma/dzes pa'o/ /rin po che'i shar bu dang mda' yab rnams ni dkar po'o/ /rin po che'i shar bu dang mda' yab dang /dar dpyangs 7kyi bar gyi sa gzhi ni sngon po ste/ nam mkha'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro / /de nyid kyi phyir bar gyi snam bu la mun pa'i snam bu zhes brjod do/ /gdung ni ji ltar mdzes par rin po che las byas pa ste/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i pa tra 'phro ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /rta babs kyi ka ba rnams ni rang rang gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha dog go/ /kyog rkye po'i nang gi bla res kyi 'og gi sa yang ste/ de ni rang gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha dog gi 'od kyis spras pa'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /rta rmig dang / ba ran dang / chu srin gye snam bu ni kha dog ji ltar mdzes par ro/ /'khor lo rnams ni gser gyi kha dog go/ /kha cig rin po che gzhan las kyang byas pa'o zhes so/ /ri dwags dang ri dwags mo ni gser gyi rang bzhin te/ rin po che gzhan gyis spras pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i ste ba ni nag po'o/ /kha cig tu gtso bo'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog go/ /dbus kyi ra gernams ni rang rang gi phyogs rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog go/ /de las gzhan pa rnams ni de'i glo dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog go/ /ra skye lnga ba la ni de las gzhan pa'i phyogs dang dbus 39—96

kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog ste ji ltar rigs par ro/ /phyogs gcig gi ra —1 thams cad kyang rang rang gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha dog kyang kha cig tu'o—/ /'khor lo'i dbang po'i bluzhal bzhi pa nyid la rang rang gi phyogs kyi zhal gyi mdog go zhes pa ni phyogs gzhan no/ /bum pa bzang po rnams ni gser las byas pa'o/ /dpag bsam gyi shing rnams ni de las gzhan pa'i shing bzang po lta bu'o/ /pad+ma'i lte ba ni ljang gu'o/ /ge sar ni ser po'o/ /'dab ma rnams ni kha dog sna tshogs pa'o/ /de'i sa gzhi ni dmar pos sha(shas che ba'i dkar po'o/ /chos 'byung gi cha'i re khā ni dkar po'o/ /khor yug gi phyogs la yang shel nyid yin na re khā dkar po'am gser nyid yin na ni ser po'o/ /rdo rje rnams dang de'i re khā nag po'o/ /gzhan rnams ni dkar po'am ser po'o zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i mdog ni ji ltar mdzes pa ste/ bsgom bya'i dkyil 'khor la 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' nas steng du 'og min gyi mtha'i bar du rdo rje'i ra ba gnas pa'i phyir dang / rlung la sogs pa rnams ni ji ltar rigs par kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phyir ro/ /'od zer rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i kha dog ste 'phro ba'i tshul lo/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/rdzogs sangs ye shes sku yin phyir/ /ngag dbang rdo rje'i rigs su brjod/ /chos sku'i rang bzhin dag pa la/ /'di yi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes pa'i rigs pas/ dkar po ser po de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni nag po nyid/ /rtsig pa'i tshon zhes gsungs so/ /gang gi tshe/ chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ni dkar/ /des na ngag dbang 'dir dkar nyid/ /ces gsungs pas/ gsung rdo rje dkar po gtso bor gyur pa de'i tshe ni tshon gyi re khā 39—97

dkar bo dang ser po dang ljang gu dang dkar po'o/ /kha sbyor du gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po nyid yin yang mi bskyod pa dang / lhan cig ro gcig pa nyid du bstan pa'i phyir/ nang gi rtsig pa nag po nyid do/ /gzhan du ni dkar po kho na yin te/ ji skad du/ gsung rdo rje gadzu bor gyur pa kha cig tu dkar po nyid du 'gyur ba'o zhes gsungs so/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi nang gi dkyil 'khor du yang zur thig gnyis gnyis kyis bcad pa'i phyogs bzhi'i sa gzhi rnams rang rang gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog go/ /bsgom bya'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi'i thig rnams de bzhin no/ /ka ba rnams kyang de bzhin te/ rang rang gi re'u mig gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan ma'i phreng bas mtshan pa'o1 / /gtso bo'i sa ni gtso bo'i mdog go/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma ni/ /bden bral ljang la dbang ldan nag /me dang rlung gi mtshams ni ser/ /phyogs rnams kyi ni dmar po'o/ /gtso bo'i snam bu la ni gtso bo'i mtshan ma'i phreng ba'o//re khā gzhan ni mdog dang sbom phra ji ltar mdzes pa'o/ /bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la ni thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po/ de'i rtsibs kyi bar rnams ni dmar po ste/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lte ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po'o/ /de'i rtsibs bar rnams ni dkar po ste/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lte ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sku'i 'khor lo ni dkar po'o/ /de'i rtsibs rnams kyi bar ni shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha dog go/ /mu khyud gsum ni go rims bzhin du rdo rje nag po dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / 'khor lo dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba'o / /phyi ngos nas brtsams te nang gi bar du ljang gu dang / dkar po dang /39—98

dmar bo dang / ser po dang / nag po'i kha dog gi re khā lnga'o/ /shar dang /byang dang / nub dang / lho dang / dbus kyi sa rnams dang / thog rnams kyi kha dog dkar po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang /nag po'o/ /gzhan ni re khā lnga dang / sa gzhi dang / thog rnams nag po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang bsres pa'i sngon po'i mdog go zhes zer ro/ /de bzhin du snga ma dang / phyi mar kha dog gi rim pa yongs su bsams nas rdul tshon dgye bar bya'o/ /de yang skal ba 3dang mi ldan pa 'dus wīn mtshan ma dang phyag rgya ji ltar rigs —par bri'o/ /skal ba dang mi ldan pa med na ni lha'i sgu bri bar bya zhing / bris sku'am—/ lugs ma'am/ 'bur du btod pa'am/ legs par 'dus byas pa gzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar klu'i blo'i zhabs kyis/ ji ltar nus pas dkyil 'khor du/ /sa bon dgod bya yang na ni/ /mtshan ma'am lha yi gzugs nyid de//lugs ma'am bzo byas dgod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phyag rgya bri ba ni mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las gsungs te/ mi nus na ni bris pa yi/ /phyag rgya'am mtshan ma dgod par bya'o/ /gang yang gsungs pa/ tshon nam yang na pir rnams kyis/ /bris pa rnams kyis rnam par spras/ /zhes so/ /dpal kha sbyor gye rgyud du yang / de ltar lugs ma dang / 'dus byas pa la sogs pa'i gzugs dang / mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /de'i phyir 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ lte bar bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zla ba ral gri sngo bsangs so/ /shar du zla ba la rnam par snang mdzad kyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'o/ /lhor nyi ma la rin chen 'byung 39—99

byed byedabyed —byed————byed———— ——— —byed————byed—————— ——— — —ldan gye rin po che ljang gu cha dgu pa'o/ /nub tu nyi ma la mgon po 'od dpag med kyi nga/d+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /byang du nyi ma la don yod grub pa'i ral gri ljang gu'o/ /mer zla ba la spyan ma'i mig 'bras nag po can gyi mig dkar po gnyis sprin la gnas pa'o/ /bden bral du zla ba la mā ma shī'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa ste rgyud du de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rlung du zla ba la gos dkar mo'i pad+ma dmar po kha bye ba yu ba dang rtsa ba dang bcas pa'o/ /dbang ldan du zla ba la sgrol 1ma'i ut+pa la mdog sngo ser ro/ /rnge la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi dang / shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas su cha chung gnyis gnyis spangs pa'i 'gram dag tu zla ba rnams la go rims bzhin du gzugs dang sgra dang /dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi me long dkar po dang / dri za'i pi wang sngon po dang / dri ser po'i dung dang /ro'i snod dmar po dang / ras sna tshogs dang / chos 'byung dkar po'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor nyi ma rnams la gshin rje mthar byed dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / pad+ma mthar byed dang bgegs mthar byed kyi go rims bzhin du rdo rje tho ba nag po dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang /pad+ma dmar po dang / rdo rje kha gyes pa sngon po'o/ /'dir zla ba dang nyi ma bcu dgu ni sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /mtshan ma thams cad ni 'od zer dang bcas pa rang rang gi phyogs su mgo bstan pa'o/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug ni mgo nub tu bstan pa'o/ /de ltar phyi ma rnams su yang ngo / /rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid la ni dbus su chu skyes dang zla ba la ni zhi ba'i rdo rje sngon po'o/ /kha cig ni sna tshogs rdo rje'o zhes so/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 39—100

dbus kyi 'od zer gyi thig zlum po la tshon gyis ri1re khā mi bya'o zhes so/ /zlum po'i thig gi phyi ngos su tshangs pa'i thig gi glo so sor cha chung bzhi dor nas bum pa cha chung bzhi pa ste/ bdud rtsis bkang ba'i gser gyi bum pa cha brgyad do zhes phyogs gcig go/ /gzhan ni rin po che'i rang bzhin rang gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog go zhes so/ /'di dang phyi ma rnams la dbus su nge bzhin gshegs pa gzhan pa'i mtshan ma dgod pa nizu/ de'i dbus thusu dbus kyi mtshan ma bri bar bya'o/ /bsdus pa'i rim par gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ dbus su nyi ma la mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje kha gyes pa rtse lnga pa in+d+ra m+bi la lta bu dang / reg bya rdo rje ma'i sna tshogs pa'i gos so/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rim pa dang po dang gnyis par gnas pa bcu gnyis po rnams kyi mtshan ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /rim pa gsum pa'i sgo'i 'gram gyi snam bu la tshangs pa'i thig nas cha chung bzhi dor bar g.yon du byams pa'i klu shing gi me tog gi bye'akhor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas su sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dkar po'o/ /lhor de bzhin du phyag na rdo rje'i dang / nam mkha'i 6snying po'i rdo rje dang / rin po che margata cha dgu pa'o/ /nub tu de bzhin du 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi pad+ma dmar po dang rdo rje'o/ /byang du de bzhin du sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / kun du bzang po'i ral gri dang rdo rje'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rim pa bzhin du gshin rje gshed la sogs pa rnams kyi rdo rje tho ba dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su go rims bzhin 39byed101

du mi g.yo ba dang / 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang /stobs po che rnams kyi ral gri dang / rdo rje dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rtadabyug pa nag po'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i rdo rje sngon po dang / gshin rje gshed kyi mtshan ma la sogs phyi ngos su'o/ /kha cig ni 'khor lo ser po zhes bya'o/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po'i rdo rje ni pad+ma mthar byed kyi mtshan ma las phyi ngos su'o/ /byams pa la sogs pa brgyad rnams kyi mtshan ma ni zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bcu ni nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /'dir nyi ma dang zla ba sum cu rtsa gcig ni sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /bum pa bri ba ni sngar bzhin no/ /kha spyor du gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su zla ba la rdo rje sems dpa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po'o/ /shar du zla ba la rnam par snang mdzad kyi 'khor lo'o/ /lhor nyi ma la rin chen 5dbang po'i rin chen no/ /nub tu nyi ma la snang ba mtha' yas kyi mda'o/ /byang du nyi ma la don yod grub pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /spyan ma'i sprin la gnas pa'i mig nyid do6/ /mā ma tī'i mda'o/ /gos dkar mo'i mda'o/ /sgrol ma'i ut+pa la dmar po'o/ /rim pa gnyis par shar du drag mo'i mda'o/ /lhor rdo rje gzugs ma'i rdo rje'o/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma'i ral gri'o/ /byang du rdo rje zhib mo'i til ཿ pa thung ngu'o/ /dpal ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin ma'i dbyug pa dkar ser ro/ /mer mkha' 'gro ma'i pad+ma dmar ser ro/ /bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma'i shat+ta'o //rlung du sa rdo rje ma'i bum pa dkar ljang ngo / /rim pa gsum par shar gyi phyogs su bzhad —ma'i rdo rje kha dog dmar po'o/ /lhor sgeg ma'i 'khar rnga'o / /39—102

nub tu glu ma'i 'khar rnga'o/ /byang du gar ma'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa ljang gu'o/ /dbang ldan du gling bu ma'i gling bu'o/ /mer pi wang ma'i pi wang ngo / /bden bral du mu kun+da ma'i mu kun+da'o2/ /rlung du rdza rnga ma'i rdza rnga'o/ /phyi'i snam bu'i mer me tog ma'i me tog gi phreng ba'o/ /bden bral du bdug spos ma'i spos phor ro / /rlung du mar me ma'i mar me'i mchod sdong ngo / /dbang ldan du dri ma'i dri'i dung chos so/ /shar du me long ma'i me long ngo / /lhor ro ma'i ro'i snod do//nub du reg bya ma'i gos sna tshogs so/ /byang du chos ma'i chos 'byung dkar po'o//shar la sogs pa'i sgor ni go rims bzhin du rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma dang / rdo rje be+egs sgog 2ma dang / rdo rje dril bu ma rnams ni rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje phreng ba'i bdag nyid kyi rdo rje be+egs sgrog dang / rdo rje dril bu ma rnams te nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /'dir brjod pa'i nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'i mtshan ma bdun las mtshan ma gzhan ni zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /nyi ma dang zla ba sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du thod pa rnams la gnas pa'o/ /bum pa bri ba ni snga ma bzhin te/ thig zlum po drug pa las phyi rol 4zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor la dbus dang / shar dang byang dang / nub dang / lho rnams su go rims bzhin du ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma mi zad ma dang / ro langs ma dang / gtum mo rnams kyi 5rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga rnams so/ /dbang ldan dang / me dang bden bral dang rlung rnams su seng ge mo dang stag mo dang / ce spyang mo ༄ snadang 'ug pa mo rnams kyi rdo rje be+egs kyu rnams so/ /shar 39—103

— —— — — — — —byed——byed——— — byed——— —————— — ——byed— byed— — — ——dang byang dang nub dang / lho'i sgo rnams su rgyal po'i dbang mo dang / gsal byed ma/ dang / 'jigs /byed ma dang / shaṃ po dz+re rnams kyi go rims bzhin du lag pa gnyis snyim pa kha bye ba dang / thal mo kha sbya/ra ba dang / snyim pa khrag be+es bkang ba dang / rdo rje thal rngo/ kha sbyar ba'i mje bo'i rtse mo gnyis sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis sbyar ba'o/ /'dir mtshan ma dang phyag rgya rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i sna tshos/sa pad+ma ni rim pa bzhin du/ seng ge dang mche ba can dkar po dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi phung po dang / ma te dang /sbrul gye dbang po brgyad kyi mjug ma dang / ro bzhi la gnas pa ste/ de ltar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la ni skal ba /dang mi ldan pa 'dus pa na bri bar mi bya'o / /gzhan du ni ngal bas 'jigs pa dang / yon bdag bsrus pa la dga' bas so/ /skal ba dang ldan pa rab tu dang bar bya ba'i don du ni yon bdag gi dbang las bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar phyi ma rnams la yang ji ltar 'byung ba bri ba dang mi bri bar rig par bya'o/ /phyi ngos kyi thig zlum po'i phyi 5ngos su bum pa bri'o/ /bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi kye'i rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po'o/ /shar dang lho la sogs pa dang / dbang ldan dang me la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la ni rim pa bzhin du rdo rje drag mo dang / rdo rje gzugs ma dang / 'dod chags rdo rje ma dang / rdo rje zhi ba mo dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / sgra rdo rje ma dang / sa rdo rje ma rnams kyi mda' dang / rdo rje dang ral gri dang / tal pa 39byed/0/

thung ngu dang / dbyug pa ser po dang / pad+ma dmar ser dang / shat+ta dang /bum pa dkar ljang ngo / /rim pa gnyis par dbang ldan dang me la sogs pa rnams su gling bu ma dang / pi wang ma dang / mu kun+da 1ma dang / rdza rnga ma rnams kyi gling bu dang / pi wang dang / rnga mu kun+da 2dang rdza rnga rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma dang /rdo rje be+egs sgrog ma dang / rdo rje dril bu ma rnams kyi rdo rje lcags kyu dang /rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje be+egs sgog dang / rdo rje dril bu rnams so/ /mtshan ma bcu bdun po 'di rnams ni thod pa dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs pa brgyad kyi ni thod pa'i 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /phyag gnyis pa dang bzhi pa la ni thod pa med do/ /phyag bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po'o/ /shar la sogs pa dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la go rī dang / tso rī dang / ro langs ma dang / za phod ma dang / spos ma 4dang / ri khrod ma dang / gtum mo dang / rab tu rmongs byed ma rnams kyi rim pa bzhin du mda' dang / rdo rje dang / thod pa khrag dang bcas pa la gnas pa'i rus sbal dang / tshil gyis bkang ba 5la gnas pa'i sbrul dang /shas bkang ba la gnas pa'i seng ge dang / khu ba dang bcas pa'i thod pa la gnas pa'i dge slong dang / khrag dang bcas pa'i thod pa la gnas pa'i stag dang chang gi snod rnams so/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i mtshams rnams su gling bu ma la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor stag gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma dang / seng ge'i gdong ma rnams 39—105

kyi rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje lcags sgog dang / rdo rje dril bu'o/ /mtshan ma bcu bdun po 'di rnams nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs pa brgyad kyi nyi ma'i 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma rnams so/ /dbus kyi 'od zer gyi phyi ngos su sngar bzhin du bum pa rnams so/ /bdag med ma'i 1dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba dang / shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma ༄ rnams la go rims bzhin du bdag med ma dang / rdo rje ma dang / dkar mo dang / chu ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang /rim pa gnyis par phyag bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor du brjod pa'i dkar mo la sogs pa rnams kyi rdo rje'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ni snga ma bzhin du'on / /rta gdong ma la sogs pa'i gri gug rnams so/ /mkha' spyod ma'i rdo rje ni rta gdong ma'i phyi ngos su'o/ /sa spyod ma'i rdo rje ni khye gdong ma'i phyi ngos su'o / /'dir gri gug bzhi ni nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /mtshan ma gzhan ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /phyi'i dkar mo la sogs pa bco brgyad po rnams kyi zla ba dang / nyi ma ni sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs pa brgyad med pa ni lhag ma lha mo bco lnga po rnams kyi zla ba la gri gug rnams so / /mkha' spyod ma'i mtshan ma ni dkar mo'i phyi ngos so/ /ro langs ma'i phyi ngos su sa spyod ma'o/ /de bzhin du ku ru kul+le'i dkyil 'khor la yang yin te/ khyad par ni zla ba la yu ba dang bcas pa'i at+pa la dmar po kha 'bus pa'i mda' yod pa'o/ /'dir lha mo bco lnga po rnams kyang ku ru kul+le'i 4bzhin du mdog dmar po'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dang po la sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba dang /39—106

shar la sogs pa dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la go rims bzhin du rdo rje bdud rtsi dang / zhi ba mo dang / 71zla ldan ma dang / ri bong can ma dang / zla dkyil ma dang / zla tshes ma dang / yid 'ong ma dang /yid tshom byed pa byernams kyi rdo rje'o/ /khyad par ni zla tshes ma'i zla ba cha gcig pa'o—/ /rim pa gnyis par dbang ldan la sogs pa rnams su me tog ma dang /bdug spos ma dang / mar me ma dang / dri chab ma rnams kyi me tog gi za ma tog dang / spos phor dang / mar me'i mchod sdong dang / dri'i dung chos rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i snam bu rnams su gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhi'i gling bu la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su khro gnyer rim par ldan dang / 'jigs sdigs dang / rta gzugs dang / tshogs kyi gtso bo rnams kyi rdo rje lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgog dang / dril bu rnams so/ /mtshan ma nyi shu rtsa gcig po 'di rnams ni zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /me tog ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis kyi zla ba'i 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /yang na dkyil 'khor pa thams cad la chos 'byung bri bar bya'o/ /'di nyid kho na zi bar bya'o zhes pa ni gzhan dag go/ /gzhan rdo rje bdud rtsi gsum gyi dkyil 'khor kyi mtshan ma rnams ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud du rig par bya'o/ /dgu'i bdag nyid can kye'i rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje sngon po kha gyes pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab mar zla ba rnams la go rims bzhin du dkar mo dang /chom rkun ma dang / ro langs ma dang / za phod ma dang / spos ma 4dang /ri khrod ma dang / gtum mo dang / g.yung mo rnams kyi gri gug dang / cang 39—107

te'u dang / rus sbal dang / sbrul dang / seng ge dang / dge slong dang /'khor lo dang / rdo rje rnams so/ /phyag bcu drug pa'i nyi ma la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ / hūṃthod pa dkar po zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ /phyi ngos kyi zlum po las phyi ngos su bum pa rnams so/ /sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar nyi ma la bcom ldan 'das ma sgyu ma chen po'i pad+ma'i snod do/ /shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma'i zla ba rnams la g.yas skor / du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / rin chen mkha' 'gro ma dang / pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dang / sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rdo rje dang / rin po che'i snye ma dang / sna tshogs chu skyes dang / ral gri'o/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma ni rdo rje sems dpa' la 'khyud nas gnas pas de'i mtshan ma tha dad du mi dgod do/ /dgu'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs chu skyes kyi lte bar nyi ma la cang te'u'o/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang lho dang dbang ldan dang me dang bden bral dang / rlung gi 'dab mar nyi ma rnams la sna tshogs sde ma dang / 'dod ma dang / sa 'og na gnas ma dang / legs bzangs ma dang / chang 'tshong ma dang / 'byung mo dang / phyag bzhi ma dang / nam mkha' la gnas ma rnams kyi gri gug rnams so/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor la dbus su rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi rdo rje'o/ /shar la sogs par g.yon skor du rdo rje dbyug pa dang / nyi ma me dang / rdo rje gtsug tor dang / rdo rje 'khyel pa rnams dang / me la sogs par g.yas skor du rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje dus dang / nag po chen po dang / rdo rje 39—108

bsdigs pa dang / gtsug tor dang / rdo rje sa 'og rnams kyi rdo rje tho ba dang /rdo rje dbyug pa dang / chu skyes dmar po dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang /lcags kyu dang / dgra sta dang / rtse gsum dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje'i gtun shing rnams te/ mtshan ma thams cad ni sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /yang na shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su g.yas skor du gshin rje mthar byed dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / pad+ma mthar byed dang / bgegs mthar byed rnams kyi rdo rje'i tho ba dang / rdo rjes ju1mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams 27su mi g.yo ba dang / 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang /dbyug pa sngon po dang / stobs po che rnams kyi ral gri dang / rdo rje dang /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po'o—/ /gshin rje gshed kyi mtshan ma las phyi ngos su gtsug tor 'khor lo can kyi rdo rje'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed kyi mtshan ma las phyi ngos su gnod mdzes kyi rdo rje'o/ /mtshan ma bcu gcig po 'di rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /yang na bgegs dgra'i rdo rje kha gyes pa'o/ /me la sogs pa rnams su 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang / stobs bo che dang / mi g.yo ba rnams kyi lcags kyu dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon bo dang / rtse gsum pa dang / ral gri'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor lo can gye 'khor lo ser po chen po'o/ /gzhan rnams kyi bshad ma thag pa snga ma bzhin no/ /yang na gshin rje gshed la sogs pa bzhi po rnams kyi rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / rdo rje dril bu rnams te/ gzhan 39—109

rnams kyi sna—bshad ma thag pa snga ma bzhin no/ /bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs chu skyes kyi lte bar gnas pa'i nyi ma la dpal bde mchog gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po kha gyes pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma dang / lā ma dang / dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can ma rnams kyi gri gug rnams so/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la pad+ma'i snod rnams so/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rtsibs nyi shu rtsa bzhi la rab tu gtum mo dang / gtum mig ma dang / 'od ldan ma dang / sna chen ma dang / dpa' bo'i blo can ma dang / mi'u thung ma dang / lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang / shing grib ma dang / sa srung (5 ma dang / 'jigs byed chen mo dang / rlung gi shugs can ma dang / chang 'thung ma dang / lha mo sngo bsangs ma dang / rab tu bzang mo dang / rta rna mo dang / bya gdong ma dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang / dum skyes ma dang / chang 'tshong ma dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma dang / rab tu dpa' mo dang / stobs can zumo dang / 'khor los 4sgyur ma dang / brtson 'grus chen mo rnams kyi gri gug go//gtso bo ma yin pa'i phyir dpa' bo rnams kyi mtshan ma ni 5mi bri'o/ /sgo rnams su khwa gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma rnams dang / mtshams su gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje pho nya mo dang / gshin rje mche ba mo dang / gshin rje 'joms ma 5rnams kyi sna tshogs chu skyes dang 7/ nyi ma rnams la gri gug go/ /'dir shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su g.yon skor 8du dang / me la sogs pa'i mtshams bye/su g.yas skor du mtshan ma dgod do/ /phyi ngos su zlum po'i zig las phyi rol gyi mtshams kyi char 39—110

bum pa rnams bri'o/ /de las gzhan pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa dang / rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mtshan ma ①rnams ni rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi phreng bar brjod do/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas thod 3༄pa'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes la nyi mar cang te'u'o ④/ /lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams kyi gri gug rnams te shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su g.yon skor sedang / me la sogs pa'i mtshams su g.yas skor phyero/ /de la 'khor lo nag po'i rtsibs kyi steng du phyogs kyi 'dab ma gel legs phreng can ma dang / thod pa can ma dang / 'jigs ma dang / mi thub ma rnams kyi'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la thod pa rnams so—/ /de nas rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la rtsibs brgyad dmar po la gnas pa'i chu skyes brgyad rnams la phyogs rnams su dge ba'i ske tsurags ma dang / gzugs can ma dang / rnam rgyal ma dang / 'od can ma rnams kyi'o/ /mtshams rnams su dus can ma dang / mtsho chen ma 1dang /byed ma dang / gsod trem rnams kyi'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba dmar po'o/ /rim pa gsum par rtsibs brgyad dkar po la gnas pa'i pad+ma 'dab tsortebargyad la phyogs su sgol ma dang / 'jigs mthong ma dang / legs mthong ma dang /thub dka' ma rnams kyi'o/ /mtshams rnams su dge ma dang / grib gnon ma dang / dus mtshan ma bla dang / grags chen ma rnams kyi'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba dkar po'o/ /sgo'i pad+ma rnams la mdzes ma dang / nor 'dzin ma dang /skal bzang mo dang / mthong ba yid 'ong ma rnams kyi'o/ /pad+ma nyi shu'i steng du nyi ma rnams la gri gug rnams so zhes gdams so/ /39—111

rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gye dbang phyug gi sna tshogs pad+ma dang /rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'o/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i re'u mig rnams la pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i kha ṭī ga rnams so/ /dbang ldan dang me la sogs pa'i re'u mig rnams ①la kha ṭī ga dang / lcags kyu dang / dgra sta dang /dbyug pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i re'u mig rnams la kha ṭī ga rnams kyi phyi ngos su rim pa bzhin du khar bsdus pa'i lag pa gnyis dang / snyim pa sbyar ba dang khrag gi snyim pa dang / gtun shing ngo / /kha ṭī ga la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'o/ /'od zer gyi khor yug gi phyi rol gyi shar phyogs su bdud rtsi'i thod pa gsum mo/ /byang du sgron ma'i thod pa gsum dang /nub du gtor ma'i thod pa gsum dang / sgor btung ba'i thod pa gsum dang /dbang ldan du snyems pa'i lag pa dang / dri'i snod do/ /mer ni pi wang dang /me tog gi za ma tog go/ /bden bral du sdogs mdzub kyi lag pa dang spos snod do—/ /rlung du thal mo dang mar me'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba'i khor yug gi phyi'i shar la sogs pa'i snam bu rnams la so sor bzhi bzhi dang sgo dang mtshams su brgyad de kha ṭī ga nyer bzhi'o/ /bdud rtsi'i thod pa la sogs pa ni mtsho skyes ma nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa kha gyes pa'o/ /shar dang lho la sogs pa'i ra'i 3rtsa ba rnams su rtag pa dang / rin chen dbang po dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa rnams kyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang / rin po che ljang gu cha dgu pa dang / pad+ma dmar po 39—112

— byed——————byed—— —————ke— — —— ——— ——— ——— —— ——'dab ma brgyad pa dang / ral gri ljang gu rnams so/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i me dang / bden bral la sogs pa'i grwar rdo rje tsartsi ka dang / rdo rje phag mo dang /rdo rje dbyangs can ma dang / dkar mo rnams kyi 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang ral gri'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba'o/ /de nas sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyogs so sor ra 1lnga'o/ /shar dang lho la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su tho ba gshin rje gshed dang / dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dang / pad+ma gshin rje gshed dang /ral gri gshin rje gshed rnams kyi rdo rje rtse mo nyi shu pas mtshan pa'i tho ba dang /dbyug pa dkar po dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / ral gri'o/ /'dir rtag pa dang / lha mo rnams kyi mtshan ma ni zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /gzhan gye ni nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'og tu ni sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams rnams su pad+ma la gnas pa'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /ra'i glo rnams su bum pa rnams so/ / rdo rje sgol ma'i dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba la rdo rje rtse dgu pa gser gye mdog can no/ /shar dang lho la sogs pa'i 'dab mar zla ba rnams la me tog sgrol ma dang / bdug sgos sgol ma dang / mar me sgrol ma dang /dri'i sgrol ma rnams kyi me tog gi phreng ba dang / spos phor dang / mar me'i kong —bu dang / dri'i dung chos rnams so/ /me la sogs nga/'i 'dab mar rtag pa dang / mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa'i rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri rnams so/ /shar dang lho la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma 6dang / rdo rje lcags sgog ma dang / rdo rje dril bu ma rnams kyi lcags kyu la 39—/ /3

sogs pa snga ma bzhin te/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i phyi ngos su gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la'o—/ /rdo rje lcags sgog ma'i phyi ngos su rdo rje gnod mdzes ma'i sbrul gyi zhags pa ste/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su pad+ma la tso7spyan ma dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang sgol ma rnams kyi rnam par dag pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi bum pa dang / ri rab dang me thab dang rgyal mtshan chen po'o/ /pad+ma'i phyi ngos su bum pa rnams so/ /'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi sna tshogs pad+mar nyi ma'am/zla ba la mda' ste mtshan mo zla ba la gnas shing nyin mo (sdenyi ma la gnas te lha mo rnam par rgyu'o/ /shar dang lho la sogs pa'i phyogs su arka ma sī zidang / marka ma sbo sadang / an+da ra dha na ma sī '-i/dang / te dzo ma sī'i ༄7lha mo rnams kyi go rims bzhin du khab dang skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang / a shwa ka'i yal ga dang mda' rnams so/ /me dang srin po la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su u da ya ma sbo 9dang / gube+e ma sī dang / ma na ma sī nyu dang / ṭī ba ra ma sbo shā1rnams kyi mtshan ma ni go rims bzhin du arka ma sī snyel sogs pa'i mtshan ma bzhin no/ /phyi'i pho brang gi snam bu'i shar du ma hā tsi 7ba ra ma sī dang / ba ra d+kuha mu kha'i wīlha mo dag gi rdo rje dang lcags kyu gnyis so/ /lho phyogs su lha mo pa dā kra ma sbo 1 dang / ba ra lī 7dag gi a sho ka'i 'dab ma gnyis so/ /nub tu lha mo pa ra kra ma sbo 19dang / ba da lī — dag gi mda' gnyis so/ /byang du lha mo urma ma sī dang / ba rā lbo nadag gi khab gnyis so/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su baṭ+wā lbo dang / bat+ta lī dang / ba rā khā — dang / ba rā ha mu khi rnams kyi khab 39—1 14

dang skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang a sho ka'i lo ma dang mda' rnams so/ /shar sgor lha mo a lo'i rdo rje be+egs kyu'o/ /lhor lha mo ta lo'i rdo rje zhags pa'o/ /nub du lha mo ka lo'i rdo rje lcags sgrog go/ /byang du lha mo sats+tsha lo saṃ ba mūdhi ṭi'i snardo rje dril bu'o/ /'dir sgo skyong ma'i mtshan ma rnams ni pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /gzhan dag gi ni pad+ma dang zla ba la'o/ /srung 2ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes kyi lte bar zla ba la so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i rin bo che'i chun po'o/ /shar du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /lhor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin pa'i rdo rje'o/ /nub tu sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i pad+ma'o/ /byang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rma bya chen mo'i rma bya'i mjug sgo'o/ /rim pa gnyis par me la sogs pa'i mtshams su nag mo dang / dus mtshan mo dang / rna ba nag mo dang / dkar mo rnams kyi dung dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang /dgra sta cidang / rtse gsum rnams so/ /snam bu rnams la bum pa rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po'o/ /lte ba'i shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi 'dab mar zla ba rnams la go rims bzhin du g.yas skor du sems ma rdo rje ma dang / rin chen rdo rje ma dang / chos kyi rdo rje ma dang / las kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rtse mo can gyi 39—115

rin po che dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar dmar dang / de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i kha dog gi sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i pad+ma'i ste bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams la go rims bzhin du mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje ste lnga pa sngon po dang / rdo rje rin po che dang / rdo rje pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang 1/ mi bskyod pa'i pad+ma'i shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi 'dab mar zla ba rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rgyal po dang / rdo rje chags pa dang / rdo rje legs pa rnams kyi rim pa bzhin du rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rdo rje lcags kyu dang / mda' dang / rdo rje'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi pad+ma la rdo rje rin chen dang / rdo rje gzi brjid dang / rdo rje tog dang / rdo rje bzhad pa rnams kyi rim pa bzhin du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba dang / nyi ma dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / so'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi rdo rje chos dang / rdo rje rnon po dang / rdo rje rgyu dang / rdo rje srung 2ba rnams kyi pad+ma dmar po dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i lce'o/ /don yod grub pa'i rdo rje las dang / rdo rje srung ba dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje khu tshur rnams kyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang / rdo rje go cha dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mche ba dang /rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa so so'i byang chub sems dpa' gsum pa'i mtshan ma ni byang gi 'dab mar dang / bzhi pa'i mtshan ma ni nub kyi 'dab ma la bri bar bya'o/ /me la sogs pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba'i zla ba rnams la rdo 39—/16

rje sgeg mo dang / rdo rje phreng ba ma dang / rdo rje glu ma dang / rdo rje gar ma rnams kyi rdo rje dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang / pi wang dang / rdo rje'o/ /dbus kyi gzhal yas khang las phyi rol gyi snam bu'i shar du byams pa dang /mthong ba don yod dang / ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros rnams kyi pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnams so/ /lho phyogs su spos kyi glang po dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba dang /nam mkha' mdzod dang / ye shes tog rnams kyi pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje rin po che rnams so/ /nub tu 'od dpag med dang / zla 'od dang /bzang skyong dang / dra ba can gyi 'od rnams kyi chu skyes dang / zla ba rnams la rdo rje pad+ma rnams so/ /byang du rdo rje snying po dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang /spobs pa brtsegs 7pa dang / kun du bzang po rnams kyi pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje rnams so/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor kyi me la sogs pa'i grwa rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje bdug spos ma dang / rdo rje gre tog ma dang /rdo rje mar me ma dang / rdo rje dri chab ma rnams kyi mtshan ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje lcags sgog dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa rnams kyi mtshan ma rnams so/ /snam bu rnams la bum pa rnams so/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid can 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa lnga ni sngon po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu dang / ser po ste/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dang /dbus kyi sa thams cad kyang ngo / /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la rtsig pa gsum ste/39—/ /7

sngon po dang / dkar po dang / ser po'o/ /'khor lo gsum pa la rtsig pa dkar po gcig go/ /de la dbus kyi sa gzhi ser po la sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la 'jam dpal gyi ral gri yu ba ser po can no/ /shar la sogs pa'i re mig gi nyi ma 1snal mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa rnams snardo rje sngon po dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / ral gri'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i re'u mig gi zla ba rnams la spyan ma dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams kyi rdo rje ser po dang / rdo rje sngon po dang / rdo rje dkar bo dang / rdo rje ljang gu'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor la shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su zla ba rnams la sems ma rdo rje ma dang / rin chen rdo rje ma dang / chos kyi rdo rje ma dang / las kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi mtshan ma ni mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhin no / /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su zla ba rnams la tsun+da 7dang / rin chen dkar mda' dang / khro gnyer can dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ma rnams kyi ral gri dang / rin po che ser po dang / rdo rje dkar po dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ljang gu rnams so/ /rim pa gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor la shar gyi zla ba rnams la byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / spos kyi glang po dang / ye shes tog rnams kyi klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa dang / ral gri dang /lag ldan gyi snam bu la gnas pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu ser po'o/ /lho'i zla ba rnams la bzang skyong dang / blo gros rgya mtsho dang / blo gros mi zad dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa rnams kyi mda' dmar po dang / dkar po dang ser po dang / ljang gu'o/ /nub kyi zla ba rnams la mthu chen thob pa 5dang /39—118

ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros dang / dra ba can gyi 'od rnams kyi pad+ma dkar po dang / mda' dkar po dang / mda' ser po dang / ut+pa la dmar po la gnas pa'i nyi ma'o//byang phyogs kyi zla ba rnams la zla 'od dang / 'od dpag med dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba rnams kyi ut+pal la gnas pa'i zla ba dang / bum pa dmar po dang / mda' ser po dang /mda' sngon po'o/ /'dir go rims bzhin du shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su hūṃlogs gnyis kyi snam bu la mtshan ma gnyis gnyis so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor nyi ma rnams la gshin rje mthar byed dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang /rta mgrin dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rnams kyi ral gri yu ba nag po can dang /rdo rje ser po dang / rdo rje dbyug pa dmar po dang / ral gri yu ba sngon po can dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams kyi nyi ma rnams la mi g.yo ba dang /'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang / stobs po che rnams kyi ral gri sngon po dang / rdo rje sngon po dang / rdo rje dbyug pa sngon po dang /rdo rje dbyug pa sngon po'o/ /gshin rje gshed kyi mtshan ma'i phyi rol du nyi ma la gnod mdzes kyi ral gri'o/ /rta mgrin gyi mtshan ma'i phyi ngos su nyi ma la rdo rje sa 'og gi rdo rje lcags kyu'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma thams cad kyi 'og tu sna tshogs chu skyes so/ /snam bu rnams la bum pa rnams so/ /kha cig tu ni gshin rje gshed kyi mtshan ma'i phyi ngos su nyi ma la gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i 'khor lo dang de'i phyi ngos su gnod mdzes kyi ral gri'o zhes gsungs so/ /chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor la nang gi 'khor lo 39—119

tshon dkar pos dgang bar bya'o/ /gzhan ni snga ma bzhin no/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gye dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ral gri yu ba ser po can no/ /shar la sogs pa dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab ma'i zla ba rnams la go rims bzhin g.yas skor /3du gtsug tor chen bo dang / gdugs dkar po dang / gzi brjid phung po dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba dang / 'phags pa dang /cher 'phags pa dang / rgyal ba ste gtsug tor brgyad po rnams kyi 'khor lo ser bo rnams so/ /shar gyi re mig gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje sngon po'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rgyal po dang / rdo rje chags pa dang / rdo rje legs pa rnams kyi rdo rje dang / rdo rje lcags kyu dang /mda' dang rdo rje'o/ /lho'i re mig gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang / nyi ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu ser po'i rgyal mtshan no/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams kyi sna tshogs chu skyes dang / zla ba rnams 3la rdo rje rin chen dang / rdo rje nyi ma dang / rdo rje tog dang / rdo rje bzhad pa rnams kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis kyis numatshan pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / so'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'o/ /nub kyi re mig gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+mar nyi ma la snang ba mtha' yas kyi pad+ma dmar po'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje chos dang / rdo rje rnon po dang rdo rje rgyu dang rdo rje srung ba rnams kyi pad+ma dang / ral gri dang / chos kyi 'khor 39—120

lo dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i lce'o/ /byang phyogs kyi re mig gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang lkunyi ma la don yod grub pa'i ral gri'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje las dang / rdo rje srung 5ba dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin dang rdo rje khu tshur rnams kyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang / rdo rje go cha dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mche ba dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams kyi re mig gi pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la spyan ma dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams kyi mtshan ma rnams ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa'i mtshan ma bzhin no/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang /rdo rje lcags sgog dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa rnams kyi rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'o/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor 'di las dkyil 'khor gnyis par shar phyogs su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la sa bcu gnyis so/ /mos pas 4spyod pa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dri ma med pa dang / 'od byed ltapa dang / 'od 'phro ba dang / sbyang dka' ba dang / mngon du gyur pa dang / ring du song ba dang /mi g.yo ba dang / legs pa'i blo gros dang / chos kyi sprin dang / kun du 'od kyi sa rnams kyi go rims bzhin du g.yas skor du pad+ma dmar po dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma dang / at+pa la dang / nor bu margad zhwadang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang / sna tshogs chu skyes kyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje yu ba dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dang / zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po 39—121

dang / ut+pa la'i steng du ral gri dang / chos kyi sprin gyis yongs su bskor ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang / pad+ma la bzhugs pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku'o/ /lhor sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rin chen 2pad+ma'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang /thabs dang / stobs dang / smon lam dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rdo rje las kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bcu gnyis rnams kyi pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang 'bru sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i snye ma dang / lo ma dang bcas pa'i a sho ka'i me tog gi chun po dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang / chu skyes ser po la gnas pa'i rdo rje dang / ut+pal la gnas pa'i ral gri dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang / rin po che sna tshogs pa'i 'bras bus brgyan pa'i byang chub kyi shing gi yal ga dang /ut+pal la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /nub tu sna tshogs chu skyes dang / zla ba rnams la tshe dang / sems dang / yo byad dang / las dang / skye ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / mos pa dang / smon lam dang / ye shes dang /chos la dbang ba rnams dang / de bzhin nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ste/ dbang bcu gnyis rnams kyi nor bu pad+ma rā ga la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i tshe dpag med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang /rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / me tog dzā ti kha dog sna tshogs pa'i yal 'dab dang /39—122

pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang / pri yang ku'i me tog gi snye ma dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / ut+pa la la gnas pa'i ral gri dang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa bzang po dang / 'dam skyes dkar po dang / chu skyes ser po la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /byang phyogs su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la dbyig gi blo gros ma dang / rin po che'i skar mda' dang / gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dang / 'od zer can dang / ri khrod lo ma can dang /dze+e gu lbo dang / sgo mtha' yas ma dang / skul byed ma dang / shes rab 'phel ma dang / las dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ma dang / ye shes mi zad pa'i za ma tog dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi mdzod ldan ma rnams te/ gzungs ༄kyi bcu gnyis rnams kyi 'bras kyi snye ma dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa dang /skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang / rma bya'i mjug sgo dang / dug gi me tog gi chun po dang / pad+ma dmar po la gnas pa'i mi zad pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa dang / ril pa spyi blugs la phreng ba dpyangs pa dang / ut+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri dang / rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma dkar dmar dang / rin po che'i za ma tog dang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dpe sgom mo/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor chu skyes dang / nyi ma rnams la chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang don so so yang dag par rig pa dang /nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa dang / spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi rdo rje dang nyalcags kyu dang / rin po che'i zhags pa dang /mtha' gnyis su pad+mas mtshan pa'i lcags sgog dang / rdo rje rtse gsum pas 39—123

—mtshan pa'i dril bu'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su sgeg mo dang / phreng ba ma dang / glu ma dang / gar ma rnams kyi rdo rje dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang / pi wang dang / rdo rje'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum par pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la shar phyogs su kun du bzang po'i at+pa la la gnas pa'i ral gri dang /blo gros mi zad pa'i ral gri dang / sa'i snying po'i pad+ma la gnas pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing dang / nam mkha'i snying po'i rin po che'o/ /lho phyogs su nam mkha' mdzod kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / phyag na rin chen kyi rin po che dang / blo gros rgya mtsho'i dung dang / rdo rje snying po'i rdo rje'o/ /nub tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pad+ma dang / mthu chen thob kyi ral gri dang / zla 'od kyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo dang / dra ba can gyi 'od kyi ral gri'o/ /byang du pad+ma dang zla ba nyurnams la 'od dpag med dang / spobs pa brtsegs byepa dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros dang /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba rnams kyi sna tshogs pad+ma dang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i ral gri dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / ral gri'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor pad+ma dang / /nyi ma rnams la gshin rje mthar byed dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / pad+ma mthar byed dang / bgegs mthar byed rnams kyi lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgog dang / dril bu rnams so/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma rnams la 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dang / rdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar ba dang /te ru ka rdo rje dang / rta mchog rnams kyi ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje rnams so/ /gshin rje mthar byed kyi mtshan 39—124

ma'i phyir gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i 'khor lo ser po'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed kyi mtshan ma'i phyir gnod mdzes kyi rdo rje'o/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bzhi'i phyi ngos su dkyil 'khor gsum pa kho na'i zur kyi nang du re khā bya'o/ /de'i phyi ngos kyi gnas kyi me la sogs pa'i zur thig rnams kyi g.yas logs su gnas pa'i pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la me tog ma dang /bdug spos ma dang / mar me ma dang / dri chab ma rnams kyi me tog gi snod dang / spos phor dang / rin po che'i sgon 1ma'i mchod sdong dang dung ngo / /g.yon logs su gnas pa'i pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la rdo rje gzugs ma dang / rdo rje sgra ma ma thudang / rdo rje ro ma dang / rdo rje reg bya ma rnams kyi me long dang /pi wang dang / ro'i snod dang / gos sna tshogs so/ /phyi rol rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la pad+ma rnams la shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su dbang po dang /gshin rje dang / chu bdag dang / lus ngan po rnams kyi rdo rje dang /dbyug pa dang / klu'i zhags pa dang / lcags kyu'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su dbang ldan dang / me lha dang / srin po'i bdag po dang /rlung lha rnams kyi rtse gsum pa dang / blugs gzar dang / ral gri dang /rlung ras so/ /de nas dbang ldan gyi phyi ngos dang nye bar dbang ldan gye mtshams nas brtsams te/ mtshan ma rnams rim gyis bri bar bya'o/ /de la tshangs pa'i bgrang phreng ngo / /khyab 'jug gi 'khor lo'o/ /dbang phyug chen po'i rtse gsum pa dang / gdong drug gi shag ti dang / tshangs mo'i phreng ba dang /drag mo'i rtse gsum dang / khyab 'jug ma'i 'khor lo dang / gzhon nu ma'i shasti dang / dbang mo'i rdo rje dang / phag mo'i nya ro hi ta dang / tsa muṇ+ḍi'i 39—125

gri gug dang / z-isgo kyeri ti'i phreng ba dang / tshogs bdag gi dgra sta dang /nag po chen po'i rtse gsum dang / dga' byed dbang phyug gi rdza rnga dang / nyi ma'i pad+ma la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / zla ba'i kun+da 1la gnas pa'i rngudakyil 'khor dang / mig dmar kyi gri gug ④dang / lhag ⑤pa'i mda' dang /phur bu'i phreng ba dang / pa wa sangs kyi phreng ba dang / spen pa'i dbyug pa nag po dang / sgra gcan gyi zla ba dang / mjug rings kyi klu'i zhags pa dang /stobs bzangs kyi gshol dang / rgyal bar byed pa'i me tog gi phreng ba dang /sbrang rtsir byed pa'i chu srin kyi rgyal mtshan dang / dpyid kyi zla dang / mtha' yas dang / nor rgyas dang / 'jog po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / dung skyong dang / rigs ldan rnams kyis 0thal mo sbyar ba'am/ yang na rang rang gi pha'i mtshan ma dang 'dra ba'i mtshan ma'o/ /de la mtha' yas dang rigs rnguldan ni bram ze ste me lha'i bu'o/ /nor rgyas dang dung skyong ni rgyal rigs te dbang po'i'o/ /'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ni rje'u'i rigs te rlung lha'o/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma ni dmangs ldu rigs te chu lha'i'o/ /thags 9bzangs ris dang / stobs ldan dang / rab tu tshim byed dang /rnam par snang byed la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa'i pi wang ngo / /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa'i pi wang ngo / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po don kun grub pa'i me tog gi phreng ba'o/ /gang ba bzang po dang / nor bu bzang po dang / nor sbyin dang / rnam thos kyi bu dang / tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li dang / ki li mi ⑫li dang /39—126

sgo'i dbang po dang / spyod pa'i dbang po ste/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po rnams kyi shing thog bi dza ①pū ra rnams so/ /'phrog ma'i chang bu gnyis so/ /tha skar dang / bra nye dang / smin drug dang / snar ma dang / mgo dang / lag dang / nam ②so dang / rgyal dang skag dang / mchu dang / gre dang /dbo dang / me bzhi dang / nag pa dang / sa ri dang / sa ga dang /lha mtshalas dang / spyon dang / snrubs dang / chu stod dang / chu smad dang /gro bzhin dang / mon gre dang / mon gru dang / khrums stod dang / khrums smad dang / nam gru dang / bye bzhin rnams kyi ni lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag rgya rnams so/ /'dir yang sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa la bum pa rnams so/ /ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje phreng ba sngon po'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser 5 po'i dbus su chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ser po'o /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs rnams la sa gnon gyi phyag rgya dkar po dang / mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya sngon bo dang / bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya dmar po dang / mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya ljang gu rnams so/ /me la sogs pa'i rtsibs rnams la nyi ma dang yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / ral gri dang / gdugs so/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i phyi'i me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams thusu sgeg mo la sogs pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i snam bu rnams chol sgo'i g.yon du mtshan ma gnyis te/ g.yas su yang ngo / /der klu shing gi me tog dang / spyan dang bcas pa'i chu skyes dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug pa dang / dung dang /ral gri dang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi sgom dang / yid bzhin gyi nor 39—127

bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang / pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i gzugs dang / rin po che dang / rdo rje gur dang / rdo rje dang bcas pa'i a la dang bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang / chu skyes la gnas pa'i rin po che dang /rin po che'i snye ma'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams la me tog la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams so/ /sgo rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa rnams so/ /mtshan ma sum cu rtsa bdun po rnams sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /mgrin pa sngon po la sogs pa rnams kyi mtshan ma ni mi bri ba yang ngo / /'byung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor la rtsig pa lnga dang / shar la sogs pa'i sa ni dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang /nag po'o/ /thig gi re khā gsum ni dkar po dang / dmar po dang / nag po'o / /thig gi re khā gcig dang / rdo rje phreng ba'i re khā gnyis ni nag po'o/ /nang gi pho brang gi dbus kyi re mig la sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la bcom ldan 'das 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po'o/ /shar du nyi ma la dbang phyug chen po'i rtse gsum pa'o/ /lhor nyi ma la khyab 'jug gi 'khor lo'o/ /nub tu zla ba la tshangs pa'i phreng ba'o/ /byang du nyi ma la zin drug gi bu'i shat+ta'okye//dbang ldan du zla ba la tshogs bdag gi dgra sta'o/ /mer nyi ma la nyi ma'i pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /bden bral du nyi ma la sgra gcan kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rlung du zla ba la dga' byed dbang phyug gi cang te'u'o/ /rim rte pa gnyis par shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams 1su dbang mo ④dang / thig le mchog ma dang / zla ba mo dang / dka' bzlog ma rnams kyi zla ba la pad+ma dkar po dang / spos phor dang / mar me'i mchod sdong dang / gdengs ka'i 39—128

rnam pa'i lag pa'o/ /me la sogs par rin chen dpal mo dang / dbyangs can ma dang / lha mdzes ma dang / kun du 'byor pa ①rnams kyi zla ba rnams la rim pa bzhin du dri'i dung chos dang / pi wang dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang / rdo rje rtse gsum pa'o/ /rim pa gsum par shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su dbang po dang / gshin rje dang / chu bdag dang / lus ngan rnams kyi zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dang / nyi ma la gnas pa'i thod pas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dang / zla ba la gnas pa'i klu'i zhags pa dang / zla ba la gnas pa'i dbyug to'o—/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su me lha dang / bden bral dang / rlung lha dang / zla ba rnams kyi nyi ma la gnas pa'i phreng ba dang / nyi ma la gnas pa'i ral gri dang / zla ba la gnas pa'i rlung ras dang / zla ba dang ku mu da dul gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /zla ba'i mtshan ma dang nye bar dbang ldan gyi nyi ma la rtse gsum mo/ /rim pa bzhi par shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin ma dang / rnam rgyal 1ma dang / pad chen ma dang /chang 'phrog ma rnams kyi zla ba la seng ge'i rgyal mtshan dang / lcags kyu dang /mda' dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs par mchog 'phrog ma dang / rin chen dbang phyug ma dang / rgyal ma dang / 'gro skyong ma rnams kyi zla ba la me tog gi snod dang / spos phor dang / dri'i dung chos dang / mar me'i mchod sdong ngo / /'dir nyi ma dang / zla ba thams cad ni sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /rim pa bzhi par bum pa rnams so/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i (byadakyil 'khor la dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su shes rab dang bcas pa'i kye'i rdo rje'i gri gug dang thod snye pa'o/ /shar la sogs 39—129

pa'i sgor dkar mo dang / chom rkun ma dang / ro langs ma dang / za phod ma rnams kyi rdo rje lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgog dang /dril bu rnams so/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su spos mo dang /ri khrod ma dang / gtum mo dang / g.yung mo rnams kyi byang chub sems kyi bum pa dang / ri rab dang / me khab dang / rgyal mtshan chen po'i ba dan no / /de las shar gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rtag pa'i thod pa la gnas pa'i rma bya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor skam pa mo dang / zhags pa ma dang /ngo tsozlum ma dang / lcags kyu 'dzin ma rnams kyi skam pa dang / zhags pa dang /nya rgya zlum po dang / lcags kyu'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs par me tog ma dang /bdug spos ma dang / mar me ma dang / dri chab ma rnams kyi me tog gi snod dang / spos phor dang / mar me'i mchod sdong dang / dri ser pos gang ba'i dung ngo / /lho'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rdo rje nyi ma'i thod pa la gnas pa'i bya ka raṇ+ḍa snadang / shar la sogs pa'i sgor nyi lag ma dang / mar me ma dang /rin chen skar mda' ma dang / phyag na glog thogs ma rnams kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / mar me'i mchod sdong dang / rin po che dang / glog gi phreng ba'o—/ /dbang ldan la sogs par sgeg mo dang / phreng ba ma dang / glu ma dang / gar ma rnams kyi rdo rje dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang / khar kye rnga dang / rdo rje'o/ /nub kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi thod pa la gnas pa'i dom dang shar la sogs pa'i sgor pad+ma khudang / chos 'byung ma dang / sgog ma dang / rang 'khyud khyam rnams kyi pad+ma dang / chos 'byung dang / sgog dang / rdo rje'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs par gling bu ma 39—130

dang / pi wang ma dang / rnga mu kuṇ+ḍa ma dang / rdza rnga ma rnams kyi rang rang gi rol cha rnams so/ /byang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rta mchog gi thod pa la gnas pa'i gza' lhag dang / shar la sogs pa'i sgor sgo lcags ma dang /lde kyog 3rim dang / sgo glegs ma dang / yol ba 'dzin ma rnams kyi sgo lcags dang / lde kyog tredang / sgo glegs ldudang / yol ba'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs par spyan ma dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgol ma rnams kyi 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / ut+pa la'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo rnams su dkar mo la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams dang /dbang ldan la sogs par spos mo la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams so/ /mtshan ma 'di rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i thurtag pa kho na'i zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor so so la bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams so/ /kha cig ni dkyil 'khor chen po kho na la'o zhes so/ /'khor los hūṃsgyur ba drug gi dkyil 'khor la mtshan ma rnams sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa ste/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro kho na'i zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang drug po rnams kyi grwa rnams rmyesu sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i thod pa rnams so/ /de la dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi pad+ma la rdo rje sems dpa'i rdo rje'o/ /mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams la mkha' 'gro ma dang / khā mā 4dang /dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can ma rnams kyi cang te'u 3rnams so/ /'dir dgod pa'i rim pa ni shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su g.yon skor 1snadang / me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su g.yas skor ro/ /sgo'i pad+ma rnams la thod pa'i dum bu dang / rab tu gtum mo dag dang / keng rus chen po dang /39—131

gtum pa'i mig can ma dag dang / keng rus dang / 'od ldan ma dag dang /mche ba rnam par gcigs ma dang / sna chen ma dag gi rdo rje bzhi'o/ /khor yug gi dbus su rdo rje'i phreng ba'o/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du dbus kyi 1pad+ma la 'khor lo dang / sgo'i pad+ma rnams la lha dgra dang / dpa' bo'i blo can ma dag dang / 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma dag dang /rdo rje 'od dang / lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dag dang / rdo rje lus dang /shing grib ma dag gi 'khor lo rnams so/ /khor yug gi dbus su 'khor lo'i phreng ba'o / /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su rin po che'o/ /sgo'i chu skyes rnams la myu —gu can dang / e ra pa ti dag dang / rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo dag dang / dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung shugs ma dag dang / rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma dag gi rin po che rnams so/ /khor yug gi dbus su pad+ma 5rin po che'i phreng ba'o/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su pad+ma'o/ /sgo'i pad+ma rnams la shin tu bzang po dang / lha mo sngo bsangs 6ma dag dang / rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo dag dang / 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma dag dang /mig mi bzang dang / bya gdong ma rnams kyi pad+ma rnams so/ /khor yug gi dbus su pad+ma'i phreng ba'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /sgo'i pad+ma rnams la stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dag dang / rin chen rdo rje dang / dum skyes ma dag dang / rta mgrin dang / chang 'tshong ma dag dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang /'khor lo'i go cha ma dag gi rdo rje rnams so/ /khor yug gi dbus su rdo rje'i phreng 39—132

ba'o / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /sgo'i pad+ma rnams la te ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo dag dang / pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen mo dag dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los sgyur ma dag dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo 1dag gi sna tshogs rdo rje rnams so/ /khor yug gi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba'o—/ /gzhal yas khang chen po'i sgo rnams la khwa gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma rnams kyi rdo rje lcags kyu dang /zhags pa dang / lcags sgog dang / dril bu'o/ /mtshams rnams su gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje pho nya ma dang / gshin rje mche ba ma dang /gshin rje 'joms ma rnams kyi me long dang / pi wang dang / dri'i dung dang /ro'i snod rnams so/ /bum pa rnams ni ji ltar rigs 27par ro/ /de ltar brjod pa'i rjes su 'brangs te dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la rdul tshon dgye ba yang shes par bya ste/ gzhung mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bstan to/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor la ni tshon gyi kha dog gi rim pa bshad pa dag dang phal cher mi mthun pas/ rdul tshon gyi kha dog gi rim pa brjod par bya'o / /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gye rdo rje'i phreng ba gnyis pa'i bar gyi nang gis thams cad ni nag po'o/ /thugs dang / gsung dang sku'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi shar gye sa thams cad ni nag bo'o/ /lho ni dmar po'o/ /nub ni ser po'o/ /byang du geni dkar po'o/ /stegs bu ni dkar po'o/ /rin chen snam bu ni dmar po ste/ de la rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa'o/ /dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa'i sa ni nag po ste/ de la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa d+nghani dkar po'o/ /39—133

sa nag po la rin chen shar bu dkar po'o/ /sa nag po la mda' yab rnams dkar po'o/ /rta babs kyi ka ba rnams ser po'o/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la ni gtso bo'i pad+ma ljang gu'o/ /zhi ba la sogs pa la ni kha dog dkar po la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje phreng ba dang / ka ba bcu drug ni nag po ste/ shar du ral gri nag po dang / lhor rin po che dmar po dang / nub du 'khor lo ser po dang / byang du pad+ma dkar po rnams dang ldan pa'o/ /bum pa brgyad ni pad+ma la gnas shing dkar po ste/ pad+mas kha brgyan pa'o/ /thams cad du pad+ma'i gdan gyi sum cha ni lte ba'o/ /rdo rje phreng ba gnyis pa ni ljang gu'o/ /lha snam ni dkar po'o/ /rtsig pa'i re khā gsum ni nang nas brtsams nas dkar po dang / dmar po dang nag po'o/ /de rnams kyis ni cha dgur byas te/ de la cha re dor nas cha gnyis la re khā so so bya'o/ /sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su rdo rje dang rin po ches spras pa'o/ /rta babs bcu gnyis ni kha dog sna tshogs pa'o//gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam dkar po'o/ /de'i pad+ma brgyad ni zla ba dang nyi ma dang bral ba ste/ phyogs rnams su dmar po dang / mtshams rnams su dkar po'o/ /re khā lnga'i kha dog ni nang nas brtsams te ljang gu dang / nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ser po rnams so/ /de rnams kyis cha bco lngar byas te der snga ma bzhin re khā bya'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam ni dkar po'o/ /de'i pad+ma rnams ni zla ba dang nyi ma dang bral ba'o/ /re khā lnga ni sku'i 1dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /rta babs kyi ka ba rnams kyi 'og gi stegs bu'i gnas rnams su ༄ sbrul gyi gdan rnams te/ so sor cha chung bcu gnyis so/ /de la shar gye phyogs su nag po zlum po gnyis kyi steng du rgyal mtshan 39—134

gnyis so/ /lhor gru gsum dmar po gnyis la bkra shis kyis mtshan pa'o/ /nub tu gru bzhi ser po gnyis la rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /byang du zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pa 1dkar po gnyis byel pad+mas mtshan pa'o/ /shar gyi g.yas kyi zlum po'i g.yas su klu'i rgyal po rgyal ba zhes pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa'o/ /nub kyi g.yon gyi gru bzhi pa'i g.yon du rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa'o/ /shar gyi rta babs kyi rim pa dang po'i stsos pa bsrung 1ba'i steng gi dbus kyi gru bzhi pa la chos kyi 'khor lo nag po/ de'i g.yas dang g.yon du ri dwags dang ri dwags mo nag po'o/ /lhor bum pa bzang po dmar po'o/ /de'i g.yas dang g.yon du dung dang / pad+ma dmar po'o/ /nub tu byang chub kyi shing ser po'o/ /de'i g.yas dang g.yon dag tu mi 'am ci dang mi 'am ci mo ser po'o/ /byang du rnga bo che dkar po ste de'i g.yas dang g.yon du dbyug pa dang tho ba dkar bo'o/ /mda' yab dang sa'i khor yug gi dbus kyi sa ni nag po'o/ /der ji ltar mdzes par mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bri bar bya'o/ /sa'i khor yug ni ser po'o/ /der dbang ldan gyi mtshams su zla ba nya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba cha chung bcu gnyis pa dang / bden bral du nub bzhin pa'i nyi ma cha chung bcu gnyis pa'o/ /chu'i khor yug dkar po'o/ /me'i khor yug dmar po'o/ /rlung gi khor yug nag po'o/ /me dang rlung gi khor yug de dag gi dbus su so sor cha chung bcu gnyis pa'i rtsibs brgyad pa'i dur khrod kyi 'khor lo brgyad de/ phyogs su dmar po rnams dang / mtshams su dkar po rnams so/ /shar gyi 'khor lo'i phyi ngos su stong pa'i dkyil 'khor 4nub kyi 'khor lo'i phyi ngos su yang stong pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis 'dri ba ni sgrub thabs kyi le'ur 39—135

gsungs pa'i 1tshul gyis so/ /bcu char la yang mtshan ma ni gri gug go/ /rlung gi khor yug la mtshan ma sna tshogs pa bri bar bya ste/ 'dir 'dod pa spyod pa ni ma yin no/ /nam mkha'i khor yug ni nag po'o/ /de'i logs gnyis su cha chung gsum gsum dor la der re khā zlum skor gnyis so/ /dbus kyi cha chung drug la ni rdo rje phreng ba ljang gur 3snabya'o/ /'od zer 'bar ba rnams ni kha dog rnam pa lnga'o/ /yang nang gi dkyil 'khor du shar phyogs su /byetshon nag po'i dpangs su nas kyi bzhi cha gcig go/ /lho'i dmar po ni gnyis so/ /nub kyi ser po ni bzhi'o / /byang gi dkar po ni gsum mo/ /rtsig pa'i re khā rnams kyi dpangs su rdul tshon ser po sum 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje phreng ba rnams kyang ngo / /re khā gzhan ni tshon ser po las nyis 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma rnams ni snam bu las nyis 'gyur gyis so/ /nyi zla dag ni chu skyes kyi re khā las so/ /de ltar brjod pa'i dpangs las gsung gi dkyil 'khor la dpangs rnams ④ni nyis 'gyur ro/ /de rnams las nyis 'gyur ni sku'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /mda' yab las phyi'i mchod pa'i sa la 5nas gcig go/ /sa la sogs pa'i khor yug dang re khā zlum skor gnyis kyi dpangs ni sgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i re kha'i 2tshad du'o/ /sa thams cad du rdul tshon gzhan dgye ba thuthams cad kyi 2nyis 'gyur kyi dbye bas mnyam pa'o/ /de la gtso bo'i lte bar ste ba dang mnyam pa'i dkar po dang dmar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang / sgra gcan dang dus kyi me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la spos phor nag po'o/ /lhor mar me dmar po'o / /nub tu dung ser po'o/ /byang du lha bshos dkar po'o/ /me la 39—136

sogs par rnga yab nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ser po'o / /de'i phyi ngos su dbang ldan du chos kyi dung dkar po'o/ /rnger yid bzhin gyi nor bu nag po'o/ /bden bral du chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi 1dmar po'o/ /rlung du dpag bsam gye shing ser po'o/ /rim pa gnyis par shar du pad+ma dkar por nyi ma la ral gri nag po'o/ /mer pad+ma dmar por zla ba la at+pa la sngon po'o/ /lhor pad+ma dkar por nyi ma la rin po che cha dgu pa dmar po'o/ /bden bral du pad+ma dmar por zla ba la pad+ma dmar po'o/ /nub tu pad+ma dkar por nyi ma la 'khor lo ser po'o/ /rlung du pad+ma dmar por zla ba la 'khor lo ser po'o/ /byang du pad+ma dkar por nyi ma la pad+ma dkar po'o/ /dbang ldan du pad+ma dmar por zla ba la at+pa la dkar po'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i snam bu la sgo so so'i logs gnyis su gnyis te de ltar pad+ma brgyad do/ /de la drug rnams nyi ma la'o/ /nub dang byang gi sgo'i g.yon dag tu zla ba gnyis so/ /mtshams rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba bzhi ste de rnams su dbang ldan nas brtsams te me long dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / gos dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang rdo rje dang ro'i snod dang / chos 'byung dang / 'khor lo dang dri'i dung dang / pi wang dang / pad+ma rnams te/ dkar po dang / sngon po dang / nag po dang /nag po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang ser po dang / ser po dang / sngon po dang / dkar po'o/ /shar sgo'i pad+ma dang / nyi mar ral gri nag po dang / lhor dbyug pa dmar po dang /nub tu pad+ma ser po dang / byang du tho ba dkar po'o/ /'dir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams ni pad+ma dkar po la gnas shing zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams ni pad+ma 39—137

dmar po snye1la'o/ /shar gyi stegs bu la rta babs kyi ka ba'i rtsa ba'i 3g.yon du dung nag po 1dang / g.yas su me tog sngon po'i phreng ba'o/ /lhor spos phor dmar po dang / mar me'o/ /nub tu cod pan ser po dang / do shal ser po'o / /byang du 'bras bu dkar po dang bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba'i thod pa'i 4snod do/ /stegs bu thams cad la ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams so/ /shar gyi rta babs kyi mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas la dbus su gos so/ /lhor pad+ma'o/ /nub tu rnga pa ṭa ha'o/ /byang du rdo rje'o/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor la ni shar gyi pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la gri gug nag po rnams so/ /mer 'khor lo nag po rnams so/ /gshin rjer dbyug pa dmar po rnams so/ /bden bral du shat+ta 5dmar po rnams so/ /nub tu rdo rje ser po rnams so/ /rlung du tshangs pa'i dbyu gu rtse mo ser po can rnams so/ /byang du rtse gsum dkar po rnams so/ /dbang ldan du hūṃpad+ma dkar po rnams so//sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu la pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la mtshan ma rnams so/ /de la shar gyi sgo'i g.yas su ral gri rnams so/ /mer dpag bsam gyi shing rnams so/ /lho'i sgo'i g.yon du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa rnams so/ /g.yas su shat+ta 3rnams so/ /bden bral du shat+ta 8sna 'am yang na mdung rnams so/ /nub kyi sgo'i g.yon du rin po che'am/ dbyug to rnams so//g.yas su rdo rje rnams so/ /rlung du khab rnams so/ /byang sgo'i g.yon du rtse gsum rnams so/ /g.yas su zhags pa rnams so/ /dbang ldan du dgra sta rnams so/ /shar sgo'i g.yon du 'khor lo rnams so/ /shar sgor bye dbyug pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du rdo rje ljang gu'o/ /lho sgor mda' dmar po'o/ /nub sgor 39—138

dbyug to ser po'o/ /de'i phyi ngos su rtse gsum sngon po'o/ /byang sgor gtun shing dkar po'o/ /dbyug pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'di rnams pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /gsung dang sku'i dkyil 'khor dag gi phyogs kyi pad+ma rnams ni dmar po'o/ /mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams ni dkar po'o/ /'dir gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu la shar du sgo'i g.yas su a la dang / gos dang / gri gug dang / 'khor lo dang / kha ṭī ga rnams nag po'o/ /g.yon du gri gug dang /ral gri dang / gri gug rnams nag po'o/ /lho'i stegs bu la sgo'i g.yas su pad+ma dang / ro'i snod dang dbyug pa /dang shat+ta /dang pad+ma rnams dmar po'o/ /g.yon du mda' dang dgra sta dang / gri gug dang / gri gug rnams dmar po'o/ /nub sgo'i g.yas su 'khor lo dang dri'i dung chos dang / rdo rje dang / khab dang / 'khor lo rnams ser po'o/ /g.yon du chos 'byung ljang gu dang /'khor lo dang / gri gug dang / gri gug rnams ser po'o/ /byang du sgo'i g.yas su ut+pa la dang / me long dang / rtse gsum dang / pad+ma dang /a la rnams dkar po'o/ /g.yon du pi wang sngon po dang / tho ba dang gri gug dang / gri gug rnams dkar po'o/ /de ltar mtshan ma sum cu so drug po rnams ni sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu rnams la yang ngo / /de nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor bris la/ /rnam pa thams cad du gsal ④bar gyur par shes nas/ yi ge hūṃ dang / 'khyel pa bzlas 5 pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus dkyil 'khor gyi phyi ngos su byugs la/de bzlas pa'i chus 'khor lo bsangs te/ rdul tshon lhag ma rnams la/ oṃ aXhūṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes kyi tshon gshegs su gsol te/ snod na gnas pa'i 39—139

tshon rnams dben par gzhag par bya'o/ /tshon dgye ba'i cho ga'o / /①de nas sngar lhag par gnas par byas pa'i bum pa rnams g.yas skor du dgod par bya'o/ /de la 'khor lo'i dbang po'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la g.yas skor byas nas rdo rje ra ba'i bdag nyid kyi khor yug dang / 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i sa'i phyi ngos su dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad ka'i gnas las cung zad g.yas su gzhag par bya'o/ /g.yon logs su go rims bzhin g.yas skor du rnam par snang mdzad dang / spyan ma dang / las thams cad pa'i bum pa rnams so/ /g.yas su gzugs rdo rje ma dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma dang / gshin rje gshed ma rnams kyi'o/ /lho'i g.yon du rin chen 'byung ldan dang / mā ma tī dag gi dang / g.yas su sgra rdo rje ma dang / shes rab mthar byed dag gi'o/ /nub kyi g.yon du snang ba mtha' yas dang / gos dkar mo dag gi dang / g.yas su dri rdo rje ma dang / pad+ma mthar byed dag gi'o / /byang gi g.yon du don yod grub pa dang / sgol ma dag gi dang /g.yas su ro rdo rje ma dang / reg bya rdo rje ma dang / bgegs mthar byed rnams kyi'o/ /kha cig ni gshin rje gshed la sogs pa khro bo rnams kyi ni me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su'o zhes so/ /gzhan ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i de ma thag tu khro bo rnams kyi rigs kyi yum rnams kyi ni sgo'i g.yas phyogs rnams su'o zhes so/ /'di'i rjes su 'brangs te phyogs gzhan rnams su yang dgod par ge shes par bya'o/ /bzhed pa gzhan yang yod de des ci zhig bya/ de lta bu de ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa dgod pa'i tshul lo/ /bsdus pa'i 39—140

rim pa'i dkyil 'khor la g.yon du rigs kyi yum gyi de ma thag tu dang / g.yas su yang dang por byang chub sems dpa' brgyad pa rnams kyi'o/ /zur gyi khro bo rnams kyi zur rnams su'o/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rjes la gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed kyi rjes la gnod mdzes kyi zhes pa khyad par ro/ /'di'i rjes su 'brangs snate dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la bum pa dgod pa rtogs sla bas ma spros so/ /grwa'i bum pa rnams la sgo dang bcas pa'i mda' bzhi ste/oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis dgod do/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la ni phyi ngos su shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su bum pa bzhi'o/ /rgyal ba'i bum pa yang shar du ste lnga pa'o/ /de'i steng gi rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i dung chos ni drug pa'o/ /de lta bu ni bum pa lnga pa'i phyogs la'o/ /bum pa bcu pa'i phyogs la ni phyogs brgyad du bum pa brgyad do/ /nub kyi bum pa las phyi ngos su sor gnyis spangs par rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'o/ /shar gyi bum pa las /3phyi ngos su sor gnyis spangs par rgyal ba'i bum pa'o/ /de'i steng du rnam par rgyal ba chen po'i bum pa dung chos te bcu gcig pa'o/ /de ltar bum pa stong dang brgya rnams su yang zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang las thams cad pa la rnam par rgyal ba chen po dung chos yin no/ /bum pa dgod pa'i cho ga'o / / de nas dkyil 'khor la phyi ngos su phyogs bzhir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos bzhi klog tu gzhug par bya'o/ /ga pur dang /a ka ru dang / tu ruska thul sogs pa'i spos phor brgyad gzhag par bya'o/ /na bza' sna tshogs pa stong la sogs pa'am/ lha so so la re re 'am/ ji ltar 39byed141

nus pa yang rung ste/ slob ma la sogs par gzhag pa dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams dang / rta babs dang / gos bzang po dang / dril bu dang bcas pa'i rnga yab dang / bum pa gang ba dang / bo ma dang bcas pa'i chu shing gi sdong bu'i kyesnaka ba rnams la yi ge hūṃ dang / bdag po'i sngags kyi bzlas pa/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pas dbul bye te/ gnas ji lta ba bzhin gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas khrus byas te dri zhim po'i lus stod g.yogs dang gtsug tor dang / rgyan dang bcas pas ④'khyil pa bzlas pa'i chus dkyil 'khor bsangs te/ yi ge gsum dang 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis rgyabasrungs nas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung ste/ shar gyi sgo dang / nye bar nub tu kha bltas te 'dug la 'khor lo'i dbang po'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dubris pa'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi rjes la srung tshuba'i 'khor lo dang / bgegs la phur bus gdab pa la sogs pa'i cho ga 'khor dang bcas pas bsgom (snye par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du nges par brtags nas/ btsun mo mdzes shing mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon rnyed nas/ /dri dang me tog brgyan byas te/ /de yi dbus su 'dod pa bya/ /yon tan ske ⑩rags mā ma tī//shes rab can gyis de byin rlabasadzi7/ /zhi ba spros byas sangs rgyas gnas⑫/ /nam mkha'i dbyengs ni rab tu brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pas bsgrub 6pa'i phyi jol gyi phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs /rtesam/ de med na ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pas kyang rung ste/ yang dag par bskyod pa'i dga' ba'i sgras ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la zhabs bsel dang / mchod yon phul la ⑫sngon du 'gro bas rang gi nang du bcug nas 'dod chags chen pos zhu bar gyur te/39—142
