par snang mdzad lta bu rin po che'i me long dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /srin por sgra rdo rje ma mi bskyod pa lta bu pi wang sngon po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du dri rdo rje ma rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu dri chab kyi dung ser po dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ro rdo rje ma ①snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa ro'i snod dmar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgo'i g.yon logs su reg bya rdo rje ma don yod grub pa dang mtshungs pa gos sna tshogs dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgo'i g.yas logs su chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa chos 'byung dkar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha 'di rnams ni zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa phyag mtshan dang po gnyis ni g.yas pa dag gis so/ /gzhan gnyis ni g.yon pa dag gis 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i zhal ni sku mdog bzhin no/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo ru gshin rje mthar byed dang shes rab mthar byed dang pad+ma mthar byed dang bgegs mthar byed rnams so/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje dang rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo bcu po du rnams ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje skyil ①krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan ni nyi ma la'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma'i 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ④gtso bo'i phyag dag gis rang 'od kyi shes rab dag la 'khyud pa ste de bzhin du shes rab rnams du'od kyi thabs la'o/ /dbu la rigs kyi bdag po ste 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / mā ma tī dang sgra rngo 7rdo rje ma dang / srung ⑦ba'i 'khor lo'i khro bo brgyad la ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /39—267

spyan ma dang gzugs rdo rje ma dang gshin rje gshed rnams la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /dri rdo rje ma la ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gos dkar mo dang ro rdo rje ma dang pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med do/ /sgol ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma la ni don yod grub pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma la ni rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /'dir rdo rje sems dpa' ni sku mdog dkar po la cung zad dmar po'i ①mdangs dang ldan pa g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal ni sngon po dang dmar po gtso bo'i phyag dag gis rang 'od kyi shes rab la 'khyud pa rdo rje sngon po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang / zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zla ba'i mdog can rin po che'i cod pan dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa dbu la mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar dam tshig sems dpa' lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar zla bar ral gri'i yu ba la gnas pa'i sa bon rma ngo / /rtag pa dang rin 'byung dang / 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa dang mi bskyod pa rnams kyi thugs kar phyag mtshan la ji ltar rigs par zla ba'am/ nyi ma la/ rgyu/ 4/ dzī/bye khaṃ/hūṃ ngo / /spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams la dze+e rmā ①dzā tsā/ dzaḥ④hūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ ram̐ oṃcho—/ khro bo rnams la hūṃ ngo / /lha thams cad kyi snying po'i sngags ni rdo rje'i nga phreng bar bshad do/ /'dir rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor du mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa dang ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug la sogs pa ni ma bshad do//de med kyang mig gi mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pas mdzes par byas pa'i yi dam gyi lha'i sku cig car 39—268

kho na la legs par yongs su dag cing rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par rgyun du yang dang yang lhag par mos pa brtan par bya'o/ /snying po'i sngags la sogs pa bstan ①pa ni bum pa lhag par gnas pa la sogs pa la nye bar mkho ba'i ched ⑤du'o/ /gang gi tshe dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gtso bor gyur pa de'i dbus su gnas pa gzhan de'i gnas su dgod do/ /'od dpag med dkar por yang 'gyur te/ chos rnams dkar po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'dir ni ngag gi dbang phyug dkar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di dang 'chad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gang gi dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i gtso bo'i gnas gang du bshad pa de nyid du gtso bo de dkyil 'khor kyi dbang po la mngon par phyogs shing de ①dang 'khyud pa ni de la mngon du phyogs pa nyid de gzhan gyi gnas su phyin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir ni gzhal yas khang gi yan lag rnam pa chogasum ste/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i rdo rje'i gur dang / srung phya ba'i 'khor lo dang / chos 'byung ngo / /de la rdo rje'i gur ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzhal yas khang thams cad la'o/ /srung 6ba'i 'khor lo dang / chos 'byung ni 'ga' zhig kho na la 'chad do/ /bri bar bya ba'i gzhal yas khang rnams la ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo chos 'byung ngam chos kyi dbyings kyi khongs su chud par mtshon pa'i ched du rdo rje phreng ba bri bar bya'omu/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / zhes pas rdzogs rim gyi 5dkyil 'khor rtogs par bya ba'i ched du 'jig rten khams kyi khor yug mtshon pa'i phyir 1rdo rje phreng ba bri ba ni nges par ro//'dir srung ⑫ba'i 'khor lo ni de ltar ma yin pas bri mi dgos te/ bgegs bzlog pa ni gzhan gyis kyang byed pas so/ /gzhan yang stong pa nyid kho na/39—269

bcom ldan 'das kyis ①bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa rtsa ba dang bcas pa brlag par byed pa'i nus pa rab tu gyur pas/ de la lhag par mos pa brtan pa nyid bskyed pa'i ched du bri ba'i dkyil 'khor la srung ②ba'i 'khor lo bri bar ma bstan to—/ /bsgom bya'i dkyil 'khor la yang kha cig tu bsgom par gsungs pa las thams cad du ma yin no/ /bgegs bsal ba'i rjes la stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pas bsgom par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor la srung ④ba'i 'khor lo med de de'i phyir mi 'dri'o zhe na de ltar na khor yug mtshon pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba yang mi 'dri bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i dus su de yang bskyed do zhe na/ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje ra ba lan gsum ④bskyed par ni gang nas kyang ma gsungs so/ /lan gnyis bskyed pas ci zhig bya cig car rdzogs pa nyid kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang mtshams bcing ba dang rdo rje'i ra ba la sogs kun brtags mtha' dag stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma'i ngo bor gnas pa nyid do/ /des ni srung khruba'i 'khor lo yod kyang dkyil 'khor du mi 'dri ⑥ba'i 'thad pa brjod pa nyid do/ /kha cig ni kha cig la srung ⑦ba'i 'khor lo bri bar bya'o zhes 'dod do zhes bya ba ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro// //bsdus pa'i rim par gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor la ni gzhal yas khang gi bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /khro bo rnams kyi khyad par ni bshad par bya'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su mi bskyod pa nag po drag po g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal dkar po dang dmar po phyag g.yas pa rnams ni ⑧khro bo'i rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams na ⑨dril bu dang yid bzhin gyi nor 39—270

bu dang ral gri 'dzin pa rang dang 'dra ba'i reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa'o/ /de'i shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa dang /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su spyan ma la sogs pa'o/ /de la rnam par snang mdzad ni zhi ba dkar po'o/ /zhal dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dkar po dang dril bu dang nor bu dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /bshad zin pa ①dang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyag mtshan bye dang po nas rim pa bzhin du phyag g.yas par steng nas 'og tu dang / g.yon par 'og nas khusteng du rig par bya'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan ni ser po ste zhal ser po dang nag po dang dkar po'o/ /zhal rmi mdog gsum ni rim pa bzhin du rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon yin no/ /nor bu dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang / dril bu dang pad+ma ser po dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas dmar po zhal dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po phyag g.yon pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i yu ba thugs kar bzung ba/ phyag g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'o/ /gzhan rnams kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang / ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /don yod grub pa ni ljang gu zhal ljang gu rtedang nag po dang dkar po ral gri dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang dril bu dang pad+ma ljang gu dang nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po 'di dang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i kun du bzang bo'i bar ni ral pa'i thor cog dang rin po che'i cod pan dang rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /spyan ma ni rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang pad+ma dkar po'i gnas su at+pa la dkar po'o/ /mā ma tī ni mi bskyod pa lta bu ste 'on kyang pad+ma'i gnas su at+pa la sngon dmar ro/ /39—271

gos dkar mo ni snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa'o/ /sgol ma ni don yod grub pa lta bu sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang byed la sngo ser dang dril bu dang nor bu rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis par me'i mtshalas su gzugs rdo rje ma spyan ma lta bu ste 'on kyang dang po'i phyag dag gis me long dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma ser mo zhal ser po dang nag po dang ①dkar po dang ldan pa rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis pi wang sngon mo bsgring ④ba'o/ /phyag lhag ma dag gis 1rdo rje dang ut+pa la sngon mo ④dang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du dri rdo rje ma ni gos dkar mo lta bu rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos ser po 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ro rdo rje ma ljang gu zhal ljang gu dang nag po dang dkar bo phyag dang po gnyis ro'i sdod dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /lhag ma rnams kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu la byams pa dang sa'i snying po'o/ /lho'i snam bu la phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /nub kyi snam bu la spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs so/ /byang du sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang kun du bzang po'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni rang gi rigs kyi bdag po dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang byams pa ni rtsa ba'i phyag gis 'khor los mtshan pa'i yal ga dang bcas pa'i klu shing gi me tog 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo dang me la sogs pa'i mtshams dang steng dang 'og tu go rims bzhin du khro bo bcu'o/ /de la gshin rje gshed ni nag po nag po ④dang dkar po dang dmar po rdo rje'i tho ba dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs ⑪mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /shes 39—272

rab mthar byed ni dkar po zhal dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po/ rdo rje dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang / ral gri dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs ①mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed ni dmar po zhal dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po/ pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri dang gtun shing dang dril bu dang / dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bgegs mthar byed ni sngon po zhal sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang gtun shing dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs ②mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba ni sngon po zhal sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ ral gri dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang sdigs mdzub dang dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po ni sngon po zhal sngon po dang dzu dkar po dang dmar po/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa gzhan rnams kyis ④rdo rje dang ral gri dang zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyug pa sngon po ni nag po zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar bo/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang / ral gri dang 'khor lo dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang pad+ma dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /stobs po che ni nag po zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang pad+ma dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o—/ /gtsug tor 'khor los phye sgyur ba ni nag po zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis gtsug tor spyi bor 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag lhag ma rnams kyis rdo rje dang pad+ma dang sdigs mdzub dang ral gri rnams 'dzin 39—273

pa'o—/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo gan rkyal du mnyam par brkyang ba'i srin lag gnyis ni ①sen mo'i steng du mthe bo gnyis kyi sen mos mnan te mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang ngo / /de bzhin du gung mo gnyis kyi sen mo mnyam par yang dag par rtse sprad la/ mdzub mo gnyis dbus su rwa'i ⑤rnam pa ni kun du snang ba zhes bya ba gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o zhes kha cig go/ /'ga' zhig tu ni gzhan no/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po ①zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang pad+ma dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /mi baspyod pa la sogs pa 'di dag ni sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du go rims bzhin du rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang 'khor lo dang rin po che ma ra ka ④ta cha dgu pa dang pad+ma dmar bo dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang klu shing gi me tog dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang rdo rje dang tho ba dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dmar po dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang ral gri'i yu ba dang rdo rje dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang dbyug pa nag po dang rdo rje dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i nyi ma pedang zla ba la bzhugs pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /yang gzhan nas ni rang rang gi lha'i mdog lta bu'i rin po che las byas pa'o/ /de la rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /gzhan rnams ni nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rnams ni rdo rje'i skyil krung can no/ /khro bo rnams ni zhabs g.yon brkyang pa g.yas bskum pa zhal so so la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba sgra sgogs shing 'bar ba ste/ shin tu 'jigs pa srung duba'i 'khor lor 39—274

brjod pa'i 'jigs pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po kho na yum dang bcas pa ste gnod mdzes kyi bar du lha gzhan rnams yum med pa'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i gshin rje gshed la sogs pa ni rang gi 'od kyi shes rab dang bcas pa ste de rnams ni go rims bzhin du rdo rje ro langs ma dang / gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang khro gnyer can dang ral pa gcig ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang / sna tshogs rin chen ma dang / sna tshogs pad+ma dang / sna tshogs las ma dang / nam mkha' ①rdo rje ma dang / sa 'dzin ma rnams so/ /mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa dmar po yum dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ nag po'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi oṃ/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi swā/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi t+padon yod grub pa'i hā/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyi dze+e rmā r+pā tsā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ reg bya rdo rje ma'i khaṃ ngo / /byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po rnams kyi mi sh+lau/oṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ oṃ saṃ ngo / /khro bo bcu po rnams kyi hūṃ ngo / /lha rnams kyi snying po'i sngags ni rdo rje phreng bar brjod do/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni mi bskyod pa dang kun du bzang po gnyis kyi gong du brjod pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ 'on kyang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang / pad+ma dang dril bu dang / nor bu dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas yang dag par 'khyud pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mā ma tī dang / phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam dpal dang gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang / gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams kyi ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang gzugs rdo rje ma dang / byams 39—275

pa dang sa'i snying po dang gshin rje gshed dang mi g.yo ba rnams kyi rnam par snang mdzad do/ /sgra rdo rje ma dang nam mkha'i snying po dang / shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po rnams kyi ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gos dkar mo dang / dri rdo rje ma dang spyan ras gzigs dang pad+ma mthar byed dang dbyug pa sngon po rnams kyi ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sgol ma dang ro rdo rje ma dang reg bya 1rdo rje ma dang sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / bgegs mthar byed dang / stobs po che rnams kyi ni don yod grub pa'o/ /rgyas 'debs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad — rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa'o/ /dpal kun tu kha spyor gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur kyi nang du srung ba'i 'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus su rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor dang ri rab kyi steng du chos 'byung gi dkyil du gzhal yas khang ngo / /srung ba'i 'khor lor gshin rje gshed phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rnams bsnams pa/g.yon gsum gyis snying gar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab mthar byed ni rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje dang ral gri dang snying gar sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed ni lcags sgog dang pad+ma dang ral gri dang / dril bu dang dgra sta dang zhags pa'o/ /bgegs dgra ni rdo rje dril bu dang rdo rje rgya gram dang 'khor lo dang / snying gar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gtun shing dang dgra sta'o/ /mi g.yo ba ni ral gri dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang sdigs 39—276

mdzub dang dgra sta dang zhags pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po ni g.yas dang cig shos kyi phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang lcags kyu dang ral gri dang rdo rje dang zhags pa'o/ /dbyug pa sngon po ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang / ral gri dang 'khor lo dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang pad+ma dang dgra sta'o/ /stobs po che ni rtse gsum pa dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang / snying gar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang pad+ma dang dgra sta'o—/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ni g.yas dang cig shos kyi phyag dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang sdigs mdzub dang ral gri'o/ /gnod mdzes ni rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang ①/ snying gar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang pad+ma dang ral gri'o / /bcu po 'di dag ni dbu la thod pa lngas brgyan pa 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa mi mgo'i phreng ba ske la 'chang ⑤ba go rims bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa dang rtag pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa pa ④dang mi bskyod pa dang mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' zhal 'dzum pa dang ④bcas pa'i sku mdog dkar po la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa ral pa'i thor cog nag po la gnas pa'i nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i 'og tu g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i zla ba phyed pa dri ma med pa dang / sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga dang gtsug gi 'khor lo dang / rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang lag gdub dang ske rags dang thal ba rnams kyis ⑤brgyan pa zhal gsum 39—277

pa g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal sngon po dang dmar po zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa phyag drug pa rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bus rnam par mdzes pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab la 'khyud cing chu skyes la mnyam par sbyar /byeba'i dga' ba dang ldan pa phyag g.yas pa dag gis ral gri dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dkar dmar sems dpa'i 3skyil krung can sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan gyes spras pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan thu pa rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis/ rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab la 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i rang bzhin hūṃ nag po'i rnam pa'o/ /'dir sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can rdo rje 'chang gi shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhi ba phyag bzhi pa ④g.yas pa dag gis 'khor lo dang dril bu dang g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang zhags pa bsnams pa'othu/ /lhor ni 'urin chen 'byung ldan ser po phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis rin po che dang lcags kyu g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis mda' dang pad+ma g.yon pa dag gis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang lcags kyu/g.yon pa dag gis dril bu dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du spyan ma dkar mo phyag brgyad ma g.yas rnams kyis 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang ral gri 39—278

dang mda' rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa dang dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu rnams so/ /me ra mā ma tī sngon mo phyag bcu gnyis pa g.yas pa rnams kyis mda' dang ral gri dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang pad+ma'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang lcags kyu dang dril bu dang zhags pa dang thod pa dang kha ṭī ga'o/ /bden bral du gos dkar mo dmar mo phyag brgyad ma g.yas rnams kyis mda' dang pad+ma dang ral gri dang rdo rje rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang thod pa dang zhags pa dang / dril bu bsnams pa'oṭ+wā/ /rlung du sgrol ma ljang gu phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis dzu.ut+pa la dmar po dang ral gri dang / lcags kyu dang mda'o/ /cig shos rnams kyis 'khor lo dang zhags pa dang jod pa dang gzhu rnams so/ /rim pa gnyis pa la shar gyi phyogs su rdo rje drag mo dkar mo phyag na mda' dang lcags kyu dang gzhu dang byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rdo rje gzugs ma ser mo phyag na rdo rje dang / mdung dang zhags pa dang thod pa 1khrag gis gang ba'o/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo phyag na ral gri dang rdo rje dang chus gang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu'o/ /byang du rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang gu ni phyag na tal pa thung ngu dang ba dan gsum pa dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga dang sman gyis gang ba'i thod pa rnams so/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin ma rgyani dkar ser gye mdog la phyag na dbyug to dang at+pa la dang thod pa dang ḍa ⑤ ma ru'o/ /mer rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser phyag na pad+ma dang me long dang rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa dang dgra sta'o/ /bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma sngon dmar phyag na shasti dang dung dang 'khor lo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa'o/ /rlung du sa rdo rje ma dkar ljang 39—279

pad+ma dang rdo rje dang bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa mi lpags kyis g.yogs pa dang dril bu'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni phyag bzhi pa dang po'i phyag mtshan gnyis ni g.yas pa dag gis 'dzin pa gzhan gnyis ni g.yon pa dag gis 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar du bzhad ma dmar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas mngon par bzhad pa'i tshul can no/ /lhor sgeg mo sngon po shephyag gnyis rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas snyems bupa dang bcas pas mngon par sgeg pa'i tshul can no/ /nub tu glu ma ser mo ni sku cung zad g.yo zhing sgeg pa'i phyag gnyis kyis ting ting shag 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du gar ma ljang gu pad skor gyi tshul la sogs pa'i gar gyis g.yo ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo'o/ /mer pi wang ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma sgeg mo'i nyams kyis bag tsam lus g.yo ba'o/ /bden bral du mu kun+da kyem dkar mo'o/ /rlung du rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can no/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni phyag gnyis kyis rang rang gi rol cha brdung ba'o/ /de nas phyi'i snam bu la me'i mtshams su me tog ma dkar mo phyag g.yon gyis me tog gi phreng ba dang cig shos kyis 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can phyag g.yon gyis bdug spos kyi snod dang cig shos kyis rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du mar me ma gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yon du mar me'i kong ④bu g.yas su pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du dri chab ma dmar mo phyag g.yon gyis dri'i dung chos dang cig shos kyis ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /shar gyi phyogs su me long ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis me long 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor ro ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis ro'i snod 'dzin pa'o//39—280

nub tu reg ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis gos sna tshogs 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du chos ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis chos 'byung dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams dang rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i lha rnams ni zhal gcig spyan gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan nag po la thod pa lnga dang 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa/lha'i na bza' gon pa skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nam mkha'i mdog lta bu sngo bsangs zhal g.yas nag po g.yon dkar po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis lcags kyu dang ral gri dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon rnams kyis zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub dang dril bu'o/ /lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser zhal g.yas nag po g.yon dmar po/ phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis zhags pa dang rdo rje dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa'o/ /nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo zhal g.yas nag po g.yon dkar po phyag drug pa g.yas rnams kyis tūlcags sgog dang rdo rje dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu dang lcags kyu'o/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu zhal g.yas nag po g.yon dkar po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis dril bu dang rdo rje dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang lcags kyu dang zhags pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di khyarnams ni zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa dbu skra dmar ser 'bar zhing gyen du brdzes pa thod pa lnga dang 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa stag gi pags pa gon pa zhabs g.yas brkyang ba g.yon bskum pas gar byed pa'i tshul gyis sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub 39—281

pa rnams sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang nyi ma'i gdan la'o/ /lha gzhan thams cad ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa 7sna zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /thams cad kyang nyi ma'i 'od zer can kho na'o/ /'dir rdo rje sems dpa' kho na shes rab dang bcas pa ste/ lha gzhan thams cad shes rab ma grudang bral ba'o zhes pa ni phyogs gcig go/ /rang lta bu'i shes rab ma dang bcas pa zhes pa ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mā ma tī dang sgra rdo rje ma dang glu ma dang reg bya 1rdo rje ma dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang rdo rje drag mo dang sa'i rdo rje ma dang me tog ma dang / bzhad ma dang gling bu ma dang rdo rje lcags kyu ma rnams kyi rnam par snang mdzad do/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje sku ma dang rdo rje bdug spos ma dang / sgeg mo dang pi wang ma dang rdo rje zhags pa ma rnams kyi rin 'byung ngo / /gos dkar mo dang rdo rje chags pa ma dang /mar me ma dang dri chab ma dang mu kun+da rju ma dang lcags sgog ma rnams kyi snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sgol ma dang rdo rje zhi ba ma dang rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dang /gar ma dang ro ma dang / rdza rnga ma dang dril bu ma rnams kyi don yod grub pa'o/ /thugs ka'i sa bon ni rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams dkyil 'khor la dgod pa'i rim pas/ hūṃ byezhu/ dze+e tīḥkhaṃ hūṃ 7 / hūṃ s+thāḥtai i dze+e i sde sum̐ khru ⑦ e t+param̐ hūṃ/ ā+o rī lo byedzhai bo/ shaṃ baṃ bo khyadz+wa re/ oṃ oṃ e oṃ dza⑩ཿhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'i sngags ni oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ⑪ta ma hā su khaṃ haṃ swā hā zhes pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sngags oṃ t+pabadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥhaṃ swā hā zhes pa ni las ⑫thams cad pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor pa la ni 'khor 39—282

lo'i gtso bo'i snying po'i sngags nyid kyis lha gzhan rnams kyi snying po'i sngags kyis ① bsgrub bya yang 'grub par 'gyur bas de rnams ni ma bris te gzhung mangs pas 'jigs pas so/ /de bzhin du thog ma dang tha ma yang rig par bya'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gdugs dkar po dang bcas pa'i seng ge la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi mar ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo'o/ /'di'i cod pan dar gyis bcings pa'i steng du rdo rjes mtshan pa sangs rgyas lnga 'od 'phro bas brgyan pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal khro zhing gad rgyangs dang bcas pa/ g.yas dkar ba bzhad pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon dmar ba sgeg pa dang bcas pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gsum na steng du bstan pa'i kha ṭī ga dang dgra sta dang rdo rje'o/ /g.yon gyi gsum la dril bu dang khrag gis gang ba'i pyathod pa dang ral gri rnams so//'di'i shar gyi ①phyogs su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o—/ /byang phyogs su 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can no/ /nub tu ro langs ma dmar mo'o/ /lho phyogs su gtum mo sngon mo'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag kyang seng ge la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi phyag gnyis kyis ④steng du bgreng ba'i kha ṭī ga dang khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du seng ge mo ni seng ge'i gdong pa can g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba'i lus phyed phyed pa bam̐glang po che dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su stag mo stag gi gdong pa can g.yon 39—283

sngon mo g.yas dkar ba phyed phyed kyi sku rin po che bdun gyi phung po la gnas pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su ce srung ma ce spyang gi gdong can g.yas dmar ba g.yon nag po'i lus phyed phyed pa ma he la bzhugs pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su 'ug pa mo 'ug pa'i gdong can g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lus phyed phyed pa ser po dang dmar po'o/ /klu brgyad kyi gzhug ma rnams la bzhugs pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje zhags pas brgyan cing sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o / /de'i shar sgor rgyal ba'i dbang phyug ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis thal mo khar bcug pa'o/ /byang du gsal byed ma ser mo mar me lta bu'i thal mo kha sbyar ba spyi bor 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu 'jigs byed ma dmar mo khrag gis gang ba'i snyim pa steng du byas te kha'i thad kar bzung nas khrag gi kyergyun 'thung bar byed pa'o/ /lhor kaspo 2dzi nag po rdo rje'i snyim pa la mthe bo'i rtse mo gnyis phan tshun sbyar te sdigs mdzub gnyis kyi rtse mo brkyang ba sbyar nas rang gi gsang ba'i gnas ston par byed pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i yi dwags kyi snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis ni zhal gcig la spyan gsum pa'o/ /lha mo bcu gsum po thams cad kyang lha'i gos dmar po mnabs pa dbu la thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung can klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan pa bskal pa'i mtha'i me 'bar ba'i 'od lta bu'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis 'jigs par byed pa go rims bzhin du mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod 39—284

grub pa dang mi bskyod pa dang / rnam snang dang rin 'byung dang snang mtha' dang /rtag pa dang 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa rnams kyis rgyas btab pa'o—/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rmā ā+o dze+e dṛ drwa sna oṃ oṃ a(gaḥ'adi rnams ni thugs ka'i sa bon rnams so/ /oṃ byāzu ཿswā hā/ zhes bya ba ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ be+e tā zilī hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni ro langs ma'i sngags te las thams cad pa'o// //bcu bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi kye 3rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dkyil na gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru la gnas pa'i ro'i snying gar gnas pa'i khrag gis gang 9ba'i thod pa'i steng du nyi ma la kye'i rdo rje rnam pa gsum mo/ /bzhi pa la ni ro dang bral ba'o/ /de la 'jig rten gsum kun du bskyod pa nag po sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thudabu skra kham ser gyen du badze+es pa thod pa lnga dang phyag rgya drug dang / mi mgo zlon pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /rgyab kyi char stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can zhabs g.yon pa'i brla la g.yas pa'i zhabs kyi rtse mo yang dag par bzhag pa'i skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa spyan gsum dmar la 8zlum pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin pa9 /'chad par 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin gyis bdag med ma la 'khyud pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbyug pa brdeg pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /yang na phyag bzhi pa phyag gnyis pa lta bu phyag ⑫gzhan gnyis kyis bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje phag mo la yang dag par 'khyud pa'o zhes bya ba 'di ni khyad par ro/ /yang na phyag 39—285

drug pa nag po zhal gsum pa nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa phyag g.yas pa rnams ni rdo rje dang mda' dang rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dril bu dang gzhu dang thod pa'o/ /rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma la 'khyud pa ste/ gzhan ni ji ltar rigs par snga ma bzhin no/ /te ru ka 'di gsum gyi shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma brgyad la rdo rje drag mo la sogs pa brgyad do/ /de dag gi phyi rol du dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su gling bu ma dang pi wang ma dang mu kuṇ+ḍa ma dang rdza rnga ma rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma dang / rdo rje lcags sgog ma dang rdo rje dril bu ma rnams so/ /lha mo bcu drug po 'di rnams ni gang ①bzhin te/ yab dang bral ba'o/ /te ru ka gsum gyi rngorigs kyi bdag bo mi bskyod pa'o/ /thugs ka'i sa bon hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni oṃ t+pahūṃ s+thārjuḥswā hā/ so so'i sngags ni rim pa bzhin du oṃ tram̐ lokyā k+ṣe pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ④bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so/ /kye'i rdo rje phyabazhi pa ni phyag bcu drug pa mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa bdag med pa yidang snyoms par 'jug pa/ 'on kyang 'di la gong du bshad pa'i ro'i gnas su bdud bzhi ste/ de la phung po'i bdud kyi rang bzhin tshangs pa ser po/nyon mongs pa'i bdud khyab 'jug nag po/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dbang phyug chen po dkar po/ lha'i bu'i bdud ni brgya byin kham ser ro⑦/ /der bcom 39—286

ldan 'das zhabs bzhi pa'i zhabs gnyis kyis rdo rje'i skyil krung phyed pa dang gzhan gnyis kyis ni g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ sku mdog nag po dang sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa nas stag gi pags pa'i bar du sngar bshad pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa zhal brgyad pa spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal nag po gad mo can g.yas pa dkar po g.yon dmar po steng du gnas pa'i mche ba gcigs pa lhag ma rnams ni nag po'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams ni rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang 'khor lo dang thod pa dang dbyug pa dang rtse gsum pa dang lcags kyu rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams su dril bu dang pad+ma dang gzhu dang ①kha ṭī ga bgreng ba dang thod pa dang rin po che dang sdogs mdzub dang zhags pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar go rī dkar ser phyag g.yas pa gnyis na mda' phyung ba dang rdo rje gri gug go/ /g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang nya ro hi ta dang bcas pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa'o/ /lhor tso rī rngo dmar mo rdo rje dang ḍa zhu ma ru dang lcags kyu dang phag pa dang bcas pa'i thod pa khrag gis gang ba'o/ /nub tu ro langs ma ni sku mdog dkar ser ral gri dang rus sbal dang bcas pa'i thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang chang gis gang ba'i thod pa dang dri chus gang ba'i thod pa'o/ /byang du ghasma rī ljang gu cung zad ser ba rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa la lgoganas pa'i sbrul dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me thab dang dgra sta'o/ /dbang ldan du puk+ka sī ser mo shas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i seng ge dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang dpag bsam shing gi yal ga dang rin po che'o/ /me'i mtshams su sha ba rī dkar mo byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod par gnas pa'i dge slong dang rdo rje dang kha ṭī ga dang zhags pa'o/ /srin po'i ltamatshams su tsaṇ+ḍa 39—287

lbo ①sngon mo g.yas su khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa la stag dang g.yon du pad+ma dkar po dang phyag gnyis na rlung ras so/ /rlung gi mtshams su ḍo bi nī ④nag mo chang gis gang ba'i rjuthod pa dang rtse gsum pa gyen du bstan pa dang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i ce spyang dang gshol lo/ /de dag gi phyi'i zur rnams su gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhi snga ma bzhin du'o/ /shar gyi sgo ru rta gdong ma nag mo zhal rnams nag mo dang dkar mo ④dang ser mo dang steng gi rta gdong ljang gu'o/ /lho ru phag gdong ma ser mo zhal rnams ni ser mo dang nag mo dang dkar mo'i steng du phag zhal dmar po'o/ /nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar po ⑤zhal rnams ni dmar mo dang nag mo dang dkar mo'i steng du khyi gdong ser po'o/ /byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang gu zhal rnams ni ljang gu dang nag mo dang dkar mo'i steng du seng ge'i gdong pa dmar po'o/ /'di ltar rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang cig shos dang steng gi rim pas zhal bzhi pa'o/ /sgo skyong ma rnams phyag bzhi pa rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa bzhin du phyag mtshan 'dzin pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i ro'i steng du g.yas bskum pa dang g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams ni skyil krung phyed pa dang ldan pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re zhing spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa yab med pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /ghasma rī'i oṃ oṃ swā hā/ zhes pa ni las thams cad pa'i sngags so / /du 39—288

bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur kyi nang du hu chos 'byung gi dbus su gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bdag med pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar rdo rje ma dang go rī ma dang chu kyem dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /rim pa gnyis par sna tshogs pad+ma rnams la shar la sogs par go rī tsa/ tso rī be+e tā ④byā ghasma rī rnams so—/ /dbang ldan la sogs par puk+ka sī ⑤dang sha ba rī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī 6dang ḍo bi be+e rnams so/ /bdag med ma'i steng gi shar ngos kyi pad+ma la gnas pa'i mkha' spyod ma steng zhal can no/ /'og gi nub ngos kyi pad+ma la gnas pa'i sa spyod ma 'og zhal can no/ /'dir phyi ma la gnas pa'i go rī la sogs pa brgyad ni phyag bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor lta bur kye ser po la sogs pa'i mdog can no/ /gzhan bdun ni sngon mo'o/ /bco lnga po yang skyil krung phyed pas ro'i snying gar gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa dmar ba dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can phyag bzhi pa g.yas dag gis rdo rje dang gri gug go/ /g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang / gyen du bsgreng ba'i kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /dbu la thod pa lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /zur rnams la gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhi ni snga ma bzhin no/ /shar gyi sgor rta gdong ma dkar sngo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser sngo/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar sngo/ byang du seng gdong ma ljang sngo/ bzhi po 'di dag kyang g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis nyi ma la gnas pa'o—/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ming gis byerjes su mthun pa'i zhal gcig ma phyag 1gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /39—289

'di dag gi khyad par kyeni bdag med ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /bdag med ma la sogs pa rnams la go rims bzhin du mi bskyod pa dang rtag pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa dang mi bskyod pa dang /rtag pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang rnam par snang mdzad dang mi bskyod pa rnams kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs pa dang stag tsagadong ma la sogs pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams kyis so/ /bdag med ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni dze+e oṃ saṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni ghasma rī'i sngags te las thams cad pa'o/ /yang na bdag med ma la sogs pa lha mo bco lnga'i bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de la lha mo thams cad sku mdog nag mo g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa mchod phyir thogs pa 'dra ba'i kha ṭī ga dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhan rnams ni gong ma tshi bzhin no/ /oṃ snyabadz+ra ghasma rī oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni ghasma rī'i sngags so// //gang gi tshe dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po ku ru kul+le dmar mo phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis kyis mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis at+pa la dmar po dang gzhu 'dzin pa zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa snang ba mtha' yas kyis rigs kyi bdag po byas pa/ rdo rje ma la sogs pa bcu bzhi sgu mdog dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa bco lnga po thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang ro'i snying gar zla ba la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'o/ /ku ru kuste'i snying ga'i sa 39—290

bon ni s+thāḥ.oṃ ku ru kupre ① s+thāḥswā hā/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /gzhan ni sngar bzhin du ste de'i tshe ku ru kul+le'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro / /༄na rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rjudakyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'brur zla ba la dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa me tog thra choyang ku lta bu ljang ser/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal gsum me tog pri thuyang ku lta bu ljang ser dang dkar po dang dmar po sna tshogs pa'i lag gdub dang rkang gdub la sogs pa dang gos rnams kyis brgyan pa phyag drug pa rdo rje dang dril bur bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa g.yas pa gnyis kyis du'akhor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis ⑦zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams kyi petshogs can no/ /shar kyi 'dab mar zhi ba mo dkar mo zhal gsum ni dkar ba dang nag ⑨pa dang dmar ba'o/ /lhor zhi gdong ma ser mo zhal gsum ni ser po dang / dkar po dang ⑩dmar po'o/ /nub tu zla ldan ma dmar mo zhal gsum ni dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po'o/ /byang du ri bong can ma ljang gu zhal gsum ni ljang gu dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /me'i mtshams su zla dkyil ma sngon mo zhal gsum ni sngon mo dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /bden bral du zla tshes ma me tog pri yang ku lta bu ljang ser mo zhal gsum ni ljang ser dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /rlung du yid 'ong ma at+pa la sngon mo'i mdog can zhal gsum ni sngon mo dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /dbang ldan du yid tshim 39—291

byed ma gser gyi mdog can ma zhal gsum ni ser po dang dkar bo dang dmar po'o / lha mo 'di rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i phyag mtshan lta bu 'dzin pa'o / /'on kyang 'khor lo'i gnas su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /zla tshes ma ni zla ba'i cha gcig 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis par dbang ldan gyi mtshams su me tog ma dkar mo ni zhal gsum pa dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'o—/ /mer bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can zhal gsum pa du ba'i mdog dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'o/ /bden bral du mar me ma gser gyi mdog can ma 1zhal gsum pa gser mdog dang dkar po dang nag po'o/ /rlung du dri chab ma dmar mo zhal gsum pa dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po'o/ /'di rnams ni go rims bzhin du g.yas kyi dang pos me tog gi za ma tog dang spos phor dang mar me'i mchod sdong dang dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag lhag ma rnams kyis gtso bo'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i snam bu la gling bu ma dang pi wang ma dang mu kun+da ma dang rdza rnga ma rnams ni dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po dang du ba'i mdog can gyi zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis kyis 2gling bu la sogs pa'i sgra sgrogs par bsgon pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor khro gnyer rim par ldan ma sngon po nam mkha' lta bu sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum mo/ /lho'i sgor 'jigs sdigs dkar po 'jigs su rung ba dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum mo/ /nub sgor rta'i gzugs can dmar mo dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po'i zhal gsum mo/ /byang sgor tshogs kyi gtso bo ljang gu ljang gu dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum pa'o4/ /'di dag ni 'gying ba'i khro bo 'gying ba'i stang stabs kyis bzhugs pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i phyag 39—292

mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /khyad par ni g.yas dang po'i phyag gis ⑨rim pa ji lta bar lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang / lcags sgog dang dril bu 'dzin pa mche ba cung zad gcigs pa'o/ /'dir dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i gzugs brnyan ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan dang ldan pa'o/ /de las gzhan pa'i lha nyi shu pa rnams ni rdo rje dang zhubadud rtsi dang po tis mtshan pa'i rin po che'i cod pan can zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa—/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lta bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa la sogs pa'o/ /me tog ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi zla ba'i 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni haḥ'o/ /oṃ haḥbadz+ra a mṛ ta swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang 'di nyid yin no/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi gzhan rnam pa gsum po kye'adi ltar bsgom pa'i khyad par gyi rim pa ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud nyid las shes par bya'o/ /mangs pas 'jigs pas 'dir ma bshad do// //dgu'i bdag nyid kyi dgyes pa rdo rje rnam pa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du gnas pa'i chos 'byung la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang ngo / /phyag bcu drug pa la slar yang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lta bu srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yang yod do zhes pa ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba'i nang du gan rkyal du gnas pa'i tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug dang / lha'i dbang po ste/ bdud rnam pa bzhi'i rang bzhin can gyi snying gar gnas pa'i nyi ma la zhabs bzhi pa gcer bu gar gye 39—293

nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis skyil krung phyed pa dang / zhabs gnyis kyis g.yon bskum pa dang / g.yas brkyang ba'i gar gyi tshul gyis gnas pa dang spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa dpral ba'i steng du pags pa dang bral ba'i mi mgo skam po lngas brgyan pa sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ sgu mdog nag po phyag bcu drug pa zhal brgyad pa/zhal re re la dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum yod pa rtsa ba'i zhal nag po g.yas pa rnams ni dkar po dang nag po dang nag po'o/ /g.yon pa rnams ni dmar po dang nag po dang nag po'o/ /steng gi zhal ni du ba'i mdog can mi sdug pa zhal thams cad ni smin ma kyog ṣ+pepo dang bcas pa khro gnyer can mche ba'i myu gu gcigs pa g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad kyis bsnams pa'i thod pa rnams la glang po che dang rta dang bong bu dang / glang dang rnga mo dang mi dang shar bha dang byi la rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad pa'i thod pa rnams ni sa dang chu dang rlung dang me dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang gshin rje dang nor sbyin rnams so/ /gtsug gi 'khor lo dang rna cha dang mgul rgyan 27dang lag gdub dang ska rags dang thal ba rnams dang mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang dpung rgyan dang rkang gdub rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /'di'i yum bdag med ma nag mo gcer bu gri gug dang thod par ldan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la yang dag par 'khyud pa/ g.yas bskum pa g.yon brkyang ba'i gar gyis gnas pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa zhal gcig pa stan ④gsum pa dmar la zlum pa mche ba gcigs pa dbu skra dmar ser 'bar ba gyen du bsdes pa/ dpral ba'i mtshams su thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ mgrin par mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba 'phyang ba dang /39—294

rkang gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi 'dab mar gnas pa'i tshangs pa dang dbang po dang nye ba'i dbang po dang drag po'i snying ga'i steng du zla ba rnams la go rī la sogs pa'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab mar gnas pa'i gshin rje dang lus ngan dang srin po dang / thags hūṃ bzangs ris kyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i puk+ka sī la sogs pa'o—/ /de la go rī nag mo g.yas na gri gug g.yon na ro hi ta'i nya 'dzin pa'o/ /tso rī dmar mo g.yas ḍa ma ru g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs ma gser gyi mdog can g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis rus sbal dang pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o—/ /ghasma rī ljang gu phyag g.yas pa na sbrul g.yon pa na rnal 'byor gyi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /puk+ka sī sngon mo phyag g.yas pa na seng ge g.yon pa na dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /sha ba rī ②dkar mo phyag g.yas pa na dge slong g.yon pa na gsel nabyed 'dzin pa'o/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ④nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs ma phyag g.yas pa na 'khor lo g.yon pa na gshol 'dzin pa'o/ /ḍo bi nī khra mo phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /khyad par gzhan ni sngar brjod pa'i bdag med ma bzhin no/ /he ru ka dang bdag med ma dag gi rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa'o//go rī la sogs pa rnams ni mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas so/ /puk+ka sī la sogs pa rnams kyi yang ngo //yang na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas rdo rje gyen du 'phyar ba g.yon pa sgerdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pas bdag med ma la 'khyud pa kha ṭī ga dpung pa g.yon pa la brten pa'o/ /yang na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phyag bzhi 39—295

pa sngon po phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ①ba 'dzin pa phyag lhag ma dag rang dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /yang na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phyag drug pa sngon po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal gsum sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang gri gug dang g.yon pa dag gis rtse gsum pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa lhag ma dag gis rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma la 'khyud pa'o/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma ni sku mdog dang zhal dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa rnams bdag med ma dang mtshungs par yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs kyis gsungs so/ /phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa 'di rnams sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru la ro'i snying gar nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pas gar mdzad pa mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa mi mgo lngas dbu brgyan pa/ smin ma 'khyog pa dang bcas pa'i khro gnyer can mche ba gcigs pa phyag bcu drug pa bzhin du gtsug gi 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa go rī la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bskor ①ba'o/ /lha mo thams cad ni thal ba dang bral ba'o/ /rdo rje phag mo dang rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma ni mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /kye'i rdo rje rnam pa bzhi'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni phyag bcu drug pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ tre ①lokyā k+ṣe pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni phyag gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag bzhi pa'o/ /oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag drug pa'o/ /oṃ t+pabadz+ra ghasma rī oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni ghasma rī'i sngags te las thams cad pa'o// //39—296

sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i ①dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang na gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi dbus su gzhal yas khang ngo / /kha cig ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung med par gzhal yas khang ngo zhes so/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma ②brgyad pa'i ze 'brur nyi ma la sgyu ma chen mo las byung ba'i he ru ka nag po nyi ma lta bu'i 'od zer can 'bar ba'i phreng ba du mas 'khrigs pa 'gying ba'i khro bo dbu skra dmar ser 'bar ba gyen du badze+es pa jod pas brgyan pa'i cod pan can rtsa ba dang g.yas dang rgyab dang g.yon gyi zhal bzhi sngon po dang ser po dang dkar po dang ljang gu'o/ /zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum pa phyag bzhi pa'i g.yas gnyis na thod pa dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭī ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa snyemi'i pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma ni sku mdog dmar mo gtso bo lta bu'i phyag mtshan can phyag gnyis kyis de'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po dang ljang gu'i zhal lo/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo ser po dang dkar po dang ljang gu'i zhal rdo rje dang thod pa dang dril bu dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o—/ /lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po dang ljang gu'i zhal rin po che'i pa tra dang tri shu ④la dang mgrin pa btsir ba'i ce spyang dang ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo dkar po dang ser po dang dmar ⑤po dang / ljang gu'i zhal sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda' dang thod pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu ljang gu rjodang ser po dang dkar po dang sngon po'i zhal lo/ /ral gri dang ḍa ⑦ma 39—297

ru dang zhags pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad kyang phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa / zla ba'i gdan la khye'od dang ldan pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi khyad par gzhan rnams ni gtso bo lta bu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi kye rigs kyi bdag po ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyang go rims ji ltar rnam snang dang / mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang ngag gi dbang phyug dang don yod grub pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i sa bon — hūṃ ngo / /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ snying po'i sngags so/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyi yang oṃ oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ swā hūṃ/ oṃ yisahūṃ/ oṃ haṃ hūṃ/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags ni las thams cad pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu'i bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /de'i ze 'bru la ro'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la shes rab ma dang bral ba'i bcom ldan 'das sku mdog la sogs pa phyi nas 'chad pa'i 'khor lo gsum la gnas pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thod pa bzhin no/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i 'dab ma la rim pa ji lta bas sna tshogs sde ma dang 'dod ma dang sa 'og na gnas ma dang legs bzangs mo rnams ni sku mdog sngon mo g.yas bskum pa g.yon brkyang ba stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can phyag g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭī dang ḍa 1 ma ru 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan dang me dang bden bral dang / rlung gi 'dab ma la chang 'tshong ④ma dang 'byung mo dang phyag bzhi ma dang nam mkha' la gnas ma rnams ni ser mo na bza' ser po 39—298

gon pa 'od zer ①ser po 'phro ba zhabs gnyis kyis g.yas brkyang ba g.yon bskum pa klu brgyad kyis ⑤brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍa kye ma ru/g.yon gnyis kyis ④kha ṭī ga dang pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gar gyi tshul gyis gnas pa dbu skra ser po gyen du badze+es pa/ dbu la jod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang ldan pa phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu mgul du 'phyang ba mche ba cung zad gcigs pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas lngas rgyas btab pa'o/ /sna tshogs sde ma la sogs pa rnams la mi bskyod pa dang rnam snang dang rin 'byung dang snang mtha' rnams kyis so/ /chang 'tshong ⑤ma la sogs pa rnams kyi stsoyang de dag rnams so/ /yang na bcom ldan 'das 'di dang phyogs kyi lha mo rnams kyang mdog dkar mo mtshams kyi lha mo rnams dmar po 'di ni yum dang bral ba'am yum dang bcas pa'o/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su gzhal yas khang ngo / /de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang bas mnan pa'i 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i bcom ldan 'das khro bo ni bskal pa 'jig dus ⑦me lta bu'i 'od zer 'bar zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad rab tu bsal bar mdzad pa sku mdog sngon po sngon po 'u7dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi mi sdug kyepa gdangs pa/mche ba gcigs pa rab tu gtum pa ljags 'dril 7ba 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal 39—299

gsum pa re re zhing spyan gsum gsum pa ①dmar la zlum pa smin ma g.yo ba khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ dpral ba'i steng na thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgul par 'phyang ba yum dang bcas pa klu mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra 'bar zhing dmar ser gyen du bcings pa/ klu 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ klu pad+ma chen po pad+ma'i rtsa ba lta bu dkar pos mgul rgyan byas pa/ klu karko ṭa drur ba lta bu ④ljang gus mchod phyir thogs byas pa nor rgyas dkar pos ska rags byas pa/ pad+ma dkar po kun da'i ①me tog lta bur mdzes pas rkang gdub byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas pa/ rigs ldan du ba lta bu khra bos dpung rgyan byas pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu la rgyas btab pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyis 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas ④rang gi yum la snyoms par zhugs pa g.yas gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /'di'i shar phyogs su rdo rje dbyug pa sngon po sngon po dang ser po dang ljang gu ni rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje tho ba dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gyen du 'phyar ba/g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser po dang sngon po dang ljang gu'i zhal lo/ /khyad par du ⑤phyag dang pos rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ khyad par du rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rnams kyang rdo rje dbyug pa lta bu'o/ /'og nas 'chad pa rnams kyang de ltar shes par bya'o/ /byang du rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar po dang ljang gu'i zhal lo/ /pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa'i phyag go/ /lhor rdo rje 'khyil ba ljang gu ni ljang gu dang dkar po 39—300

dang ser po'i zhal lo/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phyag go/ /mer rdo rje gnod sbyin du ba'i mdog du ba'i mdog ①dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal lo/ /lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /srin por rdo rje bdud rtsi tso dmar po dmar po dang /ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal lo/ /dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du nag po chen po sngon po dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal tri shu la rngu'adzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba nag po ④nag po dang / ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa la sogs pa brgyad po 'di rnams ni rim pa ji lta bar ⑤gshin rje mthar byed dang shes rab mthar byed dang pad+ma mthar byed dang bgegs mthar byed dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang stobs po che dang mi g.yo ba rnams kyi ming gzhan no/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dkar po dkar po ⑥dang sngon po dang ljang gu'i zhal 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /'og tu rdo rje sa 'og gnod mdzes kyi ming rnam grangs can sngon po sngon po ④dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal rol pa dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ /'di'i phyag duganyis kyis klu'i zhags pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa dang kha ṭī ga'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa la sogs pa'i khro bo 'di rnams ni phyag mtshan kyi gtso bo dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang mtshungs pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /dbu skra dmar ser 'bar zhing gyen du 'khyel ba rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos cod pan mdzes par brgyan (7 pa smin ma g.yo ba dang ⑩bcas pa'i khro gnyer can mche ba gadzigs pa'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa dmar zhing zlum pa mi mgo'i phreng ba dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa dang klu'i rgyal bo brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la 39—301

gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang steng du tshangs pa dang 'og tu thags ①bzangs ris rnams la g.yas brkyang gis mnan nas bzhugs pa rang gi rigs kyi bdag bos dbu brgyan pa ste/ ji ltar 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsibs bcu pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor bshad pa bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ kha badz+ra j-ika bubadz+ra hūṃ ka ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi snying po'i sngags so/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags ni oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ①bya ba'o/ /yang shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dang steng dang 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan rnams la g.yas skor gyis gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa'i khro bo bcu'o/ /'di rnams kyi gnas dang sku mdog la sogs pa bsdus pa'i rim par gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin no/ /yang na 'jam pa'i rdo rje ④srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu pa bzhin no/ /yang na kun du kha sbyor gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /phyogs 'di gsum ka la yang oṃ u bihūṃ ta kṛta ⑤hūṃ zhes bya bas ⑥bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags te las thams cad pa'o// //bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mo g.yas brkyang gi zhabs gnyis kyis mnan pa'i bcom ldan 'das sku mdog nag po shar dang byang la sogs pa'i zhal bzhi nag po dang ljang gu dang dmar bo dang ser po zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa stag gi pags pa'i 39—302

sham thabs can/ phyag bcu gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rgyab tu glang po che dkar po'i pags pa khrag dang bcas pa brgyangs nas 'dzin pa/ de las gzhan pa'i g.yas pa'i phyag rnams kyis ḍa ma ru dang dgra sta dang gri gug dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa—/ g.yon rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang rdo rje zhags pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams so/ /mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgul du 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa'i mi'i rgyu mas mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po rnam par 'gyur zhing gdangs pa/ mche ba gatshigs pa'i zhal can gar gyi nyams dgu'i tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo ni dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa skra'i tshogs grol ba gcer bu thod pa'i dum bu'i ska rags bcings pa 'khyud pa'i phyag gis bzung ba'i thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzag khyepa'i rgyun gtso bo la stob pa/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa rdo rje steng du 'phyar ba'i phyag g.yas pas gdug pa rnams la sdigs )par byed pa khrag dang bral ba'i mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba can nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can—/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa cung zad bzhad pa zla mtshan 'bab pa dang bcas pa spu gyen du langs pa'o/ /de nas shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams la g.yon skor kyi ④dang / me la sogs pa'i phyogs bral rnams la g.yas skor gyis dgod do/ /de la phyogs kyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma dang / lā mā kru dang /dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can ma rnams ni ⑤nag mo dang ljang gu dang dmar 39—303

mo dang / ser mo'i mdog can rnams zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa dbu skra grol ba phyag bzhi ma g.yon pa gnyis kyis kha ṭī ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa dag gis ḍa hu)ma ru dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa rnams so—/ /mtshams kyi 'dab mar byang chub kyi sems dang khrag dang bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga rnams grub pa'i bcud lta bu'i bdud rtsir gyur pas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod rnams so/ /yang na bzhi char yang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o/ /de nas thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs su thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo'o/ /byang du keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /nub tu keng rus dang 'od ldan ma'o/ /sgo ru mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma'o/ /mer chang dgra ma ②dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'o/ /srin por 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma'o/ /rlung du rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma'o/ /rim pa de bzhin du gsung gi 'khor lo la myu gu can dang sa srung ma'o④// /rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo'o—/ /dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma'o/ /rdo rje bzang po dang lha mo sngo bsangs ma'o/ /rdo rje 'od dang shin tu bzang mo'o/ /'jigs byed chen mo dang rta rna ma'o/ /mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma'o/ /de bzhin du sku'i 'khor lo la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma'o/ /rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma'o/ /nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha 'dzin pa'obu/ /dpal te ru ka dang shin tu bzang mo'o/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyu ra ma'o/ /rdo rje sems 39—304

dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /de la thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa dpa' bo rnams zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can dpral bar tsho gnas pa'i rdo rje phreng bas mtshan pa'i dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs can phyag bzhi pa 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu g.yon pas kha ṭī ga dang g.yas pa ḍa ④ma ru bsnams pa/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang dpung rgyan 3can mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa drag po'i gzugs can ma dbu skra grol ba'i gcer bu ma/ phyag gnyis pa 'khyud pa'i phyag gis thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa gdug pa rnams bsdigs pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'o—/ /sgo rnams la khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma dang phag gdong ma rnams ni mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhin no/ /khyad par du 'di rnams kyi zhal ni ming gi rjes su mthun pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje pho nya ma ④ dang / gshin rje mche ba ma dang gshin rje 'joms ma rnams ni mi'i zhal lo/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyogs kyi lha mo gnyis kyi dugayas dang g.yon gyi sku phyed phyed 'dra ba'o/ /brgyad po 'di rnams ni ro'i gdan can no/ /ḍā ki ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni mi mgo'i phreng ba can rdo rje phreng bas dpral bar brgyan pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa ska rags la sgra dang bcas pa'i g.yer ga la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥mi bskyod pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par snang mdzad do—/ /ḍā ki ma la sogs pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan dang / thugs dang gsung dang sku'i 'khor lor gnas pa rnams ni mi bskyod pa dang snang ba mtha' yas dang 39—305

rtag pa rnams so/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo la gnas pa rnams ni don yod grub pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru rka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki bhā dzā la saṃ ①ba ram̐ swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba ni dum skyes ma'i sngags te las thams cad pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams kyi ni kho bos dpal bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa'o/ /yang dkyil 'khor byi dbang phyug la sogs pa nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar thams cad ni zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa de la dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lngas ༷ 'khyud pa'i g.yas g.yon gye phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ ḍā ki ma la sogs pa bzhi dang khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams ni g.yon pas thod pa dang dpung pa la brten pa'i kha ṭī ga dang g.yas pa ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa gzhan thams cad ni gong bzhin no/ /yang na 'dir 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la sogs pa phyag gnyis pa nyid kyis spyophyogs la dpal bde mchog dang rdo rje phag mo gnyis kyis /④gser gyi mdog gam sngon pos yang ste/ bcom ldan 'das ni phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gsor 'ub la mchog tu brtson pa g.yon pas thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'am/ yang na rdo rje dang dril bu'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pas gnas pa'o/ /ḍā ki ma la sogs pa bzhi ni ser mo g.yas pa ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa rnams so/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams nag po rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ④dpa' mo rnams dkar mo phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can rnams so/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams ni dmar po pad+ma dang pad+ma'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /ḍā ki ma rnams ni nag mo phyag g.yas pa na pad+ma dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i 39—306

dpa' bo rnams ni dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo rnams ni dmar mo g.yas pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa rnams so/ /dpa' bo thams cad ni yum la 'khyud par brtson pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa rnams so/ /dpa' mo rnams ni de'i brla gnyis la 'khril ①ba'i tshul lo/ /khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams ni 5 g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo thams cad ni g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gshin rje brtan ma la sogs pa ni g.yas pas ḍā ma ru g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i mi mgo 'dzin pa'o/ /ḍā ki ma la sogs pa rnams dang khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams kyi g.yon pa'i dpung pa la kha ṭī ga'o/ /bcu gnyis po 'di rnams ni skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa khyad par gzhan thams cad ni gong bzhin no/ /'di ni bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum mo// //gang gi tshe 'di rnams la dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga mi bsgom par rdo rje phag mo zhu dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa de'i tshe rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gsum mo—/ /rdo rje phag mo'i snying ga'i sa bon ni baṃ mo/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī sgoye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa ni snying po'o/ /bde mchog gi phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa ltalha 'di rnams kyi 'u phyag g.yas su gnas pa'i phyag mtshan ni bri bya'i dkyil 'khor la ⑦ bri bar bya'o// //bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi 39—307

dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur kyi nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa nag po la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi ze 'brur ro/ /gan rkyal gyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog nag po skyil krung phyed pa gar gyi nyams dgus gar byed pa zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa g.yas kyi phyag gnyis na ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gyi phyag gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag rgya drug pa mi mgo zlon pa ① lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgrin pa ④la 'phyang ba/ gnyis 'thung gi pags pa'i sham thabs cung zad rgyab na nyil ba sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan pa sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan ①can no/ /mnga' bdag 'di'i btsun mo ni sna tshogs sde ma gcer bu mi mgo'i phreng ba can skra sil bur 'gro zhing gyen du 'bar ba thod pa lngas dbu brgyan pa/ mche ba cung zad gcigs pa sgu mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis khruspyan gsum ma rjo/ yab kyi mgrin pa la chags pa'i phyag g.yon pas thod pa khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob pa/ g.yas kyi phyag gis gri gug brdeg ⑦pa'i tshul lo/ /shar gyi rtsibs nag po'i steng gi 'dab ma la legs phreng can ma'o/ /byang du thod pa can ma'o/ /nub tu 'jigs can ma'o/ /lhor mi thub ma'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la g.yas skor kyis byang sems dkar ba dang dmar ba dang bdud rtsi lnga dang sgon me lngas gang ba'i thod pa rnams so/ /rim pa dang po 'di ni rdo rje phreng ba sngon pos bskor ba'o/ /de nas rim pa gnyis pa ni rtsibs brgyad dmar po la gnas pa'i pad+ma brgyad kyi phyi rim rdo rje dmar po'i phreng bas 39—308

bskor ba'o/ /de'i shar gyi rtsibs la dge ba'i ska rags ma'o/ /byang du ni gzugs can ma'o/ /nub tu rnam rgyal ma'o/ /lhor 'dod can ma'o/ /dbang ldan du dus can ma'o/ /mer ni mtsho chen ma'o/ /bden bral du byed ma'o—/ /rlung du gsod ①ma'o/ /de nas rim pa gsum pa la ni 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa la gnas pa'i pad+ma brgyad de rdo rje dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /de'i shar gyi rtsibs la sgol ma'o/ /byang du 'jigs mthong ma'o//nub tu legs mthong ma'o/ /lhor thub dka' ma'o/ /dbang ldan du dge ma'o//mer grib non ma'o/ /bden bral du dus mtshan ma'o/ /rlung du grags 5chen ma'o—/ /shar kyi sgo'i pad+ma la mdzes ma'o/ /byang gi sgo'i pad+ma la nor 'dzin ma'o—/ /nub sgo'i pad+ma la skal ①bzangs ma'o/ /lho sgo'i pad+ma la mthong na / rgyayid 'ong ma'o/ /'di rnams thams cad g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa so pyecung zad ston pa zhal gcig ma spyan gsum ma rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa mi mgo'i phreng ba dang bral ba/ dbu skra sel bu dmar ser gyi tshogs gyen du badze+es pa ⑥byang sems 'dzag pa nyi ma'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar rmi tshul gyis ⑦gnas pa rnams so/ /sgo skyong ma rnams ni g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'o/ /thams cad kyang stag gi pags pa gyon ma sku mdog sngon mo'o/ /yang na legs phreng can ma la sogs pa bzhi nag mo'o/ /rim pa gnyis ma ④la gnas pa rnams dkar ser ro/ /rim pa gsum pa la gnas pa rnams ljang gu ma'o/ /sgo'i lha mo rnams nag mo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lngas rgyas btab pa'o/ /sna tshogs sde ma ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /legs phreng can ma la sogs pa bzhi ni 39—309

rin 'byung gis so/ /rim pa gnyis pa la gnas pa rnams ni snang ba mtha' yas kyis so/ /rim pa gsum pa la gnas pa rnams ①ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /sgo'i lha mo rnams kyi don yod grub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 4 snying ga'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ budhe ka pā li nī t+patī heḥhūṃ phaṭa snying po'o/ /sngags 'di nyid kyis dkyil 'khor 'di'i las thams cad pa'o// //dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur byi nang du rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor byi steng du rgya mtsho chen po la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dkyil du dbus kyi rim pa'i lte bar seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' nag bo rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal gsum nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum ①pa phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa dpral bar gnas pa'i ④ thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan 5pa'i ral pa nag po'i cod pan can / de bzhin gshegs pa lnga 'phro ba'i dbu rgyan can stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu cung zad nyil ba/ phyag drug pa rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa'i phyag gnyis kyis ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma nag mo'am pyadakar mo la 'khyud pa/lag pa g.yas pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang mda' 'dzin pa g.yon pa gnyis kyis pad snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas shar gyi re mig la glang po che'i rgyal po la 'gying ba'i tshul kyis gnas pa'i rdo rje ḍā ki ma dkar mo/ byang du rma bya la 39—310

skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'i 'jigs byed ḍā ki ma ser mo sbrul gyis brgyan pa/nub tu bya khyung la tsog pur gnas pa'i ro langs ma dmar mo/ lhor khol po'i gdan la byin pa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa'i gtum mo sngon mo dbu skra dmar po 'gram ①par grol zhing spyi bor thal mo sbyor 4 ba'o/ /'dir ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma la sogs pa lnga ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis kha ṭī ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams ni glang po che la sogs pa la gnas pa'i pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa glang po che'i pags pa smad la gon pa mi'i pags pa stod la gon pa'o/ /dbang ldan du seng ge la 'gying ba'i 1 tshul gyis gnas pa'i seng ge ma dkar ser phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas steng du 'phyar ba'i kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas snyigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o//mer rdo rje phag mchu ④ma zlum po'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i stag mo kha dog dkar nag mo phyag gnyis ma ⑤g.yas pa dang cig shos kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du ma he la skyil krung byed pas bzhugs pa ce spyang ma ce spyang gi gdong can sku mdog dmar nag dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis so/ /rlung du ce spyang gi gdan la tsog pur bzhugs pa'i 'ug pa ma 'ug pa'i gdong can dmar ser mo phyag gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams ni rang rang gi chibs rnams la pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje ḍā ki ma'i rgyab tu ḍā ki ma dkar mo phyag gnyis rtse mo khar bcug pa'o/ /byang du 'jigs byed ḍā ki ma'i rgyab tu mar me ma ser mo spyi bor mar me lta bur thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /nub tu ro langs ma'i rgyab tu 'jigs byed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba'o/ /lhor gtum mo'i rgyab 39—311

tu kaspo dzi 1nag mo/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar gtun shing 'phyar ba'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ro la gnas pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba dang 'od zer kyi zlum po'i rim pa bskor ba la pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la shar phyogs su puk+ka sī dang ḍi mi ḍi byedang gtum mo rnams phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsi'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du 'jigs byed ma dang grags ma dang sha ma rnams ni sha lngas bkang ba'i pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu drag shul ma dang 'bar ma dang mi sdug ma rnams gtor ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor thod pa ma dang rdo rje ma dang bum pa ma rnams btung ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du sgeg mo snyems 4pa'i phyag rgya can dang dri chab ma dri'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su pi wang ma pi wang bsgreng ba dang me tog ma me tog 'thor ba'o/ /bden bral du glu ma kha'i thad kar mdzub mo g.yo ba dang / bdug spos ma spos dang bcas pa'i spos phor 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du gar ma gar gyi tshul byis steng du thal mo sbyar ba dang / mar me ma mar me dang bcas pa'i mar me'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes ḍā ki ma la sogs pa'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gsum po 'di dag ni zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa dbu skra grol ba/ dbu la thod pa lnga'i phreng ba can no//'jigs byed ḍā ki ma ni dbu skra gyen la badze+es pa/ seng ge ma la sogs pa ni gos dmar po gyon pa'o/ /puk+ka sī la sogs pa dang me'i mtshams kyi lha mo rnams dkar mo'o/ /'jigs byed ḍā ki ma la sogs pa dang dbang ldan gyi lha mo dag ser mo'o/ /drag shul ma la sogs pa dang rlung mtshams kyi lha mo dag dmar mo'o//thod pa ma la sogs pa dang bden bral gyi lha mo dag nag mo'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba zlum po'i phyi rol gye rim pa'i sgo rnams dang snam bu rnams la chu skyes dang 39—312

zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /de la shar sgor khyab 'jug nag po dang / byang du tshangs pa ser po dang / nub tu dbang phyug chen po dkar po dang / lhor gdong drug dmar bo dang / dbang ldan du dbang po ser po dang / mer lus ngan ser po dang / srin por gshin rje nag po dang / rlung du chu lha dkar po'o / /lha'i hūṃ snam bu la shar du keng rus 'jigs byed dang kha ṭī ga'i srin po dang tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang / dril bu'i rna ba can rnams dkar po'o/ /byang du gtum mo'i dbang phyug dang mdun sa'i lha dang rigs kyi dbang phyug dang /r+ghaṃ ga pyer 'jigs su rung ba rnams ser po'o/ /nub tu drag po'i 'dod pa dang ṣa ṇa ḍi kyela'i dbang phyug dang ḍa ma ru'i 'dul byed dang rnga sgras 'jigs byed rnams dmar po'o/ /lho ru tum thu bu ra'i dbang phyug dang s+thā ra na dang / mche ba gcigs pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa rnams ni nag po'o/ /khyab 'jug la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis kha ṭī ga dang rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis lha mo la 'khyud pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ral pa nag po'i thor gtsug 5can rnams thod pa lnga'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /'di rnams kyi yum lha mo rnams kyang phyag g.yas pa dang cig shos kyis kha ṭī ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lngas rgyas btab pa'o/ /ye shes kyi thumakha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa'am/ rdo rje dz+wa rnam par snang mdzad kyi 3snargyas btab pa'o/ /rdo rje ḍā ki ma la sogs pa bzhi /la rtag pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don 39—313

byedayod grub pa rnams kyis so/ /seng ge ma la sogs pa bzhi ni mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas rnams kyis so/ /tshangs pa la rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /dbang phyug chen po la snang ba mtha' yas kyis so/ /lha gzhan dkar po rnams la rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /ser po rnams kyi ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyis so/ /dmar po rnams la snang ba mtha' yas kyis so/ /nag po rnams la mi bskyod pa'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug gi snying ga'i sa bon hūṃ ngo / /oṃ hūṃ haḥswā hā/ zhes pa ni snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃ ghaḥswā hā/ ro langs ma'i las thams cad pa'i sngags so 2zhes bya ba nin/ rim pa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang lta bu la ḍā ki ma la sogs pa bzhi po rnams ni sgo rnams su'o zhes pa gzhan no/ /rim pa gnyis pa yang gzhal yas khang gi dbyibs so zhes pa ni gzhan no/ /de yang zlum po'o zhes bya ba ni kha cig go// //bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi dbus su chos 'byung gi lte bar gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs mtsho skyes dang nyi ma'i steng du gnas pa'i ma he nag po khros pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rgyab tu sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i gshin rje'i gdan la g.yas bskum pa g.yon brkyang pas mnan nas bzhugs pa'i gshin rje gshed nag po smin ma dang ag tshom gyen du langs shing dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sku bong thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba dregs pa mi mgo'i phreng ba mgul par 'phyang ba/ ljags 'gyu 5ba mche ba 'bar ba gcigs pa/39—3/ /

rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po0 /phyag drug pa gri gug ①thod par ldan pa'i g.yas dang cig shos kyi phyag gnyis kyis 1 rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/g.yon pa gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bzhin du mtha' yas la sogs pa'i klus brgyan pa'o/ /'di'i shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po ste/ rtsa ba dang g.yas dang cig shos kyi zhal dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po phyag g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri'o—/ /g.yon gyi phyag gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu zhal gsum ser po dang sngon po dang / dkar po g.yas kyi phyag dag na byerin po che dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa dag na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po zhal gsum dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po'o/ /g.yas pa dag na pad+ma dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa dag na nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang phyogs su phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu zhal gsum ljang gu dang nag bo dang /dkar po g.yas pa dag na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon pa dag na nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi char yang khro bo 'khor lo'i bdag po'i mtshan nyid can g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing rang dang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su rdo rje tsartsi ka ma ni skem phyazhing / gzugs dang phyag mtshan rnams ni gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu'o—/ /bden bral du rdo rje phag mo phag zhal can ma zhe sdang gshin rje gshed lta bu'o—/ /rlung du rdo rje dbyangs can (67ma 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /39—315
