dbang ldan du dkar po 3phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa ni sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra'i tsartsa ba rnams su'o/ /rdo rje'i ra — mtshams rnams su rdo rje tsa rtsi ka la sogs pa bzhi ni rang 'od thu dang 'dra ba'i thabs dang bcas pa'o/ /shar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po zhal gsum ni nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /g.yas dag gis rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri/g.yon dag gis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po zhal gsum dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'o/ /g.yas pa dag gis dbyug pa dang 5ral gri/ g.yon pa dag gis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje gshed 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu'o / /byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu la cung zad sngo ba'o/ /thams cad kyang ༄ 7ma rungs pa/ 'jigs pa gad rgyangs can dbu skra dmar ser 'bar ba gyen la badze+es shing mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal can rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa'o/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i thod pa bzhi ni byang sems dkar ba dang dmar ba dang bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lngas bkang ba'o/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i rigs kyi bdag po ni spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid do/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa bzhi yang de bzhin no/ /de rnams ni go rims ji lta bar spyan ma la sogs pa bzhi dang tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs pa rnams kyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 39—316

thugs ka'i sa bon ni yi ngo / /oṃ jiḥsgoḥtū bi kṛ tā na na —hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni snying po gesngags dang las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang 'di'o// //rdo rje sgol ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dkyil du gzhal yas khang gi lte ba la sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje sgol ma gser btso ma lta bu sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan thu rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang rgyab dang g.yon kyi zhal bzhi gser mdog dang dkar po dang sngon po dang / dmar po phyag brgyad ma g.yas kyi phyag rnams kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa dang mda' dang dung rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis hūṃ.ut+pa la ser po dang gzhu dang lcags kyu dang sdigs gemadzub po/ /shar gyi 'dab mar me tog sgol ma dkar mo ni phyag gnyis kyi 8me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor bdug spos sgol ma nag mo ni phyag gnyis kyis bdug spos 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu mar me'i sgrol ma ser mo ni phyag gnyis kyis mar me'i gong byebu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du dri'i sgol ma dmar mo ni phyag gnyis kyis dri chab kyi dung 'phyar ba'o/ /lha mo bzhi po 'di rnams ni zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /me la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i mdog lta bu 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang ral gri'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo ni g.yas pa na lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo ni phyag g.yas pa zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog ma dmar mo ni lcags sgog la rdo rjes mtshan pa phyag g.yas su'o/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu ma ni phyag g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 29—317

'dzin pa'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma rnams la spyan ma la sogs pa rnam par dag pa'i byang sems kyi bum pa dang / ri rab dang gre thab dang rgyal mtshan chen po'o/ /steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo ni 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yas pa'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes ma sngon mo ni g.yas pa klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo drug po 'di rnams ni phyag g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'o/ /bcu po 'di rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /bcu gcig po rnams kyang zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gser gyi rna cha g.yo bas brgyan pa gos sna tshogs dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa pad+ma rā ga'i 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /rdo rje sgrol ma'i rigs bdag ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /me tog sgol ma la sogs pa ni rnam par snang mdzad dang mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams te rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa rnams kyi yang ngo / /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rin 'byung ngo / /gnod mdzes ma'i mi bskyod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i snying ga'i sa bon ni ྅ ngo / /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā zhes pa ni snying po'i sngags dang las thams cad nga/'i yang sngags so// //'od zer can ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du gzhal yas khang ngo / /kha cig gi lugs la chos 'byung med do/ /ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang ngo zhes so/ /gzhal yas khang gi lte bar mchod rten gyi phug gi dkyil du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba 'am nyi ma la 39— 3/8

g.yas bskum pa g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ma ser mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi cod pan can dbu skra la mchod rten gyis tshobargyan pa—/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhal gsum pa rtsa ba'i zhal ser po g.yas dkar po g.yon zhal nag po phag pa'i zhal khros pas khro gnyer dang zur mig dang 3ldan pa/ ljags 'dril ba 'jigs par byed ma phyag drug ma g.yas pa rnams kyis mda' dang rdo rje dang khab 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang skud pa dang / mya ngan med pa'i shing me tog dang bcas pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa'o/ /smad gos sngon po gyon pa stod g.yogs rnam par bkra ba'i gos sngon po can/ gser mdog lta bu'i phag pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa rang gi mdog lta bu'i phag pas yongs su bskor ba/ mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi phreng ba dbu la brgyan pa/ shar phyogs su arka ma sī gezhes bya ba me tog ban+d+ra choka'i mdog lta bu khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyag go/ /lho ru marka ma sī zhes bya ba'i lha mo gser kyi mdog lta bu'i g.yas pas skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang / g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa'o//nub tu an+ta ra bye khrun ma sbo ser mo ni g.yas pa mya ngan med pa'i yal ga g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du ṣ+pe ra shesna ma sī zhes bya ba sku mdog dmar mo stiphyag gnyis kyis gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams la sogs par u da ya ma sbo dang / gube+e ma sī dang / ba na ma sī dang / ṭī ba ra ma sī rnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du arka ma sī 3la sogs pa'i mdog dang phyag mtshan bzhin no/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i shar gyi snam bu la ma hā ṭī ba ra ma sī dang / ba rā ha mu khi ni nag mo mche ba gatshigs pa 'jigs su 39—319

rung ba/ g.yas pa rdo rje lcags kyu dang g.yon pas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru pa dā kra ma sī dang ba rā ①li ser mo ni g.yas pas mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang g.yon pas rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pa ra kra ma sī dang bi da li dmar mo ni g.yas pa dang g.yon mda' dang gzhu 'dzin nga/'o/ /byang du khrur ma ①sī dang / ba rā rteli ljang gu khab dang sgud pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa dang g.yon gyi phyag go//me'i mtshams su ba tā li dmar mo g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du ba dā li ser mo ni g.yas pa skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang g.yon pas yal 'dab dang bcas pa'i mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi chun po 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du ba rā li sku mdog dkar mo g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du bā rā ha mu khi dmar mo ni phyag gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor ā lo dang tā lo dang kā lo dang sats+tsha lo saspa ta mudhi ṭī ④rnams ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu phyag gnyis ma rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgog dang / dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /arka ma sī ༄ltel sogs pa'i lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams ni mngon par gsar du byung ba'i lang tsho can mchod rten gyis dbu la brgyan pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pa'i gos sngon bos stod g.yogs byas pa phag zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa gser mdog lta bu'i phag pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang ldan pa gser mdog lta bu'i phag pa la chibs — pa'o/ /sgo skyong ma rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la g.yon bskum pa g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /gzhan nyi shu po ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la g.yas bskum g.yon 39—320

brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /'od zer can ma'i rigs bdag brtag 1pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs la gnas pa rnams kyi 1mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams so/ /me la sogs pa'i phyogs bral rnams su yang de bzhin no kha cig go/ /yang na dkar po rnams la rnam snang nag po rnams la mi bskyod pa/ ser po 7rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ dmar po chornams la snang mtha' ljang gu rnams la don yod grub pa'o zhes pa ni gzhan no/ /'od zer can gyi snying ga'i sa bon ni rmā ngo / /oṃ mā rī rī rtsu swā hā/ zhes pa ni snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ mā rī pya byi hūṃ sarba bispyo at+pa dha 4ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo ni 'od zer dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can zhal bzhi pa phyag bcu gnyis pa rtsa ba'i zhal ser po g.yas dkar po nub sngon po g.yon dmar po'o/ /g.yas pa rnams kyis 2rin po che'i pa tra dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang mda' dang ral gri dang / mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rngurdo rje dang zhags pa dang rtse gsum pa dang /gzhu dang dgra sta dang dung rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /dbu la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung can ma'o/ /de'i shar phyogs su stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rol pa'i kun nas bskyod ⑫pas bzhugs pa sku mdog dkar po zla ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can zhal bzhi ma rtsa ba'i zhal dkar 39—321

po g.yas sngon po rgyab ser po g.yon pa ljang gu'o/ /de'i g.yas pa rnams kyis ①pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang mchog sbyin pa dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang ral gri rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa dang gzhu dang dgra sta rnams so zhes bya ba'i phyag bcu'o//lho ru sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'i lanyi ma'i 'od can kyi gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma chen mo ni rdo rje skyil krung can ma nag mo nag mo ①dang dkar po dang dmar po ni rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal lo/ /phyag bcu gnyis pa g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa/gzhan rnam pa gnyis kyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i gzhan rnams kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang / mchog sbyin dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis thu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / gzhu dang rin po che'i pa tra dang pad+mas mtshan pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od can kyi bsel ba'i tshal chen po ni dmar mo dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po dang (snye rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal lo/ /phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas rnams kyis pad+ma dang bcas pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang mda' dang rdo rje dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu dang /rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang snying gar gnas pa'i po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la zla ba'i 'od can sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rma bya chen mo ljang gu ni ljang gu dang nag po dang dkar po ni rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rma bya'i gzhug sgro dang 39—322

mda' dang mchog sbyin dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis lhung bzed la gnas pa'i dge slong dang gzhu dang pang du gnas pa'i bum pa rin po che 'bar ba 'bab pa can dang / sna tshogs rdo rje la rin po ches mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la me'i mtshams su nag po ni phyag gnyis kyis dung 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du dus mtshan ma ser mo 3phyag gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su rna ba nag mo dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis dgra sta 'dzin pa'o / /—dbang ldan gyi mtshams su dkar mo sku mdog dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /dgu po 'di dag ni rat+na ③sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang gos dang rin po che'i cod pan can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du rin chen 'byung ldan dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa dang / mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma dang / rdo rje lcags sgog ma dang / rdo rje dril bu ma rnams kyi yang sngar bzhin no/ /so sor 'brang ma la sogs pa rnams kyi sa bon ni shaṃ ngo / /oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ra ṇi ma hā pra ti sā re zihūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces bya ba ni snying po'o/ /sa bon ni bye shāmo/ /oṃ āḥm hā sa hā sra pra marda ni bye ④hūṃ snying po'o/ /sa bon ljuhūṃ ngo / /oṃ t+pam hā man+t+ra a nu sā ri ni khyehūṃ hūṃ snying po'o/ /sa bon ni dzī ⑨ngo / /oṃ snyam hā shi ta pa ti badz+re 0hūṃ snying po'o/ /sa bon ni mo ngo / /oṃ ma hā mā yu ⑪ra bir+ya rā rnyi kyihūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa 39—323

swā hā/ zhes pa snying po'o/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis 'di rnams gang yang rung bas 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug ma'i snying po'i sngags kyis ni las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang bya'o / /rmyerdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du gling dang nye ba'i gling phran dang rgya mtsho dang ri bdun la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng gzhal yas khang ste de'i dbus su seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dkar po rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas pa nyi ma'i 'od can/ sangs rgyas lngas spras pa'i rat+na'i thucod pan kyis brgyan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can rat+na sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang gos dang ldan pa zhi ba'i zhal bzhi dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu dang / phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /gzhan gnyis kyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas pa gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /yang na 'di ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sgu mdog dkar po rdo rje dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje'i 1 khu tshur gyi mdzub mo langs pa la g.yas pa rdo rje shekhu tshur gyis bzung ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la sems ma rdo rje ma sngon mo g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po 'dzin pa g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa ⑤ zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen rdo rje ma ser mo g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i rin po che 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas sdigs par byed pa'i 39—324

sdigs mdzub po/ /nub tu chos kyi rdo rje ma dmar mo ni rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar dmar g.yas pas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du las kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i kha dog can 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub sdigs ①par byed pa'o/ /de nas shar phyogs su glang po che'i dbangasko la'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas pa/ phyag g.yas pa bugung mos rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po bzung nas sa gnon gyi tshul byed cing phyag g.yon pa gan rkyal du pang du bzhag rngupa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas pa'i gung mos snying gar 'gying ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje gsor ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis nga rgyal dang bcas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa'o/ /lhor rdo rje rgyal po ser po g.yas par gnas pa'i rdo rje lcags kyus 'gugs pa'i tshul byed cing phyag g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /kha cig ni phyag gnyis kyis ④rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pas 'gugs pa'i tshul byed pa'o zhes so/ /byang du rdo rje chags pa dmar po phyag g.yon dang cig shos rnam pa gnyis kyis gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje snyi legs pa margad kyi mdog lta bu rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis snying gar legs so sbyin pa'i tshul byed pa'o/ /lhor rta'i rgyab tu sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rdo rje spril krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che gung mos bzung ste mchod sbyin gyi tshul byed pa/g.yon pa mnyam bzhag ⑥go/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje rin chen ser po ni g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtha' gnyis la rdo rje gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i rin po 39—325

che'i phreng ba rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'ching bar byed cing g.yon pas rdo rje dril bu snyems rmye pa dang bcas pas dkur brten pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje gzi brjid dmar po snying gar phyag gnyis kyis 'dzin pa'i nyi mas gsal bar byed pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje tog ljang gu g.yon gye bar du lhur gnas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing 'phyar ba'o/ /nub tu rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po g.yas pas so'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas kyang de bzhin te so'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje gnyis khar bzhag 1pa'o/ /nub tu rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru la snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje skyil krung can dmar po phyag g.yon pa dang cig shos gan rkyal du byas pa pang pa'i steng du bzhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'i g.yas pa'i gung mos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje chos dmar skya g.yon pa 'gying ba'i tshul dang bcas pas pad+ma'i yu ba 'dzin cing g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje rnon kyepo nam mkha' lta bu sngon po g.yon pas thugs kar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste 'dzin pa g.yas pas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje rgyu gser btso ma'i mdog can g.yon par gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa g.yas pa'i gung mo mgal me lta bu bskor zhing chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje smra ④ba dmar po g.yon pa chos kyi dung dang g.yas pas rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i lce 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du khyung gi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar don yod grub pa ljang gu rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/phyag g.yas pa'i gung mos thusna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i tshul byed cing g.yon pa gan rkyal du pang bar bzhag pa'o/ /shar byu 'dab mar 39—326

rdo rje las ljang gu g.yas pas snying gar babe+eng ba'i sbyor bas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ yang na lag pa gnyis kyis rmye thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rdo rje bsrung ba ser po phyag gnyis kyi ri rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis mthe chung gnyis kyi rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon gyi rtse mo gnyis rang gi khar bcug pas gdug pa rnams sdigs cha par byed pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje khu tshur ser po khu tshur gyi 4mtshams su rdo rje ste/ rdo rje khu tshur dag gis bzung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsdams pa'o/ /dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi me'i pad+ma la rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje dkur brten pa'i phyag rgya'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du pad+ma la phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rat+na'i thuphreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du pad+ma la glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang gi rgyud sbreng ge / ba'o/ /dbang ldan du pad+ma la gar ma ljang gu rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis bzung nas phyag gnyis kyis gar byed pa'o/ /dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi phyi ru snam bu la shar du pad+ma rnams la byams pa dang mthong ba don yod dang ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros rnams ni mi bskyod pa lta bu'o/ /lhor pad+ma rnams la spos kyi glang po dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / ye shes tog rnams ni 7rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu'o/ /nub tu pad+ma rnams la 'od dpag med dang / zla ba'i 'od dang bzang skyong dang dra ba can kyi 'od rnams ni 'od dpag med lta bu'o/ /byang du pad+ma rnams la rdo rje snying po dang / blo gros mi bzad pa dang / spobs pa brtsegs (— snapa dang /39—327

kun du bzang po rnams ni don yod grub pa lta bu'o/ /yang na shar la sogs pa'i snam bu rnams la bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' ①byams pa la sogs pa stong du bzhis ma tshang ba bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i mtshan rnams mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bshad do / / sgro me'i mtshams su rngupad+ma la rdo rje bdug spos ma dkar mo dang bden bral gyi pad+ma la rdo rje me tog ma ser po ④dang / rlung gi pad+ma la rdo rje mar me ma khyadakar dmar dang / dbang ldan gyi pad+ma la rdo rje dri chab ma ljang gurmye/ bdug spos ma la sogs pa 'di rnams gong bzhin du phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo'i pad+ma rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu dang rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje lcags sgog dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa rnams rim pa bzhin du dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu rnams ni gong bzhin du phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings las gzhan pa'i lha rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gos dang rat+na ⑦sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa rat+na'i cod pan can gerdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa ma gtogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug la mngon ⑨ du phyogs pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug ni rang gi rigs kyi bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon spudu phyogs pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa nas rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar gyi lha rnams ni ji ltar gsungs pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la gnas shing nyi ma'i 'od zer can no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las gzhan pa'i lha bzhi bcu zhe brgyad ni sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings rnam par snang mdzad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid la rang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems 39—328

dpas rgyas btab pa'o/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa'i bdag nyid kyis tshomi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i rigs kyi bdag po ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /sems ma rdo rje ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bzhi dang sgeg mo dang bdug spos ma dang byams pa la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje lcags kyu rnams kyi ②mi bskyod pa'o/ /rin chen rdo rje ma dang rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa bzhi dang / phreng ba ma dang me tog ma dang spos kyi glang po la sogs pa bzhi dang rdo rje zhags pa rnams kyi ⑪rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /chos kyi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje chos la sogs pa bzhi dang glu ma dang / mar me ma dang / 'od dpag med la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje lcags sgog rnams kyi pesnang ba mtha' yas so/ /las kyi rdo rje ma dang / rdo rje las la sogs pa bzhi dang / gar ma dang dri chab ma dang / rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dzibazhi dang rdo rje 'bebs pa rnams kyi pyadon yod grub pa'o/ /'dir nang gi gzhal yas khang gi sgo rnams su'ang ⑦/ rdo rje be+egs kyu la sogs pa sgo skyong bzhi bsgom par bya'o zhes pa phyogs gzhan no/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying ga'i sa bon t+pa.oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma hā yo gī shwa ④ra hūṃ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /gang yang rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa'i rgyud gzhan gyis kyang lha'i rnam pa'i khyad par gsungs pa de ni 'dir mangs kyis dogs pas ma bshad do// //bzhi bcu rtsa gsum gyi ⑨bdag nyid can/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang la sogs pa gzhal yas khang ⑫bar du dang por bshad 39—329

pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'dir khro bo rnams ni 'og nas 'chad pa'i gzugs can no zhes pa ni phyogs gcig go/ /rdo rje gur gyi nang na ri rab kyi steng na sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang zhes pa ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /phyogs gnyis ka la yang mchod rten dkar po'i nang du gzhal yas khang ngo / /de'i lte ba la seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu sdug cing yid du 'ong ba me tog sna tshogs kyis ①mdzes pa'i gtsug phud can shegasum gyis rnam par brgyan pa rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyi ④ral gri dang / mchog sbyin dang mda' dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste dang chu skyes sngon po dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bdag lta bu'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la snyoms par zhugs pa'o/ /de'i shar phyogs kyi le tshe la glang po che'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la mi bskyod pa sngon po 'gying ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po phyag brgyad pa g.yaṭa pa'i gung mos snying gar rdo rje gyen du bgreng ba/g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje dril bu dku la brten pa/ g.yas thugazhan rnams kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu dang mda' rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis nu ma dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru rta'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la rin chen 'byung ldan ser po sems dpa'i byas krung gis bzhugs pa/ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /phyag 39—330

drug pa ①rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis mnyam gzhag ①gi phyag rgya byas la/ g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis ④nu ma dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas pa'i snang ba mtha' yas dkar po dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /phyag drug pa g.yon pa sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i pad+ma'i yu ba snying gar bzung ④ste/ g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'o/ /g.yas pa gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa byaganyis kyis nu ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du khyung gi steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la don yod grub pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa kha dog dmar po dmar po dang sngon po dang dkar po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon byi zhal lo/ /phyag drug pa dang po gnyis kyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya bcing ba'o/ /g.yas pa ⑥gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du spyan ma ser mo ni sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis mchog sbyin dang mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / rin po che'i snye ma dang bgrang phreng dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /mer mā ma tī sems dpa'i skyil krung can ma sngon mo ni khro ba dang bcas pas dgod pa phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis 3mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda' khyedang / g.yon pa rnams kyis sdogs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du gos dkar mo dmar mo ni phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda'o/ /g.yon pa 39—331

rnams kyis pad+ma dang bgrang phreng dang gzhu 'dzin cing 'gying ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o / /rlung du sgol ma margad lta bu'i mdog can ma sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa/ phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang at+pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su sems ma rdo rje ma dang rin chen rdo rje ma dang chos kyi ①rdo rje ma dang / las kyi ①rdo rje ma rnams rim pa bzhin du sku mdog dang / phyag ①mtshan ni mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang nu ma 'dzin pa med pas sems ma rdo rje ma rin chen rdo rje ma las kyi ④ rdo rje ma rnams sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa'o/ /chos kyi rdo rje ma ni zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du tsun+da dkar mo zla ba'i mdog can phyag nyi shu rtsa drug ma rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis snying gar rtsa ba'i phyag rgya dang / g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang ral gri dang rat+na'i phreng ba dang bi dza pū ⑤ra dang mda' dang dgra sta dang mdung thung dang tho ba dang lcags kyu dang rdo rje dang ba dan gsum gyi tshul dang bgrang phreng ngo / /g.yon pa rnams kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / pad+ma dang spyi blugs dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang shag ti dang 'khor lo dang ral gri dang sdigs mdzub dang bum pa bzang po dang bi di ba la dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti'o/ /kan dz+re ka'i stod g.yogs bcings pa bla gos phrag pa la gzar ba gar gyi nyams dgu'i rang bzhin rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yas pa'i sngon po ljags 'gul du zhing mche ba bag tsam gcigs pa/ g.yon pa ser po ma mchu mnan pa/ thal mo sbyar te mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs par zlum po'i rnam par bzhag ste mthe bong gnyis mdzub 39—332

mo'i rtsa ba'i logs la gzhag kye)par bya ste/ snying gar bzhag (gapa 'di ni rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /mer ni rin chen skar mda' ser mo phyag drug pa gnyis kyis snying gar rin po che kha sbyor 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas pa gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang mda' 'dzin pa g.yon pa gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du khro gnyer can dkar mo phyag drug ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rngusdigs mdzub dang spyi blugs dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du rdo rje be+egs sgrog ma ljang gu phyag drug ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang mda' 'dzin pa g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis po 'di rnams ni rol pa'i kun du bskyod pa dang ldan pa zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po bzhin du zhal gsum pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar gyi snam bu la byams pa gser gyi mdog lta bu phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang / g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon pa me tog dang bcas pa'i klu shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa'o/ /'jam dpal ni brjod zin pa'i gzugs can te/ khyad par du shes rab ma dang bral ba'o/ /spos kyi glang po ljang gu g.yon pas bum par gnas pa'i glang po che'i sna 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas kyi je mchog sbyin no/ /ye shes tog ser po g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas mchog sbyin no/ /lho ru bzang skyong sku mdog dmar po/ g.yon pa rat+na 'dzin pa g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /blo gros rgya mtsho dkar po phyag gnyis kyi snyesor mo thams cad brkyang bas chu rlabs kyi tshul 39—333

byed— —— — ———————byed pa'o/ /blo gros mi zad pa gser gyi mdog lta bu g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag ste/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /spobs pa brtsegs pa ljang gu g.yon pas khu tshur mkhal khung du bzhag pa'o/ /g.yas pas se gol gtogs pa'o / /nub tu mthu chen thob dkar po g.yon pas bag tsam kha phye ba'i pad+ma dkar po'o/ /g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis kyis sdig 1pa sprug pa'i tshul lo/ /mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros gser gyi mdog lta bu phyag gnyis kha sbyar brdabs 4pa'i tshul lo/ /dra ba can gyi 'od dmar po g.yon pas at+pa/ la la 5gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /byang du zla 'od sgu mdog zla ba'i 'od lta bu g.yon pas ut+pa lar gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis kyis dbang bskur ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nam mkha' mdzod sgu mdog gser lta bus g.yon pas rdo rje khu tshur 'gying bas dkur brten pa6/ g.yas pas nam mkha' la bskor ba'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sngon po'am dkar po g.yon pas sa la reg pa/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis mje bong dang sdigs mdzub sbyar te/ dri ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams ni zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od can no/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa spyan gsum pa rang phyogs kyi bdab po bzhin du zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa phyag gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya byas pa/ gnyis kyis gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs gnyis la ni mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya med do/ /'jam pa'i rdo 39—33 /

rje la sogs pa'i lha thams cad gos sna tshogs pa dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ral pa'i thor tshugs dang 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i zhal dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor ma he'i steng du gshin rje mthar byed nag po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang rdo rje dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pas zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub gyen du bsgrengs pas sdogs ①par byed pa/g.yon pa'i gnyis pas 'khyud pa'i lha mo'i nu ma 'dzin pa'o/ /de yang zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa phyag g.yas pas yab la 'khyud par brtson pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i gsum pas dngul gyi gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /margad lta bu'i lha mo ljang gu phyag gnyis ma g.yas ut+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa phyag g.yon pa yab kyi ske ('ul 'khyud pas g.yas rtephyogs su brgyan pa/ zhal drug pa gsus /shepa 'phyang ba/ zhal drug ni sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal dgyes pa'i gad mos bzhad pa/ gnyis pas 'jigs par byed pa/gsum pa'i zhal gdangs pa/ bzhi pa 'jigs su rung ba/ lnga pa rdo rje mche ba can—/ drug pa mgo'i steng du gnas pa ljags 'gul ༷ba'o/ /yang na steng gi sngon po rtsa ba la sogs pa'i zhal rnams ni g.yas skor 'urmis sngon po dang dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang lngang gu rnams so/ /lho sgor gzhan gyes mi thub pa ser po ser po dang nag po dang dkar po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon kyi zhal lo/ /phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug tho dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rta mgrin dmar po dmar po dang sngon po dang dkar po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang 39—335

dbyug pa dang ka na ya dang mda' rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du bdud rtsi 'khyel pa sngon po rkang pas bgegs mnan pa/ phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang dgra sta dang mda' ①'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su rat+na'i ri bo'i steng du mi g.yo ba sngon po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang zhags pa dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon ngos su 'phyang ba'i gos sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /khrag gis brlan ⑤pa'i ljags 'gul ༄ ba'i zhal gdangs pa'o/ /mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po phyag drug pa dang po gnyis kyis rang gi ④phyag rgya byas pa g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang g.yon pa gnyis nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis phan tshun rgyab sbyar te mthe'u 3chung gnyis bsnol te sdigs mdzub gnyis phyir brkyang nas zhags 3pa'i tshul ④byas pa no 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /bden bral du dbyug pa sngon po sku mdog sngon po ④phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang mda'/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du stobs po che sngon bo phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang ral gri dang mda'o//g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang tho ba dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug gi steng du gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po phyag drug pa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings pa 39—336

g.yas pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya de nyid kyi mdzub mo gnyis gyen du bgreng ba ni gnod mdzes kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'og tu rdo rje sa 'og sngon po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o—/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis nu ma dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i rtse gcig pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bgegs mthar byed la sogs pa bdun po ni sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po rtsa ba dang g.yas ri1g.yon gyi zhal gsum mo/ /khro bo bcu yang khros pa'i lta stangs can spyan dmar po 2smin ma g.yo ba bag tsam rtsa ba'i zhal kha phye ba/ g.yas pa'i zhal gdangs pa/ g.yon pa'i zhal ma mchu mnan pa mche ba gcigs pa stag gi pags pas smad dang stod la gon pa thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu skra 'bar ba gyen la bcings shing 'khyil ba sma ra dmar ser rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pa can/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/phud kyi sgra sgogs pa dang bcas pa'i gdengs ka can rnams kyis 'jigs pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed ni g.yas brkyang ba'am rdo rje skyil krung gis kyang bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la gnod mdzes rgyal po'i gzugs kho nas rnam par gnas pa'i phyir gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ni dkyil 'khor nyid du tha dad du ma bshad de/dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las rnal 'byor rgyas par bstan pa la'o/ /'bring por bstan pa la ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i spyi bo'i steng na rat+na'i ri la gnas pa'i pad+ma dang nyi ma la rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas pa'i gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gye zhal lo/ /39—337

phyag brgyad pa'i phyag gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya byas pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang bgrang phreng dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ ral pa'i thor cog gi cod pan can gzhogs gnyis su spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi po rnams kyis brgyan pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /de'i rjes su 'brangs nas rnal 'byor rgyas pa la/ yang gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ni dkyil 'khor pa tha dad du dang de'i steng du gnod mdzes rgyal po shes par bya'o zhes pa ni kha cig go/ /lha gzhan bzhi bcu zhe gsum po rnams kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa'o/ /'dir nu ma 'dzin par bstan pa de yang mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhi bdag lta bu'i shes rab ma la stoms par zhugs pa rnams kyi'o/ /khro bo rnams kyis ni bdag lta bu'i shes rab ma g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i nu ma 'dzin pa'o zhes shes par bya'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed las gzhan rnams la shes rab ma med kyang de'i nu mar 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis bdag gi nu mar 'dzin pa'o zhes pa ni gzhan no/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang / spyan ma dang tsun+da 5rnams la 'jam pa'i rdo rjes) rgyas btab pa/ mā ma tī dang sems ma rdo rje ma dang byams pa la sogs pa bzhi dang / khro bo bcu la mi bskyod 6pas rgyas btab pa/ rin chen rdo rje ma dang rin chen skar mda' ma dang / bzang skyong ma la sogs pa bzhi la rin 'byung gis rgyas btab pa/ gos dkar mo dang chos kyi rdo 39—338

rje ma dang khro gnyer ma dang mthu chen thob la sogs pa bzhi la snang ba mtha' yas kyis rgyas btab pa/ sgol ma dang las kyi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang /zla 'od la sogs pa bzhi la don yod grub pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar sa bon ni ①muḥ'o/ /oṃ āḥzhes pa snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li bispyornya ka hūṃ zhes pa las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor la/ rdo rje gur la sogs pa bsgom par rnam par bzhag pa ni bshad ma thag pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /khyad par du gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzugs can no/ /mchod rten ni 'dir med do/ /gzhal yas khang gi lte ba la sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la 'jam pa'i dbyangs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa nyi ma 'char ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od dang ldan pa sku mdog gser lta bu/ in+d+ra nī la lta bu'i gtsug phud dang ldan pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba'i cod pan gyi steng du sangs rgyas lnga dang rin po che'i cod pan can/rat+na sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa pyadang na bza' sna tshogs bsnams pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa/ ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po ni rtsa ba dang g.yas dang nub dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /phyag brgyad pa'i phyag gnyis kyi ①chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang mda' dang rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis ④shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste dang gzhu dang rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /'dab ma 39—339

brgyad pa la tusnaseng ge'i steng du gnas pa'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams la shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su gtsug tor chen po dang gdugs dkar po dang gzi brjid phung po dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor rnams dang /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams byesu 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba dang 'phags pa dang cher 'phags pa dang rgyal ba rnams so/ /gtsug tor brgyad po 'di rnams ni rdo rje skyil krung dang rin po che'i cod pan can 1sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis pa'o / /phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo gyen du bzung ba/ g.yon pas rang gi gdan la mnan pa rnams so/ /de nas shar gyi re mig gi dbus su glang po che'i rgyal po la mi bskyod pa sngon po/ zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po bag tsam khro ba dang bcas pa'i rol pa dang ldan pa g.yas pa dkar po kha gdangs pa drag po'o/ /nub kyi ser po dpa' bo g.yon pa dmar po mche bas ma mchu mnan pa phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang rdo rje dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rgyal po dang rdo rje chags pa dang rdo rje legs pa rnams kyis ④yongs su bskor ba'o/ /lho'i re mig gi pyedabus su rta mchog gi steng du rin chen 'byung ldan ser po ser po dang / nag po dang dkar po dang dmar bo'i zhal bzhi pa phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu'o/ g.yon pa rnams kyis yid bzhin kyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang rdo rje dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen dang rdo rje nyi ma dang rdo rje tog dang rdo rje bzhad pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o / /nub kyi re mig gi dbus su rma bya'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas dmar po 39—340

dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po dang ser po'i zhal bzhi'o/ /phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis lhardo rje dang mda' dang ral gri dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis pad+ma dang gzhu dang zhags pa dang / dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje chos dang rdo rje rnon po dang / rdo rje rgyu dang rdo rje gsung 7ba rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /byang gi re mig gi dbus su khyung gi steng du don yod grub pa ljang gu zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal ljang gu mche ba gcigs pa g.yas ser po zhi ba nub dmar po sgeg pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon dkar po zhi ba phyag brgyad pa—/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang rdo rje dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/g.yon pa rnams kyis rmyesdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /rdo rje las dang rdo rje bsrung ba dang rdo rje gnod sbyin dang rdo rje khu tshur rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang rang gi chibs kyi steng dusna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rat+na sna tshogs dang gos kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan 0no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bcu drug po 'di rnams ni dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa rdo rje dbyings kyi thudakyil 'khor las bshad pa'i rang bzhin can rnams so/ /'di dag kyang phyogs su gnas pa'o zhes pa'i phyogs kyang yod do—/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshalas la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang mā ma tī dang gos dkar mo dang sgol ma rnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi bskyod pa dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa lta bu'o/ /shar 39—341

gyi sgo ru rdo rje lcags kyu dmar ser rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje zhags pa ser po rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog dmar po rdo rje lcags sgrog phyag gnyis kyis 'dzin pa sa ga'i stang stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang gu phyag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pas 1rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/zlum pa'i stang stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sma ra dmar ser dang ldan pa klu chen po chabargyad kyis brgyan pa'o//nang gi dkyil 'khor 'di las dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la/ shar gyi phyogs kyi thudabang ldan nas brtsams nas g.yas skor ④ du rim pa bzhin du sa bcu gnyis kyi lha mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa thams cad kyis rdo rje 'dzin pa—/ g.yon pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de la mos pa spyod pa'i sa ma ni thu pad+ma bzhin du dmar ba pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /rab tu dga' ba dmar mo h+phu/yid bzhin byu nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /dri ma med ma dkar mo chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /'od byed ma dmar mo sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /'od 'phro ma margad skye lta bu'i mdog at+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /spyang kha byem ser mo pang par gnas pa'i phyag gan rkyal gyis ma ra ga ta'i nor bu bsnams pa'o/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa ma gser gye mdog can pad+ma'i kyesteng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /ring du song ba ma nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba ma ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog lta bu zla ba la 39—342

gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar pos mtshan pa'i pad+ma'i yu ba 'gying ba dang bcas pa ①'dzin pa'o/ /lags pa'i blo gros ma dkar mo ral gris mtshan pa'i at+pa la 'dzin pa'o/ /chos kyi sprin ma ser mo chos kyi sprin gyis yongs su bskor ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste 'dzin pa'o/ /kun du 'od ma nyi ma phyed kyi nyi ma'i mdog can pad+ma'i steng du yang dag par sdogs pa'i byang chub mtshon par byed pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru pha rol tu phyin ma bcu gnyis ni phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa thams cad kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ni phyag gnyis kyis lhag pa'o/ /de la rin po che'i gupad+ma'i pha rol tu phyin ma dmar mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma dkar dmar gyi mdog can 'bras so ba'i snye ma sna tshogs 'dzin pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang bcas pa'i me tog gi chun po 'dzin pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma ser mo chu skyes dkar po ④'dzin pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ma ra ga ta lta bu'i mdog can a la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin ma khya nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gser mdog lta bu yid du 'ong ma pad+ma la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusnyi 'dzin ma/ phyag gnyis kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma me tog pri yang ku lta bu ljang gu pad+ma ser po la gnas pa'i ral gri dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin ma ut+pa la sngon po'i mdog can ut+pa la sngon po la 39—343

gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /stobs kyi rmyepha rol tu phyin ma dmar mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo rat+na sna tshogs pa'i 'bras bus brgyan pa'i byang chub kyi shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje las kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ni sku mdog sna tshogs pa ut+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu dbang bcu dum ni phyag gnyis g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+ma 'dzin pa'o3/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis snyems pas rang rang gi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /de la tshe la dbang ba ma ni dkar dmar gyi mdog can nor bu pad+ma rā rte ga la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gyis sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dzin pa'o/ /sems la dbang ba ma ni dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /yo byad la dbang ba ma ni ser mo yid bzhin gye nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /las la dbang ba ma ni ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /skye ba la dbang ba ma ni sku mdog sna tshogs ma me tog dzā 5ti kha dog sna tshogs pa'i yal 'dab 'dzin pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba ma ni nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /mos pa la dbang ba ma ni pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba'i thra yang ku'i me tog gi snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /smon lam la dbang ba ma ni ser mo at+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes la dbang ba ma sngon mo at+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /chos la dbang ba ma sku mdog dkar mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa bzang po 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin nyid ma dkar mo phyag g.yas pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas rdo rje rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ma gser gzhu ⑥ lta bu'i mdog can phyag g.yas kyis pad+ma 39—344

ser po la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi steng du 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du gzugs ma bcu gnyis ni phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang g.yon pa rnams 1snyems pa dang bcas pas rang rang gi mtshan ma 'dzin pa ste/ de la dbyig gi blo gros ma ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rin chen skar thumada' ma dmar mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo nor bu zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'od zer can dkar dmar skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab 'dzin pa'o/ /ri khrod lo ma can ljang gu rma bya'i mjug sgo 'dzin pa'o/ /dug sel ma dkar mo dug gi me tog gi chun po 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo mtha' yas ma me tog pri yang ku ltar ljang bu — chu skyes dmar po la gnas pa'i mi zad pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /tsun+da ce ma dkar mo bgrang phreng 'phyang ba'i ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab 'phel ma dkar mo at+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /las dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba rnguljang gu ste rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma dkar dmar 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes mi zad pa'i za ma tog dmar mo rat+na'i za ma tog 'dzin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i rat+na sna tshogs kyi dpe sgom 'dzin pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor chos so so yang dag par rig pa ma sku mdog dkar dmar phyag gnyis kyis 4rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor don so so yang dag par rig ma ma ra ka ta'i kyemadog can phyag g.yon gyi byerin po che'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /nub kyi sgor nges pa'i tshig ⑩so so yang dag par rig pa ma dmar po'i 7139—345

phyag gnyis kyis mtha' gnyis su pad+mas mtshan pa'i lcags sgog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi sgor spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa ma ma ra ka ta lta bu ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su sgeg mo ser mo sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa'o//bden bral du phreng ba ma dmar ser phyag gnyis 1rat+na'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang bsgreng ba'o/ /dbang ldan du gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis gar byed pa'i tshul kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa la sogs pa'i lha mo 'di rnams thams cad rgo rat+na'i rgyan sna tshogs dang gos dang rat+na'i cod pan dang ldan pa dang cung zad 'dzum pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /khyad par du sgo skyong ma rnams ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan ni 1de rnams kyang zla ba la gnas pa'o zhes so/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa dbang ldan nas brtsams nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams te/ de la shar phyogs kyi snam bu la kun tu bzang po ser po phyag g.yas pas mchog sbyin g.yon pas at+pa la la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /blo gros mi zad pa ser po g.yas pas ⑪ral gri dang g.yon pas mi 'jigs pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /sa'i snying po ser po g.yas pas sa gnon mdzad pa/ g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing 'dzin pa'o/ /nam mkha'i snyeng po ljang gu g.yas pas rat+na sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa/ g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi snam bu la nam mkha' mdzod ser po g.yas pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa/39—346

g.yon pas bum pa bzang po la 'phyang ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag na rin chen ljang gu phyag g.yas pas rin po che dang g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho dkar po g.yas dung dang g.yon pas rdo rje ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje snying po at+pa la sngon po'i lo ma lta bu'i mdog can g.yas pas rdo rje dang g.yon pas mdo sde sa bcu pa'i puste 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya g.yon pas chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /mthu chen thob ser po g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /zla 'od dkar po g.yas pas rdo rje 'khor lo dang g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /dra ba can gyi 'od dkar dmar g.yas pas ral gri dang g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du 'od dpag med dkar po g.yas na sna tshogs pad+ma dang g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /spobs pa brtsegs pa ser po g.yas pas se gol g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros gur gum lta bu g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang g.yon pa sheshaka ti 'dzin pa'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sngon po g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /bcu drug po 'di dag ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rin po che'i cod pan can rin po che dang na bza' sna tshogs pas brgyan pa zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa rnams so/ /shar sgor ma he la gshin rje mthar byed nag po zhal drug pa gsus pa 'phyang ba zhabs drug pa phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis be+egs kyu 39—347

dang ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /zhal dang zhabs rnams kyi bye brag gong bzhin no/ /lho ①sgor shes rab mthar byed ser po zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i g.yas gdangs pa/ nub tu ⑤drag po chen po g.yon zhi ba yang na 'di rnams ni go rims ji lta bas ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po dang ljang gu rnams so/ /'di ni phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis nazhags pa dang rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis snying gar lcags kyu dang rdo rje dril bu dang mdung dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o—/ /nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po zhal bzhi dmar ba sgeg pa dang drag po dang bzhad pa dang zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa ni/ rtsa ba dang g.yas dang rgyab dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams so/ /yang na 'di rnams ni dmar po dang nag po dang ser po dang dkar po rnams so/ /phyag brgyad pa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin pa phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum po 'di dag ni rol pa'i kun du bskyod pas gnas pa'o/ /byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po zhal bzhi sngon po'am yang na sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu rnams so/ /phyag brgyad pa gnyis kyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i tshul kyis rdo rje dril bu dang g.yas pa rnams na ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /tshogs kyi bdag po g.yon brkyang bas kun nas mnan nas bzhugs pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi 39—348

mtshams su 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sngon po zhal bzhi sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba dang bcas pa'i sgeg pa dang tsa7 g.yas drag po rgyab dpa' ba g.yon mi sdug pa'o/ /yang na 'di dag sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po rnams so/ /'di ni phyag brgyad pa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu dang ldan pa thugs kar bzung nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa dang / gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon brkyang ba'i stang stabs kyis zhabs g.yon pas dbang phyug chen po'i mgo mnan pa g.yas pas u ma'i nu mar mnan pa'o/ /mer rdo rje nyi ma rnge ltar 'bar ba nag po na7 sgeg pa dang dpa' ba dang 'jigs su rung ba dang / snying rje'i ro dang ldan pa'i zhal bzhi nag po'am yang na 'di dag ni sngon po dkar po ser po dmar po rnams so/ /'di ni phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o—/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang kha ṭī ga la 'byel pa'i ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab 'jug g.yas brkyang gis mnan pa'o/ /bden bral du he ru ka rdo rje sngon po sngon po'i zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal drag po g.yas pa rab tu dga' bas bzhad pa rgyab ni za bar rngams ④pa g.yon pa sgog pa'o/ /yang na 'di dag ni sngon po dang dmar po dang ljang gu dang dkar po'o/ /'di ni phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang mda' dang khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis snying gar pad+ma kha bye ba dang / gzhu dang dril bu dang ba dan dang bcas pa'i kha ṭī ga ⑤'dzin pa'o/ /phyag gnyis kyis 'jigs byed kyi shi pags pa rlung gi gos 39—349

'dra ba 'dzin pa'o/ /chung ma dang bcas pa'i tshangs pa g.yon brkyang bas mnan nas gnas pa'o/ /rlung du rta mchog ljang gu ①ljang gu'i zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba khro ba dang bcas pa'i sgeg pa g.yas pa drag po g.yon pa'i zhal tshangs pa lta bu ste/yang na ni 'di ni ljang gu dang sngon po dang dkar po rnams te/ spyi bor rta mgo ljang gu'o/ /'di ni phyag brgyad pa g.yas dang po sna tshogs rdo rje dang ba dan gsum pa dang ldan pas phyag bsgreng ba'i tshul byas pa gnyis pas ba dan gsum pa'i tshul byas pa/ phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pas phub dang bcas pa'i phyag gi ṭusna tshogs chu skyes 'dzin pa/ lhag ma gsum gyis shaka ཿti dang dbyug pa dang gzhu rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs g.yon bskum pa g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs bzhi'o/ /g.yas dang po gcig gis dbang mo 9 dang dpal mo/ gnyis pas dga' mo dang tshim mo/ /g.yon pa gcig gis dbang po dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / gnyis pas rgyal bar byed pa dang / dpyid kyi lha mnan nas gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i steng du nam mkha' la gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po zhal bzhi ser ba'am yang na ser po dang sngon po dang dmar bo dang dkar po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda'o—/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang zhags pa dang bgrang phreng dang gzhu bsnams pa/ rol pa'i kun du bskyod pas gnas pa'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po zhal bzhi pa drag po dang zhi ba dang / bzhad pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i nag po'o/ /yang na zhal bzhi ni nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po dang ser po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams ni rdo rje dang 39—350

lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang zhags pa gsal shing rtse gcig pa dang gzhu rnams 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /khro bo bcu po 'di dag ni sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dmar ba smin ma 'khyog pa stag gi pags pas sku'i stod smad la dkris pa thod pa'i phreng bas gtsug tor byas pa 1dbu skra 'bar ba dmar ser gyen du bcings pa sma ra dmar ser dang ldan pa klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa kho na'i grwa bzhi'i nang na 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa khro bo bzhi'i phyi'i re khā'i phyi rol gyi gnas su me la sogs pa'i zur thig bzhi po rnams kyi g.yas logs su me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /g.yon logs su gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /de la me tog ma ser mo phyag na me tog gi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /bdug spos ma nag mo phyag na bdug spos kyi phor pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mar me ma dmar mo phyag na rat+na'i sgon me'i dumachod sdong 'dzin pa'o/ /dri chab ma ljang gu phyag na dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gzugs ma ser mo phyag na me long 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje sgra ma ljang gu phyag na pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje ro ma dmar mo phyag na ro'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje reg bya ma sna tshogs pa'i kha dog can phyag na gos sna tshogs 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rat+na'i cod pan dang ldan pa gos sna tshogs dang rin po ches brgyan pa / pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /bzhi pa rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la dbang po'i phyogs su dbang po ser po glang po che sa srung 4 dkar po'i steng na gnas pa phyag g.yas na rdo rje g.yon pa ltanu ma 'dzin pa'o/ /39—351

gshin rjer ①ma he la gshin rje nag po phyag gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang rtse gcig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /chur chu srin la chu bdag dkar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun pa klu'i zhags pa dang dung dkar 'dzin pa'o/ /lus ngan du mi la lus ngan ser po lcags kyu dang dbyug to 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang gi steng na gnas pa rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa thod pa ②dang ral pa'i thor cog dang zla ba phyed pas dbu brgyan pa/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs dang ldan pa mgrin pa sngon po'o/ /mer ra la me lha dmar po blugs gzar dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du srin po'i bdag po sngon po ro la gnas pa ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la gnas pa rlung ras 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni phyag bzhi pa phyag g.yas pas phyag mtshan dang po 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas phyag mtshan gnyis 'dzin cing rang rang gi btsun mo la 'khyud pa phyag 'og ma gnyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis spyi bor thal mo sbyor ba'o/ /dbang ldan dang nye ba'i phyi rol du dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas brtsams nas rim pas tshangs pa la sogs pa ste de la tshangs pa ni ngang pa la zhon pa ser po zhal bzhi ni ser po'o/ /phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs bzung nas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /khyab 'jug nag po khyung la zhon pa phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dung 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis mdung thung dang sa ram̐ 3kha'i gzhu 'dzin pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /dbang phyug chen bo dkar po glang la zhon pa ral pa'i thor cog can zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa/ phyag bzhi pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang rtse gsum pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /39—352

gdong drug dmar po rma bya la zhon pa gdong drug pa phyag drug pa g.yas pa gnyis sha ka ti dang rdo rje 'dzin pa g.yon pa gnyis kyis khyim bya dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lhag ma gnyis kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /'di rnams kyang gong bzhin du rang gi btsun mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /tshangs ma ni tshangs pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /drag mo ni drag po dang mtshungs pa'o/ /khyab 'jug ma ni khyab 'jug dang mtshungs pa'o/ gzhon du ma ni gdong drug dang mtshungs pa'o/ /dbang mo ni dbang po dang mtshungs pa'ormye/ /phag mo nag mo ni 'ug pa la zhon pa phyag bzhi pa phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis ro hi ta'i nya dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /tsa muṇ+ḍi 92dmar mo ri dwags la zhon pa phyag bzhi ma g.yas g.yon kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /byeṅgi spyori ti nag mo shin tu skem pa phyag bzhi pa gnyis kyis phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /tshogs bdag dkar po byi ba la zhon pa glang po che'i gdong can sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa can phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum pa dang la du g.yon gnyis kyis dgra sta dang la ④phug 'dzin pa'o—/ /nag po chen bo nag po rtse gsum pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dga' byed dbang phyug nag po rdza rnga la zhon pa rdza rnga brdung ba la brtson pa'o/ /nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis 'dren pa'i shing rta la zhon pa g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /zla ba dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pas ku mu da la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /mig dmar dmar po ra la zhon pa g.yas na gri gug ⑤g.yon pas mi mgo za ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /lhag pa ser po pad+ma'i steng du 39—353

mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /phur bu dkar po thod pa'am sbal pa la zhon pa phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /pa ba sangs dkar po pad+ma la gnas pa phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /spen pa nag po rus sbal la gnas pa dbyug pa 'dzin pa'o/ /sgra gcan dmar nag phyag gnyis kyis nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa'o//mjug rings nag po ral gri dang klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /stobs bzangs dkar po glang po la gnas pa ral gri dang gshol 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyal bar byed pa ljang gu bya ko ki la'i shing rta la zhon pa ljang gu phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na me tog gi phreng ba dang mda' g.yon ① gnyis kyis btung 1 ba'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o / /sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po no sgo'i shing rta la gnas pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas rngu chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang mda' g.yon pa gnyis na btung ba'i snod ④'dzin pa'o/ /dpyid kyi ⑤lha dkar po spre'u la gnas pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis kyis mda' dang ral gri g.yon pa gnyis btung ba'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o—/ /klu mtha' yas dang nor rgyas dang 'jog po dang stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dang dung skyong dang rigs ldan rnams sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan pa thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /yang na rang rang gi yab kyi g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan kyi gtso bo dang ldan pas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /thags bu bzangs ris dang stobs ldan dang tshim byed dang / rnam par snang byed la sogs pa lha ma yin gye dbang po chen po rnams mdog nag po g.yul 'gyed pa'i go cha sna tshogs bgos pa ral gri dang phe ta ka la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag gis 'dzin pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po gshog pa brkyang ba pus mo'i bar du dkar po de'i steng du lte ba'i tsobar du ser po de'i steng du mgrin pa'i bar du dmar po/ de'i steng du 39—354

mgo'i bar du nag po phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis pi wang gi sgra sgogs pa'o/ /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa ser po phyag gnyis kyis pi wang gi sgra sgogs pa'o/ /rig snyepa 'dzin pa'i rngu rgyal po don kun grub pa dkar po me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /gang ba bzang bo sngon po/ nor bu bzang po ser po/ nor sbyin dmar po/ rnam thos kyi bu ser po/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa ①li dmar po/ ki li ma ④lī ljang gu/ sgo'i dbang po ser po/ spyod pa'i dbang po ser po ste/ gang ba bzang po la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi bdag po 'di dag ni phyag gnyis kyi g.yas kyis shing thog pi dza pū ⑤ra dang g.yon ṣ+pe'u le 'dzin pa'o/ //'phrog ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis zan gyi chang bu gnyis 'dzin pa bu dang bcas pa'o/ /tha skar dkar po dang /bra nye ljang gu dang / smin drug sngo bsangs dang / snar ma dmar skya dang /mgo nag po dang / lag ser po dang / nab skyeso ser po dang / rgyal sngo bsangs dang / skag dkar po dang / mchu ser po dang / gre me tog thra yang ku lta bu ljang ser dang / sbo ljang gu dang / me bzhi dkar po dang /nag pa ljang gu dang / sa ri ser po dang / sa ga nag po dang / lha mtshams ljang gu dang / snon ser po dang / snrubs ser po dang / chu stod nag po dang / chu smad dkar po dang / gro 3bzhin dkar ser dang / mon gre nag po dang / mon gru ser po dang / khrums stod ljang gu dang / khrums smad ser po dang / nam gru dkar ser dang / byi bzhin sngo bsangs so tha skar la sogs pa'i lha mo 'di rnams ni stod g.yogs g.yo ba dang bcas pa rnams thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /gzhan yang lha rnams ni shing rta la gnas par shes par bya'o//39—355

dbang po la sogs pa'i lha rnams pad+ma la gnas pa re re la'ang rmye'akhor dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /sbyor ba ji lta ba bzhin du rin po che dang gos sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor byi bdag po bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing bkra shis kyi kyetshigs su bcad pa'i sgra phyogs thams cad du sgogs pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa'i sgo skyong rnams ni nang gi dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin la bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa'o//me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi sringo bo mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang gtsug tor brgyad dang / spyan ma la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bzhi dang mā ma tī dang /rdo rje lcags kyu dang sa bcu gnyis dang chos so so yang dag par rig pa ma dang /sgeg mo dang kun du bzang po la sogs pa bzhi dang / khro bo bcu dang me tog ma dang / rdo rje gzugs ma dang shar phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pas so/ /rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa bzhi dang rdo rje zhags pa dang / pha rol tu phyin ma gyebacu gnyis dang 'udon so so yang dag par rig pa ma dang phreng ba ma dang nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa bzhi dang / bdug spos ma dang rdo rje sgra ma dang lho'i phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis so/ /rdo rje chos la sogs pa bzhi dang gos dkar mo dang / rdo rje lcags sgog dang tshe la dbang ba ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis dang / nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa khum dang glu ma dang spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa ⑦bzhi dang / mar me 39—356

ma dang rdo rje ro ma dang / nub phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'od dpag med kyis so/ /rdo rje las la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje 'be+ebs pa dang /gzungs bcu gnyis dang spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa ma dang / gar ma dang 'od dpag med la sogs pa bzhi dang dri chab ma dang rdo rje reg bya ma dang /byang phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams la don yod grub pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni muḥ'ormye/ /a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya ha ra ha ra oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥbha ga wān dzñā na mūrti wā gī 1shwa ra ma hā wā byetsa sarba dharmā ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shudha dharma thudh+wa tu dzñā na gar+bha āḥzhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mri kyeta kuṇ+ḍa li baspyon+ta ⑦ka hūṃ zhes bya ba ni bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur gyi nang du rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su nang gi dkyil 'khor la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po/ rdo rje phreng ba sngon pos bskor ba ste/ 'ga' zhig tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa sngon por gsungs so/ /gzhan ni 'di'i 'khor lo'i lte ba sngon po shar gyi rtsibs dkar po lho nag po nub dmar po byang ljang gu'o zhes gsungs so/ /'khor lo'i lte ba la sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po shin tu gser gyi mdog can chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /shar gyi rtsibs la rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can no/ /lho'i rtsibs la rin chen gtsug tor sngon po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /nub 39—357

kyi rtsibs la pad+ma gtsug tor dmar po bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya can no/ /byang gi rtsibs la sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang gu mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /me'i rtsibs la gtsug tor gzi brjid sku mdog dkar dmar phyag ①gnyis kyis nyi ma 'dzin pa phyag g.yon pa dkur brten pa'o/ /bden bral gyi rtsibs la gtsug tor rgyal mtshan sku mdog dmar nag 'dres pas du phyag gnyis kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi rtsibs la gtsug tor rnon po nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs phyag g.yas pas ral gri 'dzin pa g.yon pas po ti 'dzin pa'o / /dbang ldan gyi rtsibs la gtsug tor gdugs dkar sgu mdog dkar po phyag gnyis kyis gdugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i phyi rol me la sogs pa'i mtshams su sgeg mo dang phreng ba ma dang glu ma dang gar ma rnams sku mdog dkar mo dang ser mo dang dmar mo dang sna tshogs can ma phyag gnyis pa'o/ /snam bu la sgo'i g.yon logs su byang chub sems dpa' gnyis dang g.yas logs su gnyis so / /de la shar gyi snam bu la byams pa ser bo/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis klu shing gi me tog dang / g.yon pas spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /mthong ba don yod ser po phyag g.yas pas srun dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pacho / g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros dkar ser 'dres pa'i mdog can phyag g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi snam bu la spos kyi glang po dkar ④ljang g.yas kyis dri'i dung phor 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa khrukhu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba dkar po g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas khya tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /39—358

nam mkha' mdzod dkar ser g.yas pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa g.yon pas ①khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /ye shes tog sngon po phyag g.yas kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa g.yon pas gakhu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /nub kyi snam bu la bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar po g.yas pas cod pan gyi steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o—/ /zla ba'i 'od dkar po g.yas pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba 'dzin pa g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /bzang skyong dkar po g.yas pas rin po che 'bar ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /dra ba can gyi 'od dmar po g.yas pas rdo rje'i gur 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /byang gi snam bu la rdo rje snying po sngo skya g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i at+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /blo gros mi zad pa dkar po phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o//spobs pa brtsegs pa dmar po g.yas pas chu skyes la gnas pa'i rat+na brtsegs pa bsnams pa g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /kun tu bzang po gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pas rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa g.yon pas khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi me la sogs pa rnams la me tog ma dang bdug spos ma dang mar me ma dang / dri chab ma rnams ni dkar mo dang nag mo dang dmar mo dang / ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis me tog la sogs pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje zhags pa sngon po phyag gnyis kyis zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog dmar mo ④phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du 39—359

rdo rje 'be+ebs pa ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lha sum cu so bdun po 'di dag kyang gos sna tshogs dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ༵rat+na'i cod pan can zhal gcig spyan gnyis pa phyag gnyis pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad chen po ni rang nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rnam snang gis rgyas btab po5 / /rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa bzhi la rnam par snang mdzad chen pos so/ /shar gyi phyogs dang me'i mtshams na gnas pa'i lha rnams la rdo rje gtsug tor byus so/ /lho phyogs dang bden bral gyi chamatshams na gnas pa rnams la rin chen gtsug tor gyis so/ /nub phyogs dang rlung gi mtshams na gnas pa rnams la pad+ma gtsug tor gyis so/ /byang phyogs dang dbang ldan kyi mtshams na gnas pa rnams la sna tshogs gtsug tor gyis so/ /'dir phyi rol kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gnas kyi snam bu la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad po lta'o zhes rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyir 'dod yon gyi snam bu rnams la byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug dgod par mi rigs so/ /'ga' zhig ni nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes rgyud du gsungs pas phyi rol gyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du gzhal yas khang gnyis pa'o zhes smra'o/ /'ga' zhig tu ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgu gtsug tor dang bcas pa dge slong gi cha lugs 'dzin par gsungs so/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba dang /khor yug gi nang du dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas brtsams nas g.yas skor kyis mgrin pa sngon po la sogs pa bskyed par bya ste/ de la dbang ldan du glang la mgrin pa sngon po dkar po mchod phyir thogs pa can phyag g.yas gnyis na rdo rje 39—360

dang mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya g.yon gnyis na rtse gsum tudang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /mgrin sngon ma mgrin pa sngon po lta bu'o/ /nam mkha' lding la khyab 'jug nag po g.yas gnyis na dbyug tho dang rdo rje g.yon gnyis na dung dang 'khor lo'o/ /gser gyi rdo rje ma khyab 'jug lta bu khyad par gser gyi mdog can no/ /rma bya la rdo rje dril bu zhal drug pa dmar ba g.yas pa gnyis na shaka sdeti dang rdo rje g.yon pa gnyis na khyer bya dang rdo rje dril bu'o/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ma rdo rje dril bu lta bu'o/ /ngang pa la mi smra rdo rje ser po zhal bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang sngags bzla ba'i phreng ba g.yon pa gnyis na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs so/ /rdo rje zhi ba ma tshangs pa lta bu'o/ /glang po che mche ba drug pa'i dbang po dkar po dang zla ba la rdo rje mtshon cha dkar po rol pa'i kun du bskyod pas gnas pa phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa g.yon pas rdo rje rtse gsum dkur brten pa'o/ /lha mo rdo rje khu tshur ma ni rdo rje mtshon cha ji lta bu'o④/ /rta bdun gyi shing rta la rdo rje 'khyel pa dmar po khros pa g.yas pa na pad+ma g.yon pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o—/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi ma rdo rje 'khyil pa bzhin no/ /ngang pa la rdo rje 'od dkar po khro bo phyag g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje mdog ma rdo rje 'od lta bu'o/ /ra la rdo rje dmar ser khro bo g.yas kyis rdo rje dmar po 'dzin cing g.yon pas mi bzung nas za ba'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje ske 4 rags ma rdo rje dmar ser bzhin no/ /pad+ma la rdo rje zhi ba khro bo ser po mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje zhi ba ma rdo rje zhi ba bzhin no/ /sbal pa la rdo rje bla ma khro bo ser po g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje bla ma ma rdo rje bla ma bzhin no/ /pad+ma la rdo rje pa wa sangs khro bo dkar bo g.yas 39—361

na bgrang phreng dang g.yon na spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje pa wa sangs ma rdo rje pa wa sangs bzhin no/ /rus sbal la rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo nag po g.yas pa na rdo rje g.yon pa na dbyug pa'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ma ni rdo rje dbyug pa dang 'dra ba'o//rdo rje sgra gcan khro bo ma tūdamar nag g.yas pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang g.yon pa ke nyi ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje lha min ma ni rngurdo rje sgra gcan dang 'dra ba'o/ /rdo rje mjug rings khro bo mdog nag po g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje glu ma rdo rje mjug rings bzhin no/ /bzhi po 'di dag dang rdo rje zhi ba la sogs pa ④rgyud gzhan las gsungs pa ltar bdag gis bris so//glang po che la rdo rje glang sna dkar po g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas gshol 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dul ba ma rdo rje glang sna bzhin no/ /de'i khyad par ni g.yon pas kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /bya ko ki la'i shing rta la rdo rje phreng ba can ljang gu g.yas pa na rdo rje g.yon pa na me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje brtan ma rdo rje phreng ba ji lta ba las khyad par ni phyag g.yon pa na mdung ngo / /ṣ+pe sgo'i shing rta la rdo rje dbang can ser po g.yas na rdo rje g.yon pa na chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje dbang can ma rdo rje dbang can dang 'dra ba'o3/ /khyad par ni sku mdog dmar ba'o/ /sbal pa la rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba dkar po rdo rje dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gdan ma rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba dang 'dra ba'o/ /me tog la rdo rje gtun shing ser po g.yas g.yon gyis rdo rje du gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje pho nya mo rdo rje gtun shing lta bu'o/ /khyad par ni g.yon pas kha ṭī ga kye 'dzin pa'o/ /ra la rdo rje me dmar po g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang go cha g.yon gnyis dbyug to dang / spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'bar ma rdo rje me lta 39—362

bu'o—/ /ma he la rdo rje nag po sku mdog nag po rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs la rdo rje nag mo sku mdog nag mo rdo rje dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ / lhag par klu ⑨la rdo rje lcags kyu sngon po phag pa'i zhal rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o—/ /mi la rdo rje gdong ma sngon mo phag gdong rdo rje dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /chu srin la rdo rje klu dkar po sbrul mgo brgyad dang ldan pa g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas klu'i zhags pa'o/ /chu srin la rngu chu srin ma dkar mo sbrul mgo brgyad dang ldan pa g.yas pas rdo rje dang g.yon pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i chu srin 'dzin pa'o/ /ri dwags la rdo rje rlung sngon po g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas rlung sgrib pa'i gos 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje shugs can ma rdo rje rlung lta bu'o/ /ro langs la rdo rje 'jigs byed sngon po rdo rje dang dbyug to 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rnam par gatshigs ma rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu'o/ /khyad par ni g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byi ba la rdo rje log 'dren dkar po glang po che'i zhal phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dgra sta g.yon pa gnyis kyis rtse gsum pa dang / dbyug to 'dzin pa sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa'o/ /bra ba byi ba la sbrul zimo sngon mo g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas phyags 3shing 'dzin pa'o/ /bsdigs ma ljang gu g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas ral gri'i bye brag phe ṭa ka 'dzin pa'o/ /dpal mo sku mdog ser mo g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa6/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo g.yas na rdo rje g.yon pa na 3pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /seng ge la bgrod dka' ma ljang gu phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang tsakra g.yon pa gnyis na lde mig dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir mgrin pa sngon po la sogs pa'i lha 'di dag gi sgophyag g.yas pa rnams na ji ltar rigs 6 nga ra rdo rje rtse gsum par rig par bya'o/ /39—363
