nyis 'gyur ni gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dpangs te de rnams las nyis 'gyur ni sku'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /mda' yab las phyi rol gyi mchod khye pa'i sa gzhi la ni nas gcig ste sa la sogs pa'i khor yug dang re khā rlum po gnyis kyi dpangs ni sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i re khā'i tshad du'o/ /gzhan rdul tshon dgye ba ni thams cad du nyis 'gyur gyi dbye ba mtshungs pa ste sa gzhi thams cad la'o/ /de la gtso bo'i lte bar lte ba dang mnyam pa'i dkar po dang dmar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan dang dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la spos phor nag po ⑤dang lhor mar me dmar po dang nub tu dung ser po dang byang du bshos dkar po dang / me ④la sogs pa rnams su nag po dang dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po'i rnga yab rnams so/ /de'i phyi rol gyi dbang ldan du chos kyi dung dkar po dang / mer yid bzhin byu nor bu nag po dang bden bral du chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi snyedamar po dang rlung du dpag bsam gyi shing ser po'o//rim pa gnyis bar shar du chu skyes dkar po dang nyi ma la ral gri nag po dang /mer chu skyes dmar po dang zla ba la a la sngon po dang / lhor chu skyes dkar po dang nyi ma la rin po che cha dgu pa dmar po dang / bden bral du chu skyes dmar po dang zla ba la pad+ma dmar po dang / nub tu chu skyes dkar po dang nyi ma la 'khor lo ser po dang rlung du chu skyes dmar po dang zla ba la 'khor lo ser po dang /byang du chu skyes dkar po dang tre nyi ma la pad+ma dkar po dang / dbang ldan du chu skyes dmar po dang zla ba la a la dkar po'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i snam bu la sgo so so'i ngos dag tu gnyis zhes pas pad+ma brgyad de/ de'i drug la kluni nyi ma 39—1144

dang nub dang byang gi sgo'i g.yon dag tu zla ba'o/ /mtshams rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba bzhi'o/ /de rnams su dbang ldan nas brtsams nas me long dang rdo rje dang ral gri dang 3gos dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang ro'i snod dang chos 'byung ba 3 dang 'khor lo dang dri'i dung 1dang pi wang dang pad+ma rnams te/ dkar po dang sngon po dang nag po dang 4ljang gu dang dmar po dang dmar po dang treljang gu dang ser po dang ser po dang sngon po thudang dkar po'o/ /shar gyi sgor pad+ma dang nyi ma la ral gri nag po dang lhor dbyug pa dmar po dang nub tu pad+ma ser po dang byang du tho ba dkar po'o/ /'dir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams ni )chu skyes dkar po la gnas shing zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams ni chu skyes dmar po la gnas pa'o / /stegs bu la rta babs kyi ༄snyertsa bar shar kyi g.yon du dung chos nag po dang g.yas su me tog gi phreng ba sngon po ste/ lhor spos phor dmar po dang mar me'i mchod sdong dang nub tu cod pan ser po dang do shal ser po'osgo/ /byang du 'bras bu dkar po dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod dkar po'o/ /stegs bu thams cad du ni mchod pa rnam pa /1sna tshogs pa thu'adzin pa'i lha mo rnams so/ /rta babs kyi mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas la shar kyi dbus su gos dang 11lhor pad+ma dang nub tu rnga pa ṭa ha dang byang du rdo rje'o/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor du ni pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la shar du gri gug nag po rnams dang mer 'khor lo nag po rnams dang gshin rjer dbyug pa dmar po rnams dang bden bral du shat+ta dmar po rnams dang nub tu rdo rje ser po rnams dang rlung du tshangs pa'i dbyu gu rtse mo ser po can rngurnams dang byang du rtse gsum dkar po rnams dang dbang ldan du pad+ma dkar po rnams so/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu la yang pad+ma'i lte 39—1145

ba dang 'dab ma rnams la mtshan ma rnams te de la shar sgo'i g.yas su ral gri rnams dang mer dpag bsam gyi shing rnams dang lho sgo'i g.yon du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i 1dbyug pa rnams dang g.yas su shat+ta rnams dang bden bral du shat+ta'am yang na mdung rnams dang / nub sgo'i g.yon du rin po cha'i ( byedabyug to rnams dang g.yas su rdo rje rnams dang rlung du khab rnams dang byang sgo'i g.yon du mdung rtse gsum pa rnams dang g.yas su zhags pa rnams dang dbang ldan du dgra sta rnams dang / shar sgo'i g.yon du 'khor lo rnams so/ /shar sgor dbyug pa dang de'i phyi rol du rdo rje ljang gu dang / lho sgor mda' dmar po dang / nub sgor dbyug to ser po dang / de'i phyi rol du rtse gsum sngon po dang / byang sgor gtun shing dkar po ste dbyug pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'di rnams ni pad+ma dang nyi ma nal gnas pa'o/ /gsung dang sku'i dkyil 'khor dag gi phyogs kyi pad+ma rnams ni dmar po ste mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams ni dkar po'o/ /'dir gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi 4stegs bu la shar sgo'i g.yas su ut+pa la dang gos dang gri gug dang 'khor lo dang kha ṭī ga nag po rnams te gegayon du gri gug dang ral gri dang gri gug dang gri gug —nag po'o/ /lho sgo'i g.yas su pad+ma dang ro'i snod dang dbyug pa dang shat+ta dang pad+ma rnams dmar po ste/ g.yon du mda' dang dgra sta dang gri gug dang gri gug 1dmar po'o/ /nub sgo'i g.yas su 'khor lo dang dri'i dung chos dang bye rdo rje dang khab dang 'khor lo rnams ser po ste g.yon du chos 'byung ljang gu dang gri gug thudang gri gug rnams ser po'o/ /byang sgo'i g.yas su at+pa la dang me long dang ⑫rtse gsum dang pad+ma dang ut+pa la rnams 13dkar po ste g.yon du pi wang sngon po dang 8tho ba dang gri gug dang gri gug rnams dkar po'o/ /39—1146

de ltar mtshan ma sum cu rtsa drug po rnams ni sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu rnams la yang ngo / /de nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor bris pa rnam pa thams cad du gsal bar gyur par 47shes nas hūṃ yig dang 'khyil pa bzlas pa'i bdud rtsi byedang bcas pa'i dri'i chus dkyil 'khor kyi phyi ngos su byugs la tshad des 'khor lo bsang zhing / rdul tshon lhag ma rnams la oṃ āX4 hūṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa ༄yegashegs su gsol te sgod na 9gnas pa'i tshon /thurnams dben par gzhag par bya'o zhes pa tshon dgye ba'i cho ga'o // //3de'i rjes su kyesngar lhag par gnas pa / byas pa'i bum pa rnams 1g.yas skor du dgod par bya'o/ /de la 'khor lo'i dbang po'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor /5lo'i g.yas phyogs nas bskor te rdo rje ra ba'i bdag nyid kyi khor /ceyug dang 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i shā)sa gzhi'i phyi rol du dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad ka'i gnas las cung zad g.yas su gzhag par bya'o/ /g.yon logs su ni go rims 15ji lta ba bzhin du g.yas skor gyis rnam par snang mdzad dang spyan ma dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa ste g.yas su gzugs rdo rje dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang gshin rje mthar byed rnams kyi'o/ /lho'i g.yon du rin chen rmya'abyung ldan dang mā ma tī hu3dang g.yas su sgra rdo rje ma dang shes rab mthar byed dag gi'o/ /nub kyi g.yon du snang ba mtha' yas dang gos dkar mo dag dang g.yas su dri rdo rje ma dang / pad+ma mthar byed dag gi'ocho / /byang gi g.yon du don yod grub pa dang / sgol ma dag dang / g.yas su ro rdo rje ma dang / reg bya rdo rje ma dang / bye bgegs mthar byed dag gi'o ༄ 1/ /gshin 39byed1147

rje mthar byed la sogs pa khro bo rnams kyi ni me ① la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams bye su'o zhes pa kha cig gis te 1de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byekyi de ma thag tu khro bo rnams kyi dang rigs kyi yum rnams kyi ni sgo'i g.yas rnams su'o zhes pa gzhan dag gis sothu/ /'di'i rjes su 'brangs nas phyogs gzhan rnams su yang dgod par — shes par bya'o/ /'dod pa gzhan yang yod mod des ci zhig bya/de ltar 'di ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la bum pa dgod pa'o/ /bsdus pa'i rim pa'i dkyil 'khor la g.yon du rigs kyi yum gyi de ma thag tu yang ⑦ g.yas su 8dang por byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po rnams kyi'o/ /zur gyi khro bo rnams kyi 6zur rnams su dang gshin rje mthar byed kyi rjes la gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i dang / pad+ma mthar byed kyi rjes la gnod mdzes kyi ste khyad par ro/ /'di dag gi 7rjes su 'brangs te dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la bum pa dgod pa ni rtogs sla bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /zur bzhi'i bum pa rnams la ni sgo dang bcas pa'i mda' bzhi ste/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa'i skye sngags kyis dgod par bya'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 7la ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las phyi rol du shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su bum pa 6 brgyad dang / nub kyi bum pa las phyi rol du sor gnyis spangs par rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa dang / shar gyi bum pa las phyi rol du sor gnyis spangs par rgyal ba'i bum pa ste/ de'i steng du rnam par rgyal ba chen po'i bum pa dung chos ni bcu gcig pa'o/ /5shar du rgyal ba'i bum pa yang ste lnga pa'o/ /de'i steng du rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni dung chos te drug pa'o zhes pa bum pa lnga pa'i snyephyogs la'o/ /bum pa bcu'i phyogs la ni phyogs brgyad du bum pa brgyad dang / nub kyi bum pa las phyi rol 39—11 18

du sor gnyis spangs par rnam par kyergyal ba'i bum pa dang / shar kyi bum pa las phyi rol du sor gnyis spangs par zurgyal ba'i bum pa ste de'i steng du rnam par rgyal ba chen po'i dung chos ni bcu gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du brgya phrag stong gi bum pa rnams la yang rnam par rgyal ba chen po ni dung chos te zhi ba dang rgyas pa chodang las thams cad pa la yang ngo zhes pa bum pa dgod pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du phyogs bzhir /④shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos bzhi bklag phya par bya'o/ /ga bur dang a ka ru dang tu ru bye la sogs pa'i spos phor brgyad gzhag par bya'o/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i na bza' stong la sogs pa 'am lha so so re re la sogs pa ji ltar nus pa yang rung slob ma la sogs par 3/gzhag pa dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan rnams hūṃ yig dang bdag po'i sngags kyis bzlas pa oṃ spa ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pas phul nas gnas ji lta bar gzhag par bya ste/ rta babs dang gos bzang po dang dril bu dang bcas pa'i rnga yab dang bum pa gang ba dang lo ma dang bcas pa'i chu shing gi sdong bu'i hūṃ7ka ba rnams kyang ngo / /de nas khrus byas shing dri zhim po'i lus stod g.yogs dang gtsug tor dang rgyan dang bcas pas 'khyel pa bzlas pa'i chus dkyil 'khor bsangs te yi ge gsum dang 'khyel pa'i sngags kyis tso snabasrungs nas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung ste shar kyi sgo dang nye bar nub tu gdong phyogs tshipas 'dug la 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi tsharnal 'byor dang ldan pas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor shāshāskad cig gis stong pa nyid kyi rjes su srung — ba'i 'khor lo dang bgegs la phur bus gdab pa la sogs pa'i cho ga 'khor dang 39—1149

bcas pas bsgom par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi rang bzhin du nges par brtags nas / btsun mo mdzes shing ltas bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon rnyed nas—/ /dri dang me tog gis brgyan te/ /de yi dbus su 'dod pa bya/ /yon tan ska rags mā ma /tīr/ /shes rab can kyis de byin brlab/ /zhi ba spro bya sangs rgyas gnas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni rab tu brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pas rab tu bsgrub ri —pa'i phyir phyi rol gyi phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pa'am/ / de med na ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang snyems par 'jug pas yang dag par bskyod pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la/zhabs bsil dang zhal bsel dang mchod yon dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas rang gi gnas su 4bcug nas 'dod chags chen po 5zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mar phyung ba'i ye shes kyi lha'i 'khor lo'i bdag nyid spros te/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo la ji lta ba bzhin du sdozhugs par bsams nas/ mig dang sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs shing rāde ma thag tu rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug 8pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur nas ji ltar rigs par rgyas gdab ste rigs mi shes pa rnams ni mi bskyod pa'am rdo rje sems dpas so/ /de nas lha mo spros pa she7rnams kyis yid kyi rang bzhin gyi mchod pas mchod cing / bsel ba'i ras dang ras zung bla re la rmyedapyangs pa dang gos dang / yi ge gsum gyis bsngags pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dang bldag tshipa dang ⑫btung ba'i nye bar spyad pa la sogs pa dang / gser dang bu mo dang glang po che dang rta dang ba lang la sogs pa phul la gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i ngo bo phyi rol gyi rnal 'byor ma bcu drug gam brgyad dam bzhis rang 39—1150

rang gi mchod pas 1 mchod nas dril bu dkrol zuzhing mi bskyod rdo rje zhes byepa la sogs pas bstod de/ rang dang shes rab kyi me tog dang bcas pa'i byang chub kyi sems pad+ma'i sgod du bcug pa bdud rtsi dang bcas pa phul bas/ de rnams bdud rtsi myangs pas 5 tshim par gyur cing bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du mos par byas la 'khor lo'i dbang po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang / de las gzhan dkyil 'khor ba'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig dang yi ge brgya pa bzlas par bya'o/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i cho gas 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma gtang byebar bya ste—/ yod na sgrub pa'i grogs po dkyil 'khor du bzhag nas phyi rol du phyung la shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su 'chad par 'gyur ba'i cho gas pa sna'abyung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho gas rang gi 'dod pa'i 4lha dang dbang po la sogs pa la gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa gan rkyal du byas la gung mo dang ming med cung zad bkug pa kha la mngon du phyogs par gzung bar bya'o/ /de'i rtse mos lag pa gnyis pus mo'i nang du byas nas tsog potsog por 'dug ste mi smra bar de'i rtse mos 7lag pa'i ze'u 'bru'i chas kha la lan mang du byab cing /lan gnyis sam gsum du 1 rna ba'i bug pa gnyis dang mig dag dang kha dang lag pa dag dang lte ba dang mgo bo rnams la reg par bya'o zhes pa nye reg gi cho ga bya'o//de nas grub na lhag pa ⑪ la sogs pa'i nyes pa kyezhi bar bya ba'i phyir zhi ba dang /dkyil 'khor tshim par bya ba'i phyir zhi ba dang shārtergyas pa'i sbyin sreg 'chad par 'gyur ba byas nas khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas me tog gi phreng ba blangs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi 6 hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ kṛ1 pa ya kṛsnra bla pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bibyā 039—1151

rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dpal kha sbyor du gsungs pa'i khams gsum 1rnam par rgyal ba'i sngags zlos shing rdo rje shugs kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa ⑤la rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol te rdo rje'i rkang pas de kho na bzhin du oṃ t+pa①hūṃ phaṭa ces pa dang / oṃ hūṃ uphaṭa ces pa dang / oṃ hūṃ snya.oṃ④ phaṭa ces pa dang /oṃ hūṃ ha na mā ra ya dubyen ghā ta ya ghā ta ya āḥ.āḥhūṃ trīḥ④phaṭa ces pa'i sngags rngu rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du zlos pa'i shar dang lho la sogs pa'i sgo'i slob dpon rnams dang pelhan cig tu g.yas skor ④byas nas lhag pa dang ma tshang ba'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir 'khor lo la bltas te phreng ba bcom ldan 'das la dbul zhing bskor ⑨ba'i grangs ji lta ba bzhin du nub sgo la sogs pa bzhir gnas pas shar sgo la sogs pa bzhi oṃ badzot+ta ṭa rmye 7 sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis phye bar bsams te/ oṃ sa ma yi pra be ⑪shā mi zhes brjod nas gar byed cing phreng ba blangs la rang gi mgo la bcings te 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal nas sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi skal ba thams cad stsol ⑫cig ces gsol ba gdab cing bsgom pa dang bzlas pa bya'o/ /'dir dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa las phyi rol du rnam par snang mdzad dang de'i rigs kyi lha rnams kyi ba dan ni mer dgod par bya'o / /rin chen dbang po dang de'i rigs kyi lha rnams ni bden bral du'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas dang de'i rigs las byung ba rnams kyi rlung du'o/ /don yod grub pa dang de'i rigs kyi lha rnams kyi ⑫dbang ldan du'o/ /'khor lo'i ⑩dbang po'i shar phyogs su ste de'i rigs kyi lha rnams kyi ni rang rang gi phyogs su'o zhes pa kha cig go/ /dbang por ni ⑫khyab 'jug gi nag po dang zla ba'i dkar po dang nyi ma'i dmar po dang me'i —3ser po ste nub tu sa'i lha mo'i ser po dang 39—1152

thags rmyebazangs ris kyi nag po'o/ /dbang ldan du ni tshogs kyi bdag po'i dkar po ste ma 'byor na ji ltar nus pa'i ba dan dbul bar bya'o zhes pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub (zhe pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i cho ga'o // //ge 'dir brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ④lha rnams kyi kha dog la sogs pa bsgom phyepa'i rim pa shes par bya ba'i phyir yang dag par bsdus nas mchog tu gyur pa'i sems can rnams la bshad par bya'o/ /'dir gang gi phyir chung ngu dang 'bring po'i rim pa dag gi ting nge 'dzin legs par bsgom hūṃpa las shes rab mchog tu gyur pa rnams la bcom ldan 'das kyis⑦ / rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /spro du zhing sdud pa'i byed pa po/ /skad cig gis ni ye shes rdzogs/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs par bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa de'i phyir rang dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang bye 7nyid thob par 'dod pa'i mngon par spro ba dang ldan pas phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa gzugs can gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang ro gcig par 'i nges par byas nas 'od gsal bar /nyezhugs pa las skad cig gis yan lag dang bcas pa'i gzhal yang khang gi dbus su dkyil 'khor pas yongs su bskor zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i dbu rgyan dang thugs ka'i sa bon dang ldan pa stong pa nyid dang snying rje ro gcig pa bden pa skye chen po'i rang bzhin can dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i sku dpag tu med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo la sogs pa spros te chos ston pa la sogs pas skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du gzhan la phan pa kyemadzad nas bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la 'jog 39—1153

cing sdud pa bsam gyis 1mi khyab pa'i skur 'char bar bya'o/ /de la yan lag la sogs pa ni 'di yin te/ sa 'og gi mthar thug par ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i rgyar gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi bskal 2pa'i mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng bas mtshams bcings pa dang sa 'og nas steng gi bar du shin tu mtho ba mthug 4cing mkhregs la sra zhing 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i ra ba dang rdo rje'i ra ba'i steng du bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i steng rdo rje'i dra ba dang 'og rdo rje'i bla res brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i gur 'bar ba'o/ /de'i nang du 6gnas par sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa ser snye po g.yas skor du 'khor ba'o/ /de'i rtsibs la shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can rdo rje tho ba nag po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po nag po dang dmar po'i zhal can rdo rjes ༄ —mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po sngon po dang dkar po'i zhal can/ pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 9'dzin pa'o/ /byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can rdo rje kha gyes pa dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can/ lcags kyu dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma tre'adzin pa'o/ /bden bral du dbyug sngon can nag po dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du stobs po che nag po dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can/ rtse gsum dang ral gri dang 39byed1154

nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du mi g.yo ba sngon po rmye dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can ral gri dang rdo rje dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba rteser po sngon po dang dmar po'i zhal can 'khor lo ser po dang ral gri dang nor bu zudang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can rdo rje dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /de la gtsug tor dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang mi g.yo ba thudang gnod mdzes rnams ni rin po che'i cod pan can/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po ches brgyan cing 'gying bar gyur pa mche ba cung zad gcigs par ston cing rngu khros pa'i sma ra dang ldan pa'o/ /de las gzhan pa rnams ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i gzugs can smin ma 'khyog pa dang bcas pa dbu skra ser po gyen du badze+es pa smin ma dang sma ra ser ba mche ba gcigs shing zhal gdangs pa ljags 'gyur ba gad rgyangs dang ldan pa drag po'i klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa sku bong thung zhing rags khupa lto ba 'phyang ba'o/ /bcu po 'di dag ni g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa kyertsibs kyi rtse mo la cung zad ma reg pa'i sna tshogs chu skyes nyi ma dang bcas pa'i gdan la brtan par gnas pa/ nyi ma'i 'od can rab tu khro ba zudang 'bar bas shin tu 'jigs kyepa dus mtha'i me lta bu'i 'od dang ldan pa'i rang gi sprul pa dpag tu med pa'i tshogs kyis kyang khams gsum mtha' yas pa na gnas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa yang dang yang du rlag 0par byed pa phyag drug pa rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab la 'khyud ⑪pa/ zhal gsum pa rtsa ba'i zhal sku mdog lta bu g.yas pa dang g.yon pa ni brjod zin pa ji lta ba bzhin te/ zhal re re la yang dmar la zlum pa'i 39—1155

—spyan gsum gsum 1mo/ /'khor lo yang rgyun mi 'chad par drag tu 'khor bas brtan par gnas pa lta bu ste 'bar ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'o /de'i lte ba'i nang 'og gi rtsibs snyekyi steng du chos 'byung kyigru gsum pa dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i nang du 'og gi zur la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'o/ /rdo rje de'i phyogs kyi ra rnams dang lte ba ni ji ltar rigs par rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sku mdog dang 'dra ba'o/ /der rin po che kha dog lnga las yongs su rdzogs shing 'od gsal ba'i thub pa'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pa'i 'od kyi sa phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang ngo / /de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' 5'jam pa'i rdo rje'i 4sku gur kum kyi mdog lta bu g.yas dang phyo g.yon gyi zhal nag po dang dkar po rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab la 'khyud pa/ ral gri dang mda' dang a la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can sna tshogs pa'i rin po che la sogs pas brgyan cing 'od zer mtha' yas pa'o/ /de'i shar phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal nag po dang dmar po/ phyag rnams na 8 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dkar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che cha dgu pa'i ma ra ka ta dang ral gri 6dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang 'khor lo dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o hūṃ/ /'di gsum gyi g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal ni nag po dang dkar po'o/ /de bzhin 39—1156

gshegs pa thams cad rin po che'i cod pan dang ldan zhing rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /mer spyan ma rnam par snang mdzad dang ṭ+wāmatshungs pa'o//bden bral du mā ma tī bye mi bskyod pa lta bu ut+pa la dmar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa ste sgrub thabs thams cad las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro//rlung du gos dkar mo snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa'o/ /dbang ldan du sgol ma rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu at+pa la ser po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas dbus kyi rim pa las phyi rol du me'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma rnam par snang mdzad lta bu me long dmar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma mi bskyod pa lta bu pi wang sngon po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du dri rdo rje ma rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu dri'i dung chos ser po dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ro rdo rje ma snang ba mtha' yas lta bu ro'i snod dmar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgo'i g.yon logs su reg bya rdo rje ma don yod grub pa lta bu gos sna tshogs pa gdang / ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgo'i g.yas logs su chos dbyings rdo rje ma rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu chos 'byung dkar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha 'di rnams ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa ༄phyag mtshan dang po gnyis rgyagayas pa dag gis dang gzhan pa gnyis g.yon pa dag gis 'dzin pa ste thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i zhal ni sku mdog bzhin no/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su gshin rje mthar byed dang shes rab mthar byed dang pad+ma mthar byed dang bdud rtsi 'khyel pa 39—1157

rnams so/ /'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo bcu drug 7po rnams ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje thuskyil krung gis bzhugs pa ste/gzhan rnams ni nyi ma la'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma rnams kyi 'og tu sna tshogs 'dam skyes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'i phyag kyedag gis rang 'od kyi shes rab la 'khyud pa ste lha mo rnams kyang rang 'od kyi thabs la'o/ /dbu la rigs kyi bdag po ste 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mā ma tī 4dang sgra rdo rje ma dang srung 5 ba'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i khro bo brgyad la mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang gzugs rdo rje ma dang gshin rje mthar byed rnams la rnam par snang mdzad de/ dri rdo rje ma la ni rin chen dbang po'o/ /gos dkar mo dang ro rdo rje ma dang pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med de sgol ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma la ni don yod grub pa'o/ /chos dbyings rdo rje ma la rdo rje 'dzin pa ste gzhan rnams la ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /'dir rdo rje sems dpa' ni sku mdog dkar po la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal ni sngon po dang dmar po/ rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis rang 'od kyi shes rab la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje sngon po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis rtsobazhugs pa zla ba'i 'od can rin po che'i cod pan dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa mi bskyod pas rgyas 3btab pa'o/ /'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar dam spyotshig sems dpa' lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' ste de'i thugs ka'i zla bar ral gri'i yu bar 6gnas pa'i zla ba la sa bon saṃ mo 3/ /rtag pa dang rin chen dbang po dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa dang mi bskyod pa rnams kyi thugs kar phyag 39—1158

par yongs su dag cing rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa la rgyun mi 'chad par yang dang yang du lhag par mos pa brtan par bya'o/ /snying po'i sngags la sogs pa bstan pa ni bum pa lhag par gnas pa la sogs pa la nye bar sbyar ba'i don du'o/ /gang gi tshe dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gtso bor gyur pa de'i tshe dbus su gnas pa de gzhan ①de'i gnas su dgod do/ /'od dpag tu med pa dkar por yang 'gyur ro/ / gru chos rnams dkar po'i rang bzhin kyis/ /'dir ni gsung gi dbang phyug dkar/ /zhes ⑦gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gang gi dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i gtso bo'i gnas dag gong chedu bshad pa de'i tshe 3gtso bo de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi ñtsa dbang po la mngon par phyogs shing / de dang 'khyud pa 7ni de la mngon par phyogs pa nyid de gzhan gyi gnas su phyin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir gzhal yas khang gi yan lag ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rdo rje'i 3 sa gzhi la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i rdo rje'i guri dang srung ba'i 'khor lo dang chos kyi 'byung gnas so/ /de la rdo rje'i gur ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzhal yas khang thams cad la ste/srung ba'i 'khor lo dang chos kyi 'byung gnas ni 'ga' zhig kho na la 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /bri bar bya ba'i gzhal yas khang rnams la ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo chos 'byung ngam chos kyi dbyings kyi khongs su chud pa mtshon pa'i ched du rdo rje'i phreng ba bri bar bshad do/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin ṭunang / /zhes pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dkyil 'khor rtogs par bya ba'i phyir 3dhe du 'jig rten gyi khams kyi khor yug mtshon pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba ⑪bri ba ni nges par ro/ /'dir srung ba'i 'khor lo ni de lta ma yin pas bri mi dgos te/ bgegs zlog ⑫ pa ni 39—1160

gzhan gyis kyang byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang stong pa nyid kho na bcom ldan 'das ma ste bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa rtsa ba dang bcas pa rlag she par byed pa'i nus pa rab tu gyur pas de la lhag par mos pa brtan pa nyid bskyed pa'i ched du bri bar bya ba'i dkyil 'khor la srung ba'i 'khor lo bri bar ma bstan to/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor la yang kha cig tu bsgom par gsungs kyi thams cad la ni ma yin no/ /bgegs bsal ba'i grurjes la stong pa nyid du rab tu zhugs pas bsgom dupar bya ba'i dkyil 'khor la srung ba'i 'khor lo med de/ de'i phyir mi bri'o zhe na de lta na khor yug mtshon pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba yang mi bri bar 'gyur ro/ /yang gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i dus su de yang bskyed do zhe na ma yin te/bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje'i ra ba lan gnyis bskyed par gang nas kyang ma gsungs pas lan gnyis bskyed pas ci zhig bya/ cig car lgordzogs pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang mtshams bcing ba (dedang rdo rje'i ra ba la sogs pa thum lus pa kun brtags pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma'i ngo bor gnas pa nyid kyi phyir ro4—/ /de ltar srung ba'i 'khor lo yod kyang dkyil 'khor du mi bri ba nyid kyi 3 'thad pa brjod pa nyid do/ /kha cig ni srung ba'i 'khor lo bri bar bya'o zhes kyang 'dod do zhes pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro / /9 bsdus pa'i rim par gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor la yang gzhal yas khang gi mthar thug pa ni snga ma bzhin te/ khro bo rnams kyi khyad par ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su mi bskyod pa nag po drag po g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal dkar po dang dmar po phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis ⑩khro bo'i rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma rnams dang g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang yid 39—1161

bzhin gye nor bu dang kyeral gri 'dzin pa rte dang 'dra ba'i reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud pa'o cho / /de'i shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa ste/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams snyesu spyan ma la sogs pa'o/ /de la rnam par snang mdzad ni dkar po zhi ba/ dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i 5 zhal can 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dkar po dang dril bu dang nor bu dang 4ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /bshad zin pa dang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyag mtshan rnams ni rim pa bzhin du dze+ephyag g.yas par dang por 5 steng nas 'og tu dang g.yon par 'og nas steng du rig par bya'obye / /rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i rim pas zhal gyi kha 6 dog gsum yang rig par bya'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan ni ser po ste ser po dang nag po dang dmar po'i ⑪ zhal can nor bu dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang dril bu dang pad+ma ser po dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas ni dmar po dang nag po dang dkar ba'i rkyezhal can phyag g.yon pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar nyurtepo'i yu ba thugs kar bzung ba phyag g.yas pas ḍikha 'byed pa ste gzhan rnams kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ / don yod grub pa ni ljang gu ste ljang gu dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal can ral gri dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang dril bu dang pad+ma ljang gu dang nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /mude bzhin gshegs pa lnga po 'di dag dang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i kun du bzang po'i bar ni ral pa'i thor cog dang rin po che'i cod pan can rnam pa /zisna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /spyan ma ni rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang pad+ma dkar po'i gnas su at+pa mul dkar po'o/ /mā ma tī ni thumi bskyod pa dang 39—1162

mtshungs pa ste 'on kyang pad+ma'i gnas su ut+pa la sngo /1dmar ro/ /gos dkar mo ni ⑤ snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa'o/ /sgol ma ni don yod grub pa dang mtshungs pa ste/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang at+pa la sngo ser dang dril bu dang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la me'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma spyan ma lta bu ste 'on kyang phyag dang bo dag gis me long dmar po 'dzin pa'ohūṃ/ /bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma ser mo ser po dang nag po 4dang dkar po'i zhal can rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis hūṃpi wang sngon po bsgreng ba 6ste phyag lhag ma rnams kyis rdo rje dang ut+pa la sngon po shaṃdang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o—/ /rlung du dri rdo rje ma gos dkar mo lta bu rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis dri'i dung chos ser po'o5 / /dbang ldan du ro rdo rje ma ljang gu ljang gu dang nag po dang dkar ba'i tsu zhal can phyag dang po dag gis ro'i snod dmar po 'dzin pa ste lhag ma rnams kyis khu rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o 3 / /rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu la byams pa dang sa'i snying po'o/ /lhor phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /nub tu 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs so/ /byang du sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang kun du bzang po'o/ /brgyad po 'di rnams ni /1rtsa ba'i rigs kyi bdag po dang mtshungs pa ste 'on kyang byams pa ni rtsa ba'i phyag gis yal ga dang bcas pa'i klu shing gi me tog 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo dang me la sogs pa'i mtshams dang steng dang 'og tu yang rim pa ji lta ba 1nabazhin du khro bo bcu'o/ /de la gshin rje gshed nag po nag po dang ladakar po dang mudamar po'i zhal can rdo rje ⑩tho ba dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i 39—1163

sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar po dang nag po dang ①dmar po'i zhal can du rdo rje dang rdo rjes rngumatshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang ral gri dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar po 5 dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal can pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri dang gtun shing dang dril bu dang dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngon po ⑤dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang gtun shing dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba sngon po sngon po bye dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can ral gri dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang sdigs mdzub dang dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can rtsa ba'i phyag ⑦ gis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad cing gzhan rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyug sngon can nag po nag po dang dkar po dang ṅkudamar po'i zhal can rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang pad+ma dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o—/ /stobs bo che nag po nag po dang dkar po dang kyedamar po'i zhal can rdo rjes / snamatshan pa'i dbyug pa dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang thugs kar sdigs mdzub nyu1zhags pa dang bcas pa rkyedang pad+ma dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba nag po nag po 1 dang dkar bo dang dmar po'i zhal can rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya 6spyi bor 'dzin pa lhag ma rnams kyis 39byed1164

rdo rje dang pad+ma dang sdigs mdzub dang ral gre 'dzin pa ste/ phyag gnyis thal mo gan rkyul du mnyam par brkyang ba'i srin lag gnyis kyi sen mo'i steng du maze bong gnyis kyi sen mos mnan te mthe ①chung gnyis brkyang ba'o/ /de bzhin du bye gung mo gnyis kyi sen mo rnguyang dag par rtse sprad la mdzub mo dbus su gnyis ka'i chornam pa ni kun du snang ba zhes bya ba gtsug tor kyi phyag rgya'o zhes 37 kha cig gi ste 'ga' zhig ni gzhan no/ /gnod mdzes nag po nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang pad+ma dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa 'di rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du go rims 7ji lta ba bzhin du rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang 'khor lo dang cha dgu pa'i rin po che ma ra ka ta ju snadang pad+ma dmar po dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang 9klu shing gi me tog dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang rdo rje dang rdo rje tho ba dang rdo rje dang te chu skyes dmar po dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang ral gri dang rdo rje khu tshur dang dbyug pa sngon po dang tso1dbyug pa nag po dang rdo rje dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i dbyug pa dang thunyi ma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa'i 11zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /yang gzhan las ni lha rnams kyi rang rang thugi mdog lta bu'i rin po che las byas pa'o/ /de la 6rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni zla ba la gnas pa ste ltogazhan rnams ni nyi 7ma la gnas pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rnams ni rdo rje paskyil krung can no/ /khro bo rnams ni zhabs g.yas brkyang ba g.yon bskum pa zhal so so la dmar la zlum 39—1165

pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa 'bar zhing sgra sgogs pa shin tu 'jigs su rung ba srung ba'i 'khor lor bshad pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba'i gzugs la sogs pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir ni 'khor lo'i dbang phyug kho na yum dang bcas pa ste gnod mdzes kyi mthar thug pa'i lha gzhan rnams ni yum med pa'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i gshin rje gshed khyel sogs pa ni rang 'od kyi shes rab dang bcas pa ste/ de yang go rims bubazhin du rdo rje ro langs ma dang gzhan gyis mi thub ma ④ dang khro gnyer can ma dang ral gcig ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang sna tshogs rin shechen ma dang sna tshogs pad+ma ma bye 7dang sna tshogs las ma dang nam mkha'i rdo rje ma dang sa 'dzin ma 3rnams so/ /mi bskyod pa la thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa dmar po shes rab dang bcas pa 1de'i thugs kar hūṃ nag po'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi ⑨thugs kar oṃ dang rin chen dbang po rkul swā dang snang ba mtha' yas la 26 ⑪dang don yod grub pa la hā mudang / spyan ma la sogs pa'i kyenalha mo rnams la dze+e rmā dzā tsā dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrngudang reg bya rdo rje ma la khaṃ dang byams pa la sogs pa brgyad po rnams la mo zlo ⑫oṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ oṃ 1r+ṣasaṃ dang khro bo bcu po rnams la hūṃ ngo du / /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rnams kyi snying po'i sngags ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du gsungs pa nyid de byams pa la sogs pa rnams kyi ni oṃ āḥmo tre ya mo tsu)hūṃ/ oṃ āXk+ṣi ti gar+bha zlo lku hūṃ/ oṃ a badz+ra pā ṇi bye oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ 26kha ḍa 1gar+bha oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ lo ki shwa ra oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ la mañdzu sgo 3ṣa hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ labyusarba ni ba ra ṇa biskasdi 3ni oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥs man+ta bha dra saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ ṭak+ki rā 3dza hūṃ hūṃ/oṃ āḥbhā la daṇ+ḍa —5hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ uṭī ṣa rngo hūṃ hūṃ/39—1166

oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza 1hūṃ hūṃ/ gang gi tshe mi bskyod pa dang dbyer med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor lo'i gedabang por gyur pa de'i tshe 'di'o / /rngu.oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags so/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni mi bskyod pa dang kun du bzang po dag gi gong du brjod pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' ste 'on kyang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang dril bu dang nor bu dang ral gri 'dzin pa rang dang 'u'adra ba'i rdo rje dbyengs kyi dbang phyug mas yang dag par 'khyud pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mā ma tī pya dang phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams kyi klu mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang gzugs rdo rje ma dang byams pa dang sa'i snying po dang gshin rje mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba rnams kyi rnam par snang mdzad do/ /sgra rdo rje ma dang nam mkha'i snying po dang shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po rnams kyi rin chen khrudabang bo'o/ /gos dkar mo dang dri rdo rje ma dang 'jig rten dbang phyug ma dang 1snapad+ma mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can rnams kyi snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sgol ma dang ro rdo rje lngadang reg bya rdo rje ma dang rnam par sel ba dang bgegs mthar byed dang stobs po che rnams kyi don yod grub skyepa'o/ /rgyas 'debs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa shārta'akhor los sgyur ba'i gzugs can no / /thudapal kun du kha sbyor du zhe/gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur kyi nang du srung ba'i 'khor lo'i lte bar rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor dang ri rab kyi steng du chos 'byung gi skyedabus su gzhal yas khang ngo //srung ba'i 'khor lo la gshin rje gshed ni phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis merdo rje lcags 39—1167

kyu dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang g.yon pa gsum gyis ①thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab mthar kyebyed ni rdo rje zhags pa dang rdo rje dang geral gri dang thugs kar sdogs mdzub dang dril bu ④dang dgra sta'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed ni lcags sgog dang pad+ma dang ral gri dang dril bu dang dgra sta dang zhags pa'o/ //④bgegs dgra ni rdo rje dril bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gtun shing dang dgra sta'o/ / mi g.yo ba ni ④ral gri dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub dang dgra sta dang zhags pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po ni g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi 3phyag gnyis kyis kyerdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang lcags kyu dang ral gri dang rdo rje zhags pa'o/ /dbyug sngon can ni ⑨rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang pad+ma dang dgra sta'o/ /stobs po che ni rtse gsum dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang pad+ma dang dgra sta'o/ /dze+egatsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ni g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi phyag gnyis kyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang sdigs mdzub dang ral gri'o/ /gnod mdzes ni rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 8dang pad+ma dang ral gri'o—/ /bcu po 'di rnams ni dbu la thod pa lngas brgyan pa ༄ ༷ 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya tsu— dang ldan pa mi mgo'i phreng ba mgul la 'phyang ba go rims ⑫ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen dbang po dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa dang rtag pa dang rin chen dbang po dang 'od dpag 839—1168

med dang don yod grub pa dang mi bskyod pa dang mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi snying por rdo rje kye 'dzum pa dang bcas pa cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa'i sku mdog dkar po ral pa'i thor cog nag po la gnas pa'i nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i 'og tu g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i zla ba phyed pa byedri ma med pa dang sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga dang 'khor lo dang rna cha dang mgul rgyan ④ dang lag gdub dang ska rags dang thal chen rnams kyis brgyan pa zhal gsum pa snye g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi zhal sngon po dang dmar po zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa phyag drug pa rdo rje dang dril bus rnam par mdzes pa'i phyag gnyis kyis 'u rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab la 'khyud cing chu skyes la mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba 4 dang ldan pa phyag g.yas pa dag gis ral gri dang lcags kyu dag dang g.yon pa dag gis 8 thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba la ye shes sems dpa' sgu mdog dkar dmar sems dpa'i skyil krung can sangs rgyas lngas spras pa'i rin po che'i cod pan dang rin po ches brgyan pa rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma kyel 'khyud pa ste de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i rang bzhin ⑩hūṃ yig nag po'o/ /'dir sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang gi shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 4 zhi ba/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis 'khor lo dang dril bu 15g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen dbang po 39—1169

ser po phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis rin po che dang lcags kyu g.yon ①dag gis thod pa dang zhags pa'o/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas tso7dmar po phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis mda' dang pad+mahūṃ/ g.yon pa dag gis gzhu dang zhags pa'o/ /byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang lcags kyu 4g.yon pa dag gis dril bu dang thod pa'o/ /dbang ldan du srun ma dkar mo phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang sa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thuthod pa dang dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu'o/ / mer mā ma tī sngon mo thu phyag bcu gnyis pa 3g.yas pa rnams kyis kyemada' dang ral gri dang rdo rje dang — 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang lcags kyu dang dril bu dang zhags pa dang thod pa dang kha ṭī shārtaga'o / /bden bral du gos dkar mo dmar po spuphyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis mda' dang pad+ma dang ral gri dang rdo rje ⑫/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rmyegazhu dang thod pa dang zhags pa dang thudril bu'o/ /rlung du sgol ma ljang gu phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis / ut+pa la dmar po dang ral gri dang lcags kyu dang mda'/ g.yon pa —rnams kyis 'khor lo dang zhags pa dang thod pa dang tsu5gzhu'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la shar phyogs su rdo rje drag mo dkar mo mda' dang lcags kyu dang gzhu dang 4 9byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa can no/ /lhor gzugs rdo rje sa— ma ser mo rdo rje dang mdung dang zhags pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa can no/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo ral gri dang rdo rje dang dri chus —kyegang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu can no/ /byang du rdo rje kyezhi ba ma ljang gu thal char dang ba dan —gsum pa dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ༷ zig dang thod pa 39—1170

can no/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin mo dkar ser dbyug pa dang ut+pa la dang thod pa dang ḍa 1 ma ru can no/ /mer rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar ser pad+ma dang me long dang rkang mar gyis 3gang ba'i thod pa dang dgra sta can no/ /bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma sngo dmar shat+ta dang dung kyedang 'khor lo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa can no/ /rlung du sa rdo rje ma dkar ljang pad+ma dang rdo rje dang bdud rtsi dang sgron mas gang ba'i thod pa mi lpags kyis cegayogs pa dang dril bu can no//brgyad po 'di rnams ni phyag bzhi ma phyag byedang po gnyis ni g.yas pa dag gis te gzhan gnyis ni g.yon pa ༷ dag gis 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa la shar phyogs su bzhad ma tho dmar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas mngon par bshad ldupa'i tshul can no/ /lhor sgeg mo sngon mo ⑨phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas bsnyems epa dang bcas par mngon par sgeg pa'i tshul can no//nub tu glu ma ser mo shārte/cung zad g.yo zhing sgeg pa'i phyag gnyis ting nyu2ting shags 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du gar 6ma ljang gu pad kor ⑫gyi tshul la sogs pa'i gar kyis g.yo ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje 6rtse gsum pa dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo'o/ /mer pi wang ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis sgeg pa'i ⑩nyams kyis sku ⑫cung zad g.yo ba'o/ /bden bral du mu kun da /5ma dkar mo'o/ /rlung du rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can te/ bzhi po 'di rnams ni phyag gnyis kyis rang rang gi rol mo sgogs pa'o/ /de nas phyi'i snam bu la rnge mtshams su me tog ma dkar mo g.yon pa dang cig shos kyi 1 phyag gis me tog gi phreng ba dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can g.yon pa dang cig shos kyi phyag gis bdug spos kyi snod hūṃrin po che 'dzin 39—1171

pa'o / /rlung du mar me ma gser gyi mdog can g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag gis mar me'i mchod sdong dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du dri chab ma dmar mo g.yon pa dang cig shos kyi phyag gis dri'i dung chos rmyedang ral gri 'dzin pa'o / /shar du me long ma dkar mo kyephyag gnyis kyis rdume long 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor ro ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis ro'i byasnod 'dzin pa'o/ / nub tu reg bya ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis sna tshogs pa'i gos 'dzin pa'o/ /3byang du chos ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis chos 'byung dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams dang rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa 1lha rnams ni zhal gcig ⑦spyan gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan nag po la thod pa byelnga dang 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa/lha'i na bza' gyon pa skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du rdo rje be+egs kyu ma nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs zhal g.yas pa dang cig shos nag po dang kyedakar po phyag drug gi tshobye g.yas pa rnams kyis lcags kyu dang ral gri dang 'khor lo nyu1g.yon pa rnams kyis zhags pa dang sdogs mdzub dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser zhal g.yas pa dang cig shos nag po dang dmar po phyag drug gi thugayas pa rnams kyis zhags pa dang rdo rje dang ral grinyu)/ g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog ma dmar mo zhal g.yas pa dang cig shos nag po dang dkar po phyag drug gi rngugayas pa rnams kyis lcags sgog ༄ 5dang rdo rje dang ral griri / g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu dang lcags kyu'o༄ rte/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu zhal g.yas pa dang cig shos nag po dang dkar po phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis dril bu dang rdo rje 39—1172

dang ral gri hūṃ/ g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang lcags kyu dang zhags pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams ni zhal re re zhing spyan gsum 1gsum pa dbu skra dmar —ser 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pasnyu/ thod pa lnga dang 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa—/ stag gi pags pa'i gos can zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bsgum pa'i gar gyis sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod blagrub pa rnams ni sna tshogs chu skyes dang thod pa dang nyi ma la ste lha gzhan thams cad sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang zla ba la du gnas pa'o/ /thams cad kyang ⑦nyi ma'i 'od zer dang ldan pa nyid do/ /'dir rdo rje sems dpa' kho na yum dang bcas pa ste lha gzhan thams cad ni yum med pa'o zhes pa ni phyogs gcig go/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab dang bcas ④pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i ⑨de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mā ma tī rmyedang sgra rdo rje ma dang glu ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma rnams kyi mi ⑪bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang rdo rje drag mo dang sa rdo rje ma dang me tog ma dang bzhad ma dang gling bu ma dang ⑫me long ma dang rdo rje lcags kyu ma rnams kyi ⑫rnam par snang mdzad do/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ni ④rdo rje gzugs ma dang bdug spos ma dang sgeg mo dang pi wang ma dang rdo rje zhags pa ma rnams kyi rin chen ⑫'byung ldan no/ /gos dkar mo dang 'dod chags rdo rje spum dang mar me ma dang dri chab ma dang mu kun da 3ma dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma rnams kyi snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sgol ma dang rdo rje zhi ba ma dang rdo rje ⑫gnod sbyin mo dang gar mkhan la/shem dang ro ma dang rdza rnga ma dang rdo rje dril bu ma rnams kyi pyadon yod grub pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs 39—1173

pa'i shethugs ka'i sa bon ni 3dkyil 'khor la dgod pa'i rim pas/ hūṃ rgyu ā hriḥkhaṃ ༵ hūṃ byeḥtī/ i dze+e i ā+o sum̐ k+shi i t+paṛ haṃ rmā dṛ lo saṃ khaṃ shaṃ/ baṃ oṃ dze+e re/oṃ oṃ e oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas sgordo rje sems dpa'i snying po'i sngags ni oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha haṃ④/ zhes pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu ma'i oṃ aXbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥ thuhaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /sdogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor thul 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi snying po'i sngags nyid kyis lha gzhan rnams kyi snying po'i sngags kyi bsgrub phyobya yang 'grub pa ste ldude rnams ni ma bris te gzhung mangs pas 'jigs pas so/ /de bzhin du snga ma dang phyi ma rnams la rig par nga da // //sgo/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje kyegur gyi nang du sna tshogs ⑪rdo rje'i lte bar gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gdugs dkar po dang bcas pa'i seng ge la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la ye shes kyi /5 mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo ste 'di'i cod pan dar gyis bcings pa'i steng du rdo rjes mtshan zhing sangs rgyas lnga 'phro bas brgyan pa rtsa ba'i zhal khro zhing gad rgyangs dang bcas pa1snye / g.yas dkar zhing bzhad pa dang thubacas pa g.yon dmar zhing sgeg pa dang bcas pa zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum nyu5pa phyag g.yas pa gsum na steng du gnas pa'i kha ṭī ga dang padagra sta dang rdo rjemu/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang khrag gis nyunagang ba'i thod pa dang ral gri'o/ /'di'i shar phyogs su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo sgeg pa'i nyams can dang / byang du mi bzad mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can dang / nub tu ro langs lku ma sngon mo dang / lhor gtum mo dmar mo ste ༄ ༷ bzhi po 'di rnams kyang seng ge la gnas pa'i sna tshogs 39—1174

pad+ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi phyag gnyis kyis steng du bgreng ba'i kha ṭī ga 3dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du seng ge mo seng ge'i gdong pa can g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lus phyed phyed dkar po dang ser po glang po che dkar po la gnas pa'o/ / mer stag mo stag gi 2 gdong pa can g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lus phyed phyed sngon po dang dkar po rin po che sna bdun gyi phung po la'o/ /bden bral du ce spyang mo ce spyang gi gdong pa can g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lus phyed bye nag po dang dmar po ma te la'o/ / nub tu ④'ug pa mo 'ug pa'i gdong pa chocan g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lus phyed phyed ser po dang dmar po 'uklu brgyad kyi mjug ma la'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams ni g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i tsozhags pas brgyan cing 3sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /de nas sgo rnams la shar du rgyal ba'i dbang phyug ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis thal mo khar bcug pa'o/ /byang du gsal byed ma ser mo mar me lta bu'i thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu 'jigs shebyed ma dmar mo khrag gis gang 7 ba'i snyim pa steng du bkan pa kha'i thad kar bzung nas khrag gi rgyun 'thung bar byed pa'o/ /lhor kai po dz+re shā1nag mo rdo rje'i snyim pa la mthe bong gi rtse mo gnyis phan tshun sbyar te sdigs mdzub gnyis kyi mdzub mo brkyang ba 1nasbyar nas gsang ba'i gnas su bzhag pas 1snye rang gi bha ga ston par byed pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams ni sna tshogs chu skyes la gnas pa'i yi dwags kyi snying gar nyi ma la bzhugs pa'o / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa tso bcu gnyis ni zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa'o/ /lha mo bcu gsum po thams cad kyang lha'i rin po che dang lha'i gos 39—1175

dang dbu la thod pa lnga'i phreng ba can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung can klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis rnam par mdzes pa/ bskal pa'i lhamatha'i me 'bar ba'i 'od lta bu'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis 'bar zhing 'jigs su rung ba ste go rims 3/ji lta ba bzhin du mi bskyod pa dang rtag pa dudang rin chen dbang po dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa dang mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang rtag pa dang rin chen dbang po dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams kyis rgyas btab pa'o / /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ā+o ā+oṃ dṛ ā+oṃ oṃ oṃ aḥthuzhes pa 'di rnams ni thugs ka'i sa bon no/ /oṃ s+thāḥ/thuswā hā/ zhes pa ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i snying po'o/ /oṃ be+e ta lī byuhūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa ni ro langs ma'i ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so / /klu bcu bdun kyi bdag nyid kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje 2gur gyi nang du chos kyi 'u'abyung gnas kyi snying por gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes kyi lte ba la gnas pa'i ro'i snying gar ṅkukhrag gis gang ba'i thod pa'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i kye'i rdo rje rnam pa gsum ste bzhi pa ni ro dang bral ba'o//de la 'jig rten gsum kun du bskyod pa nag po sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa kye/ thod pa tshelnga dang phyag rgya drug dang mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa rgyab kyi char stag gi pags pa'i smad g.yogs can zhabs g.yon pa'i brla la zhabs g.yas pa'i sen ⑫mo yang dag par bzhag pa'i skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa/ dmar la tshuzlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yon gyis rdo rjes 8mtshan pa'i thod pa khrag gis tshegang ba 'dzin pas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzugs can gyi bdag med ma la 39—1176

'khyud pa/ phyag g.yas kyis nyurdo rje rtse lnga pa thu dbyug pa brdeg pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa'o/ /yang phyag bzhi pa ni phyag gnyis pa lta bu ste phyag gzhan pa gnyis kyis 5rang dang 'dra ba'i thurdo rje phag mo la yang dag par 'khyud pa'o zhes pa ni snye khyad par ro/ /yang phyag drug pa ni nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum pa zhal re re zhing 'u /spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dril bu dang gzhu dang thod pa1/g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang dārtse gsum 'dzin pa rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma la yang dag par rasgo'akhyud pa ste gzhan ni ji ltar rigs par snga ma bzhin no/ /de ltar he ru ka gsum kyi shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma brgyad la rdo rje drag mo la sogs pa brgyad do/ /'di dag gi phyi rol du rmye dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su gling bu ma dang pi wang ma dang mu kun da ma dang rdza rnga ma'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang rdo rje zhags pa ma dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang rdo rje dril bu ma'o/ /lha mo bcu drug po 'di dag ni gong gi dang 'dra ba la yab dang bral ba'o//te ru ka gsum gyi rigs kyi bdag po ni mi bskyod pa ste thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni oṃ āḥhūṃ jiḥswā skyo4hā zhes pa'o/ /so so'i sngags ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du oṃ tri lokya asnye pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ⑫phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ skephaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhephaṭa ces pa'o chekye'i rdo rje bzhi pa ni phyag bcu drug pa ste mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa bdag med ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /'on kyang 'di la gong du bshad pa'i ro'i gnas su bdud bzhi ste/ de'ang kyephung po'i bdud kyi ngo bo tshangs pa 39—1177

ser po dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud khyab 'jug nag po dang / rmye'achi bdag gi bdud dbang phyug dkar po dang / lha'i bu'i bdud dbang po byedamar ser shāro/ /de rnams la bcom ldan 'das kyi ④/ zhabs bzhi'i gnyis kyis skyil krung phyed pa dang gzhan pa dag gis thugayon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ sku mdog nag po nas ༄ 7sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa dang smad g.yogs kyi 7bar sngar bshad pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa/ zhal brgyad pa spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal nag po gad mo can g.yas dkar po g.yon dmar po steng ma mche ba gcigs pa lhag ldum rnams nag po'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams na rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang 'khor lo dang thod pa dang dbyug pa dang rtse gsum dang lcags kyu dang / g.yon pa rnams na 1snadril bu dang pad+ma dang gzhu dang kha ṭī nyu ga bsgreng ba dang thod pa dang rin po che dang sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa'o / /shar gyi /1'dab ma la go rī dmar ser phyag g.yas /rtapa gnyis na mda' phyung nab dang rdo rje gri gug6 /g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang snyenya ro hi ta dang bcas pa'i thod pa khrag gis mugang ba'o/ /lhor chom rkun ma ⑫dmar mo rdo rje dang ḍa ma ru dang lcags 5kyu dang phag pa dang bcas pa'i thod pa khrag gis nyu7 gang ba can no/ /nub tu ro langs ma dkar ser ral gri dang rus sbal dang bcas pa'i thod pa khrag gis ༄1gang ba dang / chang gis gang ba'i thod pa dang dri chus gang ba'i thod pa can no/ /byang du ghasma rī du rtaljang gu cung zad ser ba rkang mar 3kyis gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i sbrul dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me thab dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i d+ngha4dgra sta can no/ /dbang ldan du puk+ka sī ser mo sha chen gyes gang ba'i 3thod pa la gnas pa'i seng ge dang 39—1178

mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang dpag bsam gyi shing gi 7yal ga dang rin po che can no/ /mer lduri khrod ma dkar mo khu bas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i dge slong dang rdo rje dang kha ṭī ga dang zhags pa'o'u/ /bden bral du gtum mo sngon mo g.yas pa gen khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa la stag dang / g.yon na pad+ma dkar po dang phyag gnyis na rlung ras can no/ /rlung du g.yung mo nag mo chang gi thod pa dang rtse gsum dang bdud rtsi lnga'i thod pa la gnas pa'i ce 5spyang dang thong gshol can no/ /'di dag gi 4༄phyi rol gyi mtshams rnams su gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhi snga ma bzhin no—/ /sgo rnams la shar du rta gdong ma nag mo ste zhal rnams ni nag po dang dkar po dang ⑦ser po dang steng 8snadu rta'i gdong pa ljang gu'o/ /lhor phag gdong ma ser mo ste zhal rnams ni ser bo dang nag po dang dkar po dang steng du rte phag gi gdong pa ⑩dmar po'o/ /nub tu khye gdong ma dmar mo ste rke1zhal rnams ni dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po dang steng du khye'i gdong pa ser po'o/ /byang du seng rkyegadong ma ljang gu ste zhal rnams ni ljang gu dang nag po dang dkar po 1nasteng du seng ge'i gdong pa dmar po'o/ /'dir (⑩rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang cig shos dang steng gi rim pas zhal bzhi pa'othu/ /sgo skyong ma rnams phyag bzhi ma rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa bzhin du phyag mtshan 'dzin pa sna tshogs chu skyes dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang ro'i nyu steng du g.yas bsgum zhing g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar zhing brjes 3pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams ni skyil krung phyed pa can thams cad kyang zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum pa phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa yab med pa'o/3/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i 3sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ 39—1179

phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /ghasma rī'i ①oṃ oṃ swā hā/ zhes pa ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so // // bye bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi snying por gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bdag med ma ste/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi 'dab mar rdo rje ma dang / dkar mo dang / chung / ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /rim pa gnyis par sna tshogs pad+ma rnams kyi cheshar la sogs par go rī ⑪dang chom rkun ma dang ro langs ma dang ghasma rī /༄ snarnams te/ dbang ldan la sogs par puk+ka sī 6dang ri khrod ma dang gtum mo dang g.yung mo rnams so/ / bdag med ma'i steng du shar gyi ngos kyi chu skyes la gnas pa'i mkha' spyod ma ste steng zhal can no/ /'og tu nub kyi ngos kyis pad+ma la gnas pa'i sa spyod ma ste 'og zhal can no/ /bye'adi'i phyi rim la gnas pa'i go rī byel sogs pa brgyad ni phyag bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du ser po la sogs pa'i mdog can te khugazhan bdun ni hūṃ sngon mo'o/ /bco lnga po yang skyil krung phyed pas ro dang zla ba la gnas pa zhal gcig pa spyan gsum dmar ba dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag bzhi ma g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang gri gug tsha /g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang steng du sgreng ba'i kha ṭī ga nyu1'dzin pa/ dbu la thod pa lnga'i phreng ba can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su gling bu ma 8la sogs pa bzhi ni bye 1snga ma bzhin du'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du rta gdong ma dkar sngo dang lhor phag gdong ma ser sngo dang nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar sngo dang /ḍa/ phyobyang du seng gdong ma ljang sngo shārteste bzhi po 'di rnams kyang g.yas brkyang zhing 39—1180

g.yon bskum pas nyi ma la gnas pa g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis nyu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ming dang rjes su mthun pa'i zhal gcig ma kha dog gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams ni bdag med ma dang mtshungs pa bye / bdag med ma la sogs pa rnams ni go rims ji lta ba kyibazhin du mi bskyod pa dang rtag pa dang ④rin chen dbang po dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa thudang mi bskyod pa dang rtag pa dang rin chen dbang po dang snang ba mtha' yas dang mi bskyod pa dang rtag pa dang rin chen dbang po dang snang ba mtha' yas dang rnam par snang mdzad kyis thurgyas btab pa 3ste/ gling bu ma la sogs pa dang rta gdong ma la sogs pa rnams la rnam ga par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas 9dang don yod grub pa rnams kyis so/ /bdag med ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni oṃ ste oṃ e kyeswā hā zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ saṃ nyur+sha swā hā/ zhes pa ni ghasma rī'i 3/ ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /yang bdag med ma la sogs pa lha mo bco lnga'i /— dkyil 'khor te/ de yang lha mo thams cad sku mdog nag mo g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa mchod phyir thogs pa can kha ṭī thug dang bcas pa ste gzhan rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghasma rī sku.oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes pa ghasma rī'i shisngags te las thams cad pa'o / /tshi gang gi tshe dkyil 'khor gyi dbang mo ku ru ku l+ler /5 gyur pa na sku mdog dmar mo phyag bzhi ma g.yas pa dag gis mda' dang lcags kyu — snagayon pa dag gis at+pa la dmar po dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa snang ba mtha' yas kyis rigs kyi bdag po byas pa'o/ /rdo rje ma la sogs pa bcu bzhi 39—1181

'di sku mdog dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa ste bco lnga po thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang ro'i snying gar zla ba la spril krung phyed pas gnas pa'o/ /ku ru kupre'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni s+thāḥ'okro/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le s+thāḥbye snaswā hā/ snying po'o/ /gzhan ni snga ma bzhin du gyur pa de'i tshe ku ru kul+le'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro / /hūṃ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i 4dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi snying por gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi ru7dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes kyi ste bar zla ba la dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi sems dpa'i skyil krung can me tog pri yang ku lta bur sngo bsangs rtsa ba dang g.yas ༅pa dang cig shos kyi zhal gsum me tog thra yang ku lta bu mesngo bsangs dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /ldusna tshogs pa'i lag gdub dang rkang gdub la sogs pa dang gos rnams kyis brgyan pa/ phyag drug pa rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi shes rab pyal 'khyud pa g.yas pa dag gis 'khor lo dang ral gri dang g.yon pa dag gis zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams kyi phung po can norka/ /'dab ma rnams la shar du zhi ba mo nyu1dkar mo dkar ba dang nag pa dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mosnye/ /lhor zhi gdong ma ser mo ser ba dang dkar ba dang dmar 4ba'i zhal gsum mo/ /nub tu zla ldan ma dmar mo dmar ba dang gnag pa dang dkar ba'i zhal gsum mo⑫/ /byang du ri bong can ma ljang gu ljang ba dang snyedakar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mo⑩/ /mer zla dkyil ma sngon mo sngo ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mo/ /bden bral du zla tshes ma me tog pri yang ku ltar sngo bsangs sngo bsangs dang dkar ⑫39—1182

ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mo ①/ /rlung du yid 'ong ma at+pa la sngon po'i mdog can sngo ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mozu/ /dbang ldan du yid tshim par byed ma gser gyi mdog can ser ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mo1/ /lha mo 'di rnams 'khor lo'i dbang phyug lta bu'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ 'on kyang 'khor lo'i gnas su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /zla tshes ma ni zla ba'i cha gcig 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis par dbang ldan gyi mtshams su me tog ma dkar mo dkar ba dang gnag pa dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mo④/ /mer bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can du ba'i mdog dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gsum mos/ /bden bral du mar me ma gser gyi mdog can ser ba dang dkar ba dang gnag pa'i zhal gsum mo kye/ /rlung du dri chab ma dmar mo dmar ba dang skudakar ba dang gnag pa'i zhal gsum mosnye/ /'di rnams ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du g.yas kyi phyag dang pos me tog gi za ma tog dang spos phor dang mar me'i mchod sdong dang dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa ste phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ni gtso bo'i phyag mtshan no/ /de nas shar la sogs pa'i snam bu la gling bu ma dang pi wang ma dang mu kun da ma dang rdza rnga ma rnams ni dmar mo dang ser mo dang kye dkar mo dang du ba'i mdog can zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis pa khegling bu la sogs pa'i sgra sgrogs par brtson pa'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du khro gnyer rim par ldan nam mkha' ltar sngo rngu bsangs dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum pa'o/ /lhor 'jigs sdigs ⑫dkar ba dkar po dang snonanag po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum pa'o/ /nub tu rta'i gzugs dmar po dmar po dang 1 4dkar po dang nag po'i zhal gsum pa'o/ /byang du tshogs kyi gtso bo ljang gu ljang 39—1183

gu dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal gsum pa'o/ /'di rnams ni 'akying ba'i khro bo 'gying ba'i rkang stabs kyis bzhugs pa 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ khyad par ni phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rim pa ji lta bar lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags ①sgog dang dril bu 'dzin pa mche ba cung zad gcigs pa'o/ /'dir ni 'khor lo'i khru dbang po'i gzugs brnyan de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dzudang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan no④ / /de las gzhan pa'i lha nyi shu po rnams ni rdo rje bdud rtsi dang po tis mtshan pa'i ⑤ rin po che'i cod pan zla ba la gnas pa/ gtso bo lta bur rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po che la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /me tog byul sogs pa bcu gnyis 7po rnams kyi zla ba'i 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma'o snye/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni haḥ'oshe7/ /oṃ haḥbadz+ra a mṛ ⑩ta swā hā zhes pa ni snying po ste las thams cad pa yang 'di nyid do/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi gzhan gsum 'di ltar rnam par bsgom pa'i rim pa ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud hūṃlas rig par bya ste mangs pas 'jigs nas 'dir ma bshad do / / thu dgu'i bdag nyid he ru ka bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas la gzhal yas khang ngo / /phyag bcu mudrug pa la be+er yang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yang yod do zhes pa ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes 6kyi lte ba'i steng du gan rkyal du gnas pa'i tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug dang 6dbang po ste/ bdud bzhi'i rang bzhin can gyi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i zhabs bzhi pa gcer bu gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa zhabs gnyis 39—1184

skyil krung phyed pa dang gzhan gnyis g.yon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang 67ba'i gar stabs can sna tshogs rdo rjes rngumatshan pa'i dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa/dpral ba'i steng du mi mgo skam po lngas brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can sgu mdog nag po phyag bcu drug pa gad rgyangs dang bcas pa'i zhal brgyad pa zhal re re la dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum yod pa rtsa ba'i zhal nag po g.yas pa rnams dkar po dang nag po dang nag po/ g.yon pa rnams dmar po dang nag po dang nag po ④steng ma du ba'i mdog can rnam par 'gyur ba/ zhal thams cad smin ma 'khyog po dang bcas pa khro gnyer can mche ba'i myu gu gcigs pa phyag g.yas pa brgyad kyis byethod pa rnams na glang po che dang rta dang bong bu dang 5glang dang rnga mo dang mi dang sha ra bha bye dang byi la rnams dang / g.yon pa brgyad kyis pathod pa rnams na sa dang chu dang rlung dang me dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang gshin rje dang nor sbyin rnams 'dzin pa/ 'khor lo dang rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang lag gdub dang ska rags dang thal chen rnams dang mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can dpung rgyan dang rkang gdub rnams kyis pebargyan pa'o / /'di'i yum ni bdag med ma nag mo gcer bu gri gug dang thod par ldan pa'i phyag /7 g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la yang dag par 'khyud pa/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can nyuhūṃphyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig ma ⑫mche ba gcigs ma dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/dpral ba'i mtshams su thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ mgrin par mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba 'phyang ba rkang gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i 39—1185

phyogs kyi 'dab mar gnas pa'i tshangs pa dang dbang po dang nye dbang dang khyedrag po rnams kyi snying ga'i steng du zla ba la go rī la sogs pa ste dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab mar gnas pa'i gshin rje dang lus ngan dang srin po dang thags pyabazangs ris rnams kyi grusnying ga'i steng du zla ba la puk+ka sī ④ la sogs pa'o/ /de la go rī 5 nag mo g.yas pa na ༄ gri gug dang g.yon pa na nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa'o/ /chom rkun ma dmar mo phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis ḍa ma ru dang phag pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs ma gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa lju dag gis rus ༄ sbal dang pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /ghasma rī kye ljang gu phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis sbrul dang rnal 'byor gyi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /puk+ka sī ⑫sngon mo phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis seng ge dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /ri khrod ma dkar mo phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis dge slong dang gsal spyobyed 'dzin pa'o/ /gtum mo nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis 'khor lo dang thong gatho/la 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yung mo sna tshogs pa'i mdog can phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa shārtadag gis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di rnams ni skyil krung phyed pa'i gar kyis bzhugs pa ste / khyad par gzhan rnams ni sngar brjod pa'i bdag med ma bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni he ru ka dang bdag med ma dag gi tshumi bskyod pa'o/ /go rī rtel sogs pa rnams kyi mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas te puk+ka sī snyel sogs pa rnams kyi yang ngo / /⑪yang phyag gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi hu 7gtso bor gyur pa na g.yas pas rdo rje gyen du 'phyar zhing g.yon pas rdo rje thod pa 'dzin pas bdag med ma la 'khyud pa/39—1186

kha ṭī hūṃ ga yang dpung pa g.yon pa la brten hūṃpa'o/ /yang phyag bzhi pa 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa na bye / phyag g.yas pas rdo rje sngon po dang g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa cho/ phyag lhag ma dag gis rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'o / /khya yang phyag drug pa 'khor lo'i dbang por gyur pa na rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal gsum sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po phyag g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang gri gug dang g.yon pa dag gis rtse gsum dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma dag gis rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma la 'khyud pa ste/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma ni sku mdog dang zhal dang phyag la sogs pa thubadag med ma dang 3 mtshungs par yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs kyis gsungs pa'o5/ /phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa 'di rnams sna tshogs chu skyes kyi ze'u 'bru la ro'i snying gar nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs mdzad pa/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa 9sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo lngas brgyan pa/ smin ma 'khyog pa dang bcas pa'i khro gnyer can/ mche ba gcigs pa/ phyag bcu drug pa rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /go rī /1la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rtabaskor ba'o/ /lha mo thams cad ni thabs dang 8bral ba ste rdo rje phag mo dang rdo rje lu gu rgyud la 6ni mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /kye'i rdo rje rnam pa bzhi'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ de ba pi snyetsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni phyag bcu drug pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ tre mulokya yak+ṣe 7pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni phyag gnyis pa'o me—/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa phyag nyu bzhi pa'i 'o/ /oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa phyag drug pa'i 'o bye / /oṃ ā badz+ra ghasma 39—1187

rī ri1oṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa ni ghasma rī'i rteste las thams cad pa'o/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i ༄ dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du gnas pa ni chos 'byung gi dbus su gzhal yas khang ste/ kha cig ni rdo rje dze+egur gyi nang du chos 'byung med par gzhal yas khang ngo zhes so/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma la sgyu ma chen po las byung ༄ naba'i te ru ka nag po nyi ma'i 'od zer can 'bar ba'i 3phreng ba 'khrigs pa 'gying ba'i khro bo dbu skra dmar ser 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/ thod pa'i shecod pan can rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang rgyab dang g.yon pa'i zhal bzhi sngon po dang ser po dang dkar po dang spuljang gu zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum tre pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis thod pa dang mda'atsun / g.yon pa dag gis kha ṭī ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag bzhi ༄ dang ldan pa/ mi'i pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa༄ / skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma ni sku mdog dmar mo dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po dang ljang gu'i zhal can gtso bo lta bu'i mtshon cha 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyis de'i mgul nas 'khyud pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo sngon po gedang ser po dang dkar po dang nyuseljang gu'i zhal can rdo rje dang thod pa dang dril bu dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser po dang sngon po dang spudakar po dang ljang gu'i zhal can/ rin po che'i pa tra dang rtse gsum dang mgrin pa btsir ba'i ce spyang dang ba dan 'dzin pa'o//nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo dkar po dang ser mupo dang sngon po dang ljang gu'i zhal can sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda' dang thod pa dang blagazhu 'dzin pa'o/ /39—1188

byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu ljang gu lhadang ser po dang dkar po thudang sngon po'i zhal can ral gri dang ḍa ma ru dang zhags pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad phyag rgya lnga dang ④ldan pa zla ba'i gdan dang 'od can te/ 'di rnams kyi khyad par rnams ni gtso mo lta bu'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni ④bcom ldan 'das kyi mi bskyod pa ste/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtag pa dang mi bskyod pa dang rin rgyachen dbang po dang gsung gi dbang phyug dang budon yod grub pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ snying po'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyi ⑦yang oṃ oṃ hūṃcha/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ swā hūṃ⑨/ oṃ la hūṃ/ oṃ hā ⑫hūṃ zhes pa ste sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags ni las thams cad pa'i 'o / /⑪ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa'i 8lha dgu'i bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ rdo rje ⑫ gur gyi nang du chos 'byung la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes kyi lte ba la ro'i snying gar nyi ma la shes rab ma dang 1zibral ba'i bcom ldan 'das te sku mdog la sogs pa ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i 'khor lo gsum la gnas pa'i dpal (sgosangs rgyas thod pa bzhin no/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i 'dab ma rnams la rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du sna tshogs sde ma ⑫dang 'dod ma dang sa 'og na gnas pa ma /)dang legs bzangs ma rnams ni sku mdog sngon mo g.yas bskum zhing ⑫g.yon brkyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis gri gug dang thod pa/ g.yon pa dag gis kha ṭī ga ⑫dang ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan dang me lha dang bden bral dang rlung gi 'dab ma rnams la chang 'tshong ma dang 'byung mo dang phyag ༄ 39—1189

bzhi ma dang 1nam mkha' la gnas ma rnams ni ser mo na bza' ser po gyon pa 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bsgum pa klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru / g.yon pa dag gis kha ṭī ga dang pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di rnams kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gar kyi tshul gyis gnas pa/ dbu skra dmar ser 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/ dbu la thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa5/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu mgul du 'chang dzib/mche ba cung zad gcigs pa'i zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa phyag bzhi pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la — mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas lngas rgyas btab pa ste/sna tshogs sde ma la sogs pa rnams la mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas rnams kyis so/ / chang 'tshong ma la sogs pa rnams kyi ⑩yang de rnams nyid do/ /yang na bcom ldan 'das 'di dang phyogs kyi lha mo rnams kyang dkar po ste mtshams kyi lha mo rnams dmar mo'o/ /'di ni yum dang bral ba 'am yum dang bcas pa'o rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung la gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma'i steng du g.yon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang ba'i zhabs dag gis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum las —rnam par rgyal ba khro bo bskal pa'i dus kyi 5me ltar 'od zer 'bar zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad rab tu gsol bar mdzad pa/ sgu mdog sngon po rnam par 'gyur zhing gdangs pa'i zhal gsum pa/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal 39—1190

rnams sngon po dang ser po dang ljang gu mche ba gtsigs shing rab tu gtum pa/ljags 'dril kyezhing shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhal re re zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum pa smin ma g.yo ba dang bcas pa'i khro gnyer can dpral ba'i steng na thod pa lnga'i ༄ bye phreng ba dang ldan pa/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgul par 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ klu mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra 1dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba ④bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pashu/ pad+ma chen po pad+ma'i rtsa ba lta bu dkar pos mgul rgyan — snabyas pa / stobs kyi rgyu drur thu ba lta bu ljang gus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas dkar pos zuska rags byas pa/ pad+ma dkar po kun+da'i me tog ltar mdzes pas rkang gdub byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas pa/ rigs ldan du ba lta bu khra bos dpung rgyan byas pa/ rdo rje sems dpas rngurgyas btab pa/rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gis 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pas rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la snyoms par 'jug ⑩pa/phyag g.yas pa dag gis be+egs kyu dang zhags paskye / g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga /rta'adzin pa'o/ /'di'i shar phyogs su rdo rje dbyug pa sngon po rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang nyurte g.yon pa'i zhal rnams sngon po dang ser po dang ljang gu/phyag g.yas pa dag gi /zirdo rje tho ba dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gyen du 'phyar ba⑫/ g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga snye'adzin pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po dang sngon po dang ljang gu'i zhal can/ phyag dang pos rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rnams ni rdo rje dbyug pa'i lta bu ste 'chad par 'gyur ba gzhan nyu rnams kyang ngo / /nub tu rdo rje 39—1191
