gtsug tor dmar po dmar po dang dkar po dang ljang gu'i zhal can phyag na pad+ma dmar po'o/ /lhor rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang gu ljang gu ①dang dkar po dang ser po'i zhal can phyag na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /mer rdo rje gnod sbyin du ba'i mdog can du ba'i mdog dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal can lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o / /bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po dmar po dang ser po bye dang ljang gu'i zhal can phyag na dgra sta'o/ /rlung du nag po chen po sngon po sngon po dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal can phyag na rtse gsum mo/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs rung nag po mig yon zhunag po dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal can phyag na ral gri'o/ /rdo rje dbyug ④pa la sogs pa brgyad po 'di rnams ni go rims ji lta ba bzhin 3gshin rje mthar byed dang shes rab mthar byed dang pad+ma mthar byed dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang dbyug sngon can dang stobs po che dang mi g.yo ba rnams kyi ming gzhan no/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dkar po dkar po stsodang sngon po dang ljang gu'i zhal can phyag na 'khor lo'o/ /'og tu rdo rje sa 'og ma ⑦gnod mdzes kyi ming gi rnam grangs can sngon po sngon po dang ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal can phyag na rol pa dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i zugatun shing ste/ 'di'i phyag kyegayon pa na klu'i zhags ⑫pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa dang kha ṭī ga'o ⑪/ /rdo rje dbyug pa la sogs pa'i khro bo 'di rnams phyag mtshan gyi gtso bo dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag ⑫dag gis rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra dmar ser 'bar zhing gyen du 'khyil pa rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i ⑫ cod pan mdzes par brgyan pa/ smin ma g.yo ba rngudang bcas pa'i khro gnyer can/ zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ zhal re re la 39—1192

dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyopa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa dang klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis 1brgyan pa/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma rnams la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang / steng du tshangs pa dang 'og tu thags bzangs ris rnams mnan pa'i g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs ldupa rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas ④btab pa ste/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo ji lta ba bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ kha badz+ra dh+rika skyebadz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces pa ni rdo rje 'khyil pa'i sngags ༷ snate las thams cad pa'o—/ /yang na shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dang mtshams dang steng dang 'og tu tso sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma rnams la g.yas skor byegyis gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa'i khro bo bcu ste 'di dag thams cad kyi gnas dang sku mdog la sogs pa ni bsdus pa'i rim pa'i ⑨dkyil 'khor du gsungs pa lkuji lta ba bzhin no/ /yang na 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo ji lta ba bzhin no// yang na dpal kun du kha sbyor gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin no / /⑪phyogs 'di gsum ka la yang oṃ āḥbispyon+ta kṛta rmyehūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags te las thams cad pa'o // //⑫bde mazog gi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje s+dzagur gyi nang ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs chu skyes kyi ze'u 'bru la sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gnas pa'i 8gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bcom ldan 'das te g.yas brkyang gi zhabs dag gis sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/sku mdog nag po shar dang byang ⑫la sogs pa'i zhal ni nag po dang 7ljang gu dang 39—1193

dmar po dang ser po'o/ /27 zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa du / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can phyag bcu gnyis pa 1 rdo rje dang dril bur ④ bcas pa'i phyag gis phyardo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rgyab tu glang po che dkar po'i pags pa khrag dang bcas pa brgyangs bye nas 'dzin pa/ de ⑦dag las gzhan pa'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis ḍa ma ru dang dgra sta dang gri gug dang rtse gsum pa dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rjes dumatshan pa'i kha ṭī ga dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang rdo rje zhags pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/'dzag pa'i mi ḍamago lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgul du 'phyang ba/ phyag ⑫rgya drug dang ldan pa mi'i rgyus pas kyemachod phyir thogs byas pa dpral ba'i steng du thod pa ⑫ lnga dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i zla ba phyed pa ⑪dang sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kyis mnan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ rnam par 'gyur zhing gdangs pa'i zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu'i tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo ni dmar mo zhal gcig ma spyan gsum pa skra'i tshogs grol ba gcer bu thod pa'i dum bus rked yopa'i rgyan byas pa/ 'khyud pa'i phyag gis gzung ba'i thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzag pa'i rgyun gtso bo'i zhal du 5stobs pa/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje steng du 'phyar skyebs gdug pa can rnams bsdogs mupa/ khrag dang bral ba'i mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba can/nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ cung zad rmyebazhad pa zla mtshan 'bab rke pa dang bcas shing — ba spu gyen du langs pa'o/ /de nas shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams la g.yon skor gyes dang / me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams la g.yas skor gyis dgod par bya'o/ /de la phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams su 39—1194

mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma khyedang dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma rnams ni nag mo dang ljang gu dang dmar mo dang ser mo'i mdog can zhal gcig ma spyan gsum ma rngo 7skra grol ba/ phyag bzhi ma g.yon pa dag gis kha ṭī ga dang thod pa dang /g.yas pa dag gis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis ④gnas pa'o// mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la byang chub kyi sems dang khrag dang bdud rtsi dang sgron ma lnga rnams grub pa'i dngul chu lta bu'i bdud rtsir gyur pas gang ba'i pad+ma'i sgod rnams te/ yang na bzhi char yang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o/ /④de nas thugs kyi 'khor lo la rtsibs rnams su shar du thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mosge—/ byang du keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma9/ nub tu keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor mche ba rnam par gcigs ma pedang sna chen mo87/mer chang dgra dang brtan pa'i ( dā blo can ma ⑩/ bden bral du 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma —1/ rlung du ⑫rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma 7/ dbang ldan du rdo rje'i sgu dang shing grib ma'o/ /rim pa de bzhin du gsung gi 'khor lo la myu gu can dang sa srung dze+em dang / rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo dang dpa' bo chen mo 6dang rlung gi shugs can ma dang rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma dang shin tu bzang mo ⑫dang sngo bsangs lha mo dang rdo rje bzang bo dang shin tu bzang mo dang 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma ⑫dang mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma'o/ /de bzhin du sku'i dkyil 'khor /5la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma dang rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma dang nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma dang dpal te ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma dang rnam 39—1195

par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /de la thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa'i ①dpa' bo rnams ni zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor gtsugs ②can dpral bar gnas shing /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dpa' bo'i dar dpyang 1 dang ldan pa phyag bzhis ④'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa⑤/ g.yon pas kha ṭī ga dang g.yas pas ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa/ tshangs ༄ )pa'i skud pa can dpung rgyan ⑦dang ldan pa mche ba gabyugs pa'i zhal can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni zhal gcig pa rkye spyan gsum pa drag pa'i gzugs can ma/ skra grol ba gcer bu phyag gnyis ma 'khyud pa'i phyag gis thod pa dang g.yas pas gdug pa can bsdigs kyepar byed pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'o//sgo rnams la khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma dang phag gdong ma la sogs pa ngornams ni mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhin te 'di rnams kyi zhal ni ming dang rjes su mthun pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su gshin rje brtan ma dang gshin rje pho nya mo dang gshin rje mche ba mo ⑪dang gshin rje 'joms ma rnams ni mi'i zhal can te/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi sku phyed de g.yas ⑫dang g.yon gyi lha mo rnams kyi sku dang 'dra ba'o/ /brgyad po 'di rnams ni ro'i gdan can nyid do/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo thams cad kyang 'dzag pa'i mi mgo'i phreng ba mgul du 'chang ⑫ba/ rdo rje'i phreng bas dpral ba mtshan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa ska rags la sgra rkyedang bcas pa'i g.yer kha la sogs pas chebargyan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni bcom ldan 'das kyi mi bskyod pa ste rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par snang mdzad dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i rin chen dbang phyug go/ /39—1196

thugs dang gsung dang sku'i 'khor lo rnams kyi mi bskyod pa dang snang ba mtha' yas dang rtag pa rnams te ①dam tshig gi 'khor lo la gnas pa rnams kyi ni don yod grub pa'o/ /4com ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ shrī badz+ra te he zhuru ru rka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki — dzā (snye la sasba ram̐ swā hā/ zhes pa ni snying po'o—/ /oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he thuhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni dum skyes ma'i sngags te las thams cad pa'o/ /yang na 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la sogs pa nas gshin rje 'joms ⑤ma'i mthar thug pa thams cad zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa'o/ /de la dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga thams cad ni 'khyud pa'i g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi dang khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams ni g.yon pas thod pa dang dpung pa la brten pa'i kha ṭī ga dang / g.yas pas ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa ste gzhan thams cad ni — snga ma bzhin no/ /yang na 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la sogs pa phyag gnyis pa nyid kyi phyogs la ni dpal bde mchog dang rdo rje phag mo gser kyi mdog can nam yang na sngon po ste/ bcom ldan 'das ni phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gsor ba mchog tu brtson pa—/ g.yon pas thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa 'am yang na rdo rje dang dril bu'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud par mdzad pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi ni ser mo g.yas pas ⑦ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams ni nag po rdo rje dang drudril bu 'dzin pa ste/ dpa' mo rnams ni dkar mo phyag g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can no/ / 7gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams ni dmar po pad+ma dang shā 7pad+ma'i dril bu 'dzin pa ste mkha' 'gro ma / rnams ni nag mo g.yas pa pad+ma /rte dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can no/ /sku'i 39—1197

'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams ni dkar po 'khor lo rmyedang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa ste lha mo rnams ni dmar mo g.yas pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad yum la du'akhyud par brtson zhing g.yas brkyang zhing bzhugs 1pa ste dpa' mo rnams ni ④/de'i brla gnyis la pye'akhril ba'i tshul lo/ /khā gdong ma la sogs pa ni g.yas pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa ste lha mo thams cad phyag g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /gshin rje brtan ma la sogs pa ni g.yas pas ⑥ḍa ma ru dang / g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas mi mgo ༅'dzin pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams dang khwa zu gdong ma la sogs pa rnams kyi g.yon pa na kha ṭī ga'o/ /bcu gnyis po 'di rngurnams ni skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa ste gzhan rnams ⑫ni snga ma bzhin no zhes pa bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum mo/ /gang gi tshe 'di rnams la dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga mi bsgom par rdo rje phag mo dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mor gyur pa de'i tshe rdo rje phag mo'i /༄dkyil 'khor gsum mo—/ /rdo rje phag mo'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni baṃ mo 6/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa bhā ⑫ ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa ni snying po'o/ /bde mchog phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa'i lha 'di 4 rnams kyi phyag g.yas su gnas pa'i phyag mtshan ni bri bya'i dkyil 'khor la yang bri bar bya'o / / 6 bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyi shu rtsa ⑩lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur kyi nang du chos 'byung gi snying por gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa la gnas pa'i sna tshogs chu skyes kyi lte bar ro gan rkyal gyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bcom ldan 'das 39—1198

dpal he ru ka sku mdog nag po skyil krung phyed pa can gar 17gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas gar mdzad pa zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa ②dmar la zlum pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis ḍa ma ru dang gri gugakhya /g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga ④ 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal ༄zhe mgrin pa la 'phyang ba/ gnyis 'thung gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab na cung zad dbe+engs pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa nag po'i thor cog (khyecan dpral ba'i mthar thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can no/ /mnga' bdag 'di'i dga' ma ni sna tshogs sde mahūṃ / na bza' med pa mi mgo'i phreng ba can dbu skra sil bur grol zhing gyen du 'bar ba thod pa lngas dbu la mtshan pa/ mche ba cung zad gcigs pa sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig ma spyan gsum pa phyag g.yon pa bdag po'i mgrin par 'khyud pas khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa'i thod pepa yab la stobs tsopa/ phyag g.yas pa na gri gug rdeg pa'i tshul 6/can no/ /rtsibs nag po'i steng gi 'dab ma rnams la shar du legs phreng can ma dang / byang du thod pa can ma dang nub tu 'jigs nya1ma dang lhor thub dka' ma'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la g.yas skor gyis khu ba dang rdul dang bdud rtsi dang sgron tsho rtem lngas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod de rim pa dang po 'di ni rdo rje ⑫sngon po'i khor yug can no/ /de nas rim pa gnyis pa'i rtsibs brgyad dmar po la gnas pa'i pad+ma brgyad ni rdo rje'i phreng ba dmar pos bskor ba ste/ de'i rtsibs rnams la shar du dge ba'i ska rags can ma dang / byang du gzugs can ma dang / nub tu rnam par rgyal ma dang /lhor 'dod ma dang / dbang ldan du dus can ma dang / mer mtshon thuchen ma 39—1199

dang / bden bral du phyed ma dang / rlung du gsod ma'o/ /de nas rim pa gsum pa'i rtsibs brgyad dkar po la gnas pa'i pad+ma brgyad ni rdo rje'i ①phreng ba dkar po'i khor yug can te/ de'i rtsibs rnams la shar du sgol ma dang byang du 'jigs 5mthong ma dang / nub tu legs mthong ma dang / lhor mi thub ma dang / dbang ldan du dge ma dang / mer grib ④gnon ma dang / bden bral du dus mtshan ma dang / rlung du grags chen ma'o/ /sgo rnams su shar gyi pad+ma la mdzes ma dang / byang gi pad+ma la nor 'dzin ma dang / nub kyi pad+ma la skal bzang ④ ma dang / lho'i pad+ma la mthong dga' ma'o/ /'di rnams thams cad g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag ④dag gis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ge so cung zad sto ba 3 zhal gcig ma spyan gsum ma3/ rus pa'i rgyan rmis brgyan maspu—/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang bral ba/ dbu skra sel bu dmar ser gyi tshogs gyen du 'bar ba byang sems 'dzag pa/ nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa'o / /sgo skyong ma rnams ni g.yas bsgum zhing g.yon brkyang ba ste/ thams cad stag gi pags pa'i na bza' sku mdog sngon ⑫mo'o/ /yang na legs ⑪ma la sogs pa bzhi nag mo dang rim pa gnyis pa la gnas pa rnams dkar ser dang rim pa gsum pa la gnas pa blarnams ljang gu dang sgo'i lha mo rnams nag mo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lngas rgyas btab pa ste / sna tshogs sde ma la rnam par snang mdzad dang legs phreng ma la sogs pa bzhi la rin chen dbang po dang / rim pa gnyis par ⑪ gnas pa rnams la snang ba mtha' yas dang / rim pa gsum pa na ⑫ gnas pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang / sgo'i lha mo rnams la don yod grub pa'o8/ /bcom ldan 'das 39—1200

kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ bu5 ka pā li byā āḥnyi hai 6hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o—/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags '-i/ kyang 'di nyid kyis bya'o / / rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du rlung dang ༄5 me dang chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du rgya mtsho chen bo la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i ri bye rab kyi spyi bor sna tshogs chu skyes dang sna tshogs merdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi snying por rim pa dbus ma'i lte bar seng ge'i steng ldu du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la sems dpa'i skyil ⑨krung gis bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor nam mkha' sku mdog nag po rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal gsum nag po dang dkar po dang dmar bo/ zhal re re la spyan gsum ⑩gsum pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dpral bar gnas pa nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa nag po'i thor cog can/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga 'phro ba'i dbu rgyan dang ldan pa—/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu cung zad 'phyang ba/ phyag drug pa rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa'i phyag dag gis ye shes kyi 7mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo 'am nag mo hūṃrtal 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag gis nu ma dang mda'athu/ g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas re'u mig rnams la shar du glang po che'i rgyal po la 'gying ba'i tshul kyis gnas pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mohuzi/ byang du rma bya la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'i mi bzad mkha' 'gro ma ser mo sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o/ /nub tu /5mkha' lding la tsog pu'i nyu 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa'i ro langs ma dmar /3mo'o/ /lhor mi'am ci'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'i gtum mo /1sngon mo dbu skra dmar po grol 39—1201

zhing spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /'dir ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lnga ni g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis kha ṭī ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ni glang po che la sogs pa 7trepad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa glang po che'i pags pa'i smad g.yogs dang mi'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can no/ /dbang ldan du seng ge la 'gying ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i seng ge ma dkar ser phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas steng du 'phyar ba'i kha ṭī ga dang / g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mer rdo rje phag la rlum bo'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i stag mo dkar nag phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa dang g.yon pas lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du ma te la skyol krung phyed pas gnas pa'i ce spyang mo ce spyang gi (na7gdong pa can dmar nag phyag ④gnyis kyis dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du ce spyang la tsog pu'i ④'dug stangs kyis gnas pa'i 'ug pa mo 'ug pa'i gdong pa ⑤can dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis du dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams ni rang rang gi bzhon ④pa rnams la pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'o/ /shar du dumakha' 'gro ma'i rgyab tu mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi durtse mo khar bcug pa'o( 7 / /byang du mi bzad mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyab tu mar me ma ser mo spyi bor mar me lta bu'i thal mo sbyar ba dang / nub tu ro langs ma'i rgyab tu 'jigs byubyed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis bkang nas gsol ba dang ⑫/ lhor gtum mo'i rgyab tu kam po dz+re /3nag mo phyag dag gis thugs kar gtun shing 'phyar ba ste ④'di rnams ni ⑫pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ro la gnas pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje s+dzaphreng ba dang 'od zer gyi khor yug gi phyi rol du zlum po'i rim par pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la shar phyogs su puk+ka 39—1202

sbo dang dra mi ḍi ①dang gtum mo 47rnams phyag gnyis kyis 1bdud rtsi'i snod 'dzin pa'o—/ /byang du mi bzad ma kru khrag ma dang sha ma rnams ni sgon ma byelngas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu drag ⑥shul ma dang 'bar ma dang sngami sdug ma rnams gtor ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor thod pa ma dang rdo rje ma dang bum pa can ma rnams btung 3ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du sgeg mo bsnyems ⑫ pa'i phyag rgya can dang dri chab ma ⑫dri'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /mer pi wang ma pi wang bgreng ba /nye dang me tog ma me tog 'thor ba'o/ /bden bral du glu ma kha'i thad kar mdzub mo g.yo ba dang bdug spos ma spos shā5dang bcas pa'i spos phor 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du gar ma gar gyi tshul gyis steng du thal mo sbyar ba dang mar me ma mar me ⑫dang bcas pa'i mar me'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha sum cu rtsa gsum po 'di rnams ni phyag gnyis ma 6zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa skra grol ba dbu la thod pa'i phreng ba can no/ /mi bzad mkha' 'gro ma ni dbu skra gyen du brjes pa ste seng ge mo la sogs pa ni gos dmar po gyon pa'o/ /puk+ka sbo nyunyel sogs pa me'i 3 7mtshams kyi lha mo dag ni dkar mo'o/ /mi bzad ma la sogs pa dang dbang ldan gye lha mo dag ni ser mo'o /drag shul ma la sogs pa dang rlung gi mtshams kyi lha mo dag ni dmar mo'o/ /thod pa ma la sogs pa dang bden bral gyi mtshams kyi lha mo dag ni nag mo'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba'i khor yug gi phyi rol kyi rim par sgo rnams dang snam bu rnams la chu skyes dang zla ba'i gdan rnams 7la shar sgor khyab 'jug nag po dang ⑫/byang du tshangs pa ser po dang / nub tu dbang phyug dkar po dang / lhor gdong drug dmar po dang ⑪ / dbang ldan gyi mtshams su dbang po ser po dang /39—1203

mer lus ngan po 7ser po dang / bden bral du gshin rje nag po dang / rlung du chu lha dkar po'o/ /lha'i snam bu la shar du keng rus 'jigs byedang kha ṭī ga'i srin po dang tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang dril bu'i 3rna ba can rnams dkar po'o//byang du gtum mo'i chodabang phyug dang mdun du rgyasa'i lha dang rim gyi tshe dbang phyug dang dzhai dzaka ra 'jigs su rung ba rnams ser po'o/ /nub tu drag po'i 'dod pa dang shaṇ+ḍi li'i dbang phyug dang ḍa ldum ru'i 'dul byed dang sgras 'jigs byed rnams dmar po'o/ /lhor tum+bu ra'i dbang phyug dang / s+thā ra nā do dang mche ba gcigs pa dang gzhu 'dzin rnams nag po'o/ /khyab 'jug la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams ni zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis kha ṭī ga 9snadang rtse gsum 'dzin pa g.yon pa dag gis lha mo la 'khyud pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa nag po'i thor cog can kyithod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /'di rnams kyi lha mo rnams kyang phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga ⑫'dzin pa'o/ /'dir da‘prel ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nyurtel mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i nyu5de bzhin gshegs pa lngas rgyas btab pa ste/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa 'am rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi 6 rtag pa dang rin chen dbang po thudang snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa rnams kyi ⑫ste/seng ge ma la sogs pa bzhi la mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas rnams kyis so/ /tshangs pa la rnam par snang mdzad kyis te shā dbang phyug chen po la snang ba mtha' yas kyis so/ / lha 39—1204

gzhan dkar po rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang ser po rnams la rin chen dbang po dang / dmar po rnams la tshe dpag med dang nag po rnams la mi bskyod pa nag po'o/ /①dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug gi thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ hūṃ haḥswā hā zhes pa rjoni snying po'o/ /oṃ yī yaḥswā hā 1/ zhes pa ni ro langs ma'i ste las thams cad pa'i ④sngags so zhes pa rim pa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang lta bu la mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi po rnams ni dusgo rnams su'o/ /zhes pa gzhan dag gi'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la yang rjo gzhal yas khang gi gzugs so zhes pa ni ⑦gzhan dag gi ste de yang zlum po'i byed pa kha cig go/ /khyegashin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje spugur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi ⑪lte bar gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma'i steng du gnas pa'i ma te nag po khros pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rgyab tu sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i rkang stabs kyis gshin rje mnan nas bzhugs pa'i gshin rje gshed nag po smin ma dang sma ra langs shing dbu skra ⑪gyen du badze+es pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sku bong thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ ⑫yan lag rags pa mi mgo'i phreng ba mgul par 'phyang ba ljags 'gyur ba mche ba 'bar zhing gcigs pa rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po phyag drug gi ⑫ gri gug dang thod par ldan pa'i g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag 6dag gis rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang ral gri ⑫ g.yon pa dag gis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bzhin 39—1205

du mtha' yas la sogs pa'i klu rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /'di'i shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal gsum dkar po dang nag po dang nyudamar po/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis 'khor lo dang ral gri dang / g.yon pa dag gis rin po che dang chu skyes 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen dbang tsopo gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po'i zhal gsum pa phyag g.yas pa dag gis rin po che dang ral gri 1/ g.yon pa dag gis 4'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis pad+ma dang ral gri dang / g.yon pa dag gis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang gu hūṃdang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal gsum patsu/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis ral gri dang 'khor lo ༄ / g.yon pa dag gis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi char yang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi 9mtshan nyid can gyi khro bo/ g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis gri gug dang jod pa 'dzin pas rang dang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su rdo rje tsartsi ka ༄ ༷ sku dang phyag mtshan rnams gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /bden bral du rdo rje phag mo phag zhal can ma zhe sdang lngagashin rje gshed lta bu'o/ / 5dbang ldan du go rī /1phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /'dir (zirnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa ni sna tshogs rdo rje'i rtsa ba rnams su te6/mtshams rnams su ni rdo rje tsartsi ka khye la sogs pa rang dang 'dra ba'i 7thabs dang bcas pa'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po'o/ /6nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis tho ba dang 39—1206

ral gri dang / g.yon pa dag gis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'i zhal can phyag g.yas pa dag gis dbyug pa dang ral gri3/ g.yo/na pa dag gis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pad+ma gshin rje gshed 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /byang du ral gri gshin rje gshed phrag dog gshin rje gshed 7lta bu las lducung zad sngo ba'o/ /thams cad kyang khro bo klu rnams kyis brgyan pasno /'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal can/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis khyagri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi pya shes rab ma la 'khyud pa'o/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo ⑦rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ste/ lha gzhan rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i thod pa bzhi ni/ khu ba dang rdul dang bdud rtsi lnga dang sgon ma lngas gang ba'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni gshin rje gshed nag po'i spyi bor rang nyid de/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa 87 bzhi'i yang de bzhin no/ /de rnams ni go rims ji lta bar spyan ma la sogs pa bzhi dang tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs pa rnams kyi yang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni ya'o/ /oṃ triḥskṛḥbi kṛ tā 9na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā / zhes pa ni snying po ste las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang 'di'o / / 1 rdo rje sgol ma'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi snying por gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la bcom ldan 'das rterdo rje sgol ma gser gyi mdog lta bu sangs rgyas lnga'i cod 39—1207

pan canarmye/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang rgyab dang g.yon pa'i zhal bzhi gser kyi mdog dang / dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'oshe/ /phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa dang mda' dang dung ①rnams 'dzin pa/g.yon pa rnams ni at+pa la ser po dang gzhu dang lcags kyu dang sdigs mdzub can no / /shar gyi 'dab ma la me tog sgol ma dkar ④mo phyag dag gis me tog gi thuphreng ba 'dzin pa dang du / lhor bdug spos sgol ma nag mo du phyag dag gis bdug spos kyi snod 'dzin pa dang / nub tu mar me sgol ma ser dumo phyag gnyis kyis mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa dang / byang du dri chab sgrol ma dmar mo phyag gnyis 4 kyis ⑩dri chab kyi dung chos 'dzin pa ste lha mo bzhi po 'di rnams kyang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /me la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i ngo bo de dag lta bu'i kye'akhor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang ral gri'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la sgo rnams su shar du rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo phyag g.yas pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang / lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo phyag g.yas pas zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog ma dmar mo phyag g.yas pas ⑫ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags sgog 'dzin pa dang / byang du rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma rnams la/ spyan ma la sogs pa ⑫rnam par dag pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi bum pa dang / ri rab dang me thab dang rgyal mtshan chen po'o—/ /steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma chadakar mo phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa ste/ 'og tu gnod mdzes ma sngon mo klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo bcu rkye drug po 'di rnams ni phyag g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa ste sna 39—1208

tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /bcu po 'di rnams kyang zhal gcig pa kyephyag gnyis ma'o/ /bcu gcig po rnams kyang rdo rje :kha krung gecan gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ pad+ma rā ④ga'i 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni rdo rje sgol ma'i rin chen dbang po'o—/ /me tog sgrol ma la sogs pa snyeni rnam par snang mdzad dang mi bskyod pa dang ༄ —snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams te rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa rnams kyi ④yang ngo / /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rin chen dbang po ste/ gnod mdzes ma'i mi bskyod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ zhes pa ni snying po ste las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang 'di'o / /kye 'od zer spucan gyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du gzhal yas khang ste/ kha cig ni chos 'byung med par ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang ngo zhes pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi lte bar mchod rten gyi phug gi snying por sna tshogs chu skyes la gnas pa'i zla ba 'am nyu nyi ma la g.yas bsgum zhing g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can skyo ser mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi cod pan can/ dbu'i rtser mchod rten gyis brgyan pa 8rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ zhal gsum ma rtsa ba'i zhal ser po g.yas zhal dkar po/ g.yon zhal nag po phag pa'i /— gdong can khros pa khro gnyer dang zur mig tu ldan pa/ ljags 'dril ༄ ༄ba 'jigs su rung ba phyag drug ma g.yas pa rnams kyis mda' dang rdo rje dang khab 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang skud pa dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 39byed1209

yal ga me tog dang 7bcas pa 'dzin pa/ smad g.yogs sngon po khyen pa rnam par bkra ba'i stod g.yogs sngon po can/ ser po'i mdog can gyi phag pa la gnas shing de'i mdog can gyi phag pas yongs su bskor ba/ mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /shar phyogs su arka ma sī me tog ban+d+ra — ka'i mdog can g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gis khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor marka ma sī ser mo gser gyi mdog can g.yas pas skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i 3yal ga 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu an+ta ra dha ma sī ser mo g.yas pas mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang g.yon pas 3sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du te dzo ma sī dmar mo'i mdog can g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su u da ya ma sī bye dang gul ma ma sī 3dang pa na ma sī dang tsi ba ra ma sī durnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du arka ma sī phyo7la sogs pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan no/ /rim pa phyi ma'i snam bu rnams la shar du ma hā tsi ba ra ma se dang ba rā hā ⑩mu khi mche ba gcigs pa 'jigs su rung ba g.yas pas rdo rje lcags kyu dang g.yon pas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor pa ta kra ma sī /1dang ba ra li ser mo 8g.yas pas mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang g.yon pas rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pa ra kra ma sī dang ba da le ⑫dmar mo g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du sprurma ma sī rngudang ba ra li ljang gu g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su baṭ+wā li dmar po'i 6mdog can g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du ba dā li ser mo g.yas 39—1210

pas skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang g.yon pas yal ga dang bcas pa'i mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi chun po 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du ba rā phyali dkar mo g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ba rā hā ②mu khi dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o—/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su ā lo dang / tā lo dang / kā lo dang / sad pa lo sasbra rūrnyo ṭi rnams ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ dkar mo dang / ser mo dang / dmar mo dang / ljang gu ste phyag gnyis ma rdo rje lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang lcags sgog dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /arka ma sī ldul sogs pa'i lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams mngon par gsar 4du byung ba'i lang tsho can spyi bor mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i ba rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa rnam par bkra ba'i gos sngon pos stod g.yogs byas pa / phag zhal gcig ma spyan gsum ma phyag gnyis ma gser gyi mdog can gyi phag pa la gnas shing / gser gyi mdog can gyi phag pas yongs su bskor ba'o//sgo skyong ma rnams ni sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gis ༄ snaganas pa ste gzhan nyi shu rtsa bzhi po sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba la g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni 'od zer can ma'i rtag pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs la bskor ba rnams kyi mi bskyod pa dang rin chen dbang po dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams te me la sogs pa'i mtshams la bskor ba rnams kyi'ang de bzhin no zhes pa ni kha cig go3/ /yang na dkar mo rnams kyi rnam par snang mdzad dang nag mo rnams kyi mi bskyod pa dang / ser mo rnams kyi rin chen 'byung ldan dang / ljang gu rnams kyi don yod grub pa'o zhes pa ni gzhan no//39—1211

'od zer can gyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni me mo rmye / /oṃ mā du rī byi swā hā/ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ mā 1rī byi hūṃ saza ④bispyon ud+mā da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor snye ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du ri rab kyi steng gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba la bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo 'od zer dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ zhal bzhi ma rtsa ba'i zhal ser mo g.yas dkar ba rgyab sngo ba/ g.yon dmar ba phyag bcu gnyis ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rin po che'i gdugs dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang mda' dang ral gri dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa dang rtse gsum dang gzhu dang dgra sta dang dung rnams ⑦'dzin pa/dbu la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung can ma'o/ /de'i shar phyogs su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma rol pa'i kun du bskyod pas bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar mo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od bye can zhal bzhi ma rtsa ba'i zhal dkar mo g.yas sngo ba rgyab ser ba g.yon ljang gu phyag bcu ma g.yas pa rnams kyis byepad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang mchog sbyin dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang ral gri dang g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang dgra sta rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma chen mo rdo rje'i skyil krung can ma nag mo nyi ma'i 'od can rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po phyag bcu gnyis ma g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gzhan pa gnyis 39—1212

kyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa g.yas pa'i phyag rnams kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang mchog sbyin dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs madz+rab dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu dang rin po che'i gdugs dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la bsel ba'i tshal chen mo skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa dmar mo nyi ma'i 'od can rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis tsosna pad+ma dang bcas pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang mda' dang rdo rje dang ral gri dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu dang rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang thugs kar bo ti 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rma bya chen mo sems dpa'i skyil krung can ljang gu zla ba'i 'od sna can rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams ljang gu dang nag po dang dkar po phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rma bya'i mjug sgo dang mda' dang mchog sbyin dang ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams kyis lhung bzed la gnas pa'i dge slong dang gzhu dang pang du gnas pa'i bum pa rin po che 'bar ba 'bab pa 5 can dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spras pa'i rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa la me'i mtshams su dus ma nag mo phyag dag gis dung 'dzin pa dang / bden bral du dus mtshan ma ser mo phyag dag gis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang / rlung du dus kyi rna ba mo dmar mo ④ phyag dag gis dgra sta 'dzin pa dang / dbang ldan du dkar mo sku mdog dkar mo phyag dag gis rtse gsum 'dzin pa ste bzhi po 'di dag ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'o/ /dgu po 'di rnams ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po 39—1213

che'i rgyan dang lha'i gos dang rin po che'i cod pan can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa rim pa 77 ji lta ba bzhin du rin chen dbang po dang rnam par snang mdzad dang mi bskyod pa dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa dang mi bskyod pa dang rin chen dbang po dang snang ba mtha' yas dang rnam par snang mdzad rnams kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang rdo rje zhags pa ma dang rdo rje lcags sgog ma dang rdo rje 'bebs ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /so sor 'brang — snam chen mo la sogs pa rnams kyi sa bon ni pre dang / oṃ ma ni dha ri badzī byeṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa ni snying po dang / sa bon ni sum̐ dang /oṃ āḥm hā sā ha sra byapra marda m+bi hūṃ hūṃ ni snying po dang thu/ sa bon ni hūṃ dang /oṃ āḥm hā man+t+ra a nu sā ri snari ṇi hūṃ hūṃ ni snying po dang / sa bon ni dzi dang /oṃ la ma hā shī ta ba ti dzi hūṃ hūṃ ni snying po dang / sa bon ni me dang / oṃ la ma hā ma yu rā bibye rārnyi ༄nyahūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis 1'di rnams gang yang rung bas 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma bya ste/'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i snying po'i sngags ni las thams cad pa'o / / rtsa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du gling rnams dang nye ba'i gling rnams rgya mtsho bdun la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang ste/ de'i dbus su seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dkar bo rdo rje'i skyil krung shālngagis bzhugs pa—/ nyi ma'i 'od can/ sangs rgyas lngas spras pa'i rin po che'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog dang ldan pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po 39—1214

che'i rgyan dang / gos can zhi ba/ dkar po dang ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa 4dang g.yon pa dag gis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi sniphyag rgya 'dzin pa/ gzhan pa dag gis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa dag gis bgrang phreng dang mda' 'dzin pa g.yon pa dag gis 'khor lo dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /yang na 'di ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin pa ste/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur kyi mdzub mo bslang ba g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung ba ni byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /'dab ma rnams la mdun du sems ma rdo rje ma sngon mo g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po dang g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas su rin chen rdo rje ma ser mo g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rtse mor rin po ches mtshan pa 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /rgyab tu chos kyi rdo rje ma dmar mo g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pas 4mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar dmar dang g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon du las kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu g.yas pas de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i mdog can snyesna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa 'dzin zhing g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /de nas shar phyogs su glang po che'i dbang po'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo gung mos rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po bzung rngo —nas sa gnon gyi tshul mdzad cing / phyag g.yon pa gan rkyal pang du bzhag pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la mdun du rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo gung mos thugs kar gtod dz+wapa'i tshul du rdo rje 39—1215

'dzin pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bsnyems pa dang bcas pa'i dril bu dkur brten nas 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje rgyal po ser po phyag g.yas par gnas pa'i rdo rje lcags kyus 'gugs pa'i tshul mdzad cing g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o / /kha cig ni phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje be+egs kyu 'dzin pas spyan 'dren pa'i tshul byed pa'o zhes pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje chags pa dmar po g.yon pa dang cig shos dag gis gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje legs pa ma ra ①ka ta'i mdog lta bu rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag 3gnyis kyis thugs kar legs so sbyin pa'i tshul mdzad pa'o/ /lhor rta'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rdo rje'i du skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che sor mo gung mos bzung ④nas mchog sbyin gyi tshul mdzad cing / g.yon pa rgyagan rkyal du pang par bzhag pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la mdun du rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas pas bu rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khya tshur kyis mtha' gnyis su rdo rje gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba rang gi dbang bsgur ba'i gnas su 'ching bar mdzad cing / g.yon pa rdo rje dril bu bsnyems pa dang bcas pas 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje gzi brjid dmar po phyag gnyis kyis nyi ma thugs kar 'dzin pa'i 'od kyis gsal bar mdzad pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje rgyal mtshan ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing g.yon gyi dpung pa'i gnas su 'phyang ba'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis so'i phreng ba rdo rje gnyis dang ldan pa bzung 3 nas zhal gyi thad kar 'jog pa'o/ /nub tu rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la snang ba mtha' yas dmar po rdo rje'i pya skyil krung 39—1216

gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yon pa dang g.yas pa gan rkyal du pang pa'i thad du bzhag nas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad de g.yas pa'i sor mo gung mos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i sor mo ①/'dzin pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la mdun du rdo rje chos dkar dmar g.yon pas bsnyems pa dang bcas pas pad+ma'i yu ba 'dzin zhing g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje rnon po nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs g.yon pas thugs kar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam dang /g.yas pas ral gri 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje rgyu gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yon par gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo gung mos 'gal dme'i 'khor lo ltar bskor zhing chos kyi 'khor lo'i ke phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje smra ba dmar po g.yon pas chos kyi dung dang g.yas pas brardo rje rtse gcig pa lta bu'i lce 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du nam mkha' lding gi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ste ba la don yod grub pa ljang gu rdo rje'i peskyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo gung mos sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i tshul mdzad cing / g.yon pa gan rkyal du pang par bzhag pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la mdun du rdo rje las ljang gu g.yas pas basbang ba'i sbyor bas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul du d+ku 'dzin zhing / g.yon sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa ste/yang na phyag gnyis kyi thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje srung ba ser po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag dag gis mthe'u chung gnyis rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon gyi rtse mo can rang gi zhal gyi grwar lju'adzin pas gdug pa can rnams 39—1217

bsdigs par byed pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje khu tshur ser po khu tshur ①gye mtshams su rdo rje ste rdo rje khu tshur dag gis 'tshir ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bzung duba'o/ /dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi me'i pad+ma la rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje dkur brten pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i phyag sno gis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral gyi pad+ma la phreng ba ma ser mo phyag dag gis rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi pad+ma la glu 4 ma dmar mo phyag dag gis pi wang sgrogs pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi pad+ma la gar ma ljang gu rdo rje rtse gsum pa bzung ba'i (she phyag dag gis gar mdzad pa'o/ /dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi snam bu'i shar gyi pad+ma rnams la byams pa dang mthong ba don yod dang ngan song kun 'dren dang mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros rnams ni mi bskyod pa lta bu'o/ /lho'i pad+ma rnams la spos kyi glang po dang dpa' bar 'gro ba dang nam mkha'i mdzod dang ye shes tog rnams ni rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu'o/ /nub kyi pad+ma rnams la 'od dpag med dang zla ba'i 'od dang bzang skyong dang / dra ba can gyi 'od rnams ni snang ba mtha' yas lta bu'o/ /byang gi pad+ma rnams la rdo rje snying po dang blo gros mi zad pa snadang spobs pa brtsegs pa dang kun du bzang po rnams ni don yod grub pa lta bu'o//yang na shar la sogs pa'i snam bu rnams la byams pa la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' stong 3 du bzhi yis ma tshang ba bsgom par bya'o/ /de dag gi mtshan rnams ni rnam par rgyas pas 'jigs nas ma bshad de/ gal te 'dod na bdag gis byas pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa rnal 'byor snying po'i phreng ba las rtogs par bya'o/ /me'i mtshams kyi pad+ma la rdo rje bdug spos ma dkar mo dang / bden bral gyi pad+ma la rdo rje me tog ma ser mo 39—1218

dang / rlung gi pad+ma la rdo rje mar me ma dkar dmar dang / dbang ldan gye pad+ma la rdo rje dri chab ma ljang gu ste/ bdug spos ma la sogs pa 'di rnams sngar dang 'dra ba'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo'i pad+ma rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang rdo rje be+egs sgog dang / rdo rje 'be+ebs pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin du dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu ste sngar dang 'dra ba'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings las gzhan pa'i lha thams cad rmyezhal gcig phyag gnyis pa grusna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa ma gtogs pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug la mngon du phyogs pa ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug ni rang rang gi bdag po'i de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon du phyogs pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa nas rdo rje 'bebs pa'i mthar thug pa'i lha thams cad ni ji skad bshad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba la gnas shing nyi ma'i 'od zer can no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las gzhan pa'i lha bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad ni sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings rnam par snang ba 5shin tu rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid la rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpas zirgyas gdab po/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa'i bdag nyid mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i rigs kyi bdag po ni rnam par snang mdzad do—/ /sems ma rdo rje ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bzhi dang sgeg mo dang bdug spos ma dang / byams pa la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje lcags kyu 39—1219

rnams kyi mi bskyod pa'o/ /rin chen rdo rje ma dang rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa bzhi dang / phreng ba ma dang me tog ma dang spos kyi glang po la sogs pa bzhi dang rdo rje zhags pa rnams kyi rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /chos kyi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje chos rab la sogs pa bzhi dang glu ma dang mar me ma dang 'od dpag med 1la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ma rnams kyi 2snang ba mtha' yas so/ /las kyi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje las rab la sogs pa bzhi dang gar ma dang dri chab ma dang rdo rje snying po la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa rnams kyi don yod grub pa'o/ /'dir nang gi gzhal yas khang gi sgo rnams la ༄ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o zhes pa ni phyogs gzhan no/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni a'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gī shwa ra hūṃ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /gang yang rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams su rnam pa gzhan gyis kyang lha'i rnam pa'i khyad par gsungs pa de dag ni mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bshad do / /4bzhi bcu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid can 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje'i gur la sogs pa nas gzhal yas khang gi bar du dang por bshad pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'dir khro bo rnams ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzugs can no zhes pa ni phyogs gcig ste/ rdo rje gur gyi nang ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs chu skyes kyi lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang ngo zhes pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /phyogs gnyis ka la yang mchod rten dkar po'i nang du gzhal yas khang ngo / /de'i lte bar seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla 39—1220

ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 1bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni sgu mdog gser btso ma lta bu sdug cing yid du 'ong ba me tog sna tshogs kyis namadzes pa'i zur phud gsum gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang mchog sbyin dang mda' g.yon pa rnams kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la snyoms par zhugs pa'o/ /de'i shar gyi re'u mig la glang po che'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la mi bskyod pa sngon po 'gying ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa/rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa'i sor mo gung mos rdo rje thugs kar gyen du bsgreng ba/g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje dril bu dkur brten pa/ gzhan g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang ji/ g.yon pa rnams kyis nu ma dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rta'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la rin chen 'byung ldan ser po sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po phyag 5drug pa rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis mnyam gzhag gi 6phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas pa dag gis tsurin po che dang ral gri g.yon pa dag gis 'khor lo dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o—/ /nub tu rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la snang ba mtha' yas dkar po sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po phyag drug pa g.yon pas sgeg 39—1221

pa dang bcas pa'i pad+ma'i yu ba thugs kar bzung 1ste g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/g.yas pa dag gis bgrang phreng dang rdo rje 'dzin cing / g.yon pa dag gis nu ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du nam mkha' lding gi steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la don yod grub kyepa dmar po sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams dmar po dang sngon po dang dkar po phyag drug pa dang po gnyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya bcings pa/ g.yas pa dag gis ral gri dang rdo rje g.yon pa dag gis 4/nu ma dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du spyan ma ser mo sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis mchog sbyin dang mi 'jigs pa dang 'khor lo dang mda' g.yon pa rnams kyis snyesdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang rin po che'i snye ma dang bgrang phreng dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /mer mā ma bye tī sngon mo khro ba dang bcas pas rgod pa sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ phyag drug ma g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda' g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du gos dkar mo 'gying ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa phyag drug ma thu/ g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon pa rnams kyis pad+ma dang bgrang phreng dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o / /rlung du sgol ma ma ra ka ta lta bu sems dpa'i byal krung can phyag drug ma/g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda' g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang at+pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis par ༄ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su sems ma rdo rje ma dang rin chen rdo rje ma dang chos kyi rdo rje ma dang las kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang mtshon cha 39—1222

rnams ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rnams dang mtshungs pa'o—/ /'on kyang nu ma 'dzin pa med par sems ma rdo rje ma dang rin chen rdo rje ma dang las kyi rdo rje ma rnams ni sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa ste chos kyi rdo rje ma ni zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du tsun+da hūṃm zla ba'i mdog can phyag nyi shu rtsa drug ma rtsa ba'i phyag dag ṭ+wāgis thugs kar rtsa ba'i phyag rgya dang g.yon pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang ral gri dang rin po che'i phreng ba dang bī dza pū ra dang mda' dang dgra sta dang dbyug to dang tho ba dang lcags kyu dang rdo rje dang ba dan gsum gyi tshul dang bgrang phreng rnams dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis yid bzhin kyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang pad+ma dang spyi blugs dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang shak+ta 4dang 'khor lo dang ral gri dang sdigs mdzub dang bum pa bzang po dang mtshon rtse gcig pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ kazhu zhe7ka'i stod g.yogs bcings pa bla gos phrag pa la gzar ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu'i rang bzhin can rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yas pa'i zhal sngon po ljags 'dril zhing mche ba cung zad gcigs pa g.yon pa ser po ma mchu mnan pa'o/ /thal mo yang dag par sbyar 6te mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs bar pa la zlum po'i rnam par bzhag cing mthe bong dag mdzub mo'i logs kyi rtsa bar 'dzin pa ni 'di'i 7rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /mer rin chen skar mda' ma ser mo phyag drug ma dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar rin po che kha sbyor 'dzin pa g.yas pa dag gis mi 'jigs pa dang mda' dang / g.yon pa rnams du snasdigs mdzub dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du bye/khro gnyer can ma dkar mo phyag bcu drug ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang mda'/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang spyi blugs 39—1223

dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du rdo rje lcags sgog ma ljang gu phyag drug ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang rdo rje lcags sgog dang mda' dang g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /spyan ma la sogs pa 47lha mo bcu gnyis po 'di rnams ni rol pa'i kun du bskyod pa dang ldan pas zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing 'od zer dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po bzhin du zhal gsum pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu rnams la shar du byams pa gser gyi mdog can phyag dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad cing / g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang /g.yon pas me tog dang bcas pa'i klu shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i gzugs can khyad par du shes rab ma dang bral ba dang / spos kyi glang po ljang gu g.yon pas bum par gnas pa'i glang po che'i sna 'dzin zhing g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa dang / ye shes tog ser po g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing / g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa bya'o/ /lhor bzang skyong sku mdog dmar po g.yon pas rin po che 'dzin zhing g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa dang / blo gros rgya mtsho dkar po phyag gnyis kyis du sor mo thams cad brkyang bas chu rlabs kyi tshul mdzad pa dang / blo gros mi zad pa gser gyi mdog can g.yon pa'i khu tshur thugs kar bzhag ste g.yas rngomachog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa ljang gu g.yon pa'i khu tshur pang du bzhag cing g.yas pas se gol gtogs pa'o/ /nub tu mthu chen thob pa dkar po g.yon par 4cung zad kha bye ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dzin zhing / g.yon khye pas mchog sbyin pa dang / ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis kyis sdig pa 'dor ba'i 39—122

—byedabyedatshul can dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros ser po phyag gnyis kyis kha sbyar brdeg pa'i tshul can dang / dra ba 1can gyi 'od dmar po g.yon pas ut+pa la la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin zhing g.yas mchog sbyin pa'o/ /byang du zla 'od dkar po g.yon pas ut+pa lar gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin zhing g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa dang /'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis kyis dbang bskur ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa dang / nam mkha'i mdzod ser po g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten zhing /g.yas pa nam mkha' la bskor ba dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sngon po 'am dkar po g.yon pa sa la reg cing g.yas pa'i khya tshur gyi mdzub mo dang mthe bong sbyar te dri ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams ni zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od can/sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa rang phyogs kyi bdag po dang 'dra bar zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug gi gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya dang / gnyis kyis gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /byams pa dang 'jam dpal gnyis ni mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya med pa'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha thams cad rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas shing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /shar sgor ma te'i steng du gshin rje mthar byed nag po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang rdo rje dang mda' 'dzin pa dang / g.yon pas zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub gyen du bsgreng bas bsdigs par byed pa/ gnyis pas 'khyud par byed pa'i lha mo'i nu ma nas 'dzin pa ste/ de yang phyag gnyis ma dkar mo phyag 39 ———/22bye

g.yon pas 'dam skyes 'dzin zhing g.yas pas kun nas 'khyud par brtson pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i gsum pas dngul gyi gzhu 'dzin pa ma ra ka ta k+tar 1ljang ba'i lha mo phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa ut+pa la sngon po 'dzin zhing phyag g.yon pa mgul pa la 'khyud pas g.yas phyogs nas rnam par mdzes pa zhabs drug pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ zhal drug ni sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal gad rgyangs 5 dang bcas pa/gnyis pa 'jigs par byed pa gsum pa gdangs pa/ bzhi pa drag po chen po lnga pa rdo rje'i mche ba can/ drug pa spyi bor gnas shing ljags bsgril rjuba'o/ /yang na spyi bor gnas pa sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal la sogs pa rnams g.yas skor gyis sngon po dang dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu rnams so/ /lho ④sgor gzhan gyis mi thub pa ser po rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams ser po dang nag po dang dkar po dang phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang mda' 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis zu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rta mgrin dmar po rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams dmar po dang sngon po dang phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dbyug pa dang ka ṇa ⑥ya dang mda' 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngon po zhabs kyis bgegs mnan pa phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang dgra sta dang mda' 'dzin zhing g.yon pa rnams kyis 4sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi bye mtshams su rin po che'i ri bo'i 9steng du mi g.yo ba sngon po mi g.yo ba chophyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis ral 39—sde226

gri dang zhags pa dang mda' 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa g.yon ngos su 'phyang ba'i gos sngon po can/ khrag gis brlan zhing ljags 'dril ba'i zhal gdangs pa'o/ /mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po phyag drug pa phyag dang po gnyis kyis phyag rgya mdzad pa / g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang mda' g.yon pa dag gis nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis phan tshun rgyab sbyar nas mjeb 〉—chung gnyis lu gu rgyud byeltar byas te sdigs mdzub gnyis rab tu brkyang nas zhags pa ltar byas pa ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /bden bral du dbyug sngon can sngon po phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang mda' g.yon pa rnams kyis tsusdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o—/ /rlung du stobs po che sngon po phyag brgyad pa g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang ral gri dang mda' g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang tho ba dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi steng du gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po phyag drug pa rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings pa/ g.yas pa dag gis ral gri dang mda' 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dag gis nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa ste/ 'dir 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya de nyid kyi mdzub mo gnyis gyen du bsgreng ba ni gnod mdzes kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'og tu rdo rjes 'og rīsngon po phyag drug pa g.yas pa 5rnams kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang mda' 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis nu ma dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i rtse gcig pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ / bgegs mthar byed la sogs pa bdun ni rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal gsum sngon po 39—1227

dang ser po dang dmar po'o/ /khro bo bcu po rnams kyang khros pa'i lta stangs can spyan gsum dmar la smin ma g.yo ba rtsa ba'i zhal cung zad bye ba/ g.yas pa'i zhal gdangs pa/ g.yon pa'i zhal tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ mche ba gcigs pa stag gi pags pa'i gos gyon pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/skra dang sma ra ser po gyen du badze+es pa/ rol pa'i kun du bskyod pa can/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa ste/ gshin rje mthar byed ni g.yas brkyang ba 'am rdo rje skyil krung gis so/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir gnod mdzes rgyal po'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa'i lngo7gtsug tor 'khor los thusgyur ba ni dkyil 'khor pa nyid du logs su ma bshad de dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las rnal 'byor rgyas par bstan pa la'osnye bar ma'i rim par bstan pa la ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i spyi gtsug gi steng du rin po che'i ri la gnas pa'i pad+ma dang nyi ma la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i gtsug tor 'khor los 4sgyur ba ser po rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams ser po dang sngon po dang phyag brgyad pa/ dang po gnyis kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa / g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang bgrang phreng dang mda' 'dzin zhing /g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ral pa'i cod pan can/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis gzhogs gnyis su rnam par brgyan pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /de'i rjes su 'brangs nas rnal 'byor rgyas pa la yang gtsug tor 'khor los chosgyur ba dkyil 'khor par tha dad du dang / de'i steng du gnod mdzes rgyal po shes par bya'o zhes pa ni kha cig gi'o/ /lha bzhi bcu rtsa gsum po rnams kyang zhal re re 39—1228

zhing spyan gsum pa'o/ /'dir nu ma 'dzin par bshad pa de yang mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhi ni rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la snyoms par zhugs pa rnams kyi ste khro bo rnams ni rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma g.yon logs su gnas pa rnams kyi'o zhese shes par bya'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed las gzhan rnams la shes rab ma med kyang de'i nu ma 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis rang gi nu ma 'dzin pa'o zhes pa 1ni gzhan no/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid la rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i trergyas btab pa ste/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang / spyan ma dang tsun+da rnams la 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / mā ma shī dang sems ma rdo rje ma dang byams pa la sogs pa bzhi dang / khro bo bcu la mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen rdo rje ma dang rin chen skar mda' dang bzang skyong la sogs pa bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan dang / gos dkar mo dang chos kyi rdo rje ma dang khro gnyer can ma dang mthu chen thob la sogs pa bzhi la snang ba 1mtha' yas dang / sgol ma dang las kyi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang zla 'od la sogs pa rnams la don yod grub pa'o—/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs ka'i sa bon ni muḥ'oje/ /oṃ āḥzhes pa ni snying po'o—/ /oṃ a mṛ rnguta kuṇ+ḍa le bikyān+ta ka hūṃ/ zhes pa las thams cad pa'o / /6chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gur la sogs pa bsgom pa'i rnam par gzhag ④pa ni bshad ma thag pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /gzhan 'dir gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzugs can te mchod rten 'di la med do/ /gzhal yas khang 39—1229

gi lte bar sna tshogs chu skyes kyi ze'u 6'bru la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba la 'jam pa'i snadabyangs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od dang ldan pa gser gyi mdog can in+d+ra bhā la lta bu'i zur phud dang ldan pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba'i cod pan gyi steng du sangs rgyas lnga 'phro ba'i rin po che'i cod pan can/rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan dang na bza' can sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba dang g.yas dang rgyab dang g.yon gyi 1zhal rnams ni ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po'o/ /phyag brgyad kyi gnyis kyis 4chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang mda' dang rdo rje g.yon pa rnams kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang gzhu dang rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams la shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su gtsug tor chen po dang gdugs dkar po dang gzi brjid phung po dang rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor rnams 1dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba dang 'phags pa dang cher 'phags dang rgyal ba rnams te/ gtsug tor brgyad po 'di rnams ni rdo rje'i skyil krung dang rin po che'i cod pan can/ sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas 'khor lo gyen du gzung ba g.yon pa rang gi gdan la brten pa'o/ /de nas shar gyi re'u mig gi dbus su glang po che'i rgyal po la mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po khro zhing sgeg pa dang bcas pa g.yas pa dkar po gdangs shing drag pa/rgyab ma ser po dpa' ba g.yon pa dmar po mche ba gcigs shing ma mchu mnan pa/39—1230

phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu 1sna'adzin zhing /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/rdo rje sems dpa' dang rdo rje rgyal po dang rdo rje chags pa dang rdo rje legs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /lho'i re'u mig gi dbus su rta'i rgyal po thul rin chen 'byung ldan ser po ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal can phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen dang rdo rje gzi brjid dang rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang rdo rje bzhad pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /nub kyi re'u mig gi dbus su rma bya la snang ba mtha' yas dmar po dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po dang ser po'i zhal bzhi pa phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang ral gri dang lcags kyu 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis pad+ma dang gzhu dang zhags pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa/rdo rje chos dang rdo rje rdon po dang rdo rje rgyu dang rdo rje srung ba rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /byang gi re'u mig gi dbus su nam mkha' lding la don yod grub pa ljang gu zhal bzhi'i rtsa ba ljang gu mche ba gcigs pa/ g.yas pa ser po zhi ba/rgyab ma dmar po rnam par sgeg pa/ g.yon pa dkar po zhi ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang rdo rje dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin zhing /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/rdo rje las dang rdo rje srung sngub dang rdo rje gnod sbyin dang rdo rje khu tshur rnams kyis 5bskor ba'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni rang 39—1231

rang gi bzhon pa'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan dang gos dang cod pan can no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bcu drug po rnams ni dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su gnas pa'i sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba la rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor las bshad pa'i sku mdog la sogs pa can no/ /'di dag kyang phyogs su gnas pa'o zhes pa'i phyogs kyang yod do/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su gnas pa'i sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba rnams la/ sems dpa'i spyil krung gis 1spyan ma dang mā ma tī dang gos dkar mo dang sgol ma rnams ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa lta bu'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du rdo rje lcags kyu dmar ser rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa dang /lhor rdo rje zhags pa ser po (nardo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa dang / nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog dmar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags sgog 'dzin pa— / sa ga'i stabs kyis gnas pa dang / byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang gu rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa ste/ bzhi po 'di rnams ni sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ klu brgyad kyi rgyan byes 4brgyan pa'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di las phyi rol gyi pedakyil 'khor gnyis pa la/ shar phyogs su dbang ldan nas brtsams nas g.yas skor gyi byurim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ sa ma bcu gnyis ni phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa rnams kyis thurdo rje 'dzin zhing / g.yon 39—1232

pa rnams kyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ de la mos pas spyod pa'i sa ma pad+ma dmar po lta bu chu skyes dmar po 'dzin pa dang / rab dga' ma dmar mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa gedang / dri med ma dkar mo chu skyes dkar bo 'dzin pa dang / 'od byed ma dmar mo sna tshogs chu skyes la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa dang / 'od 'phro ma ma ra ka ta'i mdog can a la sngon po 'dzin pa dang / sbyang dka' ma ser mo pang par gnas pa'i phyag gan rkyal gyis ma ra ka ta'i nor bu 'dzin pa dang / mngon du gyur ma gser gyi mdog can pad+ma'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po nyi 'dzin pa dang /ring du song ma nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs sna tshogs chu skyes la gnas pa'i 2sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / mi g.yo ma zla ba'i mdog can zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar pos mtshan pa'i pad+ma'i yu ba khengs pa dang bcas pas 'dzin pa dang / legs pa'i blo gros ma dkar mo ral gris mtshan pa'i at+pa la 'dzin pa dang / chos kyi sprin ma ser mo chos kyi sprin gyis yongs su bskor ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa dang / kun du 'od ma nyin gung gi nyi ma'i mdog can pad+ma'i steng du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mtshon par byed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 4sku gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor pha rol tu phyin ma bcu gnyis ni phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa rnams kyi 7yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ni phyag gnyis kyis lhag pa'o/ /de la rin po che pad+ma'i pha rol tu phyin ma dmar mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma dkar dmar gyi mdog can sna tshogs pa'i so ba'i snye 6ma 'dzin 39—/233

pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo yal ga dang bcas pa'i mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi chun po 'dzin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma ser mo chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ma ra ka ta'i mdog can at+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin ma nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs 1pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gser gyi mdog can pad+ma la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin zhing / phyag gnyis kyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa dang sna/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma pri yang ku ltar ljang gu chu skyes ser po la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin ma ut+pa la sngon po'i mdog can/ ut+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa dang /stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dmar mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bye po ti 'dzin pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i 'bras bus brgyan pa'i byang chub kyi shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa dang / rdo rje las kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sna tshogs mdog can ut+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /shenub tu dbang ma bcu gnyis ni/ phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa rnams kyis a la 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas bsnyems pa dang bcas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ de la tshe la dbang ma dkar dmar gyi mdog can nor bu pad+ma rā byeg la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gyi sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku gzugs 'dzin pa dang / sems la dbang ma dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po 'dzin pa dang / yo byad la dbang ma ser mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang / las la dbang ma ljang gu sna 39—1234

tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / skye ba la dbang ma sna tshogs mdog can rmyernam pa sna tshogs pa'i mdog can gyi dzā ti'i 'khri shing 'dzin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul la dbang ma nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa dang / mos pa la dbang ma pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'a7ltar dkar ba pri yang ku'i me tog gi snye ma 'dzin pa dang / smon lam la dbang ma ser mo ut+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa dang / ye shes la dbang ma sngon mo ju.ut+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa byadang / chos la dbang ma dkar mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa bzang po 'dzin pa dang / de bzhin nyid ma dkar mo phyag g.yas pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas rdo rje rin bo che'i snye ma 'dzin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ma gser zhun ma thulta bu g.yas pas chu skyes ser bo la 'u gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi steng du 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du gzugs mum bcu gnyis ni/phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa rnams kyis 27sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon pas bsnyems rtepa dang bcas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ de la nor gye blo gros ma ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa ⑩dang / rin chen skar mda' ma dmar mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang / gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo nor bu /1zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa 'dzin pa dang / 'od zer can ma dkar dmar skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab 'dzin pa dang / ri khrod lo ma can zhem ljang gu rma bya'i mjug sgro 'dzin pa dang / dug sel ma dkar mo dug gi me tog gi chun po 'dzin pa dang / sgo mtha' yas ma me tog thra ⑫yang ku ltar ljang gu chu skyes dmar po la gnas pa 5mi zad pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa 39—1235

'dzin pa dang / tsun+da ma dkar mo bgrang phreng 'chang ba'i ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa dang / shes rab 'phel ma dkar mo at+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ma ljang gu rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma dkar dmar 'dzin pa dang / ye shes mi zad pa'i za ma tog dmar mo rin po che'i za ma tog 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 3mdzod ma ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi dpe sgom 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du chos so so thuyang dag par rig ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / lhor don so so ri yang dag par rig ma ma ra ka ta'i mdog can g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis rin po che'i zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / nub tu nges pa'i tshig so so —yang dag par rig ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mtha' gnyis su pad+mas mtshan pa'i be+egs sgrog 'dzin pa dang / byang du spobs pa so so nayang dag par rig ma ma ra ka spyota ltar ljang gu phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o / /mtshams rnams su mer sgeg 7mo ser mo sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i phyag dag gis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa dang / bden bral du phreng ba ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / rlung du glu ma dmar mo phyag dag gis pi wang 'dzin zhing sgra sgogs /pa dang / dbang ldan du gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis gar gyi tshul gyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa ma la sogs pa'i lha mo 'di rnams thams cad ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan dang / na bza' dang / rin po che'i cod pan can / cung zad 'dzum zhing / snasgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs chu 39—1236

skyes dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ste/khyad par sgo skyong ma rnams ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gzhan dag ni de rnams kyang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa la dbang ldan nas brtsams nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams te/ de la snam bu rnams kyi shar du kun du bzang po ser po g.yas pas humachog sbyin dang g.yon pas ut+pa la la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa dang / blo gros mi zad pa ser po g.yas pas ral gri dang g.yon pas mi 'jigs pas pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / sa'i snying po ser po g.yas pas sa gnon mdzad cing g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing 'dzin pa dang / nam mkha'i snying po ljang gu g.yas pas rin po che thams cad kyi char 'bebs shing / g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor nam mkha'i mdzod ser po g.yas pas yid bzhin kyi nor bu dang g.yon pas bum pa bzang po las 'phyangs pa'i du dpag bsam gyi shing 'dzin pa dang / phyag na rin chen ljang gu g.yas pas rin po che dang / g.yon pas chu skyes la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa dang / blo gros rgya mtsho dkar po g.yas pas dung dang g.yon pas ral gri 'dzin pa dang / rdo rje snying po ut+pa la sngon po'i mdog can g.yas pas rdo rje dang / g.yon pas sa bcu pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkar po g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang /g.yon pas chu skyes 'dzin pa dang / mthu chen thob pa ser po g.yas pas ral gri dang g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / zla 'od dkar po g.yas pas 'khor lo dang g.yon pas chu skyes la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa dang / dra ba can gye 'od dkar dmar g.yas pas ral gri dang g.yon pas chu skyes la gnas 39—1237

pa'i nyi ma 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du 'od dpag med dkar po g.yas pas sna tshogs chu skyes dang / g.yon pas chu skyes la gnas pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa dang /spobs pa brtsegs pa ser po g.yas pas 1se gol gtogs shing rtegayon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros gur gum gyi mdog pya g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / g.yon pas shat+ta 'dzin pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sngon po g.yas pas ral gri dang g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /bcu drug po 'di rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil ④la sems dpa'i skyil krung can rin po che'i cod pan dang sna tshogs pa'i rin po che dang na bzas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa rnams so/ /sgo rnams la shar du ma te la gshin rje mthar byed nag po gsus pa 'phyang ba zhal drug pa phyag drug pa g.yas pa rnams kyis lcags kyu dang / ral gri dang mda' dang pe/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdogs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dang snegazhu 'dzin pa ste/ zhal dang zhabs kyi khyad par ni snga ma bzhin no/ /lhor shes rab mthar byed ser po zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal sgeg pa dang bcas pa g.yas pa gdangs pa/ rgyab ma drag po chen po 7/ g.yon pa zhi ba/ yang na 'di rnams rim pa ji lta bar ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po dang ljang gu'o/ /'di'i phyag brgyad kyi 8g.yas pa rnams kyis zhags pa dang / rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis 9dril bu dang shat+ta dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o//nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po zhal dmar po bzhi'i rtsa ba dang g.yas dang rgyab dang g.yon gyi zhal rnams sgeg pa dang drag pa r+ṣadang bzhad pa dang zhi ba'i nyams 39—1238

dang ldan pa/ yang na 'di rnams dmar po dang nag po dang ser po dang dkar po'o—/ /phyag brgyad kyi gnyis kyis rdo rje 1be+egs sgog dang / g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa ste/ gsum po 'di dag ni rol pa'i kun du bskyod pas gnas pa'o/ /byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po zhal sngon po bzhi pa/ yang na 'di rnams sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu/ phyag brgyad kyi gnyis kyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i tshul gyis dril bu dang /g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gis log 'dren mnan nas bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams rnams la dbang ldan du 'jig rten gsum na 2rnam par rgyal ba sngon po zhal sngon po bzhi'i rtsa ba khro zhing sgeg pa dang bcas pa g.yas drag po rgyab dpa' ba/ g.yon mi sdug pa'i nyams can/ yang na 'di rnams sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po'o—/ /phyag brgyad kyi gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bzung nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu dang mda'/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/zhabs g.yon brkyang bas dbang phyug chen po'i mgo dang / g.yas bskum pas u ma'i nu ma mnan pa'o rnyi/ /mer rdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar ba nag po sgeg pa dang dpa' ba dang 'jigs su rung ba tresnying rje'i nyams dang ldan pa'i zhal bzhi pa/yang༄ 'di rnams sngon po dang dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po/ 'di'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang 'khor lo 39—1239
