'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis chodril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang kha ṭī ga dang 'brel ba'i ba dan 'dzin pa/ chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab 'jug g.yas brkyang gis mnan nas bzhugs pa'o/ /bden bral du he ru ka sngon po zhal sngon po bzhi'i rtsa ba drag po/ / bye 7 g.yas pa rab tu dga' bas bzhad pa/rgyab ma za bar rngam byepa/ g.yon pa sgeg pa dang bcas pa/ yang na 'di rnams sngon po dang dmar po dang ljang gu dang dkar po ④phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang mda' dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis snying gar pad+ma kha bye ba dang gzhu dang kha ṭī ga dril bu ba dan dang bcas pa 'dzin zhing / gnyis kyis 'jigs rkye byed chen po'i pags pa rlung ras lta bu 'dzin pa/ chung ma dang bcas pa'i tshangs pa g.yon brkyang gis mnan nas bzhugs rwa 'o/ /rlung du rta mchog ljang gu zhal ljang gu bye bzhi'i rtsa ba khro zhing sgeg pa dang bcas pa/ g.yas pa drag po g.yon pa tshangs pa'i gdong can/yang na 'di rnams ljang gu dang sngon po dang dkar po ste spyi bor rta mgo ljang gu 'di'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje ba dan dang ldan pas bsgreng ba'i tshul dang / gnyis pas ba dan gsum pa'i tshul dang / gsum pas tshu ral gri/bzhi pas mda'/ g.yon pas phub dang bcas pa'i phyag gis sna tshogs chu skyes dang gsum gyis shat+ta dang dbyug pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang ba dang g.yon brkyang ba ste zhabs bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gcig gis dbang mo dang dpal mo//gnyis pas dga' ma dang rangs ma g.yon pa gcig gis dbang po dang sbrang rtsir byed pa/ gnyis pas rgyal bar byed pa dang dpyid kyi lha mnan nas bzhugs pa'o//'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi steng gi nam mkhar gtsug tor 'khor los spu sgyur ba ser 39—1240

po zhal ser po bzhi pa/ yang na ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po'i ①zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang zhags pa dang bgrang phreng dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i kun du bskyod pas bzhugs pa'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po drag po dang zhi ba dang bzhad pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i zhal nag po bzhi pa yang na nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po dang ser po'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda' g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang zhags pa dang rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /khro bo bcu po 'di rnams ni sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa/ zhal re re zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ smin ma 'khrog pa dang bcas pa tso /stag gi pags pa'i gos dang smad g.yogs can/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser 'bar ba gyen du bcings pa sma ra dmar ser can gdengs can gyi dbang po brgyad dang ldan pas 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa nyid kyi grwa bzhi'i nang du 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa'i khro bo bzhi'i phyi'i re khā'i 1/phyi rol gyi gnas su me la sogs pa'i zur thig ④bzhi po rnams kyi thugayas logs su me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi dang g.yon logs su rdo rje gzugs ma la ste/ de la me tog ma ser mo phyag na rnge tog gi snod can dang / bdug spos ma nag mo phyag na spos phor can dang /mar me ma dmar mo phyag na rin po che'i sgon ma'i mchod sdong can dang / dri chab ma ljang gu phyag na dri'i dung can dang / rdo rje gzugs ma ser mo phyag na me 39byed1241

long can dang / rdo rje sgra ma ljang gu phyag na pi wang can dang / rdo rje ro ma dmar mo phyag na dri'i shesdod can dang / rdo rje reg bya ma sna tshogs pa'i mdog can phyag na gos sna tshogs can no/ /brgyad po 'di rnams ni phyag gnyis ma rin po che'i cod pan can rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rin po che dang gos kyis brgyan pa/pad+ma dang zla ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /bzhi pa rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la dbang po'i phyogs su sa srung tsadakar po la gnas pa'i dbang po ser po rdo rje dang nu ma 'dzin pa dang / gshin rjer /zum te la gshin rje nag po dbyug pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ chur chu srin la chu bdag dkar po gdengs ka bdun pa klu'i zhags pa dang dung thu'adzin pa dang / lus ngan du mi la gnas pa'i lus ngan po ser po lcags kyu dang dbyug to 'dzin pa dang /dbang ldan du gla nga la gnas pa'i dbang ldan dkar po rtse gsum dang jod pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog la thod pa dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan zhing sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa mgrin pa sngon po dang / mer ra la me lha dmar po blugs gzar dang thuspyi drugs 'dzin pa dang / bden bral du ro la srin po'i bdag po bden bral sngon po ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa dang / rlung du ri dwags la rlung lha sngon po rlung ras 'dzin pa ste/ brgyad po 'di rnams ni phyag bzhi pa/g.yas pas phyag mtshan dang po dang / g.yon pas gnyis pa 'dzin zhing rang snang gi btsun mo la 'khyud pa/ gnyis kyis ༅spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas 'dud pa'o—/ /dbang ldan dang nye ba'i phyi rol du dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams nas rim pas tshangs pa la sogs pa ste/ de yang ngang pa la tshangs pa ser po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ bgrang phreng dang chu skyes 'dzin zhing g.yas pa 39—1242

dang cig shos dag thal mo sbyar bas ①dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /mkha' lding la khyab 'jug nag po phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis thu 'khor lo dang dung 'dzin zhing g.yas pa dang g.yon pa tsadag gis thal mo sbyar bas dbyug to dang sā ram̐ ④ga'i gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /glang la dbang phyug dkar po ri bong gis mtshan pa'i ④ral pa'i thor cog can/ phyag bzhi pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rma bya la gdong drug dmar po zhal drug pa phyag drug pa g.yas pa dag gis shat+ta dang rdo rje dang / g.yon pa dag gis khyem bya dang dril bu 'dzin zhing gnyis kyis phyothal mo sbyar ba'o/ /'di rnams kyang snga ma bzhin du rang snang gi btsun mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /tshangs 3ma ni tshangs pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /drag mo ni drag po dang mtshungs pa'o/ /khyab 'jug ma ni khyab 'jug dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gzhon nu ma ni gzhon nu dang mtshungs pa'o/ / dbang mo ni dbang po dang mtshungs pa'o/ /snye 7phag mo nag mo 'ug pa la gnas ma phyag bzhi ma g.yas pa dang cig shos dag gis ro hi ta dang thod pa 'dzin zhing gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /tsosnayi dwags kyi steng du tsa muṇ+ḍi dmar mo phyag bzhi ma g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin zhing gzhan pa dag gis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /j-iṅgi ni ma nag mo shin tu skem pa bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin zhing gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /byi ba la tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis rtse gsum dang la du/ g.yon pa dag gis dgra sta dang la phug 'dzin pa'o/ /nag po chen po nag po rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dga' byed dbang ⑪phyug nag po rdza rnga la zhon zhing rdza rnga brdung bar brtson pa'o/ /39—1243

rta bdun pa'i shing rta la nyi ma dmar po g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /ngang pa la zla ba dkar po g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis ku mu ta la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o//ra la bkra shis dmar po g.yas pas chu gri dang g.yon pas mi'i mgo bo zla 1ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma la gza' lhag ser po mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /sbal pa 'am thod pa la phur bu dkar po bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma la pa sangs dkar po bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rus sbal la spen pa nag po dbyug pa 'dzin pa'o/ /sgra gcan dmar nag phyag dag gis nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /mjug rings thu nag po ral gri dang klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /glang po la stobs bzangs dkar po ral gri dang gshol 'dzin pa'o//khu byug gi shing rta la rgyal bar byed pa ljang gu phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis me tog gi phreng ba dang mda'aje7 / g.yon pa dag gis btung ba'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /ṣ+pe bo'i shing rta la sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang mda'/ g.yon pa dag gis btung ba'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /spre'u la dpyid kyi lha dkar po phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa dag gis mda' dang ral gri/ g.yon pa dag gis gzhu dang btung ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /mtha' yas dang nor rgyas dang 'jog po dang stobs rgyu dang pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dang dung skyong dang / rigs pyeldan rnams ni sbrul gyi gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa thal mo sbyar ba ste/ yang na rang rang gi yab kyi phyag mtshan gtso bo dang ldan pas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ / thags bzangs 'uris dang stobs ldan dang tshim byed la sogs pa'i lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams ni nag po 39—1244

g.yul 'gyed pa'i go cha gyon pa ral gri dang phub la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha phyag na 'dzin pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po gshog pa rab tu brkyang ba pus mo'i bar du dkar ba/ de'i steng nas lte ba'i bar du ser po lte ba'i steng nas mgrin pa'i bar du dmar po/ de'i steng nas spyi bo'i bar nag po/ phyag dag gis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /mi 'am ci'i rgyal po dmar ser pi wang gi sgra sgogs par brtson pa'o/ /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa ser po pi wang gi sgra sgogs stipa'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang po don thams cad grub pa dkar po me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /gang ba bzang po sngon po dang / nor bu bzang po ser po dang / nor sbyin dmar po dang / rnam thos sras ser po dang / tsi bi kuṇ+ḍa li dmar po dang / ki li ma 3 lī ljang gu dang sgo'i dbang po ser po dang spyod pa'i dbang po ser po ste/ gang ba bzang po la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi dbang po 'di rnams ni g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis bī dza pū ra 1ka'i 'bras bu dang ṣ+pe'u le 'dzin pa'o/ /'phrog ma ser mo chang bu gnyis 'dzin pa bu dang bcas pa'o/ /tha skar dkar po dang / bra nye ljang gu dang /smin drug sngo bsangs dang / snar ma dmar skya dang / mgo nag po dang /lag ser po dang / rgyal sngo bsangs dang / skag dkar po dang / mchu ser po dang / gre me tog thra cheyang ku ltar ljang ser dang / dbo ljang gu dang /me bzhi dkar po dang / nag pa ljang gu dang / sa ri ser po dang / sa ga nag po dang / lha mtshams ljang gu dang / spyon ser po dang / snrubs ser po dang / chu stod nag po dang / chu smad dkar po dang / gro bzhin dkar ser rngudang / mon gre nag po dang / mon gru ser po dang / khrums stod ljang 39—1245

gu dang / khrums smad ser po dang / nam gru dkar po dang / byi bzhin sngo bsangs te/ tha skar la sogs pa'i lha 'di rnams ni g.yo ba dang bcas pa'i stod g.yogs yongs su 'dzin pa thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /gzhan yang lha rnams ni 'khor los 'dren pa'i khang brtsegs la gnas par shes par bya ste/ dbang po la sogs pa'i lha 'di rnams pad+ma la gnas pa/ re re 'ang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ 'byor pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang po bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra phyogs thams cad du sgogs pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs sgo skyong rnams ni snying po'i dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i rang bzhin 'jam pa'i dbyangs shin tu rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin la rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa'o/ /me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang gtsug tor brgyad dang / spyan ma rnams la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bzhi dang / mā ma tī lhadang / rdo rje lcags kyu dang / sa ma bcu gnyis dang chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang sgeg mo dang kun du bzang mo la sogs pa bzhi dang khro bo bcu dang me tog ma dang gzugs ma dang shar phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pas so / /rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa bzhi dang rdo rje zhags pa dang pha rol tu phyin ma bcu gnyis dang / don so so yang dag par rig ma dang / phreng ba ma dang nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa bzhi dang bdug spos ma dang sgra ma dang lho phyogs na 2 39byed1246

gnas pa'i lha rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis so/ /rdo rje chos la sogs pa bzhi dang gos dkar mo dang rdo rje lcags sgog dang tshe dang dbang ma bcu gnyis dang nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig ma dang glu ma dang spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa bzhi dang / mar me ma dang ro ma dang nub phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'od dpag med kyis so/ /rdo rje las rab la sogs pa bzhi dang sgrol ma dang rdo rje 'bebs —1snapa dang / gzugs snyem bcu gnyis dang / spobs pa so so yang dag par rig ma dang / gar ma dang 'od dpag med la sogs pa bzhi dang dri chab ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma dang byang phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams la don yod grub pas rgyas btab po/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni muḥ'o/ /oṃ a aḥ sarba ta thā ga tā j-i chod ya ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ dīḥbha ga wān dzñā na mūrti 5 wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā ba —tsa/ sarba dharma ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shudha dharma dh+wa tu dzñā na gasgo aḥmezhes pa snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mri 8ta kuṇ+ḍa li bhesnan+ta 9ka hūṃ/zhes pa bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags te las thams cad pa'o / /11ngan song yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang ri rab kyi steng gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ nang gi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po/ rdo rje phreng ba sngon pos yongs su pa nabaskor ba ste 'ga' zhig 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa sngon por gsungs la/gzhan du ni 'di'i 'khor lo'i lte ba sngon po dang / rtsibs rnams kyi shar dkar po dang / lho nag po dang / nub dmar po dang / byang ljang gu'o zhes gsungs so/ /'khor lo'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du/bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po gser gyi mdog can 39—1247

chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /shar gyi rtsibs la rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po sa gnon rkyagyi phyag rgya can no/ /lho'i rtsibs la rin chen gtsug tor sngon po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can no/ /nub kyi rtsibs la pad+ma gtsug tor dmar po bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya can no/ /byang gi rtsibs la sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang gu mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa'o/ /me'i rtsibs la gzi brjid gtsug tor dkar dmar 'dres pa'i mdog can phyag g.yas pas nyi ma 'dzin cing / g.yon pa dkur brten pa'o/ /bden bral gyi rtsibs la rgyal mtshan gtsug tor dmar po dang 'dres pa'i nag po phyag dag gis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi rtsibs la rnon po'i gtsug tor nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs khruphyag g.yas pa ral gri dang g.yon pas po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi rtsibs la gdugs can gtsug tor dkar po phyag dag gis gdugs 'dzin pa'o / /rdo rje phreng ba'i phyi rol me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su sgeg mo dang phreng ba dang glu ma dang gar ma rnams ni/ dkar mo dang ser mo dang dmar mo dang / sna tshogs kyi mdog can phyag gnyis ma'o/ /snam bu rnams la sgo'i g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' gnyis dang g.yas gnyis te/ de yang shar gyi snam bu la byams pa ser po g.yas pas klu shing gi me tog dang / g.yon pas bye drugs 'dzin pa dang / mthong ba don yod ser po phyag g.yas pas spyan dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang /ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros dkar ser bsres pa'i mdog can phyag g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khu tshur bkur /rngo 39—1248

—brten pa'o/ /lho nyaphyogs su spos kyi glang po dkar ljang g.yas pas dri'i dung 2 chos 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba dkar po g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dkar ser g.yas pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang / ye shes tog sngon po phyag g.yas pa 7yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /nub tu bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar po g.yas pa cod pan gyi steng du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang / zla ba'i 'od dkar po g.yas pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i gzugs 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang /bzang skyong dkar po g.yas pa 'bar ba'i 'od can gye rin po che 'dzin zhing /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang dra ba can gyi 'od dkar po g.yas pa rdo rje'i gur 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa'i khya tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje snying po sngo skya g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ut+pa la sngon po 'dzin zhing /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang / blo gros mi zad pa dkar po phyag gnyis kyis thuye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa dmar bo g.yas pa chu skyes la gnas pa'i rin po che brtsegs pa 'dzin zhing /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa dang / kun du bzang po gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pa rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su me tog ma dang bdug sgos ma dang mar me ma dang dri chab ma rnams ni dkar mo dang nag mo dang dmar mo 'udang 39—1249

—ljang gu ste me tog ①la sogs pa 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang / lhor rdo rje zhags pa sngon bo phyag gnyis kyis zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / nub tu rdo rje lcags sgog dmar po phyag gnyis kyis 5rdo rje lcags sgog 'dzin pa dang / byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lha sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di rnams kyang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po ches brgyan pa rin po che'i cod pan can/ spyan gnyis pa phyag gnyis pa sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba rnams la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad chen po la rang dang 'dra ba'i rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa bzhi la rnam par snang mdzad chen pos so/ /shar phyogs dang me mtshams na gnas pa'i lha rnams la rdo rje gtsug tor gyis so/ /lho phyogs dang bden bral kyi mtshams na gnas pa rnams la rin chen gtsug tor gyis so/ /nub phyogs dang rlung gi — 7mtshams na gnas pa rnams la pad+ma gtsug tor gyis so/ /byang phyogs dang dbang ldan gyi mtshams na ④/gnas pa rnams la sna tshogs gtsug tor gyis so/ /'dir phyi'i khrudakyil 'khor gyi lha'i ⑥gnas kyi snam bu la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad po blta ⑦bar bya'o zhes spyong rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyir—/ 'dod yon gye snam bu la byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug dgod bye pa ni yang dag par rigs so/ /kha cig ni nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes rgyud las gsungs pas phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du gzhal yas khang kyeganyis pa'o zhes smra'o / /'ga' zhig tu ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgu po gtsug tor dang bcas pa dge slong gi cha lugs 'dzin pa'o 39—1250

zhes bshad do/ /de ni mi rigs te chags pa dang ldan pa'i gzugs can 'khor los rmyesgyur ba'i gzugs su mngon par sprul pa'o zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba dang / khor yug gi nang du dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis mgrin pa sngon po la sogs pa dgod par bya ste/ de nas dbang ldan nas glang la mgrin pa sngon po dkar po sbrul kyi mchod phyir thogs pa can/ phyag g.yas pa dag na rdo rje dang mchog sbyin gye phyag rgya dang / g.yon pa dag na rtse gsum dang ral gri'o/ /nam mkha' lding la khyab 'jug nag po g.yas pa dag na dbyug to dang rdo rje dang /g.yon pa dag na dung dang 'khor lo'o/ /rdo rje gser ma khyab 'jug lta bu ste khyad par ni gser gyi mdog can no/ /rma bya la rdo rje dril bu zhal drug pa dmar po g.yas pa dag na shat+ta dang rdo rje dang / g.yon pa dag na khyim bya dang rdo rje dril bu'o/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ma ni rdo rje dril bu lta bu'o/ /ngang pa la mi smra rdo rje ser po zhal bzhi pa/ g.yas pa dag na rdo rje dang bgrang phreng dang / g.yon pa dag na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs so/ /rdo rje zhi ba ma ni tshangs pa lta bu'o/ /so ldan gyi dbang po dkar po mche ba drug pa dang / zla ba 1rdo rje mtshon cha ser po—/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin zhing ④g.yon pas rdo rje dkur brten pa'o/ /lha mo rdo rje khu tshur ma ni rdo rje mtshon cha lta bu'o/ /rta bdun kyi shing rta la rdo rje thu'akhyel pa khro bo dmar po phyag g.yas pa na pad+ma dang / g.yon pa na pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi ma ni rdo rje 'khyil pa lta bu'o—/ /ngang pa la rdo rje'i ⑥'od khro bo dkar po/ g.yas pa na rdo rje dang g.yon pa na pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa dang / rdo rje 39—1251

mdog ma ni rdo rje'i 'od lta bu'o/ /ra la rdo rje dmar ser khro bo dmar po phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang g.yon pas mi bzung nas za ba'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje ska rags ma ni rdo rje dmar ser lta bu'o/ /pad+ma la rdo rje zhi ba khro bo ser po mda' dang gzhu can no/ /rdo rje zhi ba ma ni rdo rje zhi ba lta bu'o/ /sbal pa la rdo rje bla ma khro bo ser po bgrang phreng 1dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rdo rje bla ma ma ni rdo rje bla ma rngulta bu'o/ /pad+ma la rdo rje pa sangs khro bo dkar po bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa dang / rdo rje pa sangs ma ni rdo rje pa sangs lta bu'o/ /rus sbal la rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo nag po g.yas pa na rdo rje dang g.yon pa na dbyug pa'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ma ni rdo rje dbyug pa lta bu'o/ /rdo rje sgra gcan khro bo dmar nag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag na zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can no/ /rdo rje lha min mo ni rdo rje sgra gcan lta bu'o/ /rdo rje mjug rings khro bo nag po ral gri dang klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje klu mo — rdo rje mjug rings lta bu'o//bzhi po 'di dag dang rdo rje zhi ba la sogs pa drug ni rgyud gzhan las gsungs pa ltar bris pa'o/ /glang po che la rdo rje glang sna dkar po g.yas pa na rdo rje dang g.yon pa na thang 4gshol lo/ /rdo rje 'dul ba ma ni rdo rje glang sna lta bu ste khyad par ni g.yas sapas kha ṭī ga'o/ /khu byug gi shing rta la rdo rje phreng ba 9can ljang gu g.yas pa na rdo rje dang / g.yon pa na me tog gi phreng ba'o/ /rdo rje gdan ma ni rdo rje phreng ba can lta bu ste khyad par ni phyag g.yon na dze+eshat+ta'o/ /ṣ+pe lha'i shing rta la rdo rje dbang can ser po g.yas na rdo rje dang / g.yon na chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan no/ /rdo rje dbang can ma ni rdo rje dbang can lta bu ste khyad par ni sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /sbal pa'i shing rta la rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje dkar po rdo 39—12bye2

rje dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gdan ma ni rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba lta bu'o/ /me tog gi shing rta la rdo rje gtun shing ser po g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis rdo rje gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje pho nya mo ni rdo rje gtun shing lta bu ste g.yon pas kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa ni khyad par ro/ /ra la rdo rje ma dmar mo rmyegayas pa dag na rdo rje dang go cha/ g.yon pas dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'bar ba ma ni rdo rje me lta bu'o/ /ma he la rdo rje dus nag po rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs la rdo rje dus ma nag mo durdo rje dang kha ṭī ga rngu'adzin pa'o/ /klu lhag ma rnams la rdo rje be+egs kyu sngon po phag gi gdong pa can rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /skyes bu la rdo rje gdong ma sngon mo ④phag pa'i gdong can ma rdo rje dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /chu srin la rdo rje klu dkar po gdengs ka brgyad dang ldan pa g.yas na rdo rje dang / g.yon na klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /chu srin la rdo rje zuchu srin ma dkar mo gdengs ka brgyad dang ldan pa g.yas na rdo rje dang / g.yon rte na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i chu srin can no/ /ri dwags la rdo rje rlung sngon po g.yas na rdo rje dang g.yon na rlung ras can no/ /rdo rje shugs can ma ni rdo rje rlung lta bu'o/ /ro langs la rdo rje 'jigs byed sngon po rdo rje dang dbyug to 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rnam par gtsigs ma ni rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu'o//g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa ni khyad par ro/ /byi ba la rdo rje legs tsa'adren dkar po glang po che'i gdong can phyag g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang dgra sta 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dag gis rtse gsum dang dbyug to 'dzin pa sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa can no/ /byi ba la srul mo sngon mo hūṃgayas pa na rdo rje dang g.yon pas phyags rngushing can no/ /sdigs rngu ma ljang gu g.yas pa na rdo rje dang g.yon pa na 39—1253

ral gri 'ges shebyed 'dzin pa'o/ /dpal mo ser mo g.yas pa na rdo rje dang g.yon pa na pad+ma can no/ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo g.yas pa na rdo rje dang g.yon pa na pi wang can no/ /seng ge la bgrod dka' ma ljang gu g.yas pa ñtshadag na rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang / g.yon pa dag na lde men dang ral gri can no//'dir mgrin pa sngon po la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyi ke phyag g.yas pa rnams su ji ltar 'byung ba'i rdo rje rnams ni rtse mo gsum par rig par bya'o/ /nub tu rdo rje klu dang nye bar pad+ma la sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can phyag dag gis bdud rtsi'i ④bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lha ma yin rnams ni sna tshogs pa'i mdog can go cha dang bcas pa ral gri 'dzin pa ras bal gyi gdan la 'dug pa'o/ /klu rnams ni nor bu dang ldan pa'i gdengs ka can btsun mo dang bcas pa dzuthal mo sbyar ba'o/ /khor yug gi 6phyi rol mtshams rnams su mer mnar med la sogs pa'i dmyal ba rnams dang / bden bral du yi dwags kyi 'gro ba rnams dang / rlung du byol song gi 'gro ba 3rnams dang / dbang ldan du mi'i 'gro ba rnams gnas pa ste/rim pa 'di ni rgyud gzhan las bris pa'o/ /gzhan dag dwani rdo rje 'jigs byed dang nye bar sa'i lha mo dang gnod sbyin rnams dang nye bar lha ma yin rnams so zhes rjod / par byed do/ /'khor lo'i rngodabang phyug gi thugs gar zla ba la oṃ mu ṣ+pe mu ṣ+pe ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags te 'di nyid ni snying po'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na 11rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/samyak+shi budha kiya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ṣ+pe sho dha ṣ+pe/ sarba pā paṃ sho dha rgo shudhe bi shudhetso) / sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe —swā hā/ zhes pa phreng ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ sarba bita musarba a pā ya ga ti rkeha na bi sho dha 39—1254

ni hūṃ hoḥphaṭa/ ces pa ste las thams cad pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa ni gzhan dag go / /gye'abyung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje gur gyi nang ri rab kyi steng thusna tshogs chu skyes kyi ze'u 'bru la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du gzhal yas khang gi lte ba la glang po che'i rgyal po'i steng ngam/ glang po che dang bral ba yang rung sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i 'byung po chen po dkar po ④ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i 3thor cog dang / sma ra dmar ser can/ thod pa lnga dang ldan pa/ mig gsum pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa dang bcas pa stag gi pags pa'i smad g.yogs can/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas pa dag gis hūṃgri gug dang ḍa ma ru 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa drag po ste/ de g.yon brkyang pegis mnan pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed drag po chen po sku mdog sngon po thod pa lngas mtshan pa'i cod pan la de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbu brgyan dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bcings pa na bza' sngon po mnabs pa mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal can bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs can spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas pas rdo rje sngon po kha gyes pa gsor zhing / g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis kyis phyag rgya bcings pa ste/ phyag rgya ni ming med gnyis bsnol nas mdzub mo gnyis bskum ste lkumathe'u chung dang gung mo yang mje bong rgan pas mnan pa'o zhes pa 'di gsungs so/ /klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa ste/ de'ang stobs kyi rgyu sngon pos spyi bo bcings pa/ mgrin par tsusna39—1255

'jog bo dmar po/ dga' bo dang nyer dga' ser pos ①rna rgyan/ mtha' yas dkar pos tshangs skud/ nor rgyas dkar pos ldu ska rags/ phyag rgya'i phyag dag gi ldudapung par ni rigs ldan phug ron gyi mdog can/ phyag gzhan pa gnyis kyi dpung pa la dung skyong dkar po/ rkang gdub dag ni ④pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dmar po/ re'u mig rnams la shar du glang dang nyi ma la dbang phyug chen po dkar po mtshan ma gyen du langs pa thod pa'i phreng ba can/ spyan gsum pa zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i 2 thor cog can sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa dang bcas pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa dag gis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /ltor nam mkha' lding dang nyi ma la khyab 'jug nag po rin po che'i con pan can g.yas pa dag gis rnga yab dang dung 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dag gis 'khor lo dang dbyug to 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu ngang pa dang zla ba la tshangs pa dkar po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa dag gis bgrang phreng dang gdugs kyi 'uyu ba 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du rma bya dang nyi ma la smin drug gi bu dmar bo gtsug phud gsum dang ldan pa g.yas pas rnga yab dang / g.yon pas shasti 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du byi ba dang zla ba la tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can spyan gsum pa spyi bor zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa g.yas pa dag gis la phug dang dgra sta/ g.yon pa dag gis rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la nyi ma dmar po g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du shing rta la gnas pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba la sgra 39—1256

gcan dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba mig dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'bar ba/ mche ba bzhi pa zhal gdangs pa phyag dag gis nyi ma dang zla bar bcas pas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /rlung du zla ba la dga' byed dbang phyug ser po gar byed pa/ spyi bor zla ba phyed pa can sbrul gyi mchod spyir kye7thogs pa dang ldan pa—/ g.yas pa dang cig shos dag gis zhe ḍa ma ru dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i shar phyogs su zla ba la dpal mo kyedakar mo thugs kar thal mo sbyar bas me tog pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru zla ba la thig le mchog ma dmar mo spos snod 'dzin zhing gar byed pa'o/ /nub tu zla ba la ri bong ④can ma dmar mo mar me 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du zla ba la dka' zlog phyem ser mo spyi bor gdengs ka'i rnam par byas pa'i lag pa zlog cing gar byed pa'o/ /mer zla ba la rin chen bye dpal mo dmar mo dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du zla ba la dbyangs can ma ljang gu pi wang sgrogs pa'o/ /rlung du zla ba la lha mdzes ma nag mo rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du zla ba la kun 'byor ma ser mo gar byed cing phyag na rdo rje rtse gsum pa thu'adzin pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar du sa srung thudakar po dang zla ba la brgya byin ser po rin po che'i cod pan can g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin zhing g.yon pa rdo rje'i mtshon cha can no/ /lhor ma he dang nyi ma la gshin rje nag po gsus pa 'phyang ba/ spyan dang m+bin ma dang sma ra dang ral pa dmar ser can/ gos ser po gyon pa g.yas pa thod pas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu lag 'gro dang zla ba la chu lha dkar po gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ g.yon pas klu'i zhags pa 'dzin zhing g.yas pas mchog 39—1257

sbyin pa'o/ /byang du gnod sbyin la gnas pa'i lus ngan ser po sha rgyas shing gsus pa 'phyang ba rin po che'i cod pan can/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis dbyug to dang ṣ+pe'u le 'dzin pa'o/ /mer ra dang nyi ma la me lha dmar po ral pa dang ldan pa/ skra dang sma ra ser zhing 'bar ba7/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ril ba dang mchod phyir thogs pa can/ g.yas pa dag gis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa dag gis ldu dbyu gu gsum pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du ro langs dang nyi ma la srin po nag po sma ra ser po can / g.yas pas ral gri dang g.yon pas mi shas 1gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /rlung du ri dwags dang zla ba la /5rlung lha sngon po gtsug phud gsum dang ldan pa phyag dag gis rlung ras 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ngang pa dang zla ba la zla ba dkar po g.yon pa na ku mu ta na gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang /g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du dbang ldan yang dbang phyug chen po lta bu'o/ /rim pa bzhi pa'i shar du zla ba la seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin ma thudakar mo seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru zla ba la rnam par 'byor ma dmar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pad+ma la bye ldan ma chen mo dkar mo gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du zla ba la chang mchog ma dmar mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du zla ba la mchog 'phrog ma dmar mo thugs kar me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /mer zla ba la rin chen dbang phyug ma ser mo spos phor 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du zla ba la rgyal mtshan ma ser mo dri'i ṣ+ṭadung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung du zla ba la 'gro skyod ma ser mo mar me'i mchod sdong 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir gang la khyad par gyi tshig 39—1258

med pa der ni nyi ma dang zla ba thams cad sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa ste/ lha thams cad sems dpa'i khrul krung / rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /'dir 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi rigs kyi dbang po ni mi bskyod pa ste thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa ces pa ni snying po ste/yang na/ oṃ byu ①ta ḍā ma ra bhū ①ta a dhi pa ti akhyo bh+yaḥ①ki rī ṭi na sat+tha byu ta pre ta pi ④shā tsa na sā dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang 'di nyid de 3yang na bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags so / /khye dze+emakha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa nas gzhal yas khang gi mthar thug pa sngar gyi 'jam pa'i phyardo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /de la dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su go rī ⑨la sogs pa rnams dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su puk+ka sbo ⑩la sogs pa rnams so/ /de yang gau rī dkar mo g.yas pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang / tso rī ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / be ta lī dmar mo /—1lcags sgog 'dzin pa dang / ghasma rī ⑫ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa dang / puk+ka sī ⑫sngon mo byang chub kyi sems kyi bum pa 'dzin pa dang / sha ba rī rngudakar mo ri rab 'dzin pa dang / tsaṇ+ḍa lī thusngon mo me thab 'dzin pa dang / ḍom+bi nī ⑩sna tshogs mdog can rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /shar gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su zla ba la sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo 7ste/rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yon pa dmar po lhag ma rnams sngon po g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad po rnams na rma bya dang ma te dang chu srin dang nya dang / glang po che dang rus 8sbal dang klu lhag ma can dang / ngang pa rnams dang g.yon pa'i thod pa 39—1259

brgyad po rnams na da byid 1dang / srog chags bye ④dang / sbrul ha la ha khye la dang / āñdza na sgo dang byi ba dang g.yag dang dri can ④dang tsā ta ka rnams so//shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su rim pa ji lta bar lha mo rnams te/ de yang skam pa ma sngon mo skam pa 'dzin pa dang (lte / zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / dol zlum ma dmar mo nya thurgya zlum po 'dzin pa dang / lcags kyu ma lcags kyu ④'dzin pa dang / me tog ma dkar mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa dang / bdug spos ma nag mo sgos phor 'dzin pa dang / mar me ma ser mo mar me'i mchod sdong 'dzin pa dang /dri chab ma ser mo dri yis tsagang ba'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i 67dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo ⑩ste 'di'i rtsa ba dang g.yon pa'i zhal dag nyubyeni ser po dang dkar po'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni sngon po'o/ /g.yas pas rkyethod pa rnams na bya ka raṇ+ḍa tsa dang / ngur pa dang / lug dang / tsa ko ra dang / khra dang / hor pa dang / 'ol ba dang / ku ra rnams dang /g.yon pa rnams na stobs kyi rgyu dang / dung skyong dang / rigs ldan dang /pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / 'jog po dang / nor rgyas dang / mtha' yas rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su lha mo rnams te/ de yang nyi phyag ma dkar mo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa dang / mar me ma sngon mo thumar me'i mchod sdong 'dzin pa dang / rin chen dkar / mda' ma ser mo rin po che 'dzin pa dang / glog phyag ma 3ljang gu glog gi 'khri shing 'dzin pa dang / sgeg mo dmar mo bsnyems (/snyeshing sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i tshul gyi 3phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje 'dzin pa 39—1260

dang / phreng ba ma dmar mo phyag dag gis rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang /glu ma dmar skya phyag dag gis ting ting shags sgogs ①pa dang / gar ma sna tshogs mdog can rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag dag gis gar byed pa'o/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ④dbus su pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo ①ste 'di'i rtsa ba dang g.yon pa'i zhal dag ni dmar po dang dkar po / lhag ma rnams ni sngon po'o⑤ / /g.yas pa'i thod pa rnams na dom dang / bya rgod dang bse dang ba men dang stag dang spre'u dang chu srin dang ce spyang ⑥ rnams dang / g.yon pa rnams na khwa dang 'ug pa dang / so bya dang / seng ge dang / bzhad ④bya dang / ra dang ri dwags dang phag rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su lha mo rnams te/ de yang pad+ma dkar po 3pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / chos 'byung ma ser mo chos 'byung 'dzin pa dang / lcags sgog ma nag mo phyag dag gis lcags sgog 'dzin pa dang / rang 'khyud ma ljang gu sangs rgyas la rjes su chags pa 'ching ba'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang la 'khyud par brtson pa'o/ /gling bu ma dmar mo phyag dag gis gling bu 'bud par brtson pa dang / pi wang ma ser mo tsophyag gnyis kyis mepi wang sgreng 7 ba la brtson pa dang / rnga rtse5zlum ma dkar mo phyag dag gis rnga bo che brdung ba dang / rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can phyag dag gis rdza rnga brdung ba la brtson pa'o/ /byang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs mkha' 'gro drur te ba ltar ljang gu ste / 'di'i rtsa ba'i zhal ni stag gdong ljang gu gzhan rnams ni lha'i zhal can/phyogs kha cig ni rtsa ba'i zhal yang lha'i yin la g.yon pa dkar po/ lhag ma rnams ni sngon po'o/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa rnams na gza' lhag dang phur bu dang 39—1261

mjug rings dang sgra gcan dang mig dmar dang pa sangs dang spen pa dang khyab 'jug rnams dang / g.yon pa rnams na dbang po dang chu lha dang tshongs pa dang dag tsartepo dang 'dod pa'i lha dang stobs bzang dang thags rjobazangs ris dang stobs can rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su lha mo rnams te/ de'ang sgo lcags ma dkar mo sgo lcags 'dzin pa dang / lde kyog ma ser mo lde kyog 'dzin pa dang / sgo glegs ma dmar mo sgo glegs 'dzin pa dang / yol ba ma nag mo yol ba 'dzin pa dang /spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa dang / mā ma tī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa dang /gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / sgol ma ljang gu at+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang chen po'i so hūṃrnams dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su go rī la sogs pa dang / puk+ka sī che la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gdan dang sku mdog dang dbyibs dang zhal dang phyag la sogs pa rnams ni dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag bcu drug pa'i kye'i rdo rje ji lta ba ltaste/ kun nas 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma yang de bzhin no/ /'khor lo la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro bzhi brjod pa'i khyad par gzhan rnams ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de rnams la 'khyud pa'i lha mo rnams ni rim pa ji lta bar/ spyan ma dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgol ma rnams te dkar mo dang ser mo dang ⑥ dmar mo dang ljang gu gri gug dang sdigs mdzub dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis ma rnams so/ /mkha' 'gro lnga po rnams kyang re re zhing sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can no/ /thams cad du gzhal yas khang gi lha mo rnams ni gcer bu spyan gsum dmar la 39—1262

zlum pa/ mche ba gcigs pa zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis ma dbu skra 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/ dpral ba'i dbyings su gnas pa'i thod pa ①lnga dang mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba'i do shal dang phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa sna tshogs chu skyes dang ro dang nyi ma la g.yon brkyang gi 3gar gyes gnas pa'o/ /khyad par ma bshad pa rnams ni thugs ka'i g.yon pa'i khu tshur gye sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa ste/ 'khyud pa'i lha mo rnams la ni gdan tha dad pa med do/ /go rī la sogs pa brgyad la rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du ro'i gdan gyi gnas su tshangs pa dang dbang po dang nye dbang dang drag po dang gshin rje dang lus ngan dang bden bral dang thags kye bzangs ris rnams so zhes pa ni phyogs gcig go/ /mkha' 'gro rnams dang go rī la sogs pa rnams ni 4rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mngon par phyogs pa ste lha mo gzhan rnams ni rang rang gi bdag po la mngon par phyogs pa'o / /kye'i rdo rje'i spyi bor thu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang rdo rje ste sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo la thugs dang rtag pa dang rin chen dbang po dang 'od dpag med rnams so//rtag pa la 'khor lo 'dzin pa dang 'khor lo ste sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams la thugs dang rin chen dbang po dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams so—/ /rdo rje nyi ma la rin chen 'dzin pa dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu ste/ sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams la sku dang thugs dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams so/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug la pad+ma 'dzin pa dang rdo rje pad+ma ste/sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams la sku dang rin chen dang mi bskyod pa dang 'od dpag med rnams so/ /rta mchog la ral gri 'dzin pa dang ral gri ste/ sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams la sku dang thugs dang 'od dpag med dang don yod 39—1263

grub pa rnams so/ /phyi rol gyi go rī la sogs pa rnams la ni ①snga ma bzhin no/ /rdo rje la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ hūṃ dz+wa.oṃ hūṃ āḥkhaṃ zhes pa'o/ /snying po'i sngags ni oṃ dha ra dha ra jo ra ya dh+wa ra ya marda marda badz+ra dh+rika ④phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa ta e bye hi dzi na dzika hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra srur+ya ⑤ta mo bi dha ma na sa ma ya ste ⑥a haṃ rat+na dh+rika 3phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra du dharmā sa ma ya ste ⑨hu lu hu lu ā ro loka ⑫phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hi nyi pradzñā dh+rika hūṃ kyephaṭa/ ces 6pa rnams so/ /na maḥs man+ta buzle (5bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dh+wa 4ya ma hā rdaṣ+ṭa ut+pa ṭa bye ra wa ⑫ ya badz+ra sarnyo ha dar+pā skuya a mṛ te kulco nyu—li hūṃ zhes pa ni mthar byed kyi sngags te las thams cad pa'o / /mkha' 'gro lnga po 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bsgom par bya ste re re zhing yang dkyil 'khor so so'o.e/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ gang zhig sangs rgyas mgon po nyid/ /dbus su gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /de nyid kyis ⑪ni dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor snying po yongs 'dzin phyir/ /dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa 'am /yang bsdus pa yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes pas so 3'khor los (rtasgyur ba drug gi dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa nas rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo'i mthar tshi thug pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin te/ rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo la khro bo bcu'o/ /gzhan 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor las bshad pa'i rdo rje sa 'og gi bar lta bu'o zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ /'dir 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba'i nang chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i dkyil 39—1264

'khor dang ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang rdo rje'i lte ba la gzhal yas khang chen po ste⑫// phyogs gzhan la ni 'dir chos 'byung med pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang chen po'i lte bar gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya'o zhes mngon par brjod pa bla ma las gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du rdo rje'i ngaskyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ste rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po 'am nag po/ rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bur bcas pa'i g.yas kyepa dang cig shos kyi phyag dag gis lha mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /de ni rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub tu bcas pa'i phyag g.yas brkyang zhing phyag g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ sgu mdog dmar mo ④ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ste/ ming gzhan chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang / rdo rje phag mo zhes par yang grags so/ /de nas shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su g.yas skor gyis sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la sogs pa lnga po dgod par bya ste/ de dag gi 'khor lo zhe rnams ni dkyil 'khor so so'i shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su g.yon skor dang /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su g.yas skor gyis so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshams rnams su rim pa ji lta bar mkha' 'gro ma dang khā ma dang dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma rnams ni/ sngon mo dang ser mo dang dmar mo dang ljang gu rnams te g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /sgo rnams su thod pa'i dum bu dang keng rus chen po dang bye keng rus dang mumache ba rnam par gcigs pa rnams ni nag po ste rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bur bcas pa'i phyag dag gis rab tu gtum mo 39—1265

dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma dang 'od ldan ma dang sna chen mo thal ba dkar po'i tsomadog can rnams la phu7'khyud pa'o/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba la gnas pa'i tshangs pa'i snying gar kye༄byal krung gis bzhugs pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar po ste 'khor lo dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams la chang dgra dang 'od dpag med dang rdo ④rje'i 'od dang / rdo rje'i sku rnams ni dkar po ste 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gis dpa' bo'i blo can ma dang mi'u thung ma dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang shing grib ma ser mo rnams la 5'khyud pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rta'i steng du sna tshogs cechu skyes dang nyi ma la ⑦gnas pa'i lha'i bu nyi ma'i snying gar rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo ldu ste rin po che dang rin po ches mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams la myu gu can dang rdo rje ral pa can dang dpa' bo chen po dang rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rnams ni ser po ste rin po che dang rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gis sa srung ⑨ma dang 'jigs byed chen mo dang rlung shugs ma dang chang 'thung ma ljang gu rnams la 'khyud pa'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i snying gar rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar po ste pad+ma dang pad+mas mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis pad+ma 39—1266

mkha' 'gro ma rmyedamar mo la kye'akhyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams la shin tu bzang po dang rdo rje bzang po dang 1'jigs byed chen po dang mig mi bzang rnams ni sku mdog dmar po ste pad+ma dang pad+ma'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gis sngo bsangs lha mo dang shin tu bzang mo dang rta rna ma dang bya gdong ma dkar mo rnams la 'khyud pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi ④ dbus su glang po che'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la khyab 'jug gi snying gar rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro nag po ste rdo rje dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa'o / /de ni dmar mo'am nag mo'o⑤/ /sgo rnams la stobs po che dang rin chen rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po rnams ni nag po ste rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gis 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang dum skyes ma dang chang 'tshong ma dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma sbyi rnams ser mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /don yod grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su nam mkha' lding gi steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i lha'i bu zla ba'i snying gar rdo rje'i tsuskyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang gu ste sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu la 'khyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams la dpal he ru ka dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rdo rje sems dpa' rnams zuljang gu ste sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs thurdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gis shin tu dpa' mo dang stobs chen mo ⑪dang 'khor los ⑪sgyur ma dang brtson 'grus chen mo du ba ltar sngo skya'i mdog can rnams la 'khyud pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni g.yas brkyang gis 39—1267

bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ni g.yon pas thod pa dang kha ṭī ga dang g.yas pas ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa bzhi ni kyiphyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub gdengs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma la sogs pa rnams ni 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can no/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro ma dang sa srung 2ma la sogs pa rnams ni rin po che dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma dang sngo bsangs lha mo la sogs pa rnams ni pad+ma dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma la sogs pa ni rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma zidang shin tu dpa' mo la sogs pa rnams ni sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa thams cad kyang 'khyud par byed pa g.yon pa'i phyag dag gis 'dzag pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo rnams la khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma dang khye gdong ma dang phag gdong ma rnams ni ming dang rjes su mthun pa'i zhal can te rim pa ji lta bar sngon mo dang ser mo dang dmar mo dang ljang gu'i mdog can/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgog dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshams rnams la gshin rje brtan ma dang gshin rje pho nya mo dang gshin rje mche ba ma dang gshin rje 'joms ma rnams ni mi'i gdong can te/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi sku phyed phyed g.yas dang g.yon gyi lha mo'i mdog can/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis me long dang pi wang dang dri'i dung yechos dang ro'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo brgyad po 'di dag kyang g.yon 39—1268

pas thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang drug po rnams kyi mtshams rnams su byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas gang ba'i thod pa rnams ni sna tshogs chu skyes la gnas pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i 1mthar thug pa rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i ro rnams la bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor los sgyur ba rnams kyang ro la gnas pa'o zhes pa ni phyogs gzhan no/ /lha pho rnams ni sgu rgyab tu 'phyang ba'i stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ mchod phyir thogs pa can mi mgo zlon pa'i phreng ba mgrin pa la 'phyang ba/ ral pa nag po'i thor cog can no//lha mo rnams ni gcer bu dbu skra nag po grol zhing mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba mgrin par 'phyang ba'o/ /lha mo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis po rnams kyang zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum pa rdo rje phreng bas mtshan pa'i dpral ba'i dbyis nas thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ dpung rgyan dang g.yer kha la sogs pas mngon par brgyan pa/phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /'khor los 5sgyur ba drug ni mchog gi phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa spyodang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa nag po'i thor cog can no/ /lha mo sum cu rtsa bzhi po rnams ni rang rang gi 'khor lo'i dbang po la mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /'khor los 7sgyur ba lnga dang khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams ni dbus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang po la mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /dpa' bo rnams ni rang rang gi shes rab ma la mngon par phyogs pa'o / /de ltar 'di ni phyogs gcig go/ /'khor los sgyur ba drug po 'di dag kyang g.yas brkyang gi zhabs can no zhes pa'i khyad par ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /phyogs gnyis po 'di dag la yang ye shes mkha' 'gro dang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 39—1269

dang de dag gi 'khor rnams kyang seng ge'i steng du gnas pa dang / rin chen mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams kyang rta'i steng du gnas pa dang / pad+ma mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams kyang rma bya'i steng du gnas pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams kyang glang po che'i steng du gnas pa dang / sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams kyang nam mkha'i lding gi steng du gnas pa'o / /ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa 'di dag ni rdo rje'i skyil krung can no/ /khwa gdong ma la sogs pa brgyad po 'di dag phyogs skyong ba brgyad po rnams la g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o zhes pa ni phyogs gsum pa'o/ /phyogs 'di rnams dang phyogs gzhan la yang ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma nyid la sogs pa dang / zhal gsum phyag drug ma nyid la sogs pa dang / zhal lnga phyag brgyad ma nyid la sogs pa dang / zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma nyid la sogs pa dang / zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug ma nyid la sogs pa yang ༄rtebacom ldan 'das kyis rab tu spyos nas gsungs mod/ gzhung rnam par tresnargyas pas 'jigs nas 'dir ma bstan no/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni 'khor los ldusgyur ba drug po rnams rang rang gi dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi ste④/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni 'khor los 3sgyur ba lnga'i'o/ /de'i 'uni ye shes mkha' 'gro'o/ /khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams kyi ni sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'o zhes pa ni kha gcig gi'o/ /thugs ka'i sa bon rnams ni ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa rnams kyi 4rim pa ji lta bar baṃ hūṃ zuslo spyo khaṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags rnams ni oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra satā ḍā ki 1— dzā la sasbra ram̐ hūṃ ā ⑩hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī budhe tenyaḍā ka a la la la hūṃ aḥḍā ki byā dzā rtel sasba ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/39—1270

oṃ shrī tsosnarat+na ḍā ka tram̐ aḥrngo hūṃ ḍā ki — dzā ldul sasba ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī pad+ma ḍā ki dīḥḍā ki nī dzā cel sasba re hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī byebadz+ra ḍā ka āḥhūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī bye dzā la sasbra ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi shwa ḍā ka hoḥkhaṃ na.aXhūṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la sadza ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes drupa'o/ /oṃ khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni dum skyes ma'i ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /ḍūdapal dus kyi 'khor lo la ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du srung hūṃba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'o/ /de'i shar dang lho dang nub dang byang gi rtsibs rnams la shin tu stobs dang rmugs byed dang / rengs byed dang khengs byed rnams ni ming gzhan ni bgegs mthar byed dang shes rab mthar byed dang gshin rje mthar byed dang pad+ma mthar byed rnams so/ /me la sogs pa'i rtsibs rnams la/ dbyug sngon can dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang stobs po che dang mi g.yo ba rnams so/ /steng gi rtsibs la gtsug tor 'khor los nyu1sgyur ba ste 'og gi rtsibs la gnod mdzes rgyal po'o/ /de skad du'ang bsnyus pa'i 15rgyud las/ slar yang 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu la ni phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i tshogs ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa dang dri ma med pa'i 'od las srung ba'i 'khor lo khro bo la sogs pa spro bar bya ste dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi bsrung ba'i don du'o zhes gsungs so / /khro bo 'di rnams ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzugs can no/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i lte ba'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas te/ gang yang dri ma med pa'i 'od las phyi rol du skye nyurteba'i mtshan ma ni nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa ste nang du ni shes rab kyi chos 'byung zur gsum pa'o zhes gsungs pas/ phyi rol gyi nam mkha'i ⑫ khams nyid dkyil 'khor la chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi gzugs su 39—1271

bsgom par bya'o/ /chos 'byung gi dbus su rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i ① dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ri rab dang sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang thig le nag po'i gzugs can sgra gcan kyi dkyil 'khor gyi zhusteng du gnas shing / phyi rol nas rdo rje'i 'od zer dang nam mkha' dang rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i khor yug gis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po'o/ /yang na srung ba'i 'khor lo ni bgegs nye bar zhi ba tsam gyi dgos pa'o zhes pas rngubagegs bcom pa'i rjes nas ma bsams shing / chos 'byung yang ma bsgoms ngupar srung ba'i gur gye nang du nam mkha' la rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi mthar thug pa'i steng du gnas shing phyi rol nas 'od zer la sogs pa'i khor yug rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po'o/ /de'i phyed du gsung gi 'khor lo dang / de'i phyed du thugs kyi 'khor lo dang / de'i phyed du bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dang / de'i phyed du bcom ldan 'das kyi pad+ma ljang gu ste/ pad+ma'i sum cha ni lte ba'o/ /de'i steng nas steng du gnas pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma la sgra gcan dang dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yan lag med pa dang drag po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i snying gar g.yas brkyang gi gar gyis bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo ste/ sku mdog nag po nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ rdo rje'i nor bu dang rdo rje'i rna cha dang rdo rje'i mgul rgyan dang / rdo rje'i /ltelag gdub dang / rdo rje'i ska rags dang / rdo rje'i rkang gdub dang / rdo rje'i dar dpyangs dang / rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / stag gi pags pa 'phyang ba'i sham thabs can/ zhal bzhi pa spyan bcu gnyis pa'o/ /39—1272

de yang rtsa ba'i zhal nag po mche ba gcigs pa drag po/ g.yas pa dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ rgyab ma ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ g.yon pa dkar po zhi ba'o/ /dbus dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi mgrin pa gsum ni sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar rmyepo ste bcom ldan 'das ni mgrin pa gsum pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i phrag pa dang po sngon po dang gnyis pa dmar po dang gsum pa dkar po ste—/ de bzhin du g.yon pa'i yang sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po'o/ /de ltar na phrag pa drug dang / dpung pa bcu gnyis dang nye ba'i dpung pa nas brtsams te phyag dar nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de la g.yas kyi dpung pa gnyis sngon po dang gnyis dmar po dang gnyis dkar po'o/ /de bzhin du g.yon byu 'ang ngo /de bzhin du phyag bzhi bzhi nag po dang / bzhi bzhi dmar po dang / bzhi bzhi dkar po ste/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pa rnams kyi'o/ /phyag re re 'ang sor mo lnga pa lduste/ de dag re re zhing yang khyetshigs gsum pa'o/ /de 'ang mthe bong ser po dang mdzub mo dkar po dang gung mo dmar po dang ming med nag po dang mthe chung ljang gu ste/ phyag gi mthil nas sor mo thams cad kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o/ /de rnams kyang sor gdub rnams kyi 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams kyi nag po rnams na rdo rje dang ral gri dang rtse gsum dang gri gug dang / dmar po rnams na me'i mda' dang rdo rje'i ④ lcags kyu dang / ḍa rngum ru dang / tho ba dang /dkar po rnams na 'khor lo dang / mdung dang dbyug pa dang dgra sta rnams so//g.yon pa'i nag po rnams na dril bu dang / phub dang / kha ṭī ga dbye ba dang /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / dmar po ⑥rnams na gzhu dang / zhags pa 39—1273

dang / nor bu dang 1/ rin po che dang / pad+ma dmar shepo dang / dkar po rnams na dung dang / rnge long dang / rdo rje be+egs sgog dang / tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams so/ /brla nas brtsams nas dmar po'i mdog can gyi zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil dmar pos 'dod pa'i lha dmar po gdong gcig pa lag pa bzhis me tog gi mda' lnga dang / gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan cing / brla nas brtsams nas dkar po'i zhabs g.yon pa'i mthil gyis drag po dkar po 1gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa lag pa bzhis rtse gsum dang / ḍa ma ru dang / thod pa dang / kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa'o/ /'dod lha'i gzhogs su dga' ma dang dbang phyug chen po'i gzhogs su dkar mo ste lha mo 'di dag ni dman pa'i bzhin dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'jus pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bya'akhyud pa'i sna tshogs 5yum ni g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug dang lcags kyu dang ḍa ma ru dang / bgrang phreng rnams dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa dang zhags pa dang pad+ma dkar po dang rin po che rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la shar du nag mo 'bar ma nag mo phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis bdug spos kyi snod dang tsaṇ+ḍan gyi snod dang gur gum byu snod dang gla rtsi dang bcas pa'i ga bur gyi sdod dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang pad+ma dang lha'i ljon pa'i me tog dang sna tshogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor dmar mo 'bar ma dmar mo g.yas pa rnams kyis mar me dang do shal dang cod pan dang lag gdub dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis gos dang ska rags dang rin po che'i rna rgyan dang rkang gdub 'dzin pa'o/ /nub 39—1274

tu ser mo 'bar ma ser mo g.yas pa rnams kyis dung dang gling bu dang ⑨nor bu dang ḍa ma ru dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis pi wang dang rnga zlum dang 'khar 1 rnga dang zangs dung 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du dkar mo 'bar ma dkar mo zugayas pa rnams kyis 'o ma'i snod dang chu'i snod dang lha'i sman dang chang gi snod dang /g.yon pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i sgod dang grub pa'i bcud kyi snod dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang bza' ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /me la sogs pa rnams su du ba ma dang smig rgyu ma dang mar me ma dang mkha' snang ma'i lha mo rnams te/ rim pa ji lta bar nag mo dang dmar mo dang ser mo dang dkar mo'i mdog can phyag brgyad kyis rang rang gi mdog can gyi rnga yab brgyad 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag gi rgyab kyi phyi rol du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi ④dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang chos kyi dung rnams te nag po dang dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po'o—/ /nag mo 'bar ma la sogs pa brgyad ni mnyam pa'i rkang stabs kyi sge gnas pa'o/ /sna tshogs yum la sogs pa'i lha mo thams cad phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa / phyag brgyad ma zhal bzhi ma spyan bcu gnyis ma'ozhu/ /de yang shar lho dang nub byang gi rim pas sna tshogs yum kyi zhal rnams ni ser po dang dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po ste/ de bzhin du lha mo ser mo dag gi 'ang ngo / /nag mo dag gi ni nag po dang dmar po ④dang ser po dang dkar po'o/ /dmar mo dag gi ni dmar po ldudang ser po dang dkar po dang sngon po'o/ /dkar mo dag gi spuni dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po dang ser po'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa dag gi lha mo ⑫ rnams ni zhal gsum pa spyan dgu pa phyag drug pa rnams so/ /de yang phyogs rnams la shar du don yod grub pa nag po nag po lku 39—1275

dang dmar po dang dkar po'i zhal can/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang gri gug dang rtse gsum dang g.yon pa rnams kyis phub dang thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa srun mas 'khyud pa'o/ /lhor rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po'i zhal can/ g.yas pa rnams kyis me'i mda' dang lcags kyu dang ḍa ma ru dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang zhags pa dang rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa mā ma tīs 'khyud pa'o/ /nub tu rnam par snang mdzad ser po ser po hu7dang dkar po dang nag po'i zhal can/ g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa dang mi 'jigs pa mdzad pas rdo rje dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis dung dang rdo rje lcags sgog dang dril bu 'dzin pas sgol ma la 'khyud pa'o / /byang du snang ba mtha' yas dkar po dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i zhal can/ g.yas pa rnams kyis 3tho ba dang mdung dang rtse gsum dang /g.yon pa rnams kyis 1pad+ma dkar po dang me long dang bgrang phreng ④'dzin pa/gos dkar mos 'khyud pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams ni chu skyes dkar po dang nyi ma la gnas pa ral pa'i thor cog can te/ zhal rnams ni rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i rim pas so/ /me dang bden bral dang rlung dang dbang ldan rnams su pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la sgol ma dang gos dkar mo dang spyan ma dang mā ma tī rnams ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du don yod grub pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang rtag pa dang snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa ste/ rnam par snang mdzad dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan rnams dang snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /yang na sgol ma'i kha ṭī khyaga'i gnas su ut+pa la ste/ gzhogs 6brgyad du ni bdud rtsi'i bum pa brgyad do/ /rim pa 39—1276

gsum pa'i snam bu la shar sgo'i g.yon ngos su kun du bzang po sngon po g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang gri gug dang dgra sta/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang thod pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa yang na tshangs pa'i rmye mgo'i gnas su a la ste du/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /g.yas su nam mkha'i snying po don yod grub pa lta bu la dri rdo rje mas 'khyud pa'o/ /lho sgo'i g.yon du phyag na rdo rje ljang gu g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang gri gug dang dgra sta/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang thod pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo kye'adzin pa sgra rdo rje mas 'khyud pa'o/ /g.yas su sa'i snying po rin chen ④'byung ldan lta bu a+yo gzugs rdo rje ma dang stoms par 'jug pa ( byenub sgo'i g.yon du chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma phyag na rdo rje lta bu la kun du bzang pos 'khyud pa'o/ /g.yas su sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba rnam par snang mdzad lta bu la reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud pa'o/ /byang sgo'i g.yon du sgra rdo rje ma kun du bzang po lta bu la phyag na rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas lta bu la ro 3rdo rje mas 'khyud pa'o/ /mer reg bya rdo rje ma sgol ma lta bu la sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /bden thubral du ro rdo rje ma gos dkar mo lta bu la 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'khyud pa'o/ /rlung du dri rdo rje ma spyan ma lta bu la nam mkha'i snying pos 'khyud pa'o/ /dbang ldan du gzugs rdo rje ma mā ma tī lta bu la sa'i snying pos 'khyud pa'o/ /'dir don yod grub pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rdo rje'i gdan gyes bzhugs pa ste/ sgol ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /sgo rnams la khro bo 39—1277

shin tu stobs don yod grub pa lta bu la rengs byed mas yang dag par 'khyud pa ste de'ang spyan ma lta bu'o/ /lhor rmugs ①byed rin chen dbang po lta bu la khengs byed mas snyoms par zhugs pa ste de yang mā ma khri lta bu'o/ /nub tu rengs byed rnam par snang mdzad lta bu la shin tu stobs mas 'khyud pa ste de yang sgrol ma ④lta bu'o / /byang du khengs byed 'od dpag med lta bu la rmugs byed mas yang dag par 'khyud pa ste de yang gos dkar mo lta bu'o/ /'on kyang khro bo kye'adi rnams ni ④ g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa ste khro bo'i lha mo rnams ni g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /'dir lha pho rngurnams kyi gdan ni pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma rnams te—/ lha mo rnams kyi gdan ni pad+ma dmar po la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams so/ /yang na nag po dang dkar po dang ljang gu rnams la zla ba la gnas pa dang dmar po dang ser po rnams dang kun du bzang po dang sgra rdo rje ma ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ste/ de dag gi rigs pa yang (khyedri ma med pa'i 'od las gsungs pa'o/ /'dir gang gi gnas su lha rnams gang gsungs pa de ni de'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir 'khor lo'i dbang po la mngon par phyogs pa ste/ de'i pang du gnas pa ni ma yin no/ /'dir 'dab ma brgyad kyi lha mo rnams dang bum pa rnams dang chos kyi dung la sogs pa spangs nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yang bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis nye bar bskor ba yang dpal gsang ba 0'dus pa lta bu'o/ /stegs bu rnams la shar gyi g.yon 3rta babs kyi ka ba'i spurtsa ba'i g.yon du dri chab ma nag mo dri'i ⑫dung chos 'dzin pa dang / g.yas su phreng ba ma nag mo me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / lhor bdug spos ma dmar mo bdug spos kyi snod 'dzin 39—1278

pa dang / mar me ma dmar mo mar me'i mchod sdong ①'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu sgeg mo ser mo cod pan ser po 'dzin pa dang / bzhad ma ser mo do shal ser po 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du bdud rtsi ma'am ming gzhan zhal zas ma zhes bya ba dkar mo 'bras bu dkar po 'dzin pa dang / 'bras bu mi zad pa'am ②ming gzhan bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu ma zhes bya ba dkar mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /stegs bu thams cad la yang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa 'dzin pa'i lha mo grangs med pa'o/ /shar gyi rta babs kyi mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas su gar ma sngon mo gar gyi tshul zhugyis gos 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor 'dod ma dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / nub tu sel snyan ma ser mo rnga pa rgyaṭa ha brdung ba dang / byang du glu ma dkar mo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste bdud rtsi ma la sogs pa dgod pa 'di dag ni dbang bskur ba'i le'u'i rim pa'o/ /gang yang sgrub thabs kyi le'u'i 'grel pa las byang du sel snyan ma dang gar ma dang / nam mkhar glu ma dang 'dod ma dang / 'og tu zhal zas ma dang / bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu ma zhes gsungs pa de la yang dbang bskur ba'i le'u las gsungs pa'i dgod pa 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ gzhung de dag rjes su mthun par sbyor ba rngunyid kyi phyir ro/ /gzhan du na snga ma dang phyi ma dag 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /lha mo bcu gnyis po 'di dag ni pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis ñtsaganas pa'o/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor la phyogs 3kyi pad+ma rnams ni dmar po dang / mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams ni dkar po ste de rnams nyi ma dang zla ba dang bral ba la sa ga'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa'i lha mo rnams so/ /de yang yi dwags dmar po'i steng du gnas pa'i shar gyi chu skyes kyi dulte ba la tsartsi ka klunag mo zhal gcig ma spyan gsum 39—1279

ma / phyag g.yas pa dag gis rmyegri gug dang rtse gsum dang / g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga ②'dzin pa dbang po ser pos 'khyud pa ste/ mdun la sogs pa'i 'dabaspyam brgyad la/ 'jigs ma ①dang drag mo dang dus kyi mche ba ma dang me 'bar gdong ma dang rlung shugs ma dang rab ④gtum ma dang drag mig ma dang sna chen ma rnams so/ /nam mkha' lding gi steng du gnas pa'i me'i chu skyes kyi ste ba la khyab 'jug ma nag mo g.yas pa dag gis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma dang dung 'dzin pa tshangs mas ⑤'khyud pa ste/ 'dab ma rnams la dpal mo dang sgyu ma dang grags ñtsam dang g.yang mo dang phun sum tshogs ma dang rnam par rgyal ma dang dpal ldan rgyal ma dang dpal ldan rgyal byed ma dang dpal ldan 'khor lo can ma rnams so/ /ma te'i steng du lho'i chu skyes kyi lte ba la phag mo dmar mo phag gi zhal can/ g.yas pa dag gis dbyug pa dang ral gri dang / g.yon pa dag gis lcags sgog dang phub 'dzin pa drag pos 'khyud pa ste/ 'dab ma rnams la keng rus ma dang dus mtshan ma dang rab khros gdong ma dang dus kyi lce ma dang / gatshigs ma dang nag mo dang gzugs ngan ma rnams so/ /rma bya'i steng du bden bral gyi chu skyes kyi lte ba la gzhon nu ma dmar mo zhal drug ma g.yas pa dag gis shasti dang lcags kyu/ g.yon pa dag gis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa tshogs bdag gis 'khyud pa ste/ 'dab ma rnams la pad+ma ⑦/dang lus med ma dang gzhon nu ma dang ri dwags bdag pos 'gro ma dang rin chen phreng ba ma dang / mig bzangs ma dang rul dru ma dang bzang mo rnams so / /sa srung gi 9steng du nub kyi chu skyes kyi lte ba la dbang mo ser mo g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon pa dag gis dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa 39—1280

bden bral gyis 'khyud pa ste/ 'dab ma rnams la rdo rje 'od ma dang rdo rje lus ma dang / gser ldan ma dang ur ba sī dang bkra ba'i ri mo dang chu shing ma dang zug rngu med pa dang shin tu sgol ma rnams so/ /ngang pa'i steng du rlung gi chu skyes kyi lte ba la tshangs ma ser mo huzhal bzhi ma g.yas pa dag gis pad+ma dang tshangs pa'i dbyug zhupa/ g.yon pa dag gis spyi blugs dang ④par bu 'dzin pa khyab 'jug gis stoms par zhugs pa ste/ 'dab ma rnams la mchod sbyin 'dod ma dang pad+ma'i spyan ma dang chu skyes ldan ma dang / blo gros ma dang ngag gi ④dbang phyug ma dang glu ma dang glog ma dang dran ma rnams so/ /glang gi steng du byang gi chu skyes kyi lte ba la drag mo dkar mo g.yas pa dag gis rtse gsum dang cang te'u g.yon pa dag gis kha ṭī ga dang sbrul 'dzin pa gshin rjes rgya'akhyud pa ste/'dab ma rnams la go rī ma pyadang gaṅgā ma dang rtag ma dang thu myur ma dang tro ta zul dang / mtshon byed ma dang / dmar ser ma dang / nag mo rnams so/ /seng ge'i steng du dbang ldan gyi chu skyes kyi lte ba la dpal mo dkar mo g.yas pa dag gis pad+ma dang bgrang phreng / g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa gdong drug gis 'khyud pa ste/ 'dab ma rnams la dpal ldan dkar mo dang /zla ba'i ri mo dang / ri bong 'dzin zhal ma dang / ngang pa'i mdog ma dang 'dzin ma dang / pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma dang / skar mig ma dang / dri med ri bong 'dzin ma rnams so/ /tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i lha mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag ni phyag bzhi ma spyan gsum ma ste/ 'dir 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams ni rol pa'i rkang stabs kyis gnas pa kyekha dog la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi gtso bo kyedang mtshungs pa rang rang gi gtso mo la mngon du phyogs pa'o/ /gtso mo 39—1281

brgyad po 'di dag ni sa ga'i rkang 1stabs kyis gnas pa 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la gzigs pa ste brgyad bo 'di ④rnams kyis 'khyud pa po sa ga'i rkang stabs kyis gnas pa'i rjes su gtso bo rnams ni de la mngon du phyogs pa'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu rnams la pad+ma bcu gnyis te/ de yang phyogs kyi pad+ma rnams ①dmar po dang mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams dkar po'o/ /pad+ma re re zhing yang 'dab ma rnams ni go rims bzhin dang po la bzhi dang gnyis pa la brgyad ④dang /gsum pa 5 la bcu drug ste/ de dag gi ⑥ phyi'i rim pa'i mdun byi 'dab ma nas brtsams nas g.yas skor gyis gyetshes gcig la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams dgod par bya'o / /lte ba la nya dang gnam stong dag ni gtso bo nyid kyis gnas pa yin la/de yang nya ni shes rab dang gnam stong ni thabs te/ bden bral la sogs pa'o//lha thams cad ni phyag bzhi pa'o/ /de la shar sgo'i g.yas phyogs su yi dwags dmar po'i steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la bden bral nag po srin mo me 'bar gdong mas yang dag par 'khyud ma / g.yas pa dag na ral gri dang gri gug /g.yon pa dag na phub shedang thod pa can te6/ 'dir ni nag pa'i tshes rnams so/ /mer ri dwags kyi steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la rlung lha nag po rab tu gtum mos 'khyud pa / g.yas pa dag na dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du'i ⑪ me tog g.yon pa dag na in+d+ra be+e la ⑫dang ut+pa la sngon po can te 'dir ni sa ga'i tshes rnams so/ /lho sgo'i g.yon phyogs su ma te'i steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la gshin rje dmar po dus mas yang dag par 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag na dbyug pa dang ral gri/g.yon pa dag na lcags sgrog dang zhags pa can te 'dir ni dbo'i tshes rnams so//g.yas phyogs su lug gi steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la me lha dmar po chu lha mos 'khyud pa/39—1282

g.yas pa dag na shat+ta dang dbyug pa①/ g.yon pa dag na byepad+ma dang spyi blugs can te 'dir ni spyon byu tshes rnams so/ /bden bral du rma bya'i steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la gdong drug dmar po dpal mos 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag na shat+ta dang mdung / g.yon pa dag na rin po che dang me long can te 'dir ni chu stod kyi tshes rnams so/ /nub sgo'i g.yon phyogs su pad+ma'i lte ba la lus ngan po ser po lus ngan mos yang dag par 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag na nor bu rin po che dang dbyug to/ /g.yon pa dag na ṣ+pe'u le dang pad+ma can te 'dir ni rgyal gyi hūṃtshes rnams so/ /g.yas ④phyogs su glang po che'i steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la dbang po ser po rlung lha mos 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag na rdo rje dang me'i mda' dang / g.yon pa dag na dril bu dang gzhu can te 'dir ni tha skar gyi tshes rnams so/ /rlung du ngang pa'i steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la tshangs pa ser po glog mas yang dag par 'khyud pa/g.yas pa dag na khab dang bgrang phreng / g.yon pa dag na pad+ma dang spyi blugs can te 'dir ni smig tshedrug gi tshes rnams so/ /byang sgo'i g.yon phyogs su glang gi steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la drag po dkar po ༄ snago rīs yang dag par 'khyud pa/g.yas pa dag na rtse gsum dang mda'/ g.yon pa dag na sbrul gyis dkris r+ṣapa'i kha ṭī ga dang gzhu can te/ 'dir ni mgo'i tshes rnams so/ /g.yas phyogs su chu srin gyi steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la rgya mtsho dkar po phag mos yang dag par 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag na zhags pa dang rin po che/ g.yon pa dag na sbrul zhags dang nor bu zla ba chu shel can te 'dir ni gro bzhin gyi zutshes rnams so/ /dbang ldan du byi ba la tshogs bdag dkar po gzhon nu mas yang dag par 'khyud pa / g.yas pa dag na dgra sta dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa dag na zhags pa dang 39—1283

rin po che can te 'dir ni khrums stod kyi 3tshes rnams so/ /shar sgo'i g.yon phyogs su nam mkha' lding gi steng du pad+ma'i lte ba la khyab 'jug nag po dpal mos yang dag par 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa dag na 'khor lo dang dbyug to/ g.yon pa dag na pad+ma dang dung can te 'dir ni mchu'i tshes rnams so/ /'dir lha burnams rdo rje'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa ste/ nag pa la sogs pa'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams ni rol pa'i rkang stabs kyis gnas pa rang rang gi bdag po bden bral la sogs pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang dbyebs rnams dang mtshungs pa de dag la gzigs pa'o/ /de rnams 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la ste/ de rnams kyis 'khyud pa rnams ni de nyid la gzigs pa'o/ /sgo rnams la shar du phag nag po bdun gyis / drodrangs pa'i shing rta nag po la dbyug sngon can don yod grub pa lta bu ste/ 'di la 'khyud pa'i 'od zer can ni ser mo phyag g.yas pa dag gis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon pa dag gis dung dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rta dmar po ④bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta dmar po la 'dod pa'i rgyal po rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu ste/ 'di la 'khyud pa'i tsun+da dkar mo g.yas pa dag gis tho ba dang mdung snye/ g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma dang me long 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu glang po che ser po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta ser po la stobs po che rnam par snang mdzad lta bu ste/ 'di la 'khyud pa'i rdo rje lcags sgrog ma g.yas pa dag gis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa dag gis phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du seng ge dkar po hūṃbadun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta dkar po la mi g.yo ba snang ba mtha' yas lta bu ste/ 'di la 'khyud pa'i khro gnyer can ⑦dmar mo g.yas pa dag gis mda' dang lcags kyu dang / g.yon pa dag gis gzhu dang 39—1284

zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi steng gi nam mkha' la mig hu gsum pa kha dog lnga pa'i nam mkha' lding gis drangs pa'i shing rta ljang gu la gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba pyaljang gu phyag na rdo rje lta bu ste/ 'di'i shes rab ma shin tu sngon mo sgu mdog sngon mo g.yas pa dag gis gri gug dang rdo rje dang /g.yon pa dag gis thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi 'og gi sa 'og tu rkang pa brgyad pa'i seng ge nag po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta nag po la gnod mdzes rgyal po kun du bzang po lta bu ste/ 'di'i shes rab ma drag spyan ma ljang gu phyag g.yas pa dag gis dgra sta dang rtse gsum dang /g.yon pa dag gis sbrul zhags dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir dbyug sngon can la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams ni shing rta'i steng du pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma rnams la g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa ste/ gtso bo gzhan rnams ni rang rang gi gnas na gnas pa'i phyir 'khor lo'i dbang po la gzigs pa'o/ /'od zer can la sogs pa ni g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa'i rjes su gtso mo ste/ gzhan gyi 1gnas su phyin pa'i phyir khro bo rnams la gzigs pa'o/ /'dir shing rta rnams ni nag po la sogs pa'i kha dog nyid ni sgo'i dbus su gnas pa'i shing rta rnams ni rigs kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba yin zhes pa 'dis bstan te/ de'i rjes su 'brangs byanas phag pa la sogs pa rnams kyang ngo / /rta babs kyi 'og ka ba'i 'og gi rgyastegs bu'i gnas rnams dang / steng dang 'og tu klu rnams so/ /de la shar gyi sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas dag ⑥tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag la grangs ji lta bar pad+ma dang stobs rgyu dag ni nag po ste khyi gdong ma dang khwa gdong mas 'khyud pa'o/ /lho'i sgor me'i dkyil 'khor dag la nor rgyas dang dung skyong dag 39—1285

ni dmar po ste ce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong k+ṇims 'khyud pa'o/ / ( snanub kyi sgor sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jog po dang pad+ma ser po/ ce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong mas 'khyud pa'o/ /byang gi sgor chu'i dkyil 'khor dag la mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dag ni dkar po ste stag gdong ma dang 'ug gdong mas 'khyud pa'o༄ —/ /steng gi nam mkhar stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la rgyal ba ni shin tu ljang gu ste sngon mos 'khyud pa'o/ /'og gi sa 'og tu stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la rnam par rgyal ba sngon po ste/ rdo rje'i mig can mas yang dag par 'khyud pa'o/ /klu thams cad kyang rdo rje'i 3gdan gyis bzhugs pa phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa dag gis bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang rdo rje dang / g.yon pa dag gis pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams su dbang ldan nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sdogs pa 3'char bzhin pa dang /bden bral du nyi ma nub par 'gro bzhin pa'o/ /me dang rlung gi 'khor yug gi dbus su dur khrod chen po rnams la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rnams te/phyogs rnams su dmar po dang mtshams rnams su dkar po'o/ /de la shar kyi 'khor lor khyi gdong ma nag mo dang lhor phag gdong ma dmar mo dang / nub tu ce spyang gdong ma ser mo dang / byang du stag gdong ma dkar mo'o/ /me la sogs pa rnams su khwa gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma rnams ni nag mo dang dmar mo dang ser mo dang dkar mo'o/ /steng gi nam mkhar shing rta la sngon mo sku mdog sngon mo ste 'di'i shing rta ni shin tu sngon mo'i lta bu'o/ /'og gi sa'i 'og tu shing rta la rdo rje'i mig can ma ljang gu ste/'di'i shing rta ni drag spyan gyema'i lta bu'o/ /khyi gdong ma la sogs pa 'di dag 39—1286

— byedabyed—— ———byedabyedabyed—— —————ni zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa/ sngar bshad pa'i pad+ma la sogs pas 'khyud pa/g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ spyan 1gsum ma gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ mi mgo'i phreng bas mgul du 'phyang ba'o/ /sngar gyi 'khor lo brgyad po rnams kyi 'og tu rim pa ji lta bar bse dang dom dang seng ge dang 'bri dang bhe ruṇ+ḍa dang khrung khrung dang mig sngon dang bya ma byi rnams so/ /dur khrod 'di dag nyid la rlung gi khor yug gi shar dang me'i mtshams su rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag la gnas pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma'o/ /lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor dag la gnas pa'i gza' lhag dang mig dmar ro/ /nub dang rlung du sa'i dkyil 'khor dag la gnas pa'i mjug rings dang spen pa'o/ /byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor dag la gnas pa'i pa sangs dang phur bu'o/ /steng du stong pa'i dkyil 'khor dag la sgra sacan te/ 'og tu stong pa'i dkyil 'khor dag la dus me'o/ /de bzhin du 'dir rlung gi 5khor yug la brtan pa dang a gaste dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / khyem bcu gnyis dang / cha bcu drug dang / phyogs/ bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba rnams dang / dga' bo dang nag po chen po dang dril bu'i rna ba can dang z-iṅgi ṇi dang / zhing skyong rnams dang / pho nya rnams dang /'astsog ma rnams dang / grub pa thams cad ces bya ba la sogs pa ste/ sna tshogs pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang dbyibs can bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi'o / /'dir zla ba la sogs pa'i lha rnams ni rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas pa ste lha mo rnams ni rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor gye stegs bu la 'dod pa'i lha mo rnams so/ /de yang shar gyi stegs bu la sgo'i 39—1287
