shing shin tu mdzes/ /des ni khyed rnams dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces pa'i bkra shis kyi hūṃ tshigs su bcad pa de rnams kyang rus pa 'khrud pa'i dus su 'don nam —'don du gzhug sne par bya'o/ /de nas gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol thu/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /be+er yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /muḥzhes pa'o/ /de nas mtshan mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas te thams cad yang dag par bsdu bar bya'o/ /'byor pa yod na ngan song yongs su spyong ba'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du bzhengs te/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i cho ga rnams bsgrub par bya'o/ /slar yang rdo rje slob dpon gyis chosbyin bdag las khuyon blang bar bya ste/ des kyang 'byor pa dang rjes su mthun par rab tu dbul bar bya zhing /bkrus pa'i gos kyang slob dpon nyid la dbul bar bya'o/ /yang gsungs pa/ shi ba la dmigs gang yin rnamatwa4/ /rang gi gnyen gyis slob dpon dbul/ /de ni mtho ris lam chas su/ /de la byin zhes shes par bya/ /gang zhig cung zad zhi don gyis / /sbyin pa des 'dir nges par ni/ /bde ba can gyi )sar 'gro ba/ /zhag bdun snga bar rab sbyin byed/ /de ltar gang yin kun byas te/ /cho gas lus can steng byas na/ /sdig pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bde ba can du nges par 'gro/ /de rjes de rus rnam sbyang bya/ /zhib mor rdo bas btags nas ni/ /chu klung shin tu rgya chen la/ /mchod pa byas te dor bar bya/ /yang na sa 'dzin chen po ni/ /mthon po'i rtse mo'i mthar 'dzegs nas/ /shin tu shugs drag rjes mthun pa'i/ /rlung la de ni bskur bar bya/ /shin tu drag po'i las kyi dbang du gyur pa yis/ /gal te bde ster bde ba can du ma song na/ /'di ni nges par dran hūṃpa'i 'gro 39—1489

ba spangs nas su/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa yi gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyis 7sna'adas pa tha ma dga' bar byed pa'i mtshan nyid /) ཿdza ba/mdza // //༄ 7de ltar slob dpon rnams kyi bya ba bsdus pa dngos grub chen po'i rgyur ni rab tu 'bad pa las/ /sna tshogs gzhung las 'ongs pa la sogs mang po'i me tog tshul ni bdud rtsi'i gzugs can te/ /gang zhig byas las skyes pa'i bsod nams rgyal sras rnams kyi chen po'i sa yi tshogs gyur pa/ /de yis 'jig rten gsum gyi 'jig rten rgyal mchog kun dga' dang ldan khang bzangs 1 rab 'jug shog /ces pa slob dpon gyi bya ba kun las btus pa rnam par grags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon chen po paṇ+ḍi ta a ba dhū tī ④pa dpal ldan 'gro ba'i me long gis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje slob dpon rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga mtha' yas pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i bstan bcos chen po 'di nyid ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dharma tīrti shrī 5bha dra'i thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ bka' lung snyan pas bskul zhing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs pa la brten nas/bi kra ma shī la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mañdzu shrī shedang / bod kyi lo tsā 3 ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o ༄ bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /dpal dharma tīrti'i 1gsung gi bdud rtsis bskul bar gyur pa las/'jig rten phan par nges par dga' ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang ma ti yis/ /cho ga kun las btus pa'i rin chen phung po rnam par gsal byas pa'i/ /dge bas 'jig 39—1490

rten rnams ni bde ba chen po nyid dang ldan gyur cig /phun sum tshogs pa kun nas 'bar zhing grags pa gsal bar ldan pas 'di ni rtag tu gnas gyur cig /nad dang mu ge las grol dgra mi lhag ma med pa'i sa skyong yun ring phyogs rnams srung 1gyur cig /tshul khrims sogs ldan yon gnas rnams ni gsung rab mdzod rnams kun nas 'phel ba nyid gyur cig /nyi ma zla ba ji bzhin nyid snedang mtshan du dpal ldan dharma tīrti dge zhing shis gyur cig /ces pa dag chokyang paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i smon lam bsgyur ba ste ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /slar yang dpal ldan byang chub rtse mo'i zhabs rdul 5spyi bos len zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thungs pa dge slong badz+ra shrīs zhwakyang cung zad bcos shing dag par bgyis 7so/ /de yis mtshon pa dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i 'od ldan pa/ /dpag yas phan bde'i 'od dkar brgyad 8snaldan pas/ /lus can snying la gnas pa'i mun bsal zhing / /thub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i gnyen gyur cig/ //—/ 39byed1491

so/ / 〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba kun las btus pa bzhugs so// // ldu 〈〈pe 〉mas tsargya kri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsār+ya kri/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉rgos mu ts+tsha ya/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkadapal/ snye 〈〈pe 〉khi yi/
